# About Canopy Growth

Canopy is a global, best-in-class cannabis company and CPG organization with the intention to
unleash the power of cannabis to improve lives. From expanding personal health and wellness to
creating economic opportunity and working on social justice initiatives, Canopy is demonstrating the
ability of cannabis as a positive agent for change.

## Our Vision

DEDICATED TO UNLEASHING THE POWER OF CANNABIS TO IMPROVE LIVES.

Canopy is channeling the power of cannabis to build an organization made with intention and purpose,
serving as a new model for an evolving industry.

We understand our consumer better than anyone else, and leverage best-in-class insights to steer our
innovations, creating industry-leading brands and quality products that consumers love.

Our objectives to harness the power of the plant, build a world-class CPG company and cultivate a
purpose-driven atmosphere push us to fight for the meaningful changes we know are possible.

## RESPONSIBLE CORPORATE CITIZENSHIP

We lead with purpose and demonstrate how cannabis can be a catalyst for positive change in the
world. Canopy takes pride in our robust and stringent product safety controls, responsible
consumption education programs, and environmental initiatives to create and sustain a better world.

[Learn More][20]

## OUR LEADERSHIP TEAM

Our leaders push boundaries. They look beyond today to identify exciting possibilities for tomorrow.
They thoughtfully shape our vision, listen to our customers and employees and confidently seize
opportunities that support our bold ambitions.

[Learn More][21]

## TRUSTED BRANDS

Leveraging our insights and innovations – we define and redefine relationships between consumers and
cannabis creating products that consumers love from brands they respect and trust. Canopy offers
high-quality products with the power to improve and enhance lives by delivering first-class
cannabinoid effects.

[Learn More][22]

# Leadership Team

Our leaders push boundaries. They look beyond today to identify exciting possibilities for tomorrow.
They thoughtfully shape our vision, listen to our customers and employees and confidently seize
opportunities that support our bold ambitions.

Driven by a desire to build the best cannabis company in the industry, Canopy’s leadership team
stewards the company’s vision by leveraging extensive experience in established industries including
beverage alcohol, CPG, investment banking, technology, community activism, and academia.

With no existing roadmap to success in the cannabis industry, Canopy created its own, valuing
intelligence and expertise, and attracting the types of leaders who go looking for opportunities to
innovate. Through an enduring commitment to demonstrating the potential of cannabis as a force for
good, Canopy’s leadership team demonstrates the capabilities and focus to build a roadmap for
success, creating long term value for consumers, employees, and shareholders.

[Luc Mongeau]

# We’re on a mission to normalize, professionalize and revolutionize cannabis.

## The industry’s #1 portfolio of cannabis brands chosen by you.

Cresco Labs’ assortment of top cannabis brands is thoughtfully developed for an array of consumer
lifestyles, from those who are familiar with cannabis to those who are new to it. While our brands
cater to a range of different needs, each offers a trusted, quality, consistent cannabis
experience.

## Products of the highest quality.

Attentive people. State-of-the-art facilities. Top-flight products. Whether it’s premium cannabis
for a cannabis connoisseur or medical relief for patients, Cresco Labs’ world-class facilities and
team of cultivation, manufacturing and distribution experts ensure we’re always delivering the best
product. 

[more about us][42]

## National availability. Exceptional retail experiences.

Our trusted, national brands are available wholesale so that consumers can access them in as many
places as possible. We also have our own retail locations across the country, staffed with
knowledgeable teams dedicated to educating customers around the many benefits and uses of cannabis. 

[see our retail locations][43]

## Building and leading a responsible industry.

We regulate ourselves to a higher standard and go above and beyond to help cannabis grow into a
responsible and robust industry. We’re working on essential reforms at the federal level and
collaborating with local government agencies to define appropriate regulations. We’re making
operational changes to improve our environmental impact. We’re striving to unlock the potential
healing power of cannabis through our research partnership with Temple University, and we’re
empowering communities impacted by the War on Drugs to benefit from the industry’s growth through
our SEED™ initiative.

[learn about seed][44]

## Help us grow.

Join our talented cultivation, manufacturing, retail and corporate teams who are passionate about
the future of cannabis.

With a commitment to patient empowerment and meaningful innovation, GW Pharmaceuticals aims to improve outcomes for individuals facing challenging health issues.

Advancing Care in Rare Disease

Patients and families are at the heart of every rare disease journey. Guided by their experiences,
we are committed to transforming care in rare disease and advancing meaningful innovation where
unmet needs remain.

[Read more][50]
Perspectives
Empowering Patients Through Research and Partnerships With the Sleep Community

We recognize that living with a complex sleep disorder extends far beyond the core symptoms and
profoundly impacts every facet of a person’s life. For years, we have worked to better understand
the complex, multifaceted realities faced by individuals living with these often-misunderstood
conditions.

[Read more][51]
Science Stories
Shaping the Future of Targeted Cancer Care through HER2 Science

Discover how advancing HER2 science is reshaping cancer care. By deepening understanding of tumor
complexity and leveraging biomarker-driven approaches, we are enabling more precise therapies and
driving innovation to improve outcomes for patients with HER2-expressing cancers and other areas of
high unmet need.

[Read more][52]
Perspectives
Why Innovation Matters in First-Line HER2-Positive Gastroesophageal Adenocarcinoma

People diagnosed with locally advanced/metastatic HER2-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma
continue to face limited treatment options with the need to improve outcomes. Discover why
innovation in the first-line setting remains essential to improving care.

[Read more][53]

الإبلاغ عن أثر جانبي

إذا كنت ترغب في الإبلاغ عن أثر جانبي مرتبط بالمنتجات الدوائية لشركة Jazz Pharmaceuticals، يُرجى إرسال
بريد إلكتروني إلينا عبر الرابط التالي:

[الإبلاغ عن أثر جانبي][92]

يُرجى تقديم أكبر قدر ممكن من المعلومات المتاحة.

تشمل المعلومات ذات الصلة ما يلي:
* **بيانات المريض (مثل الأحرف الأولى من الاسم، تاريخ الميلاد، العمر، الجنس، إلى آخره)**
* **المنتج الدوائي المُشتبه به من إنتاج Jazz Pharmaceuticals** (أي اسم المنتج وتركيزه)
* **الأثر الجانبي** (مثل: وصف موجز للأثر الجانبي ، ما الذي حدث، متى بدأ، متى انتهى، إلى آخره)
* **بيانات الاتصال الخاصة بك بصفتك المُبلِّغ** (مثل: الاسم، الصفة (مستهلك، طبيب، إلى آخره)، عنوان البريد
  الإلكتروني، رقم الهاتف، إلى آخره)

بتقديمك لتقريرك وتزويدنا ببيانات الاتصال الخاصة بك، فإنك تُقرّ وتوافق صراحةً على أنه يجوز لقسم السلامة
الدوائية المحلي التواصل معك بغرض طلب معلومات إضافية أو توضيحات، إذا اعتُبر ذلك ضروريًا لتقييم التقرير
ومتابعته.

يوضح إشعار الخصوصية الخاص بنا المتعلق باليقظة الدوائية والمعلومات الطبية وشكاوى المنتجات كيفية تعامل
شركة Jazz Pharmaceuticals مع معالجة المعلومات الشخصية عند التعامل مع تقريرالأثر الجانبي الخاص بك، وهو
متاح في [مركز الخصوصية][93] لدينا.

# AVALON CARE CENTER – SCAPPOOSE

## **Our Story**

Nestled in a serene, quiet neighborhood, **Avalon Care Center – Scappoose** is a skilled nursing and
intermediate care center serving Columbia County and surrounding communities. Our staff of highly
trained and compassionate care professionals provide 24-hour skilled nursing care designed to meet
the needs of our residents and cater to both the physical and emotional wellbeing of those in our
care.

We offer rehabilitation, short-term, bariatric programming, and other care services. Our team is
committed to providing quality care in a comfortable, home-like atmosphere where the unique needs of
patients, residents, and their loved ones are addressed and where family members’ feedback is highly
valued.

We are deeply rooted in our commitment to serving the community, where a visit may reunite you with
familiar faces from your past, including former neighbors, teachers, and cherished friends.

## **Committed To Quality**

At **Avalon Care Center – Scappoose**, we are driven by our commitment to provide compassionate,
quality care. We strive to create a nurturing environment where patients, residents, and their
families can truly feel at home.

Our community features a tranquil garden area with a spacious covered patio where residents have
ample opportunities for engagement and activities that enhance cognitive and mobility functions,
elevating their quality of life. Our bedrooms offer charming outdoor views, while our inviting
dining spaces overlook the serene garden, offering residents and visitors a tranquil setting to
enjoy their meals. We offer a variety of individual and group activities tailored to residents’
unique interests and preferences.

## **Points of Excellence**
* 24-hour licensed nursing care
* Medicaid and Medicare certified
* Physical therapy
* Occupational therapy
* Speech therapy
* Restorative therapy
* Bariatric care programming
* Respite care
* Hospice care
* Daily individual and group activities
* On-site registered dietitian
* Beauty salon

### Workin in cannabis

## Meet our awesome team

To be an "employee" of GTI I feel is an understatement. We are a family filled with talented amazing
people and daily we uplift and radiate positivity within our facility. A culture created that is
ultimately life changing to many. Before working at Green Thumb, I've always felt as if I had to
prove myself, but since becoming a member of this community I've learned that is not the case. The
opportunities to grow within Green Thumb are endless. Through the leadership trainings I have been
armed with the skills and the tools to become a respectful leader in this community, and the Green
Thumb print will always have a lasting impression on my life. I have gained knowledge that will open
opportunities that I had only dreamed of previously. The joy and fulfilment I have every day is
indescribable. I carry being a member of this family as a badge of honor, and I am always proud to
say I work for Green Thumb.
[Terrance Mann]
Terrance MannOrder Fulfillment Specialist Production in Las Vegas, NV
My experience working at GTI has been so positive and uplifting. The moment I set foot in the door,
I felt comfortable being my authentic self and that my differences were celebrated instead being
restrained. I love the drive and teamwork our entire facility puts forth on a daily basis. We all
have different tasks to complete throughout the day, but our end goal is the same: to provide our
patients with the highest quality cannabis. I have never in my life witnessed a group of people work
with the same passion, drive and determination that my co-workers exhibit every day. It is truly a
pleasure to work with each and every one of them, and at the end of the day, it feels good to go
home, knowing that we are positively changing peoples lives!
[Megan Gottschall]
Megan GottschallSenior Cannabis Trimmer Cultivation Danville, PA
Green Thumb has provided me a journey for personal and professional growth. I work in an environment
where not knowing the answer is considered ok and being able to go create the answer is the ultimate
empowerment. Green Thumb’s greatest resources are the incredible and unique people who work here. As
a Talent Acquisition professional, I’ve had the privilege of trying to find these people to join our
team. I’ve discovered first-hand how inclusive cannabis is to all people from every walk of life,
and together, we can accomplish anything.
[Chris Nutt]
Chris NuttSenior Talent Acquisition Partner Production Chicago, IL

## Rachel Albert

Chief Administrative Officer

## About Rachel

A seasoned human resources executive, Rachel Albert joined Green Thumb in 2020 and currently serves
as Chief Administrative Officer. In this role, she leads the People function, shaping GTI’s culture
and driving the development of a high-performing workforce, while also supporting key
enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.

Rachel has spent the past 25 years as a trusted business partner in both high growth and downsizing
organizational environments, leading teams, motivating employees, and driving business results.
Previously Rachel held various roles with strategic and tactical human resources management
oversight at GE Capital. She was also a Consultant at Mercer HR Consulting in New York. Rachel’s
areas of expertise include executive coaching, talent management, change management, employee
engagement, and HR compliance.

Rachel completed her MBA at the Kellogg School

## Rachel Albert

Chief Administrative Officer

## About Rachel

A seasoned human resources executive, Rachel Albert joined Green Thumb in 2020 and currently serves
as Chief Administrative Officer. In this role, she leads the People function, shaping GTI’s culture
and driving the development of a high-performing workforce, while also supporting key
enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.

Rachel has spent the past 25 years as a trusted business partner in both high growth and downsizing
organizational environments, leading teams, motivating employees, and driving business results.
Previously Rachel held various roles with strategic and tactical human resources management
oversight at GE Capital. She was also a Consultant at Mercer HR Consulting in New York. Rachel’s
areas of expertise include executive coaching, talent management, change management, employee
engagement, and HR compliance.

Rachel completed her MBA at the Kellogg School of Management and graduated Magna Cum Laude from
Tufts University in Boston.

## Josh Barrington

Technology

## About Josh

Josh Barrington joined Green Thumb in 2022 as the SVP of Technology. He oversees all internal
technology as well as technology supporting production and retail to ensure the best possible
experience for customers.

Prior to Green Thumb, Josh spent time as an engineer with Motorola as well as a consultant on a
variety of technology programs. The majority of his working career was at Walgreens as Vice
President of Retail Technology where he oversaw many transformational initiatives including major
acquisitions and implementation of a large-scale ERP.

Josh holds a Bachelor of Science in computer science from the University of Illinois and an MBA from
the University of Chicago.

## Doug Bailey

Government Affairs

## About Doug

Doug Bailey was named Vice President of Government Affairs at Green Thumb in January 2025, where he
leads the Company’s government affairs strategy and represents Green Thumb before local, state, and
federal policymakers and regulators across the U.S.

Before joining Green Thumb, Doug held senior government and corporate affairs roles across highly
regulated industries, including alcohol and tobacco. Most recently, he served as Vice President of
Global Corporate Affairs for GoBrands Inc., the parent company of Gopuff and BevMo!, supporting a
high-growth retail technology platform that helped pioneer the U.S. quick-commerce industry. Prior
to that role, Doug served as Vice President of U.S. Industry Affairs for Anheuser-Busch, overseeing
the company’s U.S. government affairs operations.

Doug holds a bachelor’s degree from Western Carolina University and a master’s degree in public
policy from Florida State University’s Askew School. He has held leadership and board roles with the
Beer Institute, the National Association of Manufacturers, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, TechNet,
and the Flex Association.

## Shay Caplice

Communications

## About Shay

Shay Caplice joined Green Thumb in 2021 and currently leads all communications for Green Thumb,
overseeing internal communications, PR & media relations, investor relations, crisis management, and
corporate reputation.

Shay has extensive experience across communications, marketing, and brand strategy. Prior to joining
Green Thumb, she led marketing and partnerships for a global fitness brand, launching a new business
division that expanded the brand into new channels and audiences through strategic collaborations
with top-tier partners. She has built and led teams across communications, marketing, and
partnerships, with a track record of driving results in complex, evolving industries.

Shay graduated from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign with distinction.

## Matt Faulkner

Chief Financial Officer

## About Matt

Matt Faulkner joined Green Thumb in 2018 and has served as SVP of Accounting and Chief Accounting
Officer overseeing the Accounting and Finance teams. During his tenure, he successfully facilitated
the company’s initial public offering in the U.S. and led the transition from reporting under
International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) in Canada to U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting
Principles (GAAP) reporting with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. In 2023, he was
appointed to Chief Financial Officer.

Prior to joining the Company, Matt spent over 20 years at Walgreens building teams in a variety of
Finance roles, including general accounting, financial planning and analysis, mergers and
acquisitions, and technical accounting. He was also responsible for reporting, designing and
implementing financial systems.

Matt graduated from The University of Toledo with a bachelor’s degree in accounting. He also holds
an MBA from Northern Illinois University and is a CPA.

## Anthony Georgiadis

President

## About Anthony

As President, Anthony Georgiadis is responsible for overseeing Green Thumb’s operational and
financial matters.

Anthony joined GTI in 2015 as it was planning to expand outside of its home state of Illinois. Since
then, he has played an integral role in growing the company into one of the leading cannabis
operators in the U.S.

Anthony is an investor and entrepreneur, having purchased a manufacturing business in 2005 that he
helped rebrand and build into one of North America’s largest manufacturers of wall décor.

Prior to this, he worked as a principal investing associate for a $1.5 billion private equity firm
and as an M&A analyst for an investment bank.

Anthony graduated magna cum laude from Bucknell University with a degree in finance and a minor in
mathematics.

Anthony is an active supporter of Students for Sensible Drug Policy, the Drug Policy Alliance,
Marijuana Policy Project, and the Special Operations Warriors Foundation.

## Andy Grossman

hedge fund industry. He joined Green Thumb for the opportunity to be part of a nascent industry with

When did the GTI business start?

GTI started in Illinois in 2014. Now, as a publicly-traded company, GTI is incorporated in British

Because of the highly regulated nature of GTI’s business, our manufacturing and retail facilities
are not open for public tours. However, members of the public aged 21+ can visit any of our RISE

No, GTI is not accepting applications for franchises at this time.

# Advertising and Marketing Guidelines

We believe our patients and consumers have a right to wellness. In order to fulfill this mission, we
must communicate with and notify our patients and consumers about cannabis and Green Thumb cannabis
products in a responsible and thoughtful way.

Through our advertising and marketing materials, Green Thumb strives to inform and educate patients
and consumers about cannabis products that are available in the states where cannabis is permitted.
While these efforts encourage competition within the cannabis industry, we also aim to foster
patient/consumer loyalty to Green Thumb, Rise Dispensaries and Green Thumb brands.

All marketing efforts and materials are intended to engage the perspective of the adult consumer who
is not underage. In crafting our marketing strategies, we are guided by a general set of principles:
1. Cannabis advertising should not directly or indirectly propose that any laws pertinent to the
sale and consumption of cannabis should not be complied with.
2. Advertising should adhere to general and industry standard advertising best practices.
3. Abuse or inappropriate consumption of cannabis should not be encouraged directly or indirectly.
4. Advertising themes and concepts should reflect that Green Thumb are responsible corporate
citizens.
5. Advertising themes, concepts and visuals should not depict any imagery that may target an
underage person or intend to encourage an underage person to consume cannabis.

In creating responsible advertising and marketing materials, Green Thumb follows advertising
guidelines and regulations set forth by all the states we operate within, where applicable. Please
review relevant marketing and advertising codes below.

The MedMen Retail Experience

Step inside any of our two location, and you’ll immediately feel the MedMen experience at work. Bright displays, clean lines, and a modern aesthetic set the stage for discovering some of the best cannabis strains and products in the state. Every jar, pen, and gummy is clearly labeled so you can compare terpene profiles, potency, and flavor at a glance.

A Truly Unique Shopping Experience

We’ve replaced the old-school dispensary experience with a shopping encounter built on transparency and choice. Browse at your own pace, tap our interactive screens for deeper strain data, or ask a team member about any product you see that you want to know more about. The goal at our dispensaries is always simple: empower you to find the perfect match.

A Curated Variety of Cannabis Products

Our menu highlights a carefully curated variety of cannabis products—flower, pre-rolls, vapes, edibles, concentrates, tinctures, and CBD wellness items—sourced from top cannabis brands and boutique cultivators alike. Whether you crave craft exotics or everyday staples, you’ll find a generous variety of products designed for every tolerance level and taste.

Online Ordering & In-Store Pickup

Busy day? We’ve got you covered. Tap into our online ordering portal, choose your favorites, place your order, and swing by for seamless in-store pickup. Most orders are ready in minutes, so you can fit a dispensary stop between meetings, errands, or dinner plans without missing a beat.

Helpful & Knowledgeable Staff

A great product means little without great people. Our helpful team always goes through ongoing training on cannabinoids, terpenes, and responsible consumption. Whether you’re seeking sleep support, creative focus, or post-workout relief, we translate goals into simple, actionable recommendations.

Two California Dispensaries, One Standard

From the historic buildings of DTLA to the energetic streets of WeHo, all two of our MedMen stores share the same uncompromising commitment to quality, safety, and service. We select strains and products we trust, rotate seasonal drops, and craft exclusive events that keep our community inspired.

## About Avicanna

## About Avicanna

## About

Avicanna Is a Commercial-Stage International Biopharmaceutical Company Focused on the Advancement
and Commercialization of Evidence-Based Cannabinoid-Based Products for the Global Medical and
Pharmaceutical Market Segments

Founded in 2016 in Toronto, Canada. Avicanna has strictly focused on the medical applications and
potential of cannabinoids and has dedicated 9+ years to R&D and clinical development of its
proprietary products. Supported by its Canadian scientific platform, Avicanna has successfully
commercialized its proprietary products into 20+ international markets. Avicanna has an established
scientific platform including R&D and clinical development leading to the commercialization of more
than fifty proprietary, evidence-based finished products and supporting four commercial stage
business pillars.

## Market Segments

Serving the Global Marketplace with Proprietary Advanced Cannabinoid-Based Products

## Four Commercial Stage Business Units

Avicanna’s Scientific Platform Has Resulted In 50+ Commercial and Proprietary Formulations and
Products

Including medical cannabis, medical cannabis care, Pharmaceutical pipeline and active pharmaceutical
ingredients

**Medical Cannabis Products**

**Medical Cannabis Care Platform**

**Pharmaceutical Pipeline**

**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients**

## Medical Cannabis Formulary (RHO Phyto™)

Medical Cannabis Products and RHO Phyto

The formulary offers a diverse range of proprietary products including oral, sublingual, topical,
and transdermal deliveries with varying ratios of cannabinoids, supported by ongoing patient and
medical community education. RHO Phyto is an established brand in Canada currently available
nationwide across several channels and expanding into new international markets.

## Pharmaceutical Pipeline

Pharmaceutical Candidates Designed to Address 5 Major Clinical Indications

Leveraging the Company’s scientific platform, vertical integration, and real-world evidence,
Avicanna has developed a pipeline of proprietary, indication-specific candidates that are in various
stages of clinical development. These cannabinoid-based drug candidates aim to address unmet medical
needs in the areas of sleep, dermatology, pain management, mental health, and various neurological
conditions.

## Medical Cannabis Care Platform (MyMedi.ca)

MyMedi.ca is a medical cannabis care platform formed with the aim to better serve medical cannabis
patients’ needs and enhance the medical cannabis patients’ journey. MyMedi.ca is operated by
Northern Green Canada Inc. and features a diverse portfolio of products and bilingual pharmacist-led
patient support programs. MyMedi.ca also provides specialty services to distinct patient groups such
as veterans and collaborates with public and private payers for adjudication and reimbursement.
MyMedi.ca provides educational resources to the medical community to facilitate the incorporation of
medical cannabis into health care regimens.

## Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (Aureus Santa Marta™)

Active pharmaceutical ingredients (“API”) supplied by the Company’s majority owned subsidiary Santa
Marta Golden Hemp SAS (“SMGH”) is a commercial-stage business dedicated to providing various forms
high-quality CBD, THC and CBG flower and API to the Company’s international partners for use in the
development and production of food, cosmetics, medical, and pharmaceutical products. The business
unit also forms part of the Company’s supply chain and is a source of reliable input products for
its consumer retail, medical cannabis, and pharmaceutical products globally.

## Established Scientific Platform & Institutional Validation

Supporting the Development of Evidence-Based Cannabinoid Therapeutics

## About Avicanna

## About Avicanna

## About

Avicanna Is a Commercial-Stage International Biopharmaceutical Company Focused on the Advancement
and Commercialization of Evidence-Based Cannabinoid-Based Products for the Global Medical and
Pharmaceutical Market Segments

Founded in 2016 in Toronto, Canada. Avicanna has strictly focused on the medical applications and
potential of cannabinoids and has dedicated 9+ years to R&D and clinical development of its
proprietary products. Supported by its Canadian scientific platform, Avicanna has successfully
commercialized its proprietary products into 20+ international markets. Avicanna has an established
scientific platform including R&D and clinical development leading to the commercialization of more
than fifty proprietary, evidence-based finished products and supporting four commercial stage
business pillars.

## Market Segments

Serving the Global Marketplace with Proprietary Advanced Cannabinoid-Based Products

## Four Commercial Stage Business Units

Avicanna’s Scientific Platform Has Resulted In 50+ Commercial and Proprietary Formulations and

ingredients

**Medical Cannabis Care Platform**

## Medical Cannabis Formulary (RHO Phyto™)

Medical Cannabis Products and RHO Phyto

The formulary offers a diverse range of proprietary products including oral, sublingual, topical,
and transdermal deliveries with varying ratios of cannabinoids, supported by ongoing patient and
medical community education. RHO Phyto is an established brand in Canada currently available
nationwide across several channels and expanding into new international markets.

## Pharmaceutical Pipeline

Pharmaceutical Candidates Designed to Address 5 Major Clinical Indications

Leveraging the Company’s scientific platform, vertical integration, and real-world evidence,
Avicanna has developed a pipeline of proprietary, indication-specific candidates that are in various
stages of clinical development. These cannabinoid-based drug candidates aim to address unmet medical
needs in the areas of sleep, dermatology, pain management, mental health, and various neurological
conditions.

## Medical Cannabis Care Platform (MyMedi.ca)

MyMedi.ca is a medical cannabis care platform formed with the aim to better serve medical cannabis
patients’ needs and enhance the medical cannabis patients’ journey. MyMedi.ca is operated by
Northern Green Canada Inc. and features a diverse portfolio of products and bilingual pharmacist-led
patient support programs. MyMedi.ca also provides specialty services to distinct patient groups such
as veterans and collaborates with public and private payers for adjudication and reimbursement.
MyMedi.ca provides educational resources to the medical community to facilitate the incorporation of
medical cannabis into health care regimens.

## Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (Aureus Santa Marta™)

Active pharmaceutical ingredients (“API”) supplied by the Company’s majority owned subsidiary Santa
Marta Golden Hemp SAS (“SMGH”) is a commercial-stage business dedicated to providing various forms
high-quality CBD, THC and CBG flower and API to the Company’s international partners for use in the
development and production of food, cosmetics, medical, and pharmaceutical products. The business
unit also forms part of the Company’s supply chain and is a source of reliable input products for
its consumer retail, medical cannabis, and pharmaceutical products globally.

Cannabis API

Bedrocan produces cannabis in various forms as an Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) of
pharmaceutical quality to meet the needs of large and small drug developers.

**> [READ MORE][79]**

Standardisation

What sets Bedrocan apart from all others is our standardisation methods. Our  products  contain a
constant composition of cannabinoids batch to batch.

**> [READ MORE][80]**

Cannabis products

Bedrocan produces several cannabis products for product development and clinical use. Each cannabis
product is standardised according to pharmaceutical standards with a defined active ingredient
composition.

[**> READ MORE**][81]

Medicinal cannabis

There are a lot of misconceptions about medicinal cannabis. Bedrocan strives to promote reliable,
science-based information about medicinal cannabis for patients and healthcare professionals
worldwide.

**> [READ MORE][82]**

# New Bedromed product line

Bedrocan introduces a line of standardised cannabinoid-based formulations: Bedromed. This product
line brings the trusted Bedrocan® and Bedrolina® APIs to new, patient-appropriate delivery formats.

[See details][83]
[[Bedromed Launch A4]][84]
[[Verwerking Personeel Emmeloord Bedrocan 32 2]][85]

## [Meet Bedrocan][86]

Bedrocan is an EU GMP-certified producer of standardised, pharmaceutical-grade medicinal cannabis.
Our high-quality products are used as pharmaceutical raw materials and active pharmaceutical
ingredients (APIs).

[About us][87]

## [Cannabis standardisation by Bedrocan][88]

Bedrocan has developed unique methods of producing cannabis with a constant composition of
cannabinoids, batch to batch. That is what we call cannabis standardisation. It is the only method
to ensure patients and clinical research subjects experience consistent therapeutic effects over
time.

[Learn more][89]
[[Small cannabis plant]][90]
[[Cover A clinical primer]][91]

## [Are you a health professional?][92]

Bedrocan strives to raise awareness about the medicinal use of cannabis among healthcare
professionals. We support evidence-based information about how to prescribe, dose and dispense
medicinal cannabis. We’ve made a number of informational booklets available to guide health
professionals.

[Download][93]

## [Cannabis research][94]

Bedrocan has its own clinical research unit where research is conducted into the effects of
medicinal cannabis. Additionally, our Research and Development team conducts plant and analytical
research to learn more about the medicinal properties of cannabis and other plants. We have always
supported clinical trials and offered resources to research projects worldwide.

[See studies][95]
[[Laboratory setting cannabis]][96]
[[Bedrocan cannabis flos - administration of medicinal cannabis]][97]

### [Ep. 28: Exploring Volatile Sulfur Compounds in Cannabis][118]

In this latest installment of Noid Knowledge, Jason Wilson from the Curious About Cannabis podcast
discusses with our host Evan Friedmann and guests TJ Martin, Ian Oswald, and Kyle Boyar, their
experiences at the American Chemical Society (ACS) conference in San Diego. Wilson shares insights
from a conversation with colleagues about their research on volatile sulfur compounds (VSCs) in
cannabis, which contribute to its aroma. They found that while most VSCs were present in low
concentrations, some strains like Gelato and GMO had higher levels. They also discussed the
importance of proper packaging, noting that mylar bags can effectively retain these compounds. The
conversation highlights the need for better analytical methods and open-access research to advance
the cannabis industry.

### [Ep 27: Tracking Strains in Diverse Landscapes][120]

In this latest installment of Noid Knowledge, we are joined by Daniela Vergara, PhD, Hemp Specialist

University of Colorado, discussing the evolution of cannabis cultivation and the need for regional
climate data. Their recent project, funded by the Agricultural Genomics Foundation, studies 10
cannabis varieties grown by farmers in different regions, specifically plant characteristics, soil
type, and harvest metrics. They aim to understand how environmental factors affect cannabis yield
and quality, providing actionable insights for farmers and breeders.

# Our Story

Rooted in Canada, Evolved Extraction is proud to serve a marketplace that accepts and incentivises
the exploration of cannabis-derived products. We have partnered with leading licensed North American
producers to optimize and fuel their extraction process under the guidance of the globe’s most
progressive regulating body.

### Evolved Performance Promise

We pledge that our product performance will achieve the goals set out together. Informed by an
in-depth opportunity analysis and validated by an on-site performance review, we tailor
configurations to empower your production aspirations and supply from North America’s largest
inventory of extractor parts and consumables.

***Our job is only complete once our on-site Performance Review ensures that your solution is able
to perform to the results defined by our agreement.***

[Evolved Extraction Performance Promise]

### 24-Month Warranty

Because of the exceptional reliability our customers have experienced with their EV-MASS Extraction
Platforms we are pleased to announce the extension of our warranty to 2 years on the
entire [EV-MASS ][16]product line.

## What Sets Evolved Apart:

### 1) keeping you operational

Downtime is bad for your bottom line. Our commitment is to maximize the uptime of all your
processes.
* Large inventory of parts, solvents, and consumables
* key supplies, delivered when you need them
* Consistent high-quality inputs for your processes
* Ongoing service and support from our knowledgeable technicians

### 2) Right tool for the Job

We believe every extraction method has a purpose if it’s used to maximize its unique efficiencies.
We are committed to your efficiency with results-orientated recommendations.
* Start with your end goal in mind to deliver an integrated process
* Holistic approach to all your processes to create a seamless workflow
* Tailor your solution to maximize your limited factors (Facility, regulatory, budget)
* Offer a variety of cutting-edge tech, ensuring that our recommendations are ideal for your
specific requirements

### 3) invested in your Success

Our business model is geared towards long-term partnerships with our clients. We align our interests
to ensure your ongoing success.
* Product and service offerings are designed to align with your long term success
* Provide you with after-sale support, supplies, and solutions
* An intimate knowledge of your business saves you time and money
* Guarantee the performance of our integrated solutions with our *Evolved Performance Promise*

## Team Kudos:

A company is only as good as its team, and one way we celebrate this is with our monthly kudos. True
to our values we like to keep these fun and uplifting while highlighting well-deserved hard work and
examples of our team living our core values.

## Our Core Values – Click for More:

### Evolved Zeal

Zeal is all about the energy and enthusiasm in pursuit of an objective, and our objective is being
the #1 Extraction Solutions experts in Canada. At Evolved Extraction, we are dedicated to our
customers’ success. We are passionate about extraction, and we love the look on a customer’s face
when they see our showroom for the first time. But passion for a company doesn’t just come from one
person – There is no I in Evolved. We support each other as a team, growing and evolving together.
When a team member is showing signs of a struggle, we do everything we can to get them to a place
where they can perform at their very best.

### Spirit of Learning

To serve our customers we realized that continuous learning is essential. By supporting a culture
where knowledge is shared, where employees are encouraged to take the initiative, and where
development is a priority, we and our customers become stronger. Sometimes we make mistakes, and
that’s ok because that’s where people learn. We have learned so much by doing, adjusting on the fly,
trimming the fat, and then documenting our systems. To support this value we provide opportunities
for professional development for all of our staff and we take pride in helping each other grow.

### Respect & Empathy

We pride ourselves on demonstrating empathy internally, with our customers and with our community.
At the end of the day, we are about people over profit and when people are happy profits are good!
We aren’t about selling you the most expensive product, but we are about selling you the product
that solves your problem or that effectively improves your business. By making sure our co-works and
customers feel heard and cared about we show Respect & Empathy.

### Fun & Uplifting

It’s true, when you smile the whole world smiles with you. At evolved we instill humour in our
everyday communication and have with everything we do; we don’t always take ourselves seriously, but
we take results seriously. That being said, when people love their jobs, they feel valued. We don’t
focus on the past; we focus on the future. That is why we believe it is everyone’s responsibility to
make sure everyone is succeeding and feeling valued. Often, this begins with a laugh or a smile. We
are all humans, and we want to work somewhere that is fun and where we feel uplifted.

achieve consistent, high-quality results.

## Description:

ETL-certified rotary evaporator package meets UL/CSA requirements. Most municipalities require this
certification, which also ensures higher safety standards and a longer equipment lifespan.

The 20L Rotary Evaporator Package includes everything you need to start your solvent recovery
process out of the box. As a **bonus**, it also includes a ***free dual 10L receiving flask
upgrade***. The items included in this package are as follows:
* (1) PolyScience 220V 6860 -10°C 13L 1.5HP recirculating chiller with turbine pump
* (1) Welch 220V 2052 2.3 cfm 1.5 torr 4-head diaphragm pump and vacuum hose
* (1) Ai 220V SolventVap 5.3-gallon rotary evaporator and water bath
* (1) Dual main condensers with sleeves
Single auxiliary condenser with sleeve
3-way flask
* (1) 5.3G/20L/0.7 cu ft round shaped rotating evaporating flask, glass
* (1) Dual 10L receiving flask
* (1) Reinforced food-grade vacuum & chilling tubing (15 ft.)
* (1) Vapor duct & evaporation flask seal (pre-installed)
* (1) Glass material feeding port with PTFE open/close valve and PTFE extension feeding tube
* (7 sets) QuickClamp and PTFE centering rings
* (1) Ai plexiglass bath cover for 20L SolventVap

#### Across International’s Official Canadian Distributor of High-Quality Products.

Across International rotary evaporators or rotovaps come with PTFE valves to ensure solvent
resistance. Rapid heat-up is made possible by its optimized bath volume. Glass tubes used in the
condenser unit have been designed to optimize surface area, thereby increasing evaporation
efficiency. A rotary evaporator features a motor and worm gear designed for constant rotation at
speeds up to 130 rpm. A thin layer of liquid is constantly transferred over the entire inner surface
of the flask containing the solvent. The water bath gently heats the surface, creating a large area
for evaporation. Special seals on the rotating system enable it to be placed under vacuum, which
reduces the boiling point of the solvents and removes the vapor phase, thereby increasing
efficiency. Moreover, each unit is equipped with a vacuum release that is easy to use, which allows
continuous feed. The digital water bath operates from ambient temperature to 99C (210F) with 0.1C
step-by-step temperature control. Should the controller fail, the overheat protector will shut down
the power. Standard Glassware Set contains a 20L round-bottomed evaporating flask, a 10L
round-bottomed receiving flask, and a vertical condenser. Distilling solvents with higher boiling
points is made easier by rotary evaporators with vertical glass condensers.

#### How does a Rotary Evaporator work?

Rotary evaporators (sometimes referred to as Rotavap or Rotovap) are used primarily to evaporate the
solvent from samples under reduced pressure. Reduced pressure, or vacuum, is achieved by using a
lab-grade chemical-resistant vacuum pump. Reduced pressure in the apparatus causes the solvent in
the ‘boiling flask’ to boil at a lower temperature than at atmospheric pressure. This method of
solvent evaporation is ideal for the Cannabis industry due to Cannabinoids and Terpenes tendency to
degrade when exposed to high temperatures. Furthermore, Rotary Evaporators require a chiller that is
plumbed into the ‘chilling coils’ where the solvent vapour is phase-changed to a liquid and
recollected in the ‘receiving flask’. If done correctly, the solvent recovered will be pure and can
be reused in the same or different application. It can be challenging to choose the right setup for
your lab due to the wide variety of sizes, manufacturers, and prices of rotary evaporators. This is
where Evolved Extraction Solutions can assist.

The Huber Unistat 405 chiller includes a Pilot ONE controller, which offers a brilliant 5.7"
touchscreen with graphic functions and an easy-to-use navigation menu. A new favourites menu allows
for one-click operation, and the integrated technical glossary of the process is very intuitive.
Integrated USB and Ethernet ports allow a connection to a PC or network for controlling remotely or
for data transfer.

#### Huber Unistat 405 Features:
* It offers unique thermodynamic properties and a range of functions to meet the high demands of
cannabis processors.
* Huber Unistat technology guarantees precise, reproducible temperature control results, the
shortest possible heating and cooling times, and large temperature ranges with one chiller fluid.
* All essential parameters are at a glance, with the temperature curve graphics displayed in real
time.
* Huber Unistats are equipped with the most up-to-date pump technology for optimal heat transfer.
The pump self-regulates to ensure optimal circulation and flow.
* The Huber's soft-start pump feature protects delicate glass reactors from breakage.
* Unistat technology allows for reduced operating costs and efficient energy management.
* Huber Unistat405 is hydraulically sealed.
* The service life of the temperature control fluid is dramatically increased by preventing oil loss
through vapours and oxidation, further saving resources.
* Unistat 405s are fitted with extensive safety equipment and are, therefore, suitable for
unsupervised continuous operation.

## Office of Drug Control

We regulate and monitor the cultivation, import, export and manufacture of controlled substances to
comply with Australia's obligations under International Drug Conventions. This includes the
cultivation of cannabis for medicinal purposes.

[About us][14]   [ODC transformation][15]   [The portal is live][16]

## Regulation

We regulate access to controlled drugs for medical and scientific purposes. Other authorities also
regulate specific controlled drugs like medicinal cannabis.
* ### [ International Conventions ][17]
  
  
  Three key international conventions inform how controlled substances are regulated by the Office
  of Drug Control.
* ### [ Medicinal cannabis ][18]
  
  
  Manufacturing, cultivating, importing and/or exporting medicinal cannabis in Australia.
* ### [ Related authorities ][19]
  
  
  Other state and federal government authorities have their own legislation to manage controlled
  substances.

## Industry and travellers

We have information for people who want to import, export or work with controlled drugs.
* [Icon - Cultivators and producers]
  
  ### [ Cultivators and producers ][20]
  
  
  You must get licences and permits to cultivate, produce, harvest or handle medicinal cannabis in
  Australia.
* [Icon - Importers]
  
  ### [ Importers ][21]
  
  
  You must get a licence and permit to import commercial quantities of controlled substances into
  Australia. This includes medicinal cannabis.
* [Icon - Exporters]
  
  ### [ Exporters ][22]
  
  
  Drug control information for exporters, including but not limited to medicinal cannabis, narcotic
  and psychotropic drugs and precursor chemicals from Australia.
* [Icon - Manufacturer]
  
  ### [ Manufacturers ][23]
  
  
  Drug control information for manufacturers, including the manufacture of narcotic and psychotropic
  drugs in Australia.
* [Icon - Travellers]
  
  ### [ Travellers ][24]
  
  
  Information on travelling into or out of Australia with medicines, cannabis, kava or other
  controlled substances for personal use or medical kits.
* [Icon - Health professionals]
  
  ### [ Health professionals ][25]
  
  
  Information for health professionals importing unapproved drugs into Australia under the Special
  Access Scheme or Authorised Prescriber pathways.
* [Icon - Medical or special aid missions]
  
  ### [ Medical aid missions ][26]
  
  
  Drug control information for medical and special aid missions.
* [Icon - Health professionals, Sporting teams]
  
  ### [ Sporting teams ][27]
  
  
  Drug control information for sporting teams travelling into or out of Australia with medicines,
  medical devices or medical kits.
* [Icon - Military personnel]
  
  ### [ Military personnel ][28]
  
  
  Drug control information for military personnel travelling into or out of Australia with
  medicines, medical devices and medication kits.

  Kava brought into Australia has set amounts for personal use or for commercial food use.
* ### [ Medicinal cannabis ][32]
  
  
  Manufacturing, cultivating, importing and/or exporting medicinal cannabis in Australia.
* ### [ Khat ][33]
  
  
  Khat (Catha edulis) is a prohibited substance cannot be imported into Australia.
* ### [ Precursor substances ][34]
  
  
  The import and export of precursor substances into or out of Australia are controlled.
* ### [ Monitoring and compliance ][35]
  
  
  Find out how we monitor the legal cultivation, production and manufacture of controlled drugs and
  our compliance activities like inspections and fines.
* ### [ Hemp products ][36]
  
  
  Some specific hemp seed and fibre products may be imported without requiring a licence and permit
  from the Office of Drug Control (ODC).
* ### [ Anabolic, androgenic, hormones and other controlled substances ][37]
  
  
  Anabolic or androgenic steroids, including hormones require a permit to import into Australia.

  Information for people importing vaping goods into Australia.

# Welcome to the Victorian Law Reform Commission

The Victorian Law Reform Commission is the central agency for law reform in Victoria. It is a
statutory authority, established under the [Victorian Law Reform Commission Act 2000][80]. The
Commission makes a significant contribution to developing a fair, just and inclusive legal system
for all Victorians. The Commission consults with the community and advises the Attorney-General on
how to improve and update Victorian laws.

The Commission’s major responsibility is to examine, report and make recommendations on issues that
the Attorney-General refers to it. It also has the power to recommend reforms to relatively minor
legal issues of general community concern without a reference.

## About Linneo Health

Linneo Health is a pioneering pharmaceutical company in the medicinal cannabis market, an emerging
sector with enormous growth potential. In just a few years, we have become a leader in the research,
production, and distribution of cannabis for medical use. 

At Linneo Health we work closely with other pharmaceutical partners who develop innovative medicines
to improve the quality of life of patients all over the world using our products.

and **GACP**, which regulate agricultural activity.

quality control standards globally.

From cultivation and growth, to final product production, the entire process is overseen by our team
of experienced qualified specialists.

Combined with our world-leading production and research capacity, we are able to meet our customers’
needs and fulfill the regulatory requirements of the countries in which they operate.

# Sustainability

To strengthen its commitment to Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) principles, Little Green
Pharma has established a Green Committee with the objective of identifying improvements and
supporting the company’s ESG compliance journey.

The Committee focuses on assessing the Six Dimensions of Impact (modelled by the Boston Consulting
Group) that provide a holistic framework for considering societal and environmental contributions.
By applying this lens to our strategy, Little Green Pharma is creating a framework to ensure that
our operations deliver positive outcomes for both society and shareholders.

A significant step has been the company’s move to 100% renewable power at its Western Australian
production facility, with similar goals set for our Danish site.

# Vision and Values

## We want to make *a world of difference*

We aim to contribute to ongoing research and education within the natural health sector, while
continuing to explore innovative approaches to product development and technology.

#### Our vision

By focusing on sustainability, innovation, and long-term partnerships across Australia and beyond.

#### Our bright green culture and values

Our values shape our culture and drive our team in everything we do. They’re what we stand for and
shape our behaviour, attitude and how we deliver on our mission and vision.

Trust

Our north star is being the most trusted brand in medicinal cannabis. Our ethics, honesty, and
integrity attract and retain loyal stakeholders, creating a significant point of difference.

Imagination

We think outside the box to innovate and improve. We dream big and work towards those dreams to make
a positive impact on patients’ lives.

Leadership

We lead the industry through commitment to research, quality products and best in class service

# Vision and Values

## We want to make *a world of difference*

We aim to contribute to ongoing research and education within the natural health sector, while
continuing to explore innovative approaches to product development and technology.

#### Our vision

By focusing on sustainability, innovation, and long-term partnerships across Australia and beyond.

#### Our bright green culture and values

Our values shape our culture and drive our team in everything we do. They’re what we stand for and
shape our behaviour, attitude and how we deliver on our mission and vision.

Trust

Our north star is being the most trusted brand in medicinal cannabis. Our ethics, honesty, and
integrity attract and retain loyal stakeholders, creating a significant point of difference.

Imagination

We think outside the box to innovate and improve. We dream big and work towards those dreams to make
a positive impact on patients’ lives.

Leadership

We lead the industry through commitment to research, quality products and best in class service

# Organisation

## We are a global business with production assets in Australia and Europe.

Little Green Pharma is one of the most recognisable names in the European and Australian natural
health sector. With operations in Denmark and Australia, Little Green Pharma continues to expand its
presence across established and emerging markets in Europe.

As a vertically integrated company with production capacity and strategic positioning, we are
steadily building our footprint across the region.

We remain focused on innovation, sustainability, and strong partnerships as part of our long-term
growth strategy.

We have pioneered the Australian natural health sector and overcame early hurdles to establish
cultivation and manufacturing operations. This marked the beginning of our ongoing commitment to
advancing responsible practices and innovation in the field.

To date, our growth has been supported by our first-mover status as the first Australian producer
and exporter of locally developed products, together with our early entry into key international
markets.

We have also produced Denmark’s first locally made product.

Since then, the company has continued to expand its capabilities across product development and
cultivation.

### We want to improve the science behind natural solutions

At Little Green Pharma, our focus remains on advancing research and innovation as part of our
contribution to the broader health and life sciences sector.

### *We are proud to be Little Green Pharma, *
### *and making a world of difference.*

# Thomas Huppert

## Non-Executive Director

### Non-Executive Director

Mr Thomas (Tommy) Huppert B.Ec (Monash University) was the founder of Cannatrek Ltd and a recognised
medicinal cannabis health economist with more than 30 years’ experience building and scaling
businesses across Australia and Japan.

Mr Huppert founded Cannatrek in 2015 and received the #2 medicinal cannabis licence in Australia and
led the company as Chief Executive Officer until 2024. Under his leadership, Cannatrek became one of
Australia’s largest medicinal cannabis companies and one of the first enterprises to secure the full
suite of federal and state licences covering cultivation, manufacturing, research, importation and
distribution of medicinal cannabis products.

He pioneered Cannatrek’s integrated “Seed-to-Patient” business model, combining cultivation,
pharmaceutical manufacturing and patient-focused digital healthcare solutions. During his tenure,
Cannatrek generated more than $350 million in cumulative revenue, created hundreds of jobs, and
achieved numerous industry-first milestones including the importation and commercialisation of new
medicinal cannabis product categories.

The company in FY23 was also recognised as Australia’s #2 Fastest-Growing Company in the AFR Fast
100. Mr Huppert currently focuses on strategic growth initiatives and international expansion
opportunities, particularly in Europe and Japan. Mr Huppert is also a director of 8 Grains Pty Ltd,
Cannatrek Japan KK, Cannatrek Medical KK, and Plantnation KK. Mr Huppert currently does not hold any
other material directorships, other than as disclosed in this Notice.

## About us

## Natural health products

At Little Green Pharma, we are committed to providing natural alternatives. We believe everyone
should have the opportunity to access options that suit their needs, which is why we continue to
develop innovative approaches from our world-class operations in Denmark and Australia.

As one of the most recognisable names in the European and Australian natural health sector, we are
committed to delivering trusted solutions and driving innovation across the industry.

[Why Little Green Pharma][15]

## Our manufacturing approach

Little Green Pharma manufactures products from facilities located in Denmark and Australia.

We focus on responsible practices and ongoing innovation as part of our role in the global industry.

[Learn more about LGP ][16]

## Partnerships

## Working with industry leaders and *innovators*

Little Green Pharma collaborates with industry leaders and innovators to advance research,
technology, and sustainable practices across the sector.

We are dedicated to developing new delivery technologies and pursuing opportunities for innovation
and differentiation.

[Collaborate with us][17]

## The *science *behind our research

Little Green Pharma supports ethical clinical research that contributes to a better understanding of
alternative therapies and their applications.

In Australia, we have undertaken one of the largest longitudinal studies of its kind, with plans to
expand recruitment internationally.

## Green by name, green by nature.

## Environmental *Sustainability*

At Little Green Pharma, we’ve developed a strong ESG profile built on responsible and sustainable
business practices.

With a focus on the future, we’ve established a Green Committee to ensure our operations continue to
give back while positively impacting both society and the environment.

leadership.title: Independent Non-Executive Chair
leadership.bio: Brent Dennison was most recently the Chief Executive Officer of the Cell Care Group, an international cord blood bank and cellular therapy investor. leadership.name: Paul Long
leadership.title: Group Chief Executive Officer and Director

leadership.name: Michael Lynch-Bell
leadership.title: Independent Non-Executive Director

leadership.bio: Mr. Thomas (Tommy) Huppert is a recognised medicinal cannabis health economist with over 30 years’ experience building and scaling businesses across Australia and Japan. He founded Cannatrek Ltd and led it to become one of Australia’s largest medicinal cannabis companies.

leadership.name: Seth Yakatan
leadership.title: Independent Non-Executive Director

leadership.name: Paula Butler

leadership.name: Jason Rance

leadership.bio: Jason excels at leading brands and businesses through positive change and transformation to deliver outstanding results, with expertise in product and service innovation.

leadership.name: Alistair Warren
leadership.title: General Counsel and Company Secretary
leadership.bio: Alistair has been in practice since 2003 and was previously in-house counsel to BHP, advising on international commodity sales and strategic resourcing.

leadership.name: James Kapetanios

leadership.name: Chris Petrakis

leadership.bio: Chris has over 25 years of experience in healthcare, biotech, and research environments, leading global teams and delivering major system implementations.

A Global Cannabis Company

Cronos is a global cannabis company focused on scaling leading consumer goods products through R&D and innovation. With a passion to responsibly elevate the consumer experience, Cronos is building an iconic brand portfolio. Cronos’ diverse international brand portfolio includes Spinach ® , PEACE NATURALS ® , LIT™ and Lord Jones ® .

About

Mission

Build brands and create products that enhance experiences

Vision

Take experiences to new highs

Values

At the heart of Cronos are our values. They are the principles that steer our actions and define our character. They represent who we are, how we operate, and the reputation we aspire to build and maintain within the industry and all our stakeholders who help shape it.

Community

We believe in building and supporting a fair and equitable industry.

Fun

We believe in creating your favorite products through innovation and imagination.

Responsibility

We believe our products are for adults* (*Adults are those of the legal age of consumption in the relevant jurisdiction).

Quality

We believe in elevating industry practices to provide quality products focused on reliability and transparency.

The

Team

Our management team comprises experts in their fields, with a goal to establish the most valuable international cannabis company. They are passionate, daring people, driven by quality and integrity, who are determined to write history, not read about it.

Mike Gorenstein

Anna Shlimak

Jeff Jacobson

Shannon Buggy

Terry Doucet

Arye Weigensberg

Adam Wagner

Mike Gorenstein

Mike Gorenstein

Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer
Mike Gorenstein serves as Cronos Group’s Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer. In addition, Mr. Gorenstein is a Co-Founder and passive Member of Gotham Green Partners. Before joining Cronos, Mike was the Vice President and General Counsel at Alphabet Partners, LP, a New York City based multi-strategy investment management firm, focused on identifying mispriced assets across various industries, asset classes and geographies. Prior to Alphabet Partners, LP, he was a corporate attorney at Sullivan & Cromwell LLP, where he focused on mergers and acquisitions and capital markets transactions. Mike graduated from the University of Pennsylvania Law School with a Juris Doctor, the Wharton School at University of Pennsylvania with a certificate in Business Economics and Public Policy and the Kelley School of Business at Indiana University with a Bachelor of Science of Business in Finance.

Anna Shlimak

Anna Shlimak
Chief Financial Officer
Anna serves as Cronos’ Chief Financial Officer. Anna recently served as the Company’s Chief Strategy Officer and was responsible for managing and directing the organization’s corporate strategy, investor relations, communications, government affairs, and information systems departments. Prior to joining Cronos, Anna was the Head of Investor Relations at Quest Partners LLC, a research-driven alternative investment firm. Anna was responsible for business development, investor reporting, marketing, and communication initiatives for the fund. Before that, Anna held a range of roles at the New York Stock Exchange in both the New York and London offices. She received a Master of Business Administration from Columbia Business School and holds a Bachelor of Science in Economics from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania.

Jeff Jacobson

Jeff Jacobson
Chief Growth Officer
As Chief Growth Officer, Jeff leads the Marketing, Innovation, Operations and Sales team in North America as well as the Consumer Insights and Data Analytics teams for Cronos Group’s global business. Jeff sets the strategy for our brands and is responsible for leading our global teams to help execute Cronos Group’s vision. Jeff previously served as Cronos Group’s General Manager of Canada and Europe. Before joining Cronos Group, Jeff founded a Toronto based marketing agency and successfully launched and licensed several innovative software products in the mobile industry. As a co-founder of Peace Naturals, Jeff’s expertise and experience in licensing and compliance, new business development, project management and resource management help Cronos Group lead in a variety of markets.

Shannon Buggy

Shannon Buggy
Senior Vice President, Global Head of People
Shannon serves as the SVP, Global Head of People for Cronos Group where she leads HR strategy across the Company’s global operations. Prior to Cronos Group, Shannon was the Senior Vice President of Global Human Resources for Nielsen where she led HR strategy for Nielsen Media. With over 30 years of experience, Shannon has a proven track record of leading and managing global human resources teams and driving excellence in talent acquisition, development, retention, employee relations, compensation, benefits, talent management and labor relations. Shannon holds a certification as a Senior Professional in Human Resources from the HR Certification Institute. She graduated magna cum laude with a Bachelor of Science degree in Human Resources Management from the Pace University, Lubin School of Business.

Terry Doucet

Terry Doucet
General Counsel and Corporate Secretary

Cronos is a global cannabis company focused on scaling leading consumer goods products through R&D and innovation. With a passion to responsibly elevate the consumer experience, Cronos is building an iconic brand portfolio. Cronos’ diverse international brand portfolio includes Spinach ® , PEACE NATURALS ® , LIT™ and Lord Jones ® .

About

Mission

Build brands and create products that enhance experiences

Vision

Take experiences to new highs

Values

At the heart of Cronos are our values. They are the principles that steer our actions and define our character. They represent who we are, how we operate, and the reputation we aspire to build and maintain within the industry and all our stakeholders who help shape it.

Community

We believe in building and supporting a fair and equitable industry.

Fun

We believe in creating your favorite products through innovation and imagination.

Responsibility

We believe our products are for adults* (*Adults are those of the legal age of consumption in the relevant jurisdiction).

Quality

We believe in elevating industry practices to provide quality products focused on reliability and transparency.

The

Team

Our management team comprises experts in their fields, with a goal to establish the most valuable international cannabis company. They are passionate, daring people, driven by quality and integrity, who are determined to write history, not read about it.

Mike Gorenstein

Mike Gorenstein

Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer
Mike Gorenstein serves as Cronos Group’s Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer. In addition, Mr. Gorenstein is a Co-Founder and passive Member of Gotham Green Partners. Before joining Cronos, Mike was the Vice President and General Counsel at Alphabet Partners, LP, a New York City based multi-strategy investment management firm, focused on identifying mispriced assets across various industries, asset classes and geographies. Prior to Alphabet Partners, LP, he was a corporate attorney at Sullivan & Cromwell LLP, where he focused on mergers and acquisitions and capital markets transactions. Mike graduated from the University of Pennsylvania Law School with a Juris Doctor, the Wharton School at University of Pennsylvania with a certificate in Business Economics and Public Policy and the Kelley School of Business at Indiana University with a Bachelor of Science of Business in Finance.

Anna Shlimak

Anna Shlimak
Chief Financial Officer
Anna serves as Cronos’ Chief Financial Officer. Anna recently served as the Company’s Chief Strategy Officer and was responsible for managing and directing the organization’s corporate strategy, investor relations, communications, government affairs, and information systems departments. Prior to joining Cronos, Anna was the Head of Investor Relations at Quest Partners LLC, a research-driven alternative investment firm. Anna was responsible for business development, investor reporting, marketing, and communication initiatives for the fund. Before that, Anna held a range of roles at the New York Stock Exchange in both the New York and London offices. She received a Master of Business Administration from Columbia Business School and holds a Bachelor of Science in Economics from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania.

Jeff Jacobson

Jeff Jacobson
Chief Growth Officer
As Chief Growth Officer, Jeff leads the Marketing, Innovation, Operations and Sales team in North America as well as the Consumer Insights and Data Analytics teams for Cronos Group’s global business. Jeff sets the strategy for our brands and is responsible for leading our global teams to help execute Cronos Group’s vision. Jeff previously served as Cronos Group’s General Manager of Canada and Europe. Before joining Cronos Group, Jeff founded a Toronto based marketing agency and successfully launched and licensed several innovative software products in the mobile industry. As a co-founder of Peace Naturals, Jeff’s expertise and experience in licensing and compliance, new business development, project management and resource management help Cronos Group lead in a variety of markets.

Shannon Buggy

Shannon Buggy
Senior Vice President, Global Head of People
Shannon serves as the SVP, Global Head of People for Cronos Group where she leads HR strategy across the Company’s global operations. Prior to Cronos Group, Shannon was the Senior Vice President of Global Human Resources for Nielsen where she led HR strategy for Nielsen Media. With over 30 years of experience, Shannon has a proven track record of leading and managing global human resources teams and driving excellence in talent acquisition, development, retention, employee relations, compensation, benefits, talent management and labor relations. Shannon holds a certification as a Senior Professional in Human Resources from the HR Certification Institute. She graduated magna cum laude with a Bachelor of Science degree in Human Resources Management from the Pace University, Lubin School of Business.

Terry Doucet

Terry Doucet
General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
Terry Doucet serves as Cronos Group’s General Counsel and Corporate Secretary. In this capacity, he manages all legal and regulatory affairs at Cronos Group and also serves as the Company’s Corporate Secretary. Prior to joining Cronos, Terry was a corporate lawyer at Davies Ward Phillips & Vineberg LLP in Toronto, where he focused primarily on M&A in large, complex and cross-border transactions across numerous industries, as well as securities, corporate finance and lending transactions. During that time, Terry was also seconded to RBC Capital Markets, where he supported the bank’s derivative trading desks. Terry is an Ontario-qualified lawyer, holding a Juris Doctor from the University of Toronto and a joint honours (first class) Bachelor of Arts degree from McGill University in Montreal.

Arye Weigensberg

Arye Weigensberg
Head of Research and Development
As Head of Research and Development, Arye is responsible for leading Cronos’ innovation program, where he oversees research and technology functions, and leads scientific efforts to unlock the potential of rare cannabinoids. Before joining Cronos, Arye was the CEO of Altria Israel Ltd, an Altria research and development innovation hub. Arye joined Altria as part of its acquisition of Green Smoke, where he was the Director of Marketing and Brand Management. Prior to Green Smoke, Arye held a variety of roles in brand management and marketing, supporting food brands such as Manischewitz, Lawry’s, Ragu, Knorr and Country Crock. Arye graduated from Concordia University’s John Molson School of Business with a Bachelor of Commerce in Marketing and International Business.

Adam Wagner

Adam Wagner
General Manager, Cronos Israel
Adam Wagner serves as Senior Vice President, Head of Cronos Israel. Adam oversees the business and strategy of Cronos Israel. Before he was appointed as Head of Cronos Israel, he was the VP of Finance at Cronos Israel where he oversaw the regional Israel finance department, including FP&A, controllership, audit, treasury, tax, as well as IT, supply chain and procurement . Before joining Cronos, Adam worked as a Director of Finance at Motus GI, a publicly traded medical device company, where he oversaw the Israel-based finance department. Before that, Adam was a Finance Manager at Medtronic, a publicly traded medical equipment manufacturer, where he oversaw the Israel-based finance department functions. Prior to Medtronic’s acquisition, he was the Corporate Controller for Mazor Robotics, a dual-listed public medical device company. Adam began his career as a Senior Auditor at EY where he managed a team that performed audits for various publicly traded and private companies. Adam also serves as a Finance expert on an advisory board for a wellness and healthcare start-up. Adam is a CPA (Israel) and studied Accounting at Bar-Ilan University. Adam also holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Science of Nutrition and his Master of Science in Genetics and Biochemistry from Tel Aviv University.

# About Tilray

## Our Company

Tilray was founded in Canada in 2013. Just one year later, we received approval from the Canadian
health authority for the production and research of medicinal cannabis. Since then we have been
supplying numerous doctors, pharmacies, hospitals, authorities and researchers worldwide with our
high-quality pharmaceutical products.

Tilray is one of the leading companies in the production, development and research of medicinal
cannabis world-wide. We are proud of that and are particularly pleased to be able to provide a
steadily growing number of patients with a better quality of life.

## We Are a Global Pioneer

We have supplied high-quality medical cannabis products to tens of thousands of patients in eighteen
countries spanning five continents across the globe through our subsidiaries in Europe, Canada,
Australia and Latin America, and through agreements with established pharmaceutical distributors.

Highest ethical & medical policies

Tilray is absolutely convinced that patients should have safe access and a reliable supply of
quality-tested pure, precise and predictable medical cannabis products. We aspire to lead,
legitimize and define the future of our industry by building the world’s most trusted and valued
medicinal cannabis company. We are pioneering the future of medical cannabis research, cultivation,
processing and distribution globally. Tilray’s EU campus in Cantanhede serves as a hub to support
[Tilray’s clinical research][8], product developments and distribution across Europe and other
international markets.

## GMP-certified Producer

Our Tilray Cantanhede, Portugal and Tilray Nanaimo, Canada facilities are Good Manufacturing
Practices (GMP) certified:
* GMP is an internationally recognized standard that ensures medicines are consistently produced and
controlled with the highest levels of pharmaceutical grade quality and purity.
* GMP certification has allowed us to export our products all over the world, through our
subsidiaries in Europe, Canada, Australia and Latin America, and through agreements with
established pharmaceutical distributors.

# About Tilray

## Our Company

Tilray was founded in Canada in 2013. Just one year later, we received approval from the Canadian
health authority for the production and research of medicinal cannabis. Since then we have been
supplying numerous doctors, pharmacies, hospitals, authorities and researchers worldwide with our
high-quality pharmaceutical products.

Tilray is one of the leading companies in the production, development and research of medicinal
cannabis world-wide. We are proud of that and are particularly pleased to be able to provide a
steadily growing number of patients with a better quality of life.

## We Are a Global Pioneer

We have supplied high-quality medical cannabis products to tens of thousands of patients in eighteen
countries spanning five continents across the globe through our subsidiaries in Europe, Canada,
Australia and Latin America, and through agreements with established pharmaceutical distributors.

Tilray is absolutely convinced that patients should have safe access and a reliable supply of
quality-tested pure, precise and predictable medical cannabis products. We aspire to lead,
legitimize and define the future of our industry by building the world’s most trusted and valued
medicinal cannabis company. We are pioneering the future of medical cannabis research, cultivation,
processing and distribution globally. Tilray’s EU campus in Cantanhede serves as a hub to support
[Tilray’s clinical research][8], product developments and distribution across Europe and other
international markets.

## GMP-certified Producer

Our Tilray Cantanhede, Portugal and Tilray Nanaimo, Canada facilities are Good Manufacturing
Practices (GMP) certified:
* GMP is an internationally recognized standard that ensures medicines are consistently produced and
controlled with the highest levels of pharmaceutical grade quality and purity.
* GMP certification has allowed us to export our products all over the world, through our
subsidiaries in Europe, Canada, Australia and Latin America, and through agreements with
established pharmaceutical distributors.

## Our Services

### White Label

Supply of full-spectrum medical cannabis oil. Products can be marketed under the customer’s own

### Bulk Extract

Extracted cannabinoids in bulk format. Consistent supply of bulk for formulation or further
downstream processing.

[THC][10]
[CBD][11]

## Our Products

From our facility in Denmark, we manufacture full-spectrum cannabis oil for declaration of THC, CBD,
and balanced formulations. Our unique manufacturing capabilities enable us to create the highest
quality of products with a well-preserved profile of terpenes and flavonoids. Valcon Medical is GMP
certified.

### Standardised Cannabis Oil
* Full-spectrum C02–extracted
* THC, CBD, mixed, or balanced
* MCT carrier oil
* 30 ml primary packaging

Products are manufactured under EU-GMP and tested in accordance with the German Monograph for
cannabis extracts, DAB Eingestellter Cannabisextract, and the European Pharmacopoeia, Ph. Eur.
Products are composed of a specified amount of extracted cannabinoids from Cannabis Sativa L.
flowers (floss) of a defined strain, in MCT oil (medium-chain triglycerides). The extraction solvent
is carbon dioxide.
