THE WORLD'S FIRST AND ONLY END-TO-END cGMP PRODUCTS WITH
Naturally-Extracted Cannabinoids

APIRx is the world’s only cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice) cannabis plant users and providers of cGMP API’s based on naturally extracted cannabinoids .
We produce just as pure product as synthetic cannabinoids, but from a natural source with minimum or no alteration of the cannabinoids, leading to healthier, safer and more effective cannabinoid-based medicines and products.

Find Out More

-->

OUR API PRODUCTS
Our Cannabis Plant Cultivation

APIRx’s operational process begins with the procurement of the cGMP-produced flowers of the cannabis sativa. These will be processed into stable API’ utilizing APIRx proprietary methodology.
We are the licensor of proprietary active pharmaceutical ingredients (API’s) for extraction, purification and microencapsulation from cGMP-produced Cannabis plants; and the manufacturer and marketer of Cannabis based pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic and OTC products based on end-to-end cGMP process certification.

See More

PARTNER WITH A BEST-IN-CLASS TEAM
Rooted in Advantageous Economics

Our independent Board of Directors is comprised of leading authorities in relevant industry sectors, providing objective perspective, strategic direction and network connections.

Partner with Us

WHO WE ARE
APIRx is a leading pharmaceutical company specialized in cannabinoid active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and drug products, which contain these APIs.
LEARN MORE >

WHAT WE DO

Our products are manufactured under the cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice) conditions from the highest quality natural extracts of cannabis sativa plant.
LEARN MORE >

WHY PARTNER WITH US

We can provide your business with pure cannabinoids (99.9% pure) or dissolved in ethanol or in an appropriate oil with the concentration of an active ingredient.
LEARN MORE >

-->

OUR MISSION & VISION
End-to-End cGMP Cannabis APIs

APIRx was born out of the growing need for cannabinoid-based solutions for wound healing, dermatological diseases, medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaws (MRONJ), appetite control and others.

To date, only synthetically produced cannabinoids have received cGMP certification–but these are quite expensive and artificial. APIRx’s products will be cGMP based on 100% natural cannabis plant product .

At APIRx, we believe that the market is headed in the natural cGMP direction from a regulatory compliance and from the demand for better, safer, and environmentally friendlier products.

Our motto is: “As pure as synthetic, but natural!”

THERAPEUTIC EFFECT ON DISEASES

According to WebMD , approximately 100 million in the U.S. suffer from chronic pain. APIRx produces cannabinoid-based pharmaceuticals and offers state of the art technologies for clients in need of cannabinoid-based Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, as well as final product manufacturing.

# About Us

APIRx Pharmaceuticals B.V. is a leading pharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing of natural
cannabinoid API’s (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients), which are extracted from cannabis plant
material and purified to pharma grade. All manufacturing stages are performed under cGMP conditions.
The following [cannabinoids][15] are in our product portfolio:
* Tetrahydrocannabinol (THC or Delta-9THC)
* Cannabidiol (CBD)
* Cannabidgerol (CBG)

APIRx also uses its own API’s for the development of new Rx and OTC drugs, nutraceuticals,
cosmeceuticals and other products.

APIRx was born out of the growing need for cannabinoid-based solutions for wound healing,
dermatological diseases, medication’ related osteonecrosis of the jaws (MRONJ), appetite control and
a number of other indications. To date, only synthetically produced cannabinoids have received [cGMP
certification][16]–but these are quite expensive and artificial. APIRx’s products are cGMP
certified, based on **100% natural cannabis plant products**–*and much more affordable*. We believe
that the market is headed in the natural cGMP direction from a regulatory compliance and consumer
demand perspectives.

In addition to proprietary extraction and purification technologies APIRx implements unique
encapsulation technology, which increase bioavailability of cannabinoid APIs and prevents their
oxidation and degradation.

## The World's Only Provider of cGMP API's Based on Naturally Extracted Cannabinoids

APIRx is the world’s only cGMP produced cannabinoid pharmaceutical and cannabinoid product company.
Prior to APIRx and until recently, the only cannabinoid acceptable to the FDA was dronabinol; a
synthetic THC. Recently, the FDA approved Epidiolex; a naturally extracted CBD product which has not
been scheduled yet by the DEA.

APIRx produces just as pure product as synthetic cannabinoids, but from a natural source with
minimum or no alteration of the cannabinoids. There is **no other provider in the marketplace** that
is capable of producing end-to-end cannabinoids based on [100% naturally grown cannabis
plants][17] which are cGMP certified.

## Disruptive Technology in the Rapidly Growing Cannabis Industry

APIRx is part of a large and rapidly growing market opportunity in worldwide cannabis consumption
for medicinal usage, which is constantly being re-forecasted, driven by regulatory adoption at state
and federal levels (in certain countries). While certain companies have received cGMP certification
for certain manufacturing processes, **APIRx is the first company to offer APIs and finished good
based on an end-to-end cGMP process**, starting with cGMP-produced Cannabis plant.

Current products are based on cGMP based synthetic cannabinoids (THC and CBD) but these are
extremely expensive and are prone to manufacturing errors, which could be detrimental. The
production of synthetic cannabinoids is a costly, multi-step process where the slightest error may
lead to devastating consequences. This is not the case with the naturally procured cannabinoids.
Currently, there are two regulated (EMA, FDA, etc.) products based on naturally extracted
cannabinoids: Sativex (THC and CBD) and Epidiolex (CBD). This signals a shift in the FDA’s position
on naturally extracted cannabinoids and willingness to regulate.

Therefore, pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products based on cannabinoids will be regulated and
there will be strict guidance as to the acceptability (i.e. they will have to be cGMP compliant).

# About Us

APIRx Pharmaceuticals B.V. is a leading pharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing of natural
cannabinoid API’s (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients), which are extracted from cannabis plant
material and purified to pharma grade. All manufacturing stages are performed under cGMP conditions.
The following [cannabinoids][15] are in our product portfolio:
* Tetrahydrocannabinol (THC or Delta-9THC)
* Cannabidiol (CBD)
* Cannabidgerol (CBG)

APIRx also uses its own API’s for the development of new Rx and OTC drugs, nutraceuticals,
cosmeceuticals and other products.

APIRx was born out of the growing need for cannabinoid-based solutions for wound healing,
dermatological diseases, medication’ related osteonecrosis of the jaws (MRONJ), appetite control and
a number of other indications. To date, only synthetically produced cannabinoids have received [cGMP
certification][16]–but these are quite expensive and artificial. APIRx’s products are cGMP
certified, based on **100% natural cannabis plant products**–*and much more affordable*. We believe
that the market is headed in the natural cGMP direction from a regulatory compliance and consumer
demand perspectives.

In addition to proprietary extraction and purification technologies APIRx implements unique
encapsulation technology, which increase bioavailability of cannabinoid APIs and prevents their
oxidation and degradation.

## The World's Only Provider of cGMP API's Based on Naturally Extracted Cannabinoids

APIRx is the world’s only cGMP produced cannabinoid pharmaceutical and cannabinoid product company.
Prior to APIRx and until recently, the only cannabinoid acceptable to the FDA was dronabinol; a
synthetic THC. Recently, the FDA approved Epidiolex; a naturally extracted CBD product which has not
been scheduled yet by the DEA.

APIRx produces just as pure product as synthetic cannabinoids, but from a natural source with
minimum or no alteration of the cannabinoids. There is **no other provider in the marketplace** that
is capable of producing end-to-end cannabinoids based on [100% naturally grown cannabis
plants][17] which are cGMP certified.

## Disruptive Technology in the Rapidly Growing Cannabis Industry

APIRx is part of a large and rapidly growing market opportunity in worldwide cannabis consumption
for medicinal usage, which is constantly being re-forecasted, driven by regulatory adoption at state
and federal levels (in certain countries). While certain companies have received cGMP certification
for certain manufacturing processes, **APIRx is the first company to offer APIs and finished good
based on an end-to-end cGMP process**, starting with cGMP-produced Cannabis plant.

Current products are based on cGMP based synthetic cannabinoids (THC and CBD) but these are
extremely expensive and are prone to manufacturing errors, which could be detrimental. The
production of synthetic cannabinoids is a costly, multi-step process where the slightest error may
lead to devastating consequences. This is not the case with the naturally procured cannabinoids.
Currently, there are two regulated (EMA, FDA, etc.) products based on naturally extracted
cannabinoids: Sativex (THC and CBD) and Epidiolex (CBD). This signals a shift in the FDA’s position
on naturally extracted cannabinoids and willingness to regulate.

Therefore, pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products based on cannabinoids will be regulated and
there will be strict guidance as to the acceptability (i.e. they will have to be cGMP compliant).
APIRx’s cGMP natural based Cannabis plant products will offer the marketplace decreased** cost** and
**safety for consumers.**

company.tagline: Navigating the extraction process from concept to commissioning.

products.name: Cryogenic Ethanol Extraction System
products.description: A system designed for the extraction of compounds from plant materials using cryogenic ethanol.

products.name: Supercritical Fluid CO2 Extraction System
products.description: A system that utilizes supercritical CO2 for the extraction of essential oils and other compounds from plant materials.

services.name: Consulting Services
services.description: Expert consulting services for extraction processes and system design.

services.name: Design Engineering Services
services.description: Design engineering services for extraction systems and processes.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Buffalo Extracts specializes in providing advanced extraction systems and consulting services tailored for cannabis enterprises. Their product offerings include Cryogenic Ethanol and Supercritical Fluid CO2 Extraction Systems, designed to efficiently extract valuable compounds from plant materials. Additionally, the company offers expert consulting and design engineering services to support clients in optimizing their extraction processes and system designs across various industries, including cannabis, spice, herb, and essential oil.
relevant_companies.key_products: Cryogenic Ethanol Extraction System; Supercritical Fluid CO2 Extraction System

relevant_companies.company_summary: Cannaponics is a vertically integrated medicinal cannabis company based in Australia, dedicated to cultivating high-quality cannabis under stringent global standards, including WHO Good Agricultural and Collection Practices (GACP) and EU Good Manufacturing Practices (EU GMP). With over 30 years of cultivation experience, the company specializes in developing proprietary cannabis varietals and sustainable, plant-based pain relief solutions, targeting patients, pharmacists, and partners worldwide. Cannaponics is committed to ethical production and innovative practices, leveraging renewable energy resources to meet the growing demand for premium medicinal products.

# Australian Grown Medicinal Solutions

[Our Business][8]
[Contact Us][9]

## Vertically integrated medicinal cannabis company leveraging renewable energy resources in
## Australia.

##### It’s a foundation built not just to meet today’s medicinal demands, but to pioneer the
##### therapeutics of tomorrow. Focused on cultivating medicinal cannabis under the World Health
##### Organisation (WHO) quality framework for Good Agricultural and Collection Practices (**GACP**)
##### and manufacturing pharmaceutical grade medicinal products under the European Union Good
##### Manufacturing Practices (***EU GMP**) framework.
##### 
##### Fully integrated ESG for medicinal cannabis toll production and distribution

[Our Business][10]

##### Cannaponics is on a mission to put people and the planet first, meeting the growing demand for
##### premium, plant-based pain relief with sustainable, ethically produced cannabis solutions.

[Learn more][11]
[About company][12]

#### Global pioneers. Local leaders. Cannabis cultivators with purpose.

With over 30 years of cultivation experience — including one of Canada’s first licensed growers —
our expert team leads every step of the value chain. We blend proven global practices with bold
Australian innovation to deliver consistent, high-quality products designed for patients,
pharmacists, and partners worldwide.

## Next-Gen Genetics

##### With over 200 proprietary cannabis varietals, our seed-to-solution approach blends in-house
##### breeding, global partnerships, and continual phenotype refinement to unlock elite cannabinoid
##### and terpene profiles. Grown in one of the world’s most ideal climates for cannabis — Western
##### Australia’s South West — our indoor and solar-powered greenhouse cycles ensure a consistent,
##### premium-grade supply for globally compliant, patient-focused outcomes.

[Our Genetics & Cultivation][13]

##### At Cannaponics, our strains are more than genetics — they’re the outcome of care, innovation,
##### and strategic cultivation.

[Learn more][14]

Leading Stainless Steel Process Equipment Manufacturer

At Cedarstone Industry, we work in tandem with our clients to arrive at truly turn-key solutions for commercial food, beverage, extraction, and brewery applications . As an industrial stainless steel process equipment manufacturer , we provide equipment such as stainless vessels, stainless steel mixing tanks , stainless aseptic tanks, crystallization reactors , extraction system, stainless storage tanks , etc. Additionally, we go above and beyond by providing complete automation turnkey solutions for our clients.

Learn More About Us

We’re Customer First

We augment our exhaustive list of services with a truly comprehensive catalog of stainless steel process equipment, extraction systems, and brewing systems . This includes custom mixing tanks, storage, vessels, tanks, food processing , and other stainless brewing equipment . At Cedarstone, the customer truly comes first . We lead in the industry with both competitive prices on stainless steel tanks and fittings as well as extensive customization for the products we provide. As an extraction equipment, brewery tank and stainless food processing equipment manufacturer, we know what your business needs.

Our Customers

UL and 3A Certified, ASME Partner

As a UL and 3A certified manufacturer, Cedarstone strictly follows UL508A – industrial control panels standard, and UL 698A- Industrial Control Panels Relating to Hazardous (Classified) Locations. We also adhere to the UL Standard 508A, Industrial Control Panels Canadian Standard CSA C22.2 No. 14, Standard for Industrial Control Equipment. We also strict follow ASME Boiler and Pressure code to design & manufacture stainless steel tanks, fittings, and pressure vessels.

We understand that every industry has its own requirements; there’s no one-size-fits-all approach for stainless steel brewing, mixing or storage equipment. From choosing between single-wall and jackets tanks, or customizable tank capacities, we have it all! Contact us for any queries regarding stainless brewing equipment product specifications.

Contact Us

6 Reasons to Choose Us as Your Stainless Steel Process Equipment Manufacturer

Installation Experience

We’re not only a stainless tanks and system manufacturer that specializes in stainless steel process equipment, we install them too. Numerous worldwide installation project record; Unsurpassed installation experience; Excellent quality control & progress supervision.

Manufacturing Capacity

We have an over 300,000-square-foot plant that houses a comprehensive world-class brewery tanks manufacturing facility. We have skilled workers and engineers and a 100-foot-high ceiling production workshop. We are capable of manufacturing up to 16 feet OD, 5000 bbls vessel.

ASME Standards

We strictly follow ASME’s (American Society of Mechanical Engineers) stainless steel tank design and 3A fitting standards.

Quality Assurance

20 years of experience in industries with high sanitation standards. Our complete line of manufacturing and quality control apparatuses ensure the quality of our products.

Customer Base

As a stainless process equipment and brewery tanks manufacturer, we are proud that our food processing systems have been used by Heineken, Coca-Cola, Global Beerco USA, AB InBev, ThyssenKrupp, Indonesian Orang Tau, Mongolian Haanjims, Tsingtao Brewery, and other firms in dozens of countries.

Working Culture

Cedarstone maintains a professional and humble working philosophy. Your satisfaction with your stainless steel vessels, mixing, storage tank, extraction, brewing, and processing system is our #1 goal.

Our Certifications

Contact us for a quote!

Certified stainless steel process equipment for the most demanding customers

At Cedarstone Industry, we take pride in our commitment to producing high-quality stainless steel process equipment such as tanks, mixers, fittings, and other components that meet rigorous industry standards. When designing our products, we strictly follow the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) Boiler and Pressure Vessel code. This allows us to ensure that all our design, manufacturing and testing processes meet widely recognized safety and quality standards.

Thanks to it, we’re able to ensure that our stainless solutions are designed and manufactured to prevent contamination and guarantee the safety and quality of products.

At Cedarstone Industry, we take pride in our commitment to producing high-quality stainless steel process equipment such as tanks, mixers, fittings, and other components that meet rigorous industry standards. Over 20 years of experience in industries with high sanitation standards

With over 20 years of experience as a stainless steel process equipment manufacturer for the food, beverage, extraction, and brewery industries, we have developed a deep understanding of the needs and requirements of each of these sectors. We recognize the importance of meeting high sanitation standards, that’s why we strive to continuously refine our processes to ensure our offer meets the expectations of even the most demanding customers.

Over the years in the industry, we have learned how to design and manufacture stainless steel process equipment that is durable, reliable, and easy to clean.

Our team of experts has the knowledge and experience necessary to provide turn-key solutions for a variety of industries. We work closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and requirements in order to develop custom solutions that will facilitate their everyday work.

Our Customers

Professional stainless steel process equipment manufacturer for your needs

Cedarstone Industry is your professional and accessible stainless steel process equipment manufacturer ready to provide you with systems and tanks tailored to your needs. Thanks to working with clients from various sectors, we have developed a deep understanding of their needs and requirements. Thanks to it, we’re able to provide companies with reliable solutions for different purposes.

We’re real experts in our field who believe in a humble working philosophy. We put the client first, always striving to exceed expectations and provide exceptional customer service. Contact us today to find top-notch stainless steel process equipment tailored to the needs of your organization.

Contact Us

Frequently Asked Questions

What types of stainless steel tanks or equipment do you manufacture?

Our core products include a wide range of sanitary tanks and vessels such as mixing tanks, storage tanks, aseptic tanks, and pressure vessels. We specialize in sanitary processing systems, including centrifuge extractors, crystallization reactors, filtration skids, complete cannabis/hemp extraction lines, commercial brewing systems, fermenters, and bioreactors. Additional equipment includes heat exchangers, steam jacketed kettles, distillation columns, CIP (clean-in-place) systems, flash and tunnel pasteurizers, high-shear mixers, vacuum homogenizers, sanitary pumps, valves, fittings, and full automation solutions. All products are built to stringent standards (ASME, 3A, UL, GMP) with an emphasis on custom fabrication, hygiene, and turnkey installation.

Do you build custom tanks or only standard sizes?

We specialize in custom stainless steel tanks and build the majority of our tanks to each customer’s exact specifications. Whether you need a specific capacity, unique dimensions to fit your facility, special fittings, agitation, heating/cooling jackets, ASME certification, or compliance with 3A, GMP, or pharma-grade requirements, we design and fabricate everything in-house.

We do maintain a few popular standard-size tanks (such as 50-gal and 100-gal mixing or storage tanks) for customers who want faster delivery and lower cost. In short, if you can draw it or describe it, we can build it — custom is our strength

What industries do you serve?

We primarily serve industries that require high-purity, sanitary stainless steel processing equipment. Our main markets are:

Craft and large-scale brewing & distilling

Food & beverage processing (dairy, sauces, edibles, ready-to-drink, cold brew coffee, etc.)

Cannabis and hemp extraction & refinement

Pharmaceutical & nutraceutical

Biotech & life sciences

Cosmetics & personal care

Chemical & specialty chemical processing

Over 90 % of our projects fall into one of these sectors, and all of our equipment is designed and built to meet the specific regulatory and hygiene standards of each industry (ASME, 3A, GMP, FDA, UL, CRN, etc.). If your process involves liquids, semi-solids, or extraction and needs sanitary or ASME-coded stainless steel, we most likely serve your industry

Are your tanks food-grade and sanitary (FDA / 3A)?

Yes — all of our tanks and process equipment are built to food-grade and sanitary standards as standard practice.

Material: 304 or 316L stainless steel (customer’s choice) with certified mill test reports

Interior finish: 2B mill finish on storage tanks; Ra ≤ 32 µin (0.8 µm) mechanical

# About Us

Cedarstone Industry is a leading U.S.-based manufacturer of premium stainless steel process
equipment, with over 20 years of experience delivering complete turnkey food processing systems to
the food & beverage, pharmaceutical, biotech, and chemical industries.

Backed by a team of engineers, fabricators, and process specialists, Cedarstone excels in designing
and building full turnkey [food processing equipment][120], including [blending/mixing
systems][121], [CIP (Clean-In-Place) systems][122], [pasteurizers][123], as well as [brewing
systems][124], [extraction equipment][125], and pressure vessels. All engineered to meet the
strictest ASME, UL, and 3A sanitary standards.

Trusted by global industry leaders such as Tesla, Nestle, Air Liquide, and Krones, Cedarstone
combines deep hands-on industry expertise with advanced engineering capabilities to design
high-performance, fully compliant, and scalable processing systems.

### WE SERVE BIG AND SMALL

Proudly certified by UL 698A Industrial Control Panels Relating to Hazardous (Classified) Locations
and UL Standard 508A, Standard for Industrial Control Panels Canadian Standard CSA C22.2 No. 14,
Standard for Industrial Control Equipment, The American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME),
National Board of Boiler & Pressure Vessel Inspectors(NBBI), and 3A 25-03, 32-03, and 63-03 Sanitary
Standards.

# About Us

Cedarstone Industry is a leading U.S.-based manufacturer of premium stainless steel process
equipment, with over 20 years of experience delivering complete turnkey food processing systems to
the food & beverage, pharmaceutical, biotech, and chemical industries.

Backed by a team of engineers, fabricators, and process specialists, Cedarstone excels in designing
and building full turnkey [food processing equipment][120], including [blending/mixing
systems][121], [CIP (Clean-In-Place) systems][122], [pasteurizers][123], as well as [brewing
systems][124], [extraction equipment][125], and pressure vessels. All engineered to meet the
strictest ASME, UL, and 3A sanitary standards.

Trusted by global industry leaders such as Tesla, Nestle, Air Liquide, and Krones, Cedarstone
combines deep hands-on industry expertise with advanced engineering capabilities to design
high-performance, fully compliant, and scalable processing systems.

### WE SERVE BIG AND SMALL

Proudly certified by UL 698A Industrial Control Panels Relating to Hazardous (Classified) Locations
and UL Standard 508A, Standard for Industrial Control Panels Canadian Standard CSA C22.2 No. 14,
Standard for Industrial Control Equipment, The American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME),
National Board of Boiler & Pressure Vessel Inspectors(NBBI), and 3A 25-03, 32-03, and 63-03 Sanitary
Standards.

Somos un centro médico especializado en tratamientos con Cannabis Medicinal.
Contamos con equipo médico, legal y psicológico que ofrecen un servicio y acompañamiento integral al paciente y usuario.
La modalidad es online mediante atenciones por video llamada.

Servicios

Consulta Médica Cannábica

Atención Psicológica

Asesoría Legal​

RECETARIO MAGISTRAL

Se conoce como farmacia magistral a la modalidad que comprende la preparación de los medicamentos en base a Cannabis con THC y/o CBD al momento en que se prescribe la receta.
El paciente con su Receta Médica Física o Receta Electrónica de Mariamed puede visitar alguna farmacia para la elaboración de un producto en base al tratamiento establecido en su prescripción, el cual puede ser en cápsulas, aceite sublingual, gomitas, trociscos, resina y extractos para vaporización, entre otros.
Dentro de los productos que producimos para el uso humano, tenemos los aceites, cremas, lociones, unguentos, champús, soluciones para otros fines, todos producidos con las siguientes materias primas: THC Full Spectrum, CBD Full Spectrum, CBD Asilado, CBD Broad Spectrum. Linea veterinaria, Ademas capsulas, trociscos (gomitas).

Estos productos tienen las siguientes ventajas:
> Elaborado en base a preparado FULL SPECTRUM, con informe de cannabinoides, terpenos y flavonoides.
> Receta magistral puede indicar el % de cannabinoides deseados.
> Autorizados por el ISP Esta es la forma más segura tanto en cantidades, concentraciones y registros sanitarios que recomendamos aparte de las otras vías de acceso

Preguntas Frecuentes (FAQ)

¿Es legal la receta electrónica?

Si, en en nuestra consulta médica se extienden recetas que no son retenidas, por lo tanto no requieren firma electrónica avanzada. Nuestras prescripciones contienen firma digital y código QR , la cual podrás imprimir o portar en tu celular.
Producto de la pandemia causada por el COVID-19 se han dictado numerosas resoluciones (204-2020) que han regulado con mayor detalle este tipo de atención y prestación. FONASA al respecto señala “Si el doctor debe entregar una receta médica, ésta la podrá enviar digitalmente para que el paciente la imprima o muestre en la farmacia, a excepción de aquellas recetas para estupefacientes o psicotrópicos, que deben seguir siendo emitidas físicamente, o aquellas que requieren firma electrónica avanzada.”

¿Puedo cultivar con receta médica?

Los pacientes con Receta Médica que indique el uso de Cannabis pueden cultivar para su uso personal y próximo en el tiempo, justificado por este documento emitido por un Médico Cirujano que indique el diagnóstico, tratamiento y duración según el artículo 8 de la Ley 20.000 y su nueva indicación agregada por la Ley Antinarcos.

¿Cuáles son las 5 enfermedades más tratadas con Cannabis Medicinal?

– Fibromialgia
– Ansiedad y depresión
– Insomnio
– Dolor Crónico
– Bruxismo

¿De qué se trata Mariamed?

Somos un centro médico que nace el año 2017 enfocado en tratamientos de cannabis medicinal y terapias alternativas. Contamos con equipo médico, legal y psicológico compuesto por profesionales especializados para ofrecer un servicio con una visión amplia de salud.
El usuario puede optar por una atención médica cannábica donde se analizará si el paciente se puede ver beneficiado de un tratamiento con cannabis, en el cual nosotros ofrecemos la educación, orientación, acompañamiento e indicación del tratamiento conforme al marco legal vigente en Chile.
Si el Paciente califica para un tratamiento en base a cannabis puede optar a adquirir un producto farmacéutico a través de Receta Magistral o un tratamiento particular, además de contar con la documentación necesaria para justificar el uso del cannabis medicinal y personal basado en su tratamiento médico.

¿Qué pasa si no tengo cómo acreditar mi enfermedad?

En ese caso te recomendamos tomar una hora con nuestros terapeutas para acreditar documentalmente tu condición y luego puedes tomar una hora médica con nuestros especialistas.

¿Qué debo llevar a la consulta? (exámenes, documentos, etc.)

Cualquier documentación como por ejemplo diagnóstico, epicreses, control, entre otros que acrediten tu patología o molestia sirve para agilizar el proceso de diagnóstico por parte del médico.

¿Es legal la receta electrónica?

Sí, en en nuestra consulta médica se extienden recetas que no son retenidas, por lo tanto no requieren firma electrónica avanzada. Nuestras prescripciones contienen firma digital y código QR , la cual podrás imprimir o portar en tu celular.
Producto de la pandemia causada por el COVID-19 se han dictado numerosas resoluciones (204-2020) que han regulado con mayor detalle este tipo de atención y prestación. FONASA al respecto señala “Si el doctor debe entregar una receta médica, ésta la podrá enviar digitalmente para que el paciente la imprima o muestre en la farmacia, a excepción de aquellas recetas para estupefacientes o psicotrópicos, que deben seguir siendo emitidas físicamente, o aquellas que requieren firma electrónica avanzada.”
Además para recetas magistrales nuestros especialistas se encuentran inscritos en RECEMED, por lo cual con su firma y formato electrónico se podrán adquirir productos farmacéuticos y farmacias y laboratorios.

¿El médico está certificado?

Los médicos cirujanos de nuestra consulta cuentan con registro en la Superintendencia de Salud y Eunacom aprobado.
Artículo 6 de la ley 20.000: El médico cirujano, odontólogo o médico veterinario que recete alguna de las sustancias señaladas en el artículo 1º, sin necesidad médica o terapéutica, será penado con presidio mayor en sus grados mínimo a medio y multa de cuarenta a cuatrocientas unidades tributarias mensuales.
A contrario sensu por tanto cualquier médico cirujano, dentista o veterinario puede prescribir cannábis en Chile si hay necesidad médica o terapéutica.
Además el año 2015 se hizo una regulación para la venta medicinal de cannabis que contenga THC:
Decreto 84 del Ministerio de Salud: Promulgado el 30 de Octubre de 2015, autoriza la venta de Cannabis y derivados como productos farmacéuticos a través de Farmacias y Laboratorios bajo Receta Médica (sumidades floridas o con fruto de la planta de Cannabis, resina no extraída. Resina separada, en bruto o purificada, obtenida de la planta de Cannabis)

¿Puedo optar por una receta cannábica para consumir cannabis con fines recreativos?

No, en Chile a diferencia de otros países tenemos una legislación más permisiva respecto del Cannabis, permitiendo su uso exclusivo y personal fundamentado siempre con antecedentes médicos.
Sin embargo aún falta regulación para expandir la legalidad para el consumo y cultivo de esta planta con fines recreacionales. No está demás decir que hay un sinnúmero de enfermedades que pueden tratarse con el Cannabis y sus derivados, siendo este un tratamiento paliativo y por tanto, complementario en cuanto a la medicina en general.

¿Qué me recomiendan para tal enfermedad?

Para diagnósticos, tratamientos y dosis para ciertos dolores y enfermedades lo mejor es consultar con un especialista. En nuestro centro médico contamos con médicos cirujanos especialistas en Cannabis medicinal que pueden orientarte y darte una receta.

Si no tengo documentos médicos ¿puedo atenderme?

En ese caso como no tienes un diagnóstico o algo que acredite una dolencia puedes agendar una hora con nuestro psicólogo para evidenciar eso y luego pasas por interconsulta con nuestros médicos por tu tratamiento cannábico.

FONASA al respecto señala “Si el doctor debe entregar una receta médica, ésta la podrá enviar digitalmente para que el paciente la imprima o muestre en la farmacia, a excepción de aquellas recetas para estupefacientes o psicotrópicos, que deben seguir siendo emitidas físicamente, o aquellas que requieren firma electrónica avanzada.”
Además para recetas magistrales nuestros especialistas se encuentran inscritos en RECEMED, por lo cual con su firma y formato electrónico se podrán adquirir productos farmacéuticos y farmacias y laboratorios.

¿El médico está certificado?

Los médicos cirujanos de nuestra consulta cuentan con registro en la Superintendencia de Salud y Eunacom aprobado.
Artículo 6 de la ley 20.000: El médico cirujano, odontólogo o médico veterinario que recete alguna de las sustancias señaladas en el artículo 1º, sin necesidad médica o terapéutica, será penado con presidio mayor en sus grados mínimo a medio y multa de cuarenta a cuatrocientas unidades tributarias mensuales.
A contrario sensu por tanto cualquier médico cirujano, dentista o veterinario puede prescribir cannábis en Chile si hay necesidad médica o terapéutica.
Además el año 2015 se hizo una regulación para la venta medicinal de cannabis que contenga THC:
Decreto 84 del Ministerio de Salud: Promulgado el 30 de Octubre de 2015, autoriza la venta de Cannabis y derivados como productos farmacéuticos a través de Farmacias y Laboratorios bajo Receta Médica (sumidades floridas o con fruto de la planta de Cannabis, resina no extraída. Resina separada, en bruto o purificada, obtenida de la planta de Cannabis)

¿Puedo optar por una receta cannábica para consumir cannabis con fines recreativos?

No, en Chile a diferencia de otros países tenemos una legislación más permisiva respecto del Cannabis, permitiendo su uso exclusivo y personal fundamentado siempre con antecedentes médicos.
Sin embargo aún falta regulación para expandir la legalidad para el consumo y cultivo de esta planta con fines recreacionales. No está demás decir que hay un sinnúmero de enfermedades que pueden tratarse con el Cannabis y sus derivados, siendo este un tratamiento paliativo y por tanto, complementario en cuanto a la medicina en general.

¿Qué me recomiendan para tal enfermedad?

Para diagnósticos, tratamientos y dosis para ciertos dolores y enfermedades lo mejor es consultar con un especialista. En nuestro centro médico contamos con médicos cirujanos especialistas en Cannabis medicinal que pueden orientarte y darte una receta.

Si no tengo documentos médicos ¿puedo atenderme?

En ese caso como no tienes un diagnóstico o algo que acredite una dolencia puedes agendar una hora con nuestro psicólogo para evidenciar eso y luego pasas por interconsulta con nuestros médicos por tu tratamiento cannábico.

## Who we are

MH medical hemp GmbH is an innovative and technologically leading company specializing in
cannabidiol (CBD) extraction, production and worldwide marketing of hemp-based cannabinoids and
products containing CBD.

All our efforts are committed to make the plant Cannabis sativa and its valuable components usable
for the food, cosmetics and pharmaceutical industries.

At MH medical hemp we offer bulk Cannabidiol rich hemp extracts, CBD oils and CBD isolate to
formulators and manufacturers around the world – supporting and supplying them for their own line of
CBD products.

Besides the activities in the supplement and cosmetic industries MH medical hemp GmbH has become a
GDP certified pharmaceutical wholesaler for medicinal cannabis flowers and is in the GMP
certification process for pharmaceutical manufacturing of cannabinoid based medicine.

## What we offer
* With 30 years of accumulated expertise and insight knowledge of the cannabis industry, we are
perfectly positioned to cater to the market’s needs
* No „hype train“: long term existing network and key players acting in the German hemp business
since 1995 (men of the first hour)
* Capable of predicting trends and staying one step ahead of the market
* Access to one of the most promising medical cannabis markets in the world
* Licensed pharma wholesaler, plus license to handle narcotics, an officially certified quality
assurance system according to GDP standards followed by German GMP production of API´s

## Who we are

MH medical hemp GmbH is an innovative and technologically leading company specializing in
cannabidiol (CBD) extraction, production and worldwide marketing of hemp-based cannabinoids and
products containing CBD.

All our efforts are committed to make the plant Cannabis sativa and its valuable components usable
for the food, cosmetics and pharmaceutical industries.

At MH medical hemp we offer bulk Cannabidiol rich hemp extracts, CBD oils and CBD isolate to
formulators and manufacturers around the world – supporting and supplying them for their own line of
CBD products.

Besides the activities in the supplement and cosmetic industries MH medical hemp GmbH has become a
GDP certified pharmaceutical wholesaler for medicinal cannabis flowers and is in the GMP
certification process for pharmaceutical manufacturing of cannabinoid based medicine.

## What we offer
* With 30 years of accumulated expertise and insight knowledge of the cannabis industry, we are
perfectly positioned to cater to the market’s needs
* No „hype train“: long term existing network and key players acting in the German hemp business
since 1995 (men of the first hour)
* Capable of predicting trends and staying one step ahead of the market
* Access to one of the most promising medical cannabis markets in the world
* Licensed pharma wholesaler, plus license to handle narcotics, an officially certified quality
assurance system according to GDP standards followed by German GMP production of API´s

## About PURE5™ Extraction

**PURE5™** is the most innovative cannabis & [hemp extraction equipment company][84]. With our
superior technology and unique approach to extracting botanicals with minimal degradation to the
natural constituents, we have set a new level of standards in the cannabis industry. Our gentle
extraction process does not stress the material with extreme temperature or exposes it to harmful
solvents that denature the natural plant values. We provide you the natural plant vitality in the
most unaltered form.

Our process gets its name from its superiority in all five senses. From the moment you **hear** how
quiet the process is to the moment you **see, smell, touch** and **taste** the final product, the
**PURE5™** process delivers purity in all five senses.

# 25L Mold & Yeast Remediation Reactor

## Remediation Method
* Ozone + Temperature

## Processing Vessel
* **Volume:** 40L vessel holds up to 25L of extract
* **Pressure:** Not pressurized
* **Temperature:** Max 125°C/257°F
* **Material:** 304 stainless steel
* **Vessel:** Interior is polished to food grade level
* **Closures:** flange
* **Sealing:** Flanges with PTFE flat seals
* **Temperature measurement:** Pt 100 sensors
* **Water Jacket volume:** 10 Liters (5.13 gallons)
* **Heater:** 1400 W
* **Raw material feed:** top loading
* **Residue removal:** flange closure, manual

## Flow Control
* Ozone: Dozed to 5ppm
* Air Flow: Controlled airflow
* Pressure: Maximum operating pressure 2 bar
* Temperature: max 35°C (95°F)
* Materials: 304 stainless steel
* Seals: PTFE flat seals
* Measurement: flow meter control
* Flow path: continuous with no obstructions

## Heat Exchanger
* **Construction:** Heat jacket
* **Materials:** 304 stainless steel
* **Heating Fluid:** PG

## Condenser
* **Cooling:** convection
* **Temperature range:** -10C to 50C (14F to 122F)
* **Maximum liquid content:** 2L

## Physical Dimensions
* **Height**: 1370 mm
* **Length**: 680 mm
* **Depth**: 470 mm
* **Total weight**: apr. 100 kg

## Power Supply
* **Voltage:** 220V
* **Power:** 4kW (4-way 50A Plug)

## Control System
* **Functions**: Fully Automatic Programmable PLC, touch screen interface with first-level
functionality and user-programmable pressure, temperature, and time.
* **Safety**: Non-Flamable, Non-Explosive, Non-Toxic, pressure transducers monitor system pressure
and shut down the system to prevent accidental over-pressurization.

## Extraction

R134a aerosol equipment designed and manufactured by PURE5™ Extraction is one of the latest cutting
edge techniques to enhance the speed, improve the efficacy and achieve best quality of the cannabis
extracts. Using R134a aerosol gas is a cutting-edge process that offers a “solventless” approach to
the extraction of the desired active compounds from the cannabis plant material. This process is
designed to directly replace the CO2 liquified gas process and falls into the same category of
facility certification less the pressure vessel and toxic leakage monitoring.

The small size, non polar and inert nature of the aerosol molecule helps to penetrate the plant
tissue and extracts thoroughly the oil soluble fractions. We extraction is performed at room
temperature conditions with no thermal degradation or loss of volatile compounds during isolation
and the extraction process is seamless to the full spectrum resin delivered from the plant. Full
terpene profile is collected without degradation of components and it is easily separated from
solvent.

The aerosol does not extract solids and chlorophylls and in many cases winterization may not be
required. The extracts are PH neutral and suitable for many pharmaceutical applications that are pH
sensitive. Low boiling point eliminates the need for complex and slow solvent recovery.

The extracted oil is a liquid mirror of the flower strain profile and bears the same experience when
consumed, an experience that cannot be achieved with any other extract.

## Infusion

Very often your flower may end up with potency that is below than the market accepted value. For
example if your dispensary takes over 20% potent flower and your grow batch is tested at 15% do not
worry, we have the solution for you. You just infuse your flower with the extra 5% you need in
minutes utilizing the same equipment you used to extract it. The room temperature safe and gentle
process using PURE5 Equipment allows multiple uses of the process.

We have designed revolutionary technology because we are looking at the cannabis industry the same
way as the gourmet industry. Give your clients an experience that they have never seen before. Just
cook for them in the PURE5 machine, mix and extract flavors all together, infuse the flower with
natural oils, and remediate components form the flower. All that is possible with minimum effort,
speak with us for more details on how to achieve best performance.

Since we have mentioned the gourmet experience, you can enhance your cannabis products with local
flavors and sensations. Example recipes: Add 50g fresh ginger root in the extraction chamber with
your cannabis flower to add the spicy ginger flavor to your vape juice. Add 100g mango fruit to add
tropical flavor. Add 50g lavender flowers or lemon peels to boost the linalool and limonene terpene
in your extract produced from your flower.

## Description

Introducing our entry-level 10L LPE fully automated cannabis Aerosol Extraction equipment, a
cutting-edge solution for cannabis extraction. Using natural R134A solvent, this system preserves
essential plant compounds at room temperature and low pressure. It's user-friendly, cost-effective,
and ensures pure, Full Spectrum extracts. From farming to distillation, PURE5™ offers a complete
range of cannabis processing equipment, providing businesses with everything they need for
high-quality, efficient processing. Experience innovation and quality with PURE5™.

Discover the convenience of renting our 10L LPE Full Automatic Aerosol Extraction System for as low
as $2,750 per month. Benefit from its features without the need for a long-term purchase commitment.
Minimum rental period: 6 months.

## Extraction

R134a aerosol equipment designed and manufactured by PURE5™ Extraction is one of the latest cutting
edge techniques to enhance the speed, improve the efficacy and achieve best quality of the cannabis
extracts. Using R134a aerosol gas is a cutting-edge process that offers a “solventless” approach to
the extraction of the desired active compounds from the cannabis plant material. This process is
designed to directly replace the CO2 liquified gas process and falls into the same category of
facility certification less the pressure vessel and toxic leakage monitoring.

The small size, non polar and inert nature of the aerosol molecule helps to penetrate the plant
tissue and extracts thoroughly the oil soluble fractions. We extraction is performed at room
temperature conditions with no thermal degradation or loss of volatile compounds during isolation
and the extraction process is seamless to the full spectrum resin delivered from the plant. Full
terpene profile is collected without degradation of components and it is easily separated from
solvent.

The aerosol does not extract solids and chlorophylls and in many cases winterization may not be
required. The extracts are PH neutral and suitable for many pharmaceutical applications that are pH
sensitive. Low boiling point eliminates the need for complex and slow solvent recovery.

The extracted oil is a liquid mirror of the flower strain profile and bears the same experience when
consumed, an experience that cannot be achieved with any other extract.

## Infusion

Very often your flower may end up with potency that is below than the market accepted value. For
example if your dispensary takes over 20% potent flower and your grow batch is tested at 15% do not
worry, we have the solution for you. You just infuse your flower with the extra 5% you need in
minutes utilizing the same equipment you used to extract it. The room temperature safe and gentle
process using PURE5 Equipment allows multiple uses of the process.

We have designed revolutionary technology because we are looking at the cannabis industry the same
way as the gourmet industry. Give your clients an experience that they have never seen before. Just
cook for them in the PURE5 machine, mix and extract flavors all together, infuse the flower with
natural oils, and remediate components form the flower. All that is possible with minimum effort,
speak with us for more details on how to achieve best performance.

Since we have mentioned the gourmet experience, you can enhance your cannabis products with local
flavors and sensations. Example recipes: Add 50g fresh ginger root in the extraction chamber with
your cannabis flower to add the spicy ginger flavor to your vape juice. Add 100g mango fruit to add
tropical flavor. Add 50g lavender flowers or lemon peels to boost the linalool and limonene terpene
in your extract produced from your flower.

nozzles**, **automated dosing**, and **PLC-programmable controls** to ensure flawless
operation—batch after batch.

Its integrated heated mixer and feed system maintain oil fluidity throughout the process, enabling
**accurate micro-dosing (0.3–3 mL)** into a wide range of cartridge types. With a small footprint,
food-grade components, and a user-friendly interface, this unit is ideal for **licensed vape
manufacturers**, **formulation labs**, and **automated production environments** looking to scale
with precision and speed.

## Filling Process

The PURE5™ Vape Filling Machine is built to handle **thick, high-viscosity cannabis oils and
botanical concentrates**—delivering smooth and accurate fills across the production line. Here's how
the process works:
1. **Heating & Homogenization**
The oil is first loaded into a **3000 mL stainless steel heated mixer**, where it is **gently
stirred and heated (up to 70°C / 160°F)** to ensure a uniform, flowable consistency.
2. **Automatic Transfer & Pre-Fill Heating**
The prepared oil is then **automatically transferred** to a **300 mL heated barrel** located at
the dispensing head. Jacketed piping and reservoirs ensure the oil retains its temperature and
flow characteristics during transfer.
3. **Precision Dosing with Heated Nozzle**
Using a **robotic X-Z axis filling head** and **X-Y positioning table**, the machine lines up
each vape cartridge and fills it with a programmable dose between **0.3 mL and 3 mL**. The
**stainless steel nozzle** is also **temperature-controlled (up to 50°C / 158°F)** to prevent
blockages and ensure clean, bubble-free fills.
4. **Tray Compatibility & Easy Handling**
Custom **Teflon trays with jacketed heating** maintain the cartridge’s environment, improving
fill performance and ensuring consistent results across the tray.

This fully automated filling system drastically reduces manual labor, enhances product consistency,
and eliminates the mess and waste typical of hand-filling setups.

## Automation & Features

The PURE5™ Vape Filling Machine is built around **precision automation**, allowing operators to
**program and run complete filling cycles** with minimal oversight:
* **User-Friendly PLC Interface**
A fully programmable **touchscreen controller** lets you set and adjust volume, temperature,
timing, and nozzle position—all with intuitive operation and recipe recall.
* **Full Temperature Control**
From the **oil mixer** to the **PTFE feed lines** and **nozzle**, every stage of the process is
**electrically heated** and monitored by **temperature sensors**, ensuring stable oil viscosity
throughout the workflow.
* **Compact, Clean Design**
With a **600x600x600 mm** aluminum body (black anodized), this machine fits seamlessly into most
lab or light industrial settings. At just 50 kg, it’s lightweight and easy to integrate into
modular workstations or mobile setups.
* **Safety Systems**
The unit includes an **emergency stop**, sensor-based monitoring, and electronic controllers to
prevent overheating or overfilling, enhancing both **operator safety** and **product
reliability**.

Whether you’re filling premium distillates, live resin blends, or flavored botanical oils, the
PURE5™ Vape Filling Machine offers **production-level performance** in a compact and scalable
platform.

## Extraction

R134a aerosol equipment designed and manufactured by PURE5™ Extraction is one of the latest cutting
edge techniques to enhance the speed, improve the efficacy and achieve best quality of the cannabis
extracts. Using R134a aerosol gas is a cutting-edge process that offers a “solventless” approach to
the extraction of the desired active compounds from the cannabis plant material. This process is
designed to directly replace the CO2 liquified gas process and falls into the same category of
facility certification less the pressure vessel and toxic leakage monitoring.

The small size, non polar and inert nature of the aerosol molecule helps to penetrate the plant
tissue and extracts thoroughly the oil soluble fractions. We extraction is performed at room
temperature conditions with no thermal degradation or loss of volatile compounds during isolation
and the extraction process is seamless to the full spectrum resin delivered from the plant. Full
terpene profile is collected without degradation of components and it is easily separated from
solvent.

The aerosol does not extract solids and chlorophylls and in many cases winterization may not be
required. The extracts are PH neutral and suitable for many pharmaceutical applications that are pH
sensitive. Low boiling point eliminates the need for complex and slow solvent recovery.

The extracted oil is a liquid mirror of the flower strain profile and bears the same experience when
consumed, an experience that cannot be achieved with any other extract.

## Infusion

example if your dispensary takes over 20% potent flower and your grow batch is tested at 15% do not
worry, we have the solution for you. You just infuse your flower with the extra 5% you need in
minutes utilizing the same equipment you used to extract it. The room temperature safe and gentle
process using PURE5 Equipment allows multiple uses of the process.

We have designed revolutionary technology because we are looking at the cannabis industry the same
way as the gourmet industry. Give your clients an experience that they have never seen before. Just
cook for them in the PURE5 machine, mix and extract flavors all together, infuse the flower with
natural oils, and remediate components form the flower. All that is possible with minimum effort,
speak with us for more details on how to achieve best performance.

Since we have mentioned the gourmet experience, you can enhance your cannabis products with local
flavors and sensations. Example recipes: Add 50g fresh ginger root in the extraction chamber with
your cannabis flower to add the spicy ginger flavor to your vape juice. Add 100g mango fruit to add
tropical flavor. Add 50g lavender flowers or lemon peels to boost the linalool and limonene terpene
in your extract produced from your flower.

## Description

The PURE5™ 120L SHW Extraction System is our flagship, high-capacity botanical extraction unit
engineered for **large-scale, solventless production**. Utilizing only **superheated water under
controlled pressure**, this system delivers clean, full-spectrum extracts with no need for ethanol,
hydrocarbons, or post-processing. Built for maximum efficiency, the 120L SHW features **dual 60L
extraction vessels**, capable of handling up to **54 lbs of dry plant material per batch**—making it
an ideal solution for **commercial producers**, **contract manufacturers**, and **licensed
extraction facilities**.

Backed by advanced automation, industrial-grade materials, and a compact, fully integrated skid
design, the 120L SHW System redefines botanical extraction with **clean technology, reduced
overhead**, and **consistent, premium-quality outputs**.

## Extraction

At the heart of the 120L SHW system is a **sophisticated, solventless extraction process** powered
by **superheated liquid water**. Here’s a breakdown of how it works:
1. **Thermal Activation**
Water is heated up to **180°C (356°F)** while pressurized to maintain its liquid form. Under
these conditions, water undergoes a significant change in polarity, allowing it to mimic the
behavior of an **organic solvent**—capable of extracting a broad spectrum of active compounds
from plant biomass.
2. **Penetration & Solubilization**
The heated, pressurized water is passed through the plant material inside **two 60L extraction
chambers**, efficiently dissolving and carrying both **lipophilic and hydrophilic
compounds**—including cannabinoids, terpenes, essential oils, flavonoids, and other valuable
actives.
3. **Cooling & Separation**
Once extraction is complete, the system initiates a **cool-down and depressurization cycle**. As
the water returns to its natural high-polarity state, the solubility of the dissolved compounds
drops dramatically. This shift causes the actives to **precipitate or separate out** naturally,
enabling straightforward collection without chemical residues or aggressive separation methods.

This cutting-edge method is **eco-friendly**, **GMP-ready**, and ideal for businesses aiming to
reduce operating risk, eliminate solvent handling, and **achieve pure, reproducible results** at
industrial scale.

## System & Automation

## Extraction

R134a aerosol equipment designed and manufactured by PURE5™ Extraction is one of the latest cutting
edge techniques to enhance the speed, improve the efficacy and achieve best quality of the cannabis
extracts. Using R134a aerosol gas is a cutting-edge process that offers a “solventless” approach to
the extraction of the desired active compounds from the cannabis plant material. This process is
designed to directly replace the CO2 liquified gas process and falls into the same category of
facility certification less the pressure vessel and toxic leakage monitoring.

The small size, non polar and inert nature of the aerosol molecule helps to penetrate the plant
tissue and extracts thoroughly the oil soluble fractions. We extraction is performed at room
temperature conditions with no thermal degradation or loss of volatile compounds during isolation
and the extraction process is seamless to the full spectrum resin delivered from the plant. Full
terpene profile is collected without degradation of components and it is easily separated from
solvent.

The aerosol does not extract solids and chlorophylls and in many cases winterization may not be
required. The extracts are PH neutral and suitable for many pharmaceutical applications that are pH
sensitive. Low boiling point eliminates the need for complex and slow solvent recovery.

The extracted oil is a liquid mirror of the flower strain profile and bears the same experience when
consumed, an experience that cannot be achieved with any other extract.

## Infusion

Very often your flower may end up with potency that is below than the market accepted value. For
example if your dispensary takes over 20% potent flower and your grow batch is tested at 15% do not
worry, we have the solution for you. You just infuse your flower with the extra 5% you need in
minutes utilizing the same equipment you used to extract it. The room temperature safe and gentle
process using PURE5 Equipment allows multiple uses of the process.

We have designed revolutionary technology because we are looking at the cannabis industry the same
way as the gourmet industry. Give your clients an experience that they have never seen before. Just
cook for them in the PURE5 machine, mix and extract flavors all together, infuse the flower with
natural oils, and remediate components form the flower. All that is possible with minimum effort,
speak with us for more details on how to achieve best performance.

Since we have mentioned the gourmet experience, you can enhance your cannabis products with local
flavors and sensations. Example recipes: Add 50g fresh ginger root in the extraction chamber with
your cannabis flower to add the spicy ginger flavor to your vape juice. Add 100g mango fruit to add
tropical flavor. Add 50g lavender flowers or lemon peels to boost the linalool and limonene terpene
in your extract produced from your flower.

## Extraction

R134a aerosol equipment designed and manufactured by PURE5™ Extraction is one of the latest cutting
edge techniques to enhance the speed, improve the efficacy and achieve best quality of the cannabis
extracts. Using R134a aerosol gas is a cutting-edge process that offers a “solventless” approach to
the extraction of the desired active compounds from the cannabis plant material. This process is
designed to directly replace the CO2 liquified gas process and falls into the same category of
facility certification less the pressure vessel and toxic leakage monitoring.

The small size, non polar and inert nature of the aerosol molecule helps to penetrate the plant
tissue and extracts thoroughly the oil soluble fractions. We extraction is performed at room
temperature conditions with no thermal degradation or loss of volatile compounds during isolation
and the extraction process is seamless to the full spectrum resin delivered from the plant. Full
terpene profile is collected without degradation of components and it is easily separated from
solvent.

The aerosol does not extract solids and chlorophylls and in many cases winterization may not be
required. The extracts are PH neutral and suitable for many pharmaceutical applications that are pH
sensitive. Low boiling point eliminates the need for complex and slow solvent recovery.

The extracted oil is a liquid mirror of the flower strain profile and bears the same experience when
consumed, an experience that cannot be achieved with any other extract.

## Infusion

Very often your flower may end up with potency that is below than the market accepted value. For
example if your dispensary takes over 20% potent flower and your grow batch is tested at 15% do not
worry, we have the solution for you. You just infuse your flower with the extra 5% you need in
minutes utilizing the same equipment you used to extract it. The room temperature safe and gentle
process using PURE5 Equipment allows multiple uses of the process.

We have designed revolutionary technology because we are looking at the cannabis industry the same
way as the gourmet industry. Give your clients an experience that they have never seen before. Just
cook for them in the PURE5 machine, mix and extract flavors all together, infuse the flower with
natural oils, and remediate components form the flower. All that is possible with minimum effort,
speak with us for more details on how to achieve best performance.

Since we have mentioned the gourmet experience, you can enhance your cannabis products with local
flavors and sensations. Example recipes: Add 50g fresh ginger root in the extraction chamber with
your cannabis flower to add the spicy ginger flavor to your vape juice. Add 100g mango fruit to add
tropical flavor. Add 50g lavender flowers or lemon peels to boost the linalool and limonene terpene
in your extract produced from your flower.

## Description

The PURE5™ 60L SHW Extraction System is a next-generation botanical extraction solution using only
**superheated water under pressure**—no organic solvents, no post-processing, and zero residual
toxicity. With an all-stainless-steel construction and PLC-controlled automation, this system
empowers producers to extract **high-quality, full-spectrum compounds** in a **clean, safe, and
efficient** manner. Designed for reliability and high throughput, this unit processes up to **27 lbs
of dry plant material** per run and fits perfectly in GMP and food-grade compliant environments.
Whether you're extracting cannabinoids, terpenes, essential oils, or other botanicals, the 60L SHW
system delivers **repeatable, scalable results** with minimal operational complexity.

## Extraction

The 60L SHW Extraction System leverages a scientifically advanced, **solventless extraction method**
that uses **superheated water under pressure**. Here’s how it works:
1. **Phase 1: Superheating Under Pressure**
Water is heated above 100°C—up to 180°C—while pressurized inside a sealed stainless steel vessel.
This keeps it in a **liquid phase**, even at high temperatures, and alters its **polarity**,
allowing it to behave like an **organic solvent**. In this altered state, the water penetrates
plant material and efficiently dissolves **lipophilic and hydrophilic compounds**, such as
cannabinoids, flavonoids, terpenes, and polyphenols.
2. **Phase 2: Compound Extraction**
The superheated water passes through the plant biomass, effectively solubilizing target compounds
without damaging their integrity. Unlike traditional solvent-based extractions, there’s **no
chemical contamination, no hazardous residue**, and no need for ethanol or hydrocarbons.
3. **Phase 3: Cooling & Precipitation**
After extraction, the system reduces both temperature and pressure, returning the water to its
original high-polarity state. This change **decreases solubility**, causing the extracted
compounds to **precipitate or separate out** naturally. The result is a **clean, pure extract**
with full preservation of active compounds, ready for collection.

This extraction method is ideal for operations seeking **eco-conscious, efficient, and
GMP-compliant** processes. It ensures **fast processing times**, reduced operational risk, and
**premium extract quality** without costly post-processing or solvent recovery.

## System & Automation

The 60L SHW system is engineered for industrial reliability and minimal human intervention. It
features:
* A **fully automated PLC** system with a touchscreen interface, allowing custom programming of
time, temperature, and pressure.
* Built-in **safety redundancies**, including pressure transducers and relief valves, ensure safe,
uninterrupted operation.
* Efficient thermal and pressure management, using **heat exchangers and dedicated gas vessels**,
minimizes energy use and maximizes performance.
* A **modular skid design**, ready to integrate into existing production lines or stand alone in
compact facilities.

## Extraction

R134a aerosol equipment designed and manufactured by PURE5™ Extraction is one of the latest cutting
edge techniques to enhance the speed, improve the efficacy and achieve best quality of the cannabis
extracts. Using R134a aerosol gas is a cutting-edge process that offers a “solventless” approach to
the extraction of the desired active compounds from the cannabis plant material. This process is
designed to directly replace the CO2 liquified gas process and falls into the same category of
facility certification less the pressure vessel and toxic leakage monitoring.

The small size, non polar and inert nature of the aerosol molecule helps to penetrate the plant
tissue and extracts thoroughly the oil soluble fractions. We extraction is performed at room
temperature conditions with no thermal degradation or loss of volatile compounds during isolation
and the extraction process is seamless to the full spectrum resin delivered from the plant. Full
terpene profile is collected without degradation of components and it is easily separated from
solvent.

The aerosol does not extract solids and chlorophylls and in many cases winterization may not be
required. The extracts are PH neutral and suitable for many pharmaceutical applications that are pH
sensitive. Low boiling point eliminates the need for complex and slow solvent recovery.

The extracted oil is a liquid mirror of the flower strain profile and bears the same experience when
consumed, an experience that cannot be achieved with any other extract.

## Infusion

Very often your flower may end up with potency that is below than the market accepted value. For
example if your dispensary takes over 20% potent flower and your grow batch is tested at 15% do not
worry, we have the solution for you. You just infuse your flower with the extra 5% you need in
minutes utilizing the same equipment you used to extract it. The room temperature safe and gentle
process using PURE5 Equipment allows multiple uses of the process.

We have designed revolutionary technology because we are looking at the cannabis industry the same
way as the gourmet industry. Give your clients an experience that they have never seen before. Just
cook for them in the PURE5 machine, mix and extract flavors all together, infuse the flower with
natural oils, and remediate components form the flower. All that is possible with minimum effort,
speak with us for more details on how to achieve best performance.

Since we have mentioned the gourmet experience, you can enhance your cannabis products with local
flavors and sensations. Example recipes: Add 50g fresh ginger root in the extraction chamber with
your cannabis flower to add the spicy ginger flavor to your vape juice. Add 100g mango fruit to add
tropical flavor. Add 50g lavender flowers or lemon peels to boost the linalool and limonene terpene
in your extract produced from your flower.

PURE5™ is the most innovative botanical extraction equipment company focusing on cannabis and hemp.

### HTE Extraction Systems

### **R134a Aerosol Extraction Systems**

High Terpene Extraction (HTE) is perfect for extracting the fine oil fraction from every botanical.
The extraction process is gentle to the oil and the plant material, using low pressure, room
temperature, and delivers naturally potent terpene rich full-spectrum oil. It collects the complete
terpene and cannabinoid profile without degradation of components.

Our R134a [solventless cannabis extraction equipments][86] are:
* 20 Liter MAX CBD/THC extraction machine: ideal for small-scale extraction operations
* 50 Liter CBD/THC extraction machines: ideal for small to mid-scale extraction operations
* 100 Liter CBD/THC extraction machines: ideal for mid-scale scale extraction operations
* 200 Liter systems: Ideal for medium to large commercial operations
* 500 Liter systems: For large-capacity commercial production
* 1000 Liter systems: Ideal for very-large-scale production

### 1500L Ethanol Extraction System

[ View all ][87]

### **Ethanol CBD/**THC Extraction Equipment** (EtOH) – 20-1000L Ethanol Extraction System**

Ethanol is a universal solvent with power in resin and alkaloid extraction. We pair the R134a
aerosol and EtOH extraction to extract any plant material. Our [ethanol cannabis extraction
system][88] utilize a chemical process that feeds the material continuously via a conveyor into the
extraction vessel and delivers a consistent output of purified oil.
* 20-1000 liter EtOH extraction equipment: Get a better quality final product by eliminating
undesired compounds and preserve all terpenes and cannabinoids.
* Easy evaporation results in clean and pure extract without traces of solvent
* Easy-to-use Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and touchscreen interface
* Fully automatic with all safety features. Users can program pressure, temperature, and time.

### Post Processing & Test Lab Equipment Systems

[ View all ][89]

### **Lab Equipment – Post Processing & Test Lab Equipment Systems**

PURE5™ provides own-build, high-quality [cannabis lab testing equipment][90], including stainless
steel molecular systems for the distillation process, various sizes of vacuum industrial ovens, THC
remediation equipment, stainless steel isomerization, and crystallization reactors, and gas
chromatography equipment.
* **50L Crystallization Reactor**: Produce high-quality cannabis isolate from various plant sources
with minimal impurities and no residual solvents or other unwanted compounds.
* **Gas Chromatography**: Quick and low-cost analyses of potency, residual solvents and terpenes and
the quantification of their concentrations according to molecular weight and boiling point.
* **50L – 500L Vacuum** Oven: Dry, Decas and Decarboxylate cannabis extracts and activate the
cannabinoids in the extract at low temperatures and pressures, allowing for a more efficient
extraction process.
* **20L-200L HTE**: More efficient extraction. The lower temperatures also reduce the risk of
burning off valuable compounds while allowing for more precise control over the extraction
temperature and times for optimal cannabinoid potency.

### THC Remediation Equipment

### **THC Remediation Systems and Equipment**

Our patented [THC Remediation equipment][92] is a first and only of its kind in the hemp industry.
It uses a dynamic combination of gas, low heat, and low pressure to isomerize THC into other
cannabinoids such as CBD, CBC, CBN, etc.
* Fully organic remediation process uses no solvents.
* Easy-to-use, fully automated system
* DEA compliant
* 5 liter – 150 liter/day processing capacity range for small to large-scale commercial production

## Cannabis Distillation Equipment

PURE5™ [cannabis distillation equipment][93] is designed for high-quality, large-batch cannabis
extraction. They use a highly efficient and reliable wiped-film distillation process to separate and
purify compounds in cannabis oils. The system features a two-stage thin film process, whereby the
rotation of a heated rotor element creates a thin film on the inside wall of the distillation
vessel. This process is highly efficient and can achieve very high-quality separations of compounds
in cannabis oils.

### The 6" SS Wipe Film Distillation System

[ Tech Information ][94]

### The 6″ SS Wipe Film Distillation system

Made of 304 or 316 stainless steel and can process faster compared to its glass counterpart. This is
because stainless steel has a higher heat transfer rate, resulting in more than double the
processing capacity of conventional glass wipe film distillation systems.

The SS system also features a ball valve discharge system that automates the flow rate and also
provides increased safety during the distillation process.

### The 6" GL Wipe Film Distillation system

[ More about the 6"GL ][95]

### The 6″ GL Wipe Film Distillation system

Made of food-grade glass can process up to 7 liters/hour and features a fully automated terpene and
solvent recovery collection systems, allowing for easy collection and storage of the distillate. It
also includes a unique filtration system that removes unwanted solids to ensure the highest quality
product.

#### Main features of the PURE5™ Wipe Film Distillation Systems
* Fast and efficient distillation
* High quality and purity of the final product
* Precise temperature control
* Ease of operation with automated systems
* Safe and efficient solvent recovery
* Cost-effective solution with low maintenance requirements.

## Farming Equipment

### Hemp Harvester

[ Harvester Tech Data ][96]

### Hemp Harvester

Our robust hemp harvester is a specialized agricultural machine for harvesting and collecting hemp
plants. It combines cutting, gathering, and baling hemp plants into one process. The harvester has
adjustable settings for the length and thickness of plant stems, allowing for various harvesting
styles.

### The 10T Conveyor Dryer System

[ Dryer Tech Info ][97]

### 10T Conveyor Dryer System

The dryer is composed of a heated chamber that circulates and dries the plants with warm to hot dry
air, similar to a convection oven. A 22KW heat exchange furnace generates the necessary heat from
25C to 60C to dry the plants, while a control cabinet controls temperature, airflow, power, and
other variables to ensure optimal drying conditions.

### Stick and Seed Separation

[ More about the Separator ][98]

### Stick and Seed Separation

Our Stick and Seed Separation system separates hemp sticks from flower and seeds for further
processing. Then further separates the seeds from flower in 4 fractions.
* The food-grade stainless steel feeding conveyor moves the hemp material from the drying process to
the sifter.
* The sifter uses a vibratory motion to separate the hemp sticks from the seeds that are light
enough to roll down the mesh.
* They then pass through a blower cyclone system to further separate the large particles from the
smaller ones.
* The control cabinet allows users to ensure optimal power, speed, and temperature as the sticks are
sorted and separated.

The end result is a clean, dry batch of seeds ready for further processing or sale.

## Cannabis Distillation Equipment

PURE5™ [cannabis distillation equipment][93] is designed for high-quality, large-batch cannabis
extraction. They use a highly efficient and reliable wiped-film distillation process to separate and
purify compounds in cannabis oils. The system features a two-stage thin film process, whereby the
rotation of a heated rotor element creates a thin film on the inside wall of the distillation
vessel. This process is highly efficient and can achieve very high-quality separations of compounds
in cannabis oils.

### The 6″ SS Wipe Film Distillation system

Made of 304 or 316 stainless steel and can process faster compared to its glass counterpart. This is
because stainless steel has a higher heat transfer rate, resulting in more than double the
processing capacity of conventional glass wipe film distillation systems.

The SS system also features a ball valve discharge system that automates the flow rate and also
provides increased safety during the distillation process.

solvent recovery collection systems, allowing for easy collection and storage of the distillate. It
also includes a unique filtration system that removes unwanted solids to ensure the highest quality
product.

sorted and separated.

### Stick and Seed Separation

[ More about the Separator ][98]

### Stick and Seed Separation

Our Stick and Seed Separation system separates hemp sticks from flower and seeds for further
processing. Then further separates the seeds from flower in 4 fractions.
* The food-grade stainless steel feeding conveyor moves the hemp material from the drying process to
the sifter.
* The sifter uses a vibratory motion to separate the hemp sticks from the seeds that are light
enough to roll down the mesh.
* They then pass through a blower cyclone system to further separate the large particles from the
smaller ones.
* The control cabinet allows users to ensure optimal power, speed, and temperature as the sticks are
sorted and separated.

The end result is a clean, dry batch of seeds ready for further processing or sale.
