## IN LOVING MEMORIAL.

> "The CBIS family is shocked and saddened with the passing of Mario, Allen, and Ron. These
> distinguished gentlemen will leave voids in our Company, in our hearts, and in their communities
> that will never be filled in the same way. However, we will honor their legacies by continuing the
> great work they both contributed to and championed. Fortunately, these leaders helped position our
> Company for success and we will march forward in the direction they so aptly agreed, pointed, and
> marched with us in. With our talented executive management team, our expert consultants, our
> Corporate Advisory Board Members, and all of our loyal shareholders, we will succeed."
> - Mr. Raymond C. Dabney; President, C.E.O. and Co-founder

[Dr. Allen A. Herman]

### Dr. Allen A. Herman

### - Chief Medical Officer & President of the Scientific Advisory Board

Dr. Herman was CBIS' Chief Medical Officer (CMO) and served as the President of the Company's
Scientific Advisory Board and Member of the International Government Affairs Board. In this capacity
and with his broad medical knowledge base, Dr. Herman was able to help shape and direct the
Company's successful research and development initiatives, including the structuring of partnerships
with several well-established specialized research institutions, local and international
universities, and government agencies. Along with Mr. Dabney, Dr. Herman led a formidable medical
team to create the Cannabis Science Global Consortium, a research and development framework and
platform to cooperate and collaborate with stakeholders worldwide. The Consortium links
universities, foundations, corporations, and individuals to share research, ideas, and other
relevant information, as well as to implement a cutting-edge research program to develop medicines
and delivery mechanisms.

[Honorable Ronald V. Dellums]

### Honorable Ronald V. Dellums

### - President of International Government Affairs Board

Mr. Dellums served as the President of CBIS’ International Government Affairs Board and was a member
of the Company’s Scientific Advisory Board. In this capacity, Mr. Dellums helped develop the
Company’s relationships with public and private sector stakeholders worldwide. A life-long advocate
of peace and social justice, Ron Dellums served for 27 years as an outspoken and highly respected
member of the US House of Representatives. Initially seeking a life in education, community activism
and social work, Mr. Dellums was called to public ofﬁce in 1967. His tenure in politics has been
deﬁned by a strong adherence to the principles of social justice, community activism and peace as
viable and necessary national and international pursuits.

[Mario Lap]

### Mario Lap

### - Director & President of European Operations

Mr. Lap was the President of CBIS European Operations and a CBIS Director. He brought the Company a
unique combination of expertise in Dutch and greater European medical cannabis law and policy as
well as in the areas of health care, IT security, law enforcement, and government relations. Mr.
Lap, last served as a Dutch health and IT regulatory lawyer in Amsterdam, had an extensive
educational background through studies at the Het Amsterdams Lyceum, Colloqium Doctum University of
Amsterdam, University of Amsterdam Law School, Open University and University of Liverpool, and
speaks fluent Dutch, English, French, and German. With this he was able to make strong public
presence through his numerous international papers and legislative initiatives regarding medical and
non-medicinal cannabis laws and access throughout Europe. He also made several television and radio
appearances on CNN, BBC, France 2, RTL, and various Dutch public and commercial channels to give
public education and information on policy, laws, and current medical breakthroughs.

## Premium Cannabis Products

From whole flower to isolated compounds, we provide the highest quality medicinal cannabis products
for global markets

### Premium Flower

GACP-certified whole flower cannabis from Thailand's finest growers

### Full-Spectrum Extract

High-quality extracts preserving the complete cannabinoid profile

### Isolated Cannabinoids

Pure, isolated compounds for research and medical applications

## Our Product Range

Comprehensive selection of cannabinoids, terpenes, flavonoids, and premium cannabis strains for
medicinal and research applications

### Premium Cannabinoids

Our extensive range includes high-purity **CBD (Cannabidiol)** for therapeutic applications,** THC
(Tetrahydrocannabinol)** for pain management, and **CBG (Cannabigerol)** - the "mother cannabinoid"
with unique neuroprotective properties.

We also offer minor cannabinoids including **CBN** for sleep disorders, **CBC** for
anti-inflammatory effects, **CBDV** for neurological conditions, **THCV** for appetite suppression,
and **THCA** for raw cannabis therapy.

Available as isolates, distillates, or full-spectrum extracts with 80-99% purity levels.

### Terpenes & Flavonoids

Our premium terpene collection features **Myrcene** for relaxation, **Limonene** for mood elevation,
**Pinene** for alertness, and **Linalool** for anti-anxiety effects. Additional terpenes include
**Caryophyllene**, **Terpinolene**, and **Humulene**.

**Flavonoids** are equally important bioactive compounds that work synergistically with cannabinoids
and terpenes. These include **Cannflavins A, B, and C** - unique to cannabis with potent
anti-inflammatory properties, as well as **Quercetin**, **Kaempferol**, and**Apigenin** for enhanced
therapeutic effects.

Steam-distilled terpenes and extracted flavonoids available at 90-99% purity.

### Cannabis Strains

We cultivate renowned strains including balanced **Blue Dream** for cerebral stimulation, energizing
**Sour Diesel** for creativity, award-winning **Jack Herer** for focus, and the legendary **OG
Kush** for potent effects.

Classic strains like **Northern Lights** for relaxation, pure sativa **Haze** for energy, balanced
**White Widow** for versatility, and potent **Gorilla Glue** for heavy-handed effects complete our
premium selection.

Each strain is GACP-certified with detailed cannabinoid and terpene profiles available.

#### Custom Formulations Available

We can create custom cannabinoid, terpene, and flavonoid profiles to meet your specific research or
medical requirements. Our experienced team works with you to develop products that match your exact
specifications.

## The most common questions

Explore how our platform utilizes digital twin and QR code technology to streamline your cannabis
operations. Find out how you can enhance compliance and efficiency in our detailed FAQs here.

##### How does Cannavigia ensure the security of my data?

Your data's security is paramount. Cannavigia stores sensitive information on highly secure, ISO
27005 certified servers in the European Union. We protect passwords with cryptographic hashing
functions, secure all connections with SSL/TLS encryption, and offer enhanced account protection
through Two-Factor Authentication.

##### How can I implement Cannavigia in my operations?

Implementing Cannavigia is seamless and efficient, requiring no specific hardware. We utilizse QR
code technology for easy data integration, which can be scanned with any mobile device or handheld
scanner. Our comprehensive onboarding services guide you through every step, from system integration
to training your team on how to effectively use the platform.

##### Is manual documentation still necessary, and can I create reports within Cannavigia?

Cannavigia greatly minimizes the need for manual documentation by automating data capture and
record-keeping processes. Specifically, the platform enables the creation of detailed narcotic
reports, crucial for compliance and monitoring in the cannabis industry. Our system simplifies the
generation of these reports, ensuring you can easily access and analyze critical data to maintain
regulatory compliance and make informed operational decisions.

# Über uns

### Bekannte Marken, hochwertige Produkte, einfacher Zugang und starke Partner.

## Unsere Mission

### Bekannte Marken, hochwertige Produkte,
### einfacher Zugang und starke Partner

#### Wir gestalten die Zukunft von Cannabis

Im Mittelpunkt unserer Mission steht die Entwicklung einflussreicher Marken und die Bereitstellung
hochwertiger Cannabisprodukte. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, Maßstäbe für Exzellenz und Zuverlässigkeit
in der Branche zu definieren.

Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den Weg zu modernen Cannabis-Therapien zu vereinfachen. Unsere
Bemühungen konzentrieren sich auf die Beseitigung von Hindernissen, um den Zugang zu modernen
Therapien zu erleichtern.

Starke Partnerschaften sind grundlegend für unseren Erfolg. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit
Apotheken und Lieferanten verbessern wir die Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit der Lieferkette zum
Nutzen aller Beteiligten.
Wir sehen uns als primäre Ressource und Befürworter von medizinischem Cannabis. Unsere Expertise und
Hingabe machen uns zur ersten Anlaufstelle für Patienten, Gesundheitsdienstleister und Partner, die
verlässliche Informationen und Produkte suchen.

Unsere Vision erstreckt sich über lokale Märkte hinaus bis zu internationalen Horizonten. Wir sind
bestrebt, weltweite Chancen zu erschließen, Wachstum voranzutreiben und den Zugang zu
Cannabisprodukten weltweit zu erleichtern.

## Geschichte

### Vom Großhandel zum Plattformanbieter

#### 2017: Gründung

Im Frühjahr 2017 traten die gesetzlichen Regelungen zur Erleichterung des Zugangs zu medizinischem
Cannabis in Deutschland in Kraft.

Im zeitlichen Zusammenhang damit gründeten Jakob und Benedikt Sons gemeinsam mit ihrem Vater die
Cansativa GmbH.

#### 2018: Großhandel

Das Unternehmen bezog die erste Betriebsstätte in Fechenheim, Frankfurt am Main und begann den
Großhandel mit Medizinalcannabis im Mai 2018.

#### 2019: Einfuhr und Herstellung

Im Jahr 2019 baute das Unternehmen seinen Betrieb aus und bezog den neuen Standort im
Mörfelden-Walldorf, nahe des Frankfurter Flughafens.

Im Laufe der Zeit wurde die Betriebsstätte umfangreich ausgebaut, um große Mengen an Rohwaren,
Halbfertig- und Fertigerzeugnissen zu lagern und zu vertreiben.

Neben Lagerflächen umfasst die Betriebsstätte in Mörfelden-Walldorf eine Reinraumanlage für die
Endverarbeitung und Abfüllung von Cannabisblüten.

Was als Großhandel begann, entwickelte sich zur eigenen Abfüllung- und Verarbeitungsanlage.

#### 2020: Deutsches Cannabis

Im Jahr 2020 erhielt die Cansativa GmbH den Zuschlag der Bundesrepublik Deutschland, für die beim
Bundesinstitut für Arzneimittel und Medizinprodukte (BfArM) eingerichtete Cannabisagentur die
Distributionslogistik abzuwickeln.

Seitdem verantwortet das Unternehmen den Vertrieb des in Deutschland angebauten Cannabis als
exklusiver Partner des deutschen Staates.

#### 2021: Plattform

Cansativa entwickelte sich zur zentralen Plattform für Apotheken und Lieferanten aus aller Welt.

Neben dem Großhandelsangebot fokussiert das Unternehmen besonders auf die Unterstützung von
Apotheken und Lieferanten beim Wachstum im Markt.

Cansativa ist führender Anbieter von Produktinformation und Verfügbarkeitsdaten und ist als solcher
integriert in zahlreiche Apotheken- und Fachkreisinformationssysteme.

#### 2022: Eigenmarken

Im Jahr 2022 etablierte Cansativa das Eigenmarkenportfolio mit den beiden Medizinalcannabismarken
AMICI and N!CE.

Neben eigenen Marken positioniert sich Cansativa als strategischer Partner von erfolgreichen
internationalen Marken wie Peace Natural (Cronos Inc.) und MedMen.

#### 2023: Internationalisierung

Für das Produktportfolio etablierte das Unternehmen starke internationale Lieferketten.

Cansativa begleitet das Wachstum zentraler europäischer und internationaler Märkte. Erste Exporte
erfolgten bereits im Jahr 2023.

## Unsere Experten
## für Ihre Geschäfts-
## entwicklung

Cansativa bietet ein umfangreiches Branchenwissen mit einem Team von Experten aus unterschiedlichen
Industrien.

Gemeinsam mit unseren internationalen Partnern, Regierungsvertretern, Behörden und Kunden entwickeln
wir eine verlässliche und vielfältige Produkt- und Servicelandschaft.

Unser Team ermöglicht die innovative Zukunft einer neuen Branche mit enormem Wachstumspotenzial.

## Wir sind Pioniere.

### Wir sind Umsetzer. Wir sind Wegbereiter.

Als Gründer ergänzen sich Jakob und Benedikt mit ihren unterschiedlichen beruflichen Hintergründen.

Schlüssel zum Erfolg ist die Unterschiedlichkeit unserer Talente und Perspektiven bei gleichzeitiger
Einheit in einen ausgeprägten Pionier- und Unternehmergeist mit einem starkem gemeinsamen
Wertesystem. Dadurch sind wir in der Lage, die unterschiedlichen Herausforderungen unseres Marktes
verantwortungsvoll und zukunftsorientiert zu meistern.

Gemeinsam mit einem Team aus talentierten, motivierten und visionären Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind
wir Wegbereiter einer starken Industrie. Gemeinsam wollen wir den Weg für einen einfachen und
sicheren Zugang zu Cannabis ebnen und Deutschland zum Vorreiter eines europäischen
Cannabis-Ökosystems machen.

politische Entscheidungen, branchenspezifische Neuigkeiten und Forschungsergebnisse.

Unser Newsletter informiert über die sich schnell entwickelnde Welt des medizinischen Cannabis. Das
Cannabis Briefing ist Ihre wesentliche Zusammenfassung für die neuesten Erkenntnisse,
regulatorischen Updates, Markttrends und die Bemühungen der Befürworter, die die Zukunft von
Cannabis gestalten.

## Public Affairs - Wissenstransfer zwischen Industrie und öffentlichen Akteuren fördern

Unser Team für öffentliche Angelegenheiten strebt eine führende Rolle in Bezug auf Verantwortung und
Transparenz im öffentlichen politischen Prozess für medizinisches Cannabis als auch für die
bevorstehende Legalisierung von Cannabis für den Gebrauch durch Erwachsene an.

Wir engagieren uns für offene und transparente Diskussionen, die den Diskurs über Fakten
vorantreiben und eine sichere und bessere Zukunft für unsere Partner, Kunden und Patienten schaffen,
um das Vertrauen in die europäische Cannabisindustrie zu fördern.

Wir sind Mitglied führender Verbände in der Cannabisbranche, was unser Engagement für Exzellenz und
Zusammenarbeit weiter unterstreicht. Als Vorstandsmitglied beim BPC (Bundesverband pharmazeutischer
Cannabinoidunternehmen) tragen wir aktiv dazu bei, die Stimme der pharmazeutischen
Cannabinoidunternehmen in Deutschland zu formen. Darüber hinaus sind wir als Fördermitglied beim VCA
(Verband der Cannabis versorgenden Apotheken e.V.) an der Spitze, um eine qualitativ hochwertige
Cannabisversorgung durch Apotheken sicherzustellen. Diese Partnerschaften zeugen von unserem
Engagement, die Branche mit Integrität und Fachwissen voranzubringen.

Neben unserem Fokus auf ethische Geschäftspraktiken, legen wir großen Wert auf die Einhaltung aller
relevanten Gesetze und Vorschriften in der Branche, einschließlich der Registrierung unserer

# Über uns

### Bekannte Marken, hochwertige Produkte, einfacher Zugang und starke Partner.

## Unsere Mission

### Bekannte Marken, hochwertige Produkte,
### einfacher Zugang und starke Partner

#### Wir gestalten die Zukunft von Cannabis

Im Mittelpunkt unserer Mission steht die Entwicklung einflussreicher Marken und die Bereitstellung
hochwertiger Cannabisprodukte. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, Maßstäbe für Exzellenz und Zuverlässigkeit
in der Branche zu definieren.

Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den Weg zu modernen Cannabis-Therapien zu vereinfachen. Unsere
Bemühungen konzentrieren sich auf die Beseitigung von Hindernissen, um den Zugang zu modernen
Therapien zu erleichtern.

Starke Partnerschaften sind grundlegend für unseren Erfolg. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit
Apotheken und Lieferanten verbessern wir die Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit der Lieferkette zum
Nutzen aller Beteiligten.
Wir sehen uns als primäre Ressource und Befürworter von medizinischem Cannabis. Unsere Expertise und
Hingabe machen uns zur ersten Anlaufstelle für Patienten, Gesundheitsdienstleister und Partner, die
verlässliche Informationen und Produkte suchen.

Unsere Vision erstreckt sich über lokale Märkte hinaus bis zu internationalen Horizonten. Wir sind
bestrebt, weltweite Chancen zu erschließen, Wachstum voranzutreiben und den Zugang zu
Cannabisprodukten weltweit zu erleichtern.

## Geschichte

### Vom Großhandel zum Plattformanbieter

#### 2017: Gründung

Im Frühjahr 2017 traten die gesetzlichen Regelungen zur Erleichterung des Zugangs zu medizinischem
Cannabis in Deutschland in Kraft.

Im zeitlichen Zusammenhang damit gründeten Jakob und Benedikt Sons gemeinsam mit ihrem Vater die
Cansativa GmbH.

#### 2018: Großhandel

Das Unternehmen bezog die erste Betriebsstätte in Fechenheim, Frankfurt am Main und begann den
Großhandel mit Medizinalcannabis im Mai 2018.

#### 2019: Einfuhr und Herstellung

Im Jahr 2019 baute das Unternehmen seinen Betrieb aus und bezog den neuen Standort im
Mörfelden-Walldorf, nahe des Frankfurter Flughafens.

Im Laufe der Zeit wurde die Betriebsstätte umfangreich ausgebaut, um große Mengen an Rohwaren,
Halbfertig- und Fertigerzeugnissen zu lagern und zu vertreiben.

Neben Lagerflächen umfasst die Betriebsstätte in Mörfelden-Walldorf eine Reinraumanlage für die
Endverarbeitung und Abfüllung von Cannabisblüten.

Was als Großhandel begann, entwickelte sich zur eigenen Abfüllung- und Verarbeitungsanlage.

#### 2020: Deutsches Cannabis

Im Jahr 2020 erhielt die Cansativa GmbH den Zuschlag der Bundesrepublik Deutschland, für die beim
Bundesinstitut für Arzneimittel und Medizinprodukte (BfArM) eingerichtete Cannabisagentur die
Distributionslogistik abzuwickeln.

Seitdem verantwortet das Unternehmen den Vertrieb des in Deutschland angebauten Cannabis als
exklusiver Partner des deutschen Staates.

#### 2021: Plattform

Cansativa entwickelte sich zur zentralen Plattform für Apotheken und Lieferanten aus aller Welt.

Neben dem Großhandelsangebot fokussiert das Unternehmen besonders auf die Unterstützung von
Apotheken und Lieferanten beim Wachstum im Markt.

Cansativa ist führender Anbieter von Produktinformation und Verfügbarkeitsdaten und ist als solcher
integriert in zahlreiche Apotheken- und Fachkreisinformationssysteme.

#### 2022: Eigenmarken

Im Jahr 2022 etablierte Cansativa das Eigenmarkenportfolio mit den beiden Medizinalcannabismarken
AMICI and N!CE.

Neben eigenen Marken positioniert sich Cansativa als strategischer Partner von erfolgreichen
internationalen Marken wie Peace Natural (Cronos Inc.) und MedMen.

#### 2023: Internationalisierung

Für das Produktportfolio etablierte das Unternehmen starke internationale Lieferketten.

Cansativa begleitet das Wachstum zentraler europäischer und internationaler Märkte. Erste Exporte
erfolgten bereits im Jahr 2023.

## Wir sind Pioniere.

### Wir sind Umsetzer. Wir sind Wegbereiter.

Als Gründer ergänzen sich Jakob und Benedikt mit ihren unterschiedlichen beruflichen Hintergründen.

Schlüssel zum Erfolg ist die Unterschiedlichkeit unserer Talente und Perspektiven bei gleichzeitiger
Einheit in einen ausgeprägten Pionier- und Unternehmergeist mit einem starkem gemeinsamen
Wertesystem. Dadurch sind wir in der Lage, die unterschiedlichen Herausforderungen unseres Marktes
verantwortungsvoll und zukunftsorientiert zu meistern.

Gemeinsam mit einem Team aus talentierten, motivierten und visionären Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind
wir Wegbereiter einer starken Industrie. Gemeinsam wollen wir den Weg für einen einfachen und
sicheren Zugang zu Cannabis ebnen und Deutschland zum Vorreiter eines europäischen
Cannabis-Ökosystems machen.

## Public Affairs - Wissenstransfer zwischen Industrie und öffentlichen Akteuren fördern

Unser Team für öffentliche Angelegenheiten strebt eine führende Rolle in Bezug auf Verantwortung und
Transparenz im öffentlichen politischen Prozess für medizinisches Cannabis als auch für die
bevorstehende Legalisierung von Cannabis für den Gebrauch durch Erwachsene an.

Wir engagieren uns für offene und transparente Diskussionen, die den Diskurs über Fakten
vorantreiben und eine sichere und bessere Zukunft für unsere Partner, Kunden und Patienten schaffen,
um das Vertrauen in die europäische Cannabisindustrie zu fördern.

Wir sind Mitglied führender Verbände in der Cannabisbranche, was unser Engagement für Exzellenz und
Zusammenarbeit weiter unterstreicht. Als Vorstandsmitglied beim BPC (Bundesverband pharmazeutischer
Cannabinoidunternehmen) tragen wir aktiv dazu bei, die Stimme der pharmazeutischen
Cannabinoidunternehmen in Deutschland zu formen. Darüber hinaus sind wir als Fördermitglied beim VCA
(Verband der Cannabis versorgenden Apotheken e.V.) an der Spitze, um eine qualitativ hochwertige
Cannabisversorgung durch Apotheken sicherzustellen. Diese Partnerschaften zeugen von unserem
Engagement, die Branche mit Integrität und Fachwissen voranzubringen.

Neben unserem Fokus auf ethische Geschäftspraktiken, legen wir großen Wert auf die Einhaltung aller
relevanten Gesetze und Vorschriften in der Branche, einschließlich der Registrierung unserer
Lobbying-Aktivitäten und der Einhaltung des staatlichen Verhaltenskodex.

Erfahren Sie mehr über aktuelle Veröffentlichungen und Politikbriefe hier.

## [][25]
## CBD KANU is a premium CBD product brand offering high-strength tinctures, pain-relief creams,
## capsules, and pet supplements. Available internationally, including in Brazil and the U.S., our
## products blend CBD and THC with lab-tested formulations for wellness, recovery, and relief. 

### [][26]
### Mission

CBD KANU was created to merge ancestral Hawaiian healing traditions with modern cannabinoid
research, producing high-quality, lab-tested CBD products that support balance, focus, pain relief,
and overall well-being. Each formula reflects Rico’s dual passion for performance and recovery,
designed not just for athletes, but for anyone navigating the physical and emotional demands of
modern life.

### [][27]
### 🌊 Philosophy

CBD KANU is more than a product line — it’s a reflection of Coach Rico’s Hawaiian roots and his
lifelong commitment to championship performance, recovery, and wellness. Just as Rico trained
athletes to push past limits and achieve greatness, CBD KANU empowers individuals to reclaim
balance, focus, and resilience in their everyday lives.

CBD KANU — Embrace the Aloha Spirit, Empower Your Journey.

✨ Vision & Community

CBD KANU is more than products. It’s a promise to those who want relief, balance, and support
without sacrificing clarity or quality. It’s about restoring power to people managing pain,
metabolic issues, mood, or neurodivergence—helping each person find their wellness path.

Through education, community support, and compassionate product development, Rico and the team at
CBD KANU invite you to embrace your journey. Whether you’re pushing your physical limits, navigating
autism or sensory challenges, or simply seeking better sleep, CBD KANU wants to walk with you—rooted
in aloha, grounded in science, committed to relief.

INTERNATIONAL DISTRIBUTORS OF MEDICINAL CANNABIS

ONE OF AUSTRALIA’S LEADING DISTRIBUTORS OF MEDICINAL CANNABIS

Since being Australia’s first company to import medicinal cannabis in 2017, our unwavering commitment to quality and service has positioned HHI Australia as the leading market partner for the best of Australian and international medicinal cannabis producers. From our base in Western Australia, HHI operates a state-of-the-art, national distribution business dedicated to supporting our valued suppliers and customers in consistently meeting the demands and needs of patients.

Our Suppliers

 

HHI (Australia) Pty Ltd is part of the Little Green Pharma Group

Little Green Pharma Group is a global, vertically integrated and geographically diverse medicinal cannabis and psychedelics business with operations from cultivation and production through to manufacturing, distribution and clinical services.

Global Cannabis Landscape

Over 60 countries around the world have now legalised medical cannabis.

Timeline: Towards a Legal Medicinal Cannabis Market

DATE

Nov 1996

California

California passes Proposition 215. It becomes the first US state to legalise medicinal cannabis.

DATE

July 2001

Portugal

Portugal decriminalises the use of all drugs.

DATE

Canada

Montana

Israel

Canada

DATE

Mar 2015

Italy

The Italian parliament signs a motion to legalise cannabis.

DATE

June 2016

Canopy Growth

Canopy Growth becomes the first cannabis stock to list on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

DATE

Jan 2017

Germany

Germany passes a law legalising the use of cannabis for medical purposes.

DATE

Feb 2017

Israel

Israel announces it will exports of medicinal cannabis.

DATE

Mar 2017

U.K

Sativa becomes the UK’s first medical cannabis investment vehicle to be listed on the NEX Exchange.

DATE

July 2017

Poland

Poland votes in favour of legalising medicinal cannabis.

DATE

Jan 2018

Canada

Canada’s Aurora Cannabis and CanniMed Therapeutics $3.2 billion merger becomes the industry’s biggest M&A deal.

DATE

May 2018

Canada

Canada’s Cronos Group becomes the first cannabis company to list on the US NASDAQ.

DATE

Jul 2018

U.K

UK Home Secretary Sajid Javid changes the classification of medicinal cannabis to Schedule 2.

DATE

Nov 2018

U.K

Medicinal cannabis available on prescription in the UK.

# About

HelloTerpenes offers the HIGHEST quality in 100% authentic cannabis derived terpenes. Period. No
fillers no botanicals, no substitutes. Only true and real extractions, from selected genetics,
raised for the purpose of terpene extraction. Unlike most suppliers. Who just grow extract and sell
whatever they have. HelloTerpenes.com is grower owned, grower run, grower created and maintained.

If you’re from the trenches of the cannabis world, then we are from the same place.

Our terpenes are precision extracted using several proprietary techniques. Our origins were born
with the 40 L CO2 extraction unit made my IES systems, so our first extractions were CO2 used as a
solvent for terpene and related compounds extraction, using sub-critical, temperatures and pressure.
But the tech does not stop there. We’ve obsessed over our SOPs for years. We’ve tried hundreds of
varying parameters on all of our processes, which is why we have ALWAYS featured some of the highest
quality cannabis derived terpenes available anywhere in the world.

Some extractions are done with dry-cured biomass, but I would say 98% of our terpenes are extracted
from fresh frozen, and truly fresh not even frozen ever, biomass! The terpene content from biomass
prior to being cured are roughly a multiple of five times the overall available terpenes, and even
further, extraction from never cured material, captures a much higher level of the most volatile of
the terpenes and related compounds. To explain further , the most volatile terpene compounds would
decay and or evaporate during the drying process. So regardless of the precision of our extraction,
if the most volatile Terpenes evaporate during the drying process, there would be no way to have
them in the final extraction.
However the challenges faced with extracting form never cured material are substantial. Again we
face a multiple of about 5 x the amount of work extract from fresh never cured biomass. Although
the available terpene content is substantially higher on a percentage basis, conversely the sheer
amount of biomass that needs to be processed is huge. Obviously because the cellular material
losses 80-90% if its mass during the drying process. So the more the mass the more work to move it
through the machines.
It doesn’t stop there ! Unlike any cannabis derived terpene supplier we also extract some of our
world class Terps using hydrocarbon extraction methods! Using varying ratios of proprietary blends
of hydrocarbons, we like to believe we’ve nearly perfected the job! All of our extraction methods
have been optimized for precision extraction and collection of these precious and volatile
compounds. Preserving the essence of each genetics expression, so that what you get in the end
smells EXACLTY like the bud that it’s extracted from. ONLY STRONGER !

Again unlike almost every other terpene supplier out there, our care and love of these terpenes does
not stop at the extraction method. Regardless of the method of extraction, this initial pull of
terpene compounds is not where the preparation stops, that’s where it starts. At this point we
would refer to the extract as a raw extracted terpene. Now this is where the fun continues, the
refinement processes begin !

Many terpenes suppliers just take a raw extraction and go to market. The raw extraction is just one
step of the magic recipe. During our proprietary refinement processes our terpenes are precision
refined to remove any contaminants and or undesirables resulting in a water clear or near water
clear appearance, and 100% non detectable levels of any cannabinoids. That’s right zero detectable
cannabinoids. The refinement is also done as a method of further concentrating the terpenes. And
like we’ve mentioned before the number of cycles of refinement are what determines if the final
terpene will be presented in the Premium terpenes or the Elite level terpenes. Both tiers are
absolutely excellent and usable for all cases. Considering that cost is part of a decision making
process for most customers, we do sell our premium terpenes in greater quantities than our Elite
terpenes, but make no mistake we sell a lot of Elites as well.

Many of our customers regularly buy terpenes from both tiers! The Elite tier of terpenes are our
most concentrated Terps. Everybody that uses our terpenes knows it and we love to say it. We offer
some the best 100% cannabis derived terpenes available anywhere in the world.

Again unlike almost every other terpene supplier out there, our care and love of these terpenes does
not stop at the extraction method. Regardless of the method of extraction, this initial pull of
terpene compounds is not where the preparation stops, that’s where it starts. At this point we
would refer to the extract as a raw extracted terpene. Now this is where the fun continues, the
refinement processes begin !

Many terpenes suppliers just take a raw extraction and go to market. The raw extraction is just one
step of the magic recipe. During our proprietary refinement processes our terpenes are precision
refined to remove any contaminants and or undesirables resulting in a water clear or near water
clear appearance, and 100% non detectable levels of any cannabinoids. That’s right zero detectable
cannabinoids. The refinement is also done as a method of further concentrating the terpenes. And
like we’ve mentioned before the number of cycles of refinement are what determines if the final
terpene will be presented in the Premium terpenes or the Elite level terpenes. Both tiers are
absolutely excellent and usable for all cases. Considering that cost is part of a decision making
process for most customers, we do sell our premium terpenes in greater quantities than our Elite
terpenes, but make no mistake we sell a lot of Elites as well.

Many of our customers regularly buy terpenes from both tiers! The Elite tier of terpenes are our
most concentrated Terps. Everybody that uses our terpenes knows it and we love to say it. We offer
some the best 100% cannabis derived terpenes available anywhere in the world.

##### What Is Imperial CBD Extraction?

Imperial CBD Extraction is a cryo-ethanol CBD extraction facility in Imperial, California. The
facility is the first CBD extraction facility in Imperial County.

##### What Is Your Primary Goal?

The facility is strategically positioned to serve the growing local hemp farming community as well
as non-local hemp growers. Imperial CBD Extraction will utilize cryo ethanol due to its proven
ability to be efficient, safe, and economically sound.

##### What Is Cryo-Ethanol?

Cyro-ethanol closed loop extraction is a method of drawing out essential cannabinoids by spraying
hemp biomass (ground flower and trim) with subzero ethanol.

##### How Is Hemp Processed?

After several recirculations over the material, negative pressures transfer the resulting solution
to a collection chamber where additional impurities are removed by micron circulation. This super
cold, low pressure means of extraction allows biomass to be processed into a clean desirable
distillate product.

##### What Is Remediation?

A key service of Imperial CBD Extraction will be remediation. Remediation is used to remove THC
levels as well as metals or toxins found in the biomass during extraction. Remediation of THC will
be accomplished using flash chromatography.

Imperial CBD Extraction is a cryo-ethanol CBD extraction facility in Imperial, California. The
facility is the first CBD extraction facility in Imperial County.

The facility is strategically positioned to serve the growing local hemp farming community as well
as non-local hemp growers. Imperial CBD Extraction will utilize cryo ethanol due to its proven
ability to be efficient, safe, and economically sound.

##### What Is Cryo-Ethanol?

Cyro-ethanol closed loop extraction is a method of drawing out essential cannabinoids by spraying
hemp biomass (ground flower and trim) with subzero ethanol.

##### How Is Hemp Processed?

After several recirculations over the material, negative pressures transfer the resulting solution
to a collection chamber where additional impurities are removed by micron circulation. This super
cold, low pressure means of extraction allows biomass to be processed into a clean desirable
distillate product.

##### What Is Remediation?

levels as well as metals or toxins found in the biomass during extraction. Remediation of THC will
be accomplished using flash chromatography.

# Sobre Nosotros

Nuestro objetivo es proporcionar acceso a la información sobre opciones de tratamiento alternativo
con Cannabis Medicinal. Somos parte de un extenso grupo internacional de profesionales vinculados a
las investigaciones médicas basadas en Cannabis.

## Intentamos mejorar su calidad de vida

Proporcionando acceso a la información sobre opciones de tratamiento alternativo basadas en los
efectos terapéuticos de los cannabinoides y su utilización de manera controlada

2014

**Fundado**

15+

**Profesionales**

## Nuestra Historia

## Donde el cultivo y la medicina se encuentran.

El proyecto surge de la preocupación de un pequeño grupo de personas vinculadas al sector del
cultivo y la medicina, que visualizaron la posibilidad de situar el cannabis en el mundo de las
terapias naturales.

Kalapa Clinic fue fundada en 2014 como la primera consulta para el co-tratamiento basado en
cannabinoides. El director médico de Kalapa Clinic, el Dr. Mariano García de Palau, ha estado
involucrado en la investigación de los efectos terapéuticos del cannabis desde hace más de 15 años,
desde el asesoramiento de numerosos pacientes.

Equipo Kalapa Clinic

Nuestra experticidad se refleja en todo nuestro equipo de médicos y expertos multidisciplinarios,
con años de experiencia en tratamientos con cannabis medicinal.

Dedicados a la investigación y
la educación sobre el cannabis medicinal

Kalapa Clinic se dirige al público y a los pacientes, así como a los profesionales de la salud que
estén interesados en el cannabis medicinal.
* ### Estudios e Investigaciones

Siempre a la vanguardia sobre las últimas investigación científica basada en los efectos de los
Cannabinoides. Somos parte de un grupo internacional de profesionales vinculados a las
investigaciones médicas del Cannabis
* ### Educando pacientes

Ofrecemos un soporte a las personas para que puedan entender como es que trabaja el cannabis
medicinal. Buscamos que la gente se encuentre segura y confortable al tener toda la información
necesaria.
* ### Formando Profesionales

Estamos creando una red de médicos para la formación y el intercambio continuo de investigaciones
y descubrimientos. Producimos una plataforma educativa de conocimiento y educación.

## Donde el cultivo y la medicina se encuentran.

El proyecto surge de la preocupación de un pequeño grupo de personas vinculadas al sector del
cultivo y la medicina, que visualizaron la posibilidad de situar el cannabis en el mundo de las
terapias naturales.

Kalapa Clinic fue fundada en 2014 como la primera consulta para el co-tratamiento basado en
cannabinoides. El director médico de Kalapa Clinic, el Dr. Mariano García de Palau, ha estado
involucrado en la investigación de los efectos terapéuticos del cannabis desde hace más de 15 años,
desde el asesoramiento de numerosos pacientes.

# Kind means high quality, affordable, accessible.

[Flower decoration]

Kind exists to make high-quality medicinal cannabis more accessible and affordable for Australians.

Our range offers carefully selected medicines to meet a variety of patient needs. And we are working
tirelessly with health professionals and stockists to make it easier for Australian patients to
access these life-changing medicines – because anything else would be unkind.

## We source our medicines from world-class cultivators maintaining the highest quality standards.

[Crown icon]

Our core range is sun-grown in modern greenhouses with controlled environments that promote optimal
plant growth while reducing energy consumption.

We also offer premium indoor-grown flower, crafted in small batches with precise cultivation in a
highly controlled environment to capture the unique properties. Sourcing both proprietary and
classic cultivars, our premium flower range enables the truest expression of these unique cannabis
genetics.

## Tailored Formats for Every Patient Need

Our portfolio is designed to provide healthcare professionals with a variety of options across
formats, cultivars and cannabinoid profiles. It is at the sole discretion and clinical judgement of
a healthcare professional to determine the right format and dosage based on individual patient
requirements.

[Dried cannabis flower illustration]

### Dried Cannabis Flower

Our primary format, we offer flower medicines spanning a range of unique growing environments and
strains produced to GMP standards.

A dry-herb vaporiser should be used to administer medicinal cannabis flower.

Learn more about [cannabis product types][9].

[510 vape cartridge illustration]

### 510 Vape Cartridges

Our 510 vape cartridges are crafted with full-spectrum, single-strain extracts from select
cultivars. These products are available in 1g pre-filled cartridges across a range of potencies.

These cartridges are administered by vaporisation with a 510-thread battery.

Read more about [cannabis vaporisers][10].

[Oral oil illustration]

### Oral Oils

Our oral oil range offers single-strain full-spectrum extracts alongside CBD medicines.

Available in various potencies and cultivars, these products are thoughtfully formulated with olive
oil as the carrier for optimal delivery and effectiveness.

Find out more about [cannabis oil][11].

### Cannabis Extracts

Cannabis extraction is the process of separating and isolating cannabinoids from the cannabis plant.
All our 510 cartridges and oral oils are made with cannabis extracts.

There are multiple methods to extract cannabinoids, each with individual advantages and
disadvantages.

[Learn More][12]

### Healthcare Professionals Portal

##### Access a range of educational resources and detailed product information developed for
##### prescribers and pharmacists.

[Register / sign in][13]

## Our Commitment to Quality

Quality is a core part of our brand promise and something we take very seriously. We make consistent
products using common processes with Quality Assurance built-in at every step from seed to shelf.

[Illustration of cannabis greenhouse.]

#### **Cultivation**

It all starts with genes. Our cultivars are selected for genetic stability and grown in a controlled
greenhouse using Good Agricultural and Collection Practices (GACP).

[Illustration of dried and packaged cannabis.]

#### **Processing**

We hand-select our batches which are dried, trimmed and packaged in line with Good Manufacturing
Practices (GMP). They are tested for purity and potency.

[Illustration of cannabis shipping box.]

#### **Logistics**

We ensure products maintain their quality and consistency with controlled transport and storage
conditions until final receipt by the clinic or pharmacist.

All medicinal cannabis products in Australia (including our medicines) are regulated by the
Therapeutic Goods Administration ([TGA)][14] and must be produced to [GMP][15] and [GACP][16]
standards. Learn more about [how medicinal cannabis quality is regulated in Australia][17].

## Need more information?

Check out our [Frequently Asked Questions][18] or read [the Kind Blog][19] to learn more about
medicinal cannabis.

#### Patients

Our [patients page][20] contains information about medicinal cannabis and access pathways. We also
have a robust [patient FAQs][21] section.

If you’re an existing medicinal cannabis patient with a current prescription for Kind and need
assistance with product availability and access, please reach out to your prescribing doctor or
pharmacy. For any product support, you may [contact us][22].

[Patient info][23]

#### Healthcare Professionals

We developed the [Kind Portal][24] to support registered healthcare professionals in prescribing and
dispensing medicinal cannabis. The portal offers a guided learning experience with educational
videos and research articles, which may be applicable for CPD hours. It also offers product
information, pricing and stock status.

If you're a pharmacy interested in stocking our products, please [contact us][25].

# About Altum. Cannabinoid-powered wellness for Asia-Pacific.

[Flower decoration]

Kind is part of [Altum][9], a leading regional company focused on helping people and businesses
across the Asia-Pacific region discover and access cannabinoids in a safe and rewarding way.

Kind contributes to that mission by making high-quality medicinal cannabis more accessible for
Australians.

## Why Kind?

We make our medicines as accessible as possible with affordable pricing and wide distribution
We offer a range of tools and programs to support patients and prescribers on their journey
We are environmentally conscious and favour sustainable options throughout our supply chain
Not only a nod to our products, our name represents the heart of our DNA. We exist to be a force for

# Kind means high quality, affordable, accessible.

[Flower decoration]

Kind exists to make high-quality medicinal cannabis more accessible and affordable for Australians.

Our range offers carefully selected medicines to meet a variety of patient needs. And we are working
tirelessly with health professionals and stockists to make it easier for Australian patients to
access these life-changing medicines – because anything else would be unkind.

## We source our medicines from world-class cultivators maintaining the highest quality standards.

[Crown icon]

Our core range is sun-grown in modern greenhouses with controlled environments that promote optimal
plant growth while reducing energy consumption.

We also offer premium indoor-grown flower, crafted in small batches with precise cultivation in a
highly controlled environment to capture the unique properties. Sourcing both proprietary and
classic cultivars, our premium flower range enables the truest expression of these unique cannabis
genetics.

## Tailored Formats for Every Patient Need

Our portfolio is designed to provide healthcare professionals with a variety of options across
formats, cultivars and cannabinoid profiles. It is at the sole discretion and clinical judgement of
a healthcare professional to determine the right format and dosage based on individual patient
requirements.

[Dried cannabis flower illustration]

### Dried Cannabis Flower

Our primary format, we offer flower medicines spanning a range of unique growing environments and
strains produced to GMP standards.

A dry-herb vaporiser should be used to administer medicinal cannabis flower.

Learn more about [cannabis product types][9].

[510 vape cartridge illustration]

### 510 Vape Cartridges

Our 510 vape cartridges are crafted with full-spectrum, single-strain extracts from select
cultivars. These products are available in 1g pre-filled cartridges across a range of potencies.

These cartridges are administered by vaporisation with a 510-thread battery.

Read more about [cannabis vaporisers][10].

[Oral oil illustration]

### Oral Oils

Our oral oil range offers single-strain full-spectrum extracts alongside CBD medicines.

Available in various potencies and cultivars, these products are thoughtfully formulated with olive
oil as the carrier for optimal delivery and effectiveness.

Find out more about [cannabis oil][11].

### Cannabis Extracts

Cannabis extraction is the process of separating and isolating cannabinoids from the cannabis plant.
All our 510 cartridges and oral oils are made with cannabis extracts.

There are multiple methods to extract cannabinoids, each with individual advantages and
disadvantages.

[Learn More][12]

### Healthcare Professionals Portal

##### Access a range of educational resources and detailed product information developed for
##### prescribers and pharmacists.

[Register / sign in][13]

## Our Commitment to Quality

Quality is a core part of our brand promise and something we take very seriously. We make consistent
products using common processes with Quality Assurance built-in at every step from seed to shelf.

[Illustration of cannabis greenhouse.]

#### **Cultivation**

It all starts with genes. Our cultivars are selected for genetic stability and grown in a controlled
greenhouse using Good Agricultural and Collection Practices (GACP).

[Illustration of dried and packaged cannabis.]

#### **Processing**

We hand-select our batches which are dried, trimmed and packaged in line with Good Manufacturing
Practices (GMP). They are tested for purity and potency.

[Illustration of cannabis shipping box.]

#### **Logistics**

We ensure products maintain their quality and consistency with controlled transport and storage
conditions until final receipt by the clinic or pharmacist.

All medicinal cannabis products in Australia (including our medicines) are regulated by the
Therapeutic Goods Administration ([TGA)][14] and must be produced to [GMP][15] and [GACP][16]
standards. Learn more about [how medicinal cannabis quality is regulated in Australia][17].

## Need more information?

Check out our [Frequently Asked Questions][18] or read [the Kind Blog][19] to learn more about
medicinal cannabis.

#### Patients

Our [patients page][20] contains information about medicinal cannabis and access pathways. We also
have a robust [patient FAQs][21] section.

If you’re an existing medicinal cannabis patient with a current prescription for Kind and need
assistance with product availability and access, please reach out to your prescribing doctor or
pharmacy. For any product support, you may [contact us][22].

[Patient info][23]

#### Healthcare Professionals

We developed the [Kind Portal][24] to support registered healthcare professionals in prescribing and
dispensing medicinal cannabis. The portal offers a guided learning experience with educational
videos and research articles, which may be applicable for CPD hours. It also offers product
information, pricing and stock status.

If you're a pharmacy interested in stocking our products, please [contact us][25].

# Jorge Cervantes

Growers in the cannabis cultivating community revere Jorge Cervantes as a legend for his lifetime of
contribution to the community. Cervantes is entering his fifth decade as a [cannabis
cultivation][53] author, photographer, and YouTube influencer. His books and videos have gained a
reputation as industry standards in the cannabis industry, offering crucial information and
inspiration to growers worldwide. Marijuana Grow Basics, Hydroponic Basics, and Five Easy Gardens
are just of few of more than 50 books in 8 languages that Cervantes published and wrote.

Marijuana Horticulture: The Indoor/Outdoor Medical Grower’s Bible, one of Cervantes’ most well-known
books, has been in print since 1983 and is currently in its fifth edition. This book, considered the
definitive work in the cannabis growing industry, provides in-depth explanations of every step in
the cultivation process, from seed selection and germination to harvesting, curing, and storing. The
book is packed with detailed growing techniques, including organics and hydroponics, as well as
troubleshooting advice for a broad spectrum of cultivation issues.

The Cannabis Encyclopedia: The Definitive Guide to Cultivation & Consumption of Medical Marijuana is
Cervantes’s latest best-seller. This publication is widely recognized as the most thorough manual on
[cannabis cultivation][54] and use ever produced. With more than 600 full-color pages, the
comprehensive work includes information on everything from the history of cannabis to the most
modern production methods, as well as chapters on the therapeutic uses of cannabis and different
ingestion styles, including concentrates and cooking.

Jorge Cervantes’ Ultimate Grow DVD, produced in 2005 in conjunction with High Times magazine, was
shot in British Columbia, Canada. This classic video shows indoor growers each step of indoor
[cannabis cultivation][55]. The box set contains two more videos, one shot in Spain and the other in
Amsterdam. The videos focus on greenhouse and outdoor cultivation. The visual manuals use real-world
cannabis garden footage and growers’ interviews. Viewers are given a tour of some of California’s
biggest cannabis gardens in Jorge Cervantes’ Cannabis Expeditions: The Green Giants of California in
his fourth and last DVD.

We Grow Cannabis! is the first digital-only book Cervantes will produce. You can download this FREE
book on his sites, [www.marijuanagrowing.com][56] and [www.jorge-cervantes.com][57]. The 100-page
book with 270+ color images provides growers with simple direct [cannabis cultivation][58]
information.

Last but not least, Jorge Cervantes is renowned for his in-depth understanding and proficiency in
cannabis production. His books and DVDs are packed with advice and suggestions to benefit growers of
all experience levels, from amateurs to professionals. His switch to digital publishing fits the
scene’s constant evolution.

# **Trade-in your device in 3 easy steps!**
* ### **Step 1**
  
  Disconnect your Apple device from your connected devices and iCloud. For detailed instructions,
  refer to the [Removal Guide][36].
* ### **Step 2**
  
  Visit any [iStudio store][37] (excluding Airport Terminal locations) for a device assessment.
* ### **Step 3**
  
  Receive the trade-in value of your device and immediately apply it towards the purchase of a new
  device.

Please contact us at [[email protected]][38] if you have other enquiries. Trade-in program is
provided by "Carousell".

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### What do I need to bring along?

You will be required to bring your charger and cable for laptops.

### What if I do not like the value after assessment?

You can choose to not accept the trade-in value, but the value shown is final.

### Can multiple devices be traded in during the same transaction?

Unfortunately, only one device can be traded in per transaction.

### Do I get to keep the memory card from the trade-in devices?

We recommend that you remove and keep all your memory cards before you trade-in a device

### Would I be able to get back my old device back after the trade-in?

You would not be able to retrieve your old device as all trade-ins are final. Prior to trading in
your device, we recommend backing up all your important content such as contacts, photos, videos,
etc.

### Can I trade-in my device if it does not work?

We would not be able to assess your device if we are unable to power on your device.

### What if my device is not found in the trade-in device list?

You can head down to our stores to get your device assessed by our iStudio Experts to check if it is
accepted.

HOW OUR MEDICINE WORKS
Premium extract-based solutions for quick relief

### About

Medicinal Harvest is a federally licenced cultivator of medicinal cannabis, located in Queensland,
Australia. We produce consistent medicinal flower bud all year around at our high-tech, indoor
facility. As a contract grower, we work with wholesale customers to achieve the required product
specification.

The provenance of our Australian grown medicinal flower bud is valued by the entire supply chain.
Medicinal Harvest uses sustainable production including the recycling of water and the use of solar
power. In addition, no pesticides are applied and strict microbial standards are met.

Medicinal Harvest built its first facility in 2020/21 and began cultivation in June 2021. Due to the
success of this facility, a second, co-located facility was constructed in 2023. Planning for stage
three expansion has begun.

Medicinal Harvest is 100 percent Australian owned and operated.

### Services

Medicinal Harvest provides contract growing services to third parties seeking unique medicinal
cannabis flower products, either from inhouse genetics or supplied genetics. We can provide bulk
flower bud or manufactured, finished product.

#### Indoor Cultivation

The facility is an indoor cultivation system with positive pressure air control, utilising high
output LED light at 1000 uMol/s/m plus in the flowering compartments. Customised climate control
solutions ensure high quality cannabinoid production and consistency of output.

We use multi-tiered racking to maximise canopy space and improve efficiency.

The significant degree of control in the facility, combined with our experience in high technology
greenhouse and sole source lighting facilities, enables the development and consistent supply of
unique product profiles.

Sustainability is a key driver of Medicinal Harvest's cultivation practices.

[Icon - Services Page V2.jpg]

#### Inhouse Genetics

Medicinal Harvest offers inhouse strains for the local medicinal market, curated for unique terpene
profiles. These strains are available for contract growing with the option of exclusivity.

We continue to invest in pheno-hunting at our indoor facility and have gained valuable feedback from
prescribers to achieve strains that meet patient needs.

### About

Medicinal Harvest is a federally licenced cultivator of medicinal cannabis, located in Queensland,
Australia. We produce consistent medicinal flower bud all year around at our high-tech, indoor
facility. As a contract grower, we work with wholesale customers to achieve the required product
specification.

The provenance of our Australian grown medicinal flower bud is valued by the entire supply chain.
Medicinal Harvest uses sustainable production including the recycling of water and the use of solar
power. In addition, no pesticides are applied and strict microbial standards are met.

Medicinal Harvest built its first facility in 2020/21 and began cultivation in June 2021. Due to the
success of this facility, a second, co-located facility was constructed in 2023. Planning for stage
three expansion has begun.

Medicinal Harvest is 100 percent Australian owned and operated.

## Our Directors

[Andrew Olley.jpg]

### Andrew Olley
### Co-founder and Cultivation Director

Andrew has a Bachelor of Agricultural Science Degree from the University of Queensland specialising
in plant nutrition and protected cropping. He has 25 years’ experience in all aspects of plant
nutrition, greenhouse and hydroponic production techniques for a multitude of crops.

Andrew is on the steering committee of the Australian Cannabis Cultivators Group, a sub-association
of the Australian Medicinal Cannabis Association (AMCA).

[andrew@medicinalharvest.com][9]

[+61 437 077 220][10]

[Tracey Perez.JPG]

### Tracey Perez
### Co-founder and Business Director

Tracey has a BA Honours degree in Economics from Macquarie University. She has provided services at
an executive level in product management and marketing to Australia’s largest telecommunications
company as well as to the national futures trading exchange. She also has marketing experience in
the agricultural industry.

[tracey@medicinalharvest.com][11]

[+61 439 462 954][12]

### Services

Medicinal Harvest provides contract growing services to third parties seeking unique medicinal
cannabis flower products, either from inhouse genetics or supplied genetics. We can provide bulk
flower bud or manufactured, finished product.

#### Indoor Cultivation

The facility is an indoor cultivation system with positive pressure air control, utilising high
output LED light at 1000 uMol/s/m plus in the flowering compartments. Customised climate control
solutions ensure high quality cannabinoid production and consistency of output.

We use multi-tiered racking to maximise canopy space and improve efficiency.

The significant degree of control in the facility, combined with our experience in high technology
greenhouse and sole source lighting facilities, enables the development and consistent supply of
unique product profiles.

Sustainability is a key driver of Medicinal Harvest's cultivation practices.

[Icon - Services Page V2.jpg]

#### Inhouse Genetics

Medicinal Harvest offers inhouse strains for the local medicinal market, curated for unique terpene
profiles. These strains are available for contract growing with the option of exclusivity.

We continue to invest in pheno-hunting at our indoor facility and have gained valuable feedback from
prescribers to achieve strains that meet patient needs.

Comprar Semillas de Cannabis en España: La Guía Completa

En seis años atendiendo a cultivadores en Andalucía, Cataluña, Valencia y todas las demás comunidades autónomas durante los últimos seis años, el factor más importante que separa una gran cosecha de una decepcionante es la calidad de la semilla . No los nutrientes. No la iluminación. Las semillas.
Esto lo vemos a diario porque nuestro equipo de soporte habla con cultivadores cada día — más de 200 conversaciones de selección de variedades por semana — y el patrón es constante: los cultivadores que empiezan con genética fresca y probada de una fuente fiable obtienen resultados. Los que compran semillas baratas de plataformas no verificadas se llevan una decepción.
Por eso fundamos Royal King Seeds España alrededor de una idea: dar a los cultivadores domésticos españoles acceso a más de 1.600 variedades premium de semillas de cannabis que realmente se prueban antes de llegar a tu puerta . Ofrecemos más de 1.600 variedades de cannabis categorizadas por rendimiento, nivel de THC, dificultad de cultivo, compatibilidad climática y perfil terpénico — porque creemos que un cultivador informado es un cultivador exitoso.
Un ejemplo concreto: el verano pasado un cliente de Jaén nos escribió tras perder un cultivo exterior de sativa por el oídio que llegó con las tormentas de agosto. Le recomendamos cambiar a híbridos indica-dominantes con estructura de cogollo abierta y bajar la fecha de plantación dos semanas. Cosechó 480 g por planta en su segundo intento — el mismo balcón, el mismo sustrato, distinta genética y distinto calendario. Estos ajustes regionales son la diferencia entre una cosecha frustrante y un cultivo viable.

Legalidad de las Semillas de Cannabis en España ▼

Vamos al grano, ya que es la primera pregunta que hacen la mayoría de compradores nuevos. En España, la compra y posesión de semillas de cannabis es legal, ya que se consideran productos de coleccionismo y preservación genética. Las semillas no contienen THC y su venta está permitida. Sin embargo, el cultivo de cannabis está regulado: el cultivo privado para autoconsumo en espacios no visibles al público se encuentra en una zona gris legal , mientras que los clubes sociales de cannabis operan bajo marcos regulatorios específicos en comunidades como Cataluña, País Vasco y Navarra . El cultivo con fines comerciales o la venta de marihuana sigue siendo ilegal. Siempre recomendamos a nuestros clientes informarse sobre la legislación vigente en su comunidad autónoma antes de germinar. El panorama legal evoluciona constantemente, y lo que estaba restringido el año pasado puede haber cambiado.
Cómo Funciona Realmente el Envío Discreto ▼

Nos preguntan por esto constantemente, así que aquí te explicamos exactamente lo que ocurre. Cada pedido se envía en embalaje neutro y sin marcas — sin logotipos, sin branding, sin indicación del contenido. La dirección del remitente utiliza un nombre comercial genérico. Las semillas van dentro de viales a prueba de aplastamiento dentro de sobres acolchados.
Enviamos con seguimiento completo a toda España y Europa — sin riesgos aduaneros dentro de la UE. Según los datos de seguimiento de nuestros últimos 12.000 envíos, el 94% de los pedidos llegan en 5 días laborables, y muchos de nuestros clientes en la península ibérica reciben sus paquetes en solo 3 días. Pedidos superiores a 99€ tienen envío discreto gratuito .

Esta es probablemente la decisión más importante que tomarás, así que te daremos nuestra opinión honesta basada en la experiencia de decenas de miles de clientes que han pasado por esta misma elección. Las semillas de cannabis feminizadas producen un 99,9% de plantas hembra — cada semilla se convierte en una planta cosechable sin machos que identificar ni eliminar. Son la opción número 1 para cultivadores de interior que no pueden permitirse desperdiciar espacio en el armario, y para cultivadores de exterior que quieren control total sobre el tiempo vegetativo y el tamaño del canopy. Sobre Royal King Seeds España

# Criadores Internos de Cannabis. Genéticas Estabilizadas. Cosechas Predecibles.

Royal King Seeds es un equipo interno de genéticas de cannabis enfocado en recrear, estabilizar y
refinar variedades elite. Cada semilla que enviamos a un cliente en España o en Europa está
desarrollada por nuestro equipo de cría — Royal King Genetics — y se mantiene bajo el mismo estándar
de consistencia, paquete tras paquete.

## Quiénes Somos

Royal King Seeds fue fundada por cultivadores, para cultivadores. No somos revendedores y no somos
una marca de marketing montada encima de las genéticas de otro. Somos una **operación interna de
cría de cannabis** — un equipo de genéticas activo que recrea, estabiliza y refina los cultivares
elite que nuestros clientes quieren cultivar.

Nuestros criadores, agrónomos y equipo de control de calidad operan bajo el nombre **Royal King
Genetics**. Cada variedad de nuestro catálogo en España pasa por ese equipo antes de salir de
nuestro centro de envíos hacia un único cliente en cualquier punto del país o de Europa.

## Nuestra Filosofía de Cría

Nos enfocamos en **consistencia por encima del hype**. La cultura del cannabis está llena de drops
puntuales de fenotipos y cortes de Instagram que se ven geniales en la primera ronda y colapsan en
la segunda. Eso no es lo que vendemos.

Nuestro trabajo es selección, estabilización, refinamiento y reproducción fiable de genéticas elite.
Trabajamos a lo largo de múltiples generaciones para fijar los rasgos por los que los cultivadores
realmente pagan — perfil terpénico, vigor, estructura, tiempo de floración y rendimiento — para que
**el paquete 1 cultive la misma planta que el paquete 1.000**.

Ese es el núcleo de cómo habla un criador de verdad: no “inventamos esta variedad”, sino “la
estabilizamos, la refinamos y podemos reproducirla ronda tras ronda”.

## Nuestro Proceso

### Selección de Fenotipos

Germinamos poblaciones grandes de fenotipos de cada cultivar elite y las cultivamos en condiciones
idénticas y controladas. Registramos terpenos, vigor, estructura, espaciado de entrenudos, densidad
de flor y producción de resina en cada etapa.

### Selección

De cada población culimos agresivamente y conservamos solo los fenotipos que coinciden con nuestro
perfil objetivo — los que saben bien, terminan a tiempo y rinden de forma consistente. La selección
está guiada por datos, no por estado de ánimo.

### Retrocruzamiento y Estabilización

Los fenotipos seleccionados se cruzan de vuelta con la línea parental a lo largo de varias
generaciones (BX1, BX2, BX3+) hasta que los rasgos se expresen homogéneamente. Estabilizamos hasta
que la población crezca uniforme, no solo cercana.

### Control de Calidad y Pruebas

Cada línea de semilla terminada se prueba lote a lote por encima del 99% de germinación. La
consistencia de rasgos se verifica con un cultivo final antes de que ninguna semilla salga del
edificio. Si un lote deriva, no se envía.

[Lee el Proceso Completo de Genéticas y Cría →][15]

## Por Qué Esto Te Importa

La mayoría de bancos de semillas revenden lo que pueden conseguir. Compras la misma variedad dos
veces y obtienes dos plantas diferentes. Diferentes tiempos de floración. Diferentes terpenos.
Diferentes rendimientos. Un cultivador no puede planificar una sala alrededor de eso.

Como Royal King Seeds cría y estabiliza en casa, obtienes lo contrario: **predictibilidad**,
**consistencia de rendimiento** y **fiabilidad de sabor**. El fenotipo del que te enamoraste el
ciclo pasado es el fenotipo que cultivas el próximo ciclo. Eso es lo que significa de verdad una
genética estabilizada, y eso es lo que enviamos.

Cada pedido también está respaldado por una garantía de germinación sin preguntas, embalaje discreto
y envío rastreado a toda España y Europa.

# Marijuana Seeds

Welcome to Semillas-de-marihuana.com, your **trusted online shop for premium marijuana seeds since
2001**. With our vast selection of world-class [marijuana seeds][206], we invite you to discover and
indulge in the best that nature has to offer. All our seeds are supplied in their original
packaging, ensuring authenticity, freshness, and quality. Plus, we offer free shipping and
delightful gifts with every purchase. As our commitment to authenticity, we never stock bulk seeds
or imitations, but only the finest cannabis seeds from the worlds leading producers.

Our passion for cannabis extends beyond the products we offer. At Semillas-de-marihuana.com, we love
to engage in enlightening discussions about marijuana, its diverse strains, unique characteristics,
varying effects, and everything in between. As part of our commitment to keeping you updated, we
annually refresh our seed catalogue with exciting new strains that enter the market. Our dedicated
team of experts is always ready to inform you about these latest additions and help you select the
perfect strain that aligns with your needs.

Whether youre seeking autoflowering marijuana seeds, feminized seeds, regular seeds, or CBD seeds,
Semillas-de-marihuana.com is your one-stop destination. We proudly stock an extensive range of over
1,000 strains from esteemed Dutch, Spanish, American, and other international seed banks. Upholding
our guarantee of quality, we ensure our seeds are always fresh and stored under stringent
preservation conditions. We provide urgent, discreet shipping, ensuring your privacy and rapid
delivery.

Explore our comprehensive catalogue and discover reputable cannabis seed banks available at
competitive prices. We adhere to a strict quality standard and only partner with the most
environmentally conscious producers. If any product fails to meet these high standards, we promptly
remove it from our shop. For your convenience, weve grouped our seeds into specific sections based
on their unique traits, such as high-yield or fast-flowering marijuana varieties. To simplify your
shopping experience, weve implemented advanced search filters, helping you quickly find the perfect
strains for your needs.

Semillas-de-marihuana.com is more than just a shop its a gateway to acquiring the highest quality
cannabis seeds. We strive to provide an unparalleled online shopping experience, allowing you to
enjoy the finest marijuana right from the comfort of your home. Discover the Experiencia Natural
difference today – purchase your favourite cannabis seeds from us and experience a level of quality
and service that will surely exceed your expectations! Also, be sure to visit our [Blog about
Cannabis][207], where we have many sections with fascinating articles for you.

## ABOUT US

Supercritical Fluid Technologies, Inc. develops innovative solutions for demanding separation and
material processing needs. With more than two decades of experience, SFT provides cutting-edge
equipment and custom solutions to meet your specific needs in supercritical fluid extraction,
reaction chemistry and high pressure applications.

## PRODUCTS

Innovative Leadership in Supercritical
Fluids & High Pressure Chemistry

From entry-level extractors and reactors, to research grade equipment and full-scale production
systems,
we offer a range of highly customizable products to meet your needs and your budget.

[img1]

## EXTRACTION
## PRODUCTS

We offer a wide range of supercritical fluid extractors, including small, entry-level systems,
mid-scale equipment for research and process development, and larger pilot and custom designed

# **Dr. Holger Bingmann
# ‍****‍**CEO der Nyika Ressources AG
# GF der Thinking Arabian GmbH
# GF der ReThinking Africa Foundation

**‍**Dr. Holger Bingmann is an internationally experienced entrepreneur and manager with many years
of leadership experience in business, industry associations, and international institutions. Since
2024, he has been CEO of Nyika Ressources AG, focusing on the extraction of critical raw materials

## Board of Directors

# **Oliver Conrad
# ‍‍**AHW Hunold & Partner mbB Unternehmerkanzlei

Oliver Conrad, Managing Partner at AHW Hunold & Partner in Cologne since 2023. Certified tax advisor
since 2014, appointed auditor in 2015. Specialises in national and international accounting, due
diligence, financial process optimisation, risk management, tax compliance, annual audit, company
valuation, and special economic audit. Member of IDW, Chamber of Auditors, and Chamber of Tax
Advisors NRW. Experienced in biotechnology, pharmaceutical industry, chemicals, aviation, trade, and
services. Previously worked at a Big Four firm as a director.

# **Dr. Holger Bingmann
# ‍****‍**CEO der Nyika Ressources AG
# GF der Thinking Arabian GmbH
# GF der ReThinking Africa Foundation

**‍**Dr. Holger Bingmann is an internationally experienced entrepreneur and manager with many years
of leadership experience in business, industry associations, and international institutions. Since
2024, he has been CEO of Nyika Ressources AG, focusing on the extraction of critical raw materials
in Africa and Europe, as well as Partner and Managing Director of Thinking Arabian GmbH and
ReThinking Africa Foundation. As President of the German Committee of the International Chamber of
Commerce (ICC) and Vice President of the global ICC, as well as Honorary Chairman of the
German-Emirati Chamber of Industry and Commerce, he has built an extensive network across business,
politics, and institutions. He is also committed to education as founder of the Digital Business
University of Applied Sciences and serves on several supervisory and advisory boards, including at
KfW and Commerzbank. Previously, he was President of the German Federation of Wholesale, Foreign
Trade and Services (BGA) and long-standing Managing Director of the MELO Group. Dr. Bingmann studied
Business Administration in Munich and earned his doctorate at Freie Universität Berlin.

# **Rainer Seiler
# ‍**solutions Beratung GmbH, Geneva Management & Consulting Group S.A

Rainer Seiler is a healthcare market consultant and entrepreneur. He develops and implements
value-creating business models, procurement projects, and selective contracts, primarily in the
pharmaceutical sector. Currently, he supports international companies in Market Access, Sales and
Digital Health, bringing extensive industry experience to several healthcare companies. With 20
years of leadership experience in pharmaceuticals, pharmacies, eCommerce, and wholesale, including
as Managing Director at the Swiss Zur Rose Group (including DocMorris), he has authored professional
books covering topics such as patient centricity, healthcare innovation, and managed care. He is
also active in various health-related organisations, including as a co-founder of the non-profit
initiative Pflasterpass, dedicated to providing first aid for children.

## Advisory Board

# **Bruce Linton
# ‍**Advisory

Bruce Linton is the founder and former CEO and Chairman of Canopy Growth Corporation, one of the
world's largest cannabis-focused companies. Bruce Linton is currently a member of the board of Creso
Pharma, co-chairman and former CEO of Martello Technologies Group Inc. and chairman of the advisory
board of Red Light Holland Corp. He is also an advisor to Celadon Pharmaceuticals and Above Foods.

# **Dr. Thomas Haffner
# ‍**Advisory

Dr. Thomas Haffner has over 25 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, particularly in
product development and international licensing. He is a leading expert in the conception and
marketing of over-the-counter (OTC) drugs, project management, and consulting for successful drug
manufacturers.

## WHO WE ARE

#### The Best Grow is Africa’s leading turnkey cannabis and industrial hemp solutions company, based
#### in South Africa, delivering end-to-end licensed facilities, processing infrastructure,
#### compliant machinery, and regulatory consulting

## OUR MISSION

**To empower Africa’s cannabis and hemp industry with innovative, reliable, and compliant
cultivation and processing solutions, while delivering personalized support and trusted partnerships
for long-term growth.**

## WHY LICENSED PRODUCERS TRUST US
* **Exclusive Distribution Rights – We represent leading global brands like STM Canna, Triminator,
CenturionPro, Dr Dabber, Current Culture H2O, Grotek, King Palm, and more.**
* **Industry Expertise – Over a decade of combined experience in cannabis cultivation, post-harvest
processing, and compliance standards.**
* **Local Support & Training – Technical guidance, product demonstrations, and after-sales support
tailored to African operators.**
* **Turnkey Solutions – From seed to sale, we provide equipment and strategies that integrate
seamlessly into licensed operations.**

## What We Offer

We deliver a carefully curated portfolio of professional-grade cannabis equipment and supplies,
including:
* **Pre-Roll Production Equipment** – STM Canna Mini-RocketBox Plus+, Valenveras testing devices.
* **Grinding & Milling Solutions** – STM Mini-Revolution Grinder for consistent, terpene-friendly
milling.
* **Trimming Solutions** – High-performance CenturionPro trimmers, built for speed, precision, and
gentle handling of cannabis flower, ensuring maximum yield and quality during post-harvest.
* **Extraction & Hash Processing** – Triminator Hash Maker Washing Machines and TRP Rosin Presses
for solventless live rosin production.
* **Hydroponics & Nutrients** – Grotek Impact Grow, Impact Bloom, and Monster Bloom enhancers.
* **Testing & Compliance Tools** – Valenveras potency testing solutions for on-site quality control.

## How We Help You Grow
* **Consultation & Needs Assessment** – We align with your facility’s scale, goals, and compliance
requirements.
* **Equipment Selection** – Recommend tailored solutions for cultivation, post-harvest, or retail.
* **Quote & Supply** – Transparent pricing, import logistics, and warranty-backed equipment.
* **Training & Support** – Our team

## WHO WE ARE

#### The Best Grow is Africa’s leading turnkey cannabis and industrial hemp solutions company, based
#### in South Africa, delivering end-to-end licensed facilities, processing infrastructure,
#### compliant machinery, and regulatory consulting

## OUR MISSION

**To empower Africa’s cannabis and hemp industry with innovative, reliable, and compliant
cultivation and processing solutions, while delivering personalized support and trusted partnerships
for long-term growth.**

## WHY LICENSED PRODUCERS TRUST US
* **Exclusive Distribution Rights – We represent leading global brands like STM Canna, Triminator,
CenturionPro, Dr Dabber, Current Culture H2O, Grotek, King Palm, and more.**
* **Industry Expertise – Over a decade of combined experience in cannabis cultivation, post-harvest
processing, and compliance standards.**
* **Local Support & Training – Technical guidance, product demonstrations, and after-sales support
tailored to African operators.**
* **Turnkey Solutions – From seed to sale, we provide equipment and strategies that integrate
seamlessly into licensed operations.**

## What We Offer

We deliver a carefully curated portfolio of professional-grade cannabis equipment and supplies,
including:
* **Pre-Roll Production Equipment** – STM Canna Mini-RocketBox Plus+, Valenveras testing devices.
* **Grinding & Milling Solutions** – STM Mini-Revolution Grinder for consistent, terpene-friendly
milling.
* **Trimming Solutions** – High-performance CenturionPro trimmers, built for speed, precision, and
gentle handling of cannabis flower, ensuring maximum yield and quality during post-harvest.
* **Extraction & Hash Processing** – Triminator Hash Maker Washing Machines and TRP Rosin Presses
for solventless live rosin production.
* **Hydroponics & Nutrients** – Grotek Impact Grow, Impact Bloom, and Monster Bloom enhancers.
* **Testing & Compliance Tools** – Valenveras potency testing solutions for on-site quality control.

## How We Help You Grow
* **Consultation & Needs Assessment** – We align with your facility’s scale, goals, and compliance
requirements.
* **Equipment Selection** – Recommend tailored solutions for cultivation, post-harvest, or retail.
* **Quote & Supply** – Transparent pricing, import logistics, and warranty-backed equipment.
* **Training & Support** – Our team provides onboarding, training, and after-sales care to ensure
long-term success.

## Our Commitment to Africa’s Cannabis Industry

As regulations evolve, The Best Grow is committed to supporting the African cannabis sector with
SAHPRA-compliant solutions, local expertise, and global partnerships. Our goal is to help licensed
operators remain competitive while building a sustainable, world-class cannabis market on the
continent.

## Ready to Take Your Facility to the Next Level?

Whether you’re scaling pre-roll production, building out extraction, or optimizing cultivation, The
Best Grow has the expertise and exclusive equipment to help you succeed.
