## SOLVENTLESS COMMERCIAL ROSIN PRESSES

Engineered to offer simplicity in high-volume solventless extraction, the TRP and TRP Stack Rosin
Presses were built for production scalability. The Triminator presses are designed with a Power
Frame capable of withstanding up to 25 tons of force and food-grade aluminum platens, delivering the
highest-quality rosin. The Rosin TRP Stack provides drip technology allowing the rosin to quickly
drop to a cool surface with the seamless rotation of the platens. With 6 precision heating elements
and an ergonomic construction, pressing at a commercial scale has never been easier.

## TOP-TIER COMMERCIAL ROSIN PRESS

#### PRESERVE TERPENES

Ensure maximum retention of valuable terpenes and cannabinoids by pressing your rosin at higher
pressure and lower temperatures with the innovative design of the TRP and TRP Stack. The lower temps
ensure you are preserving the quality of your rosin while minimizing any degradation of your
cannabinoids.

#### FASTER, HIGHER YIELD RETURNS

Increase your rosin production with our industry-leading aluminum large-pressing platens. Boost
pressing efficiency with the 3-platen TRP Stack while extracting more product and increasing profits
from every harvest. Achieve commercial-scale production with craft cannabis quality.

#### PURE CONCENTRATE

The technology behind the Triminator Rosin Presses ensures you are producing the cleanest possible
extracts with no use of solvents or harsh chemicals. Using consistent pressure and low temperatures,
the versatile TRP and TRP Stack can press rosin from flower, trim, kief, or bubble hash.

### USED BY BEST SOLVENTLESS EMERALD CUP AWARD WINNER

## INDUSTRY-LEADING TECHNOLOGY

#### PATENTED EASY PIVOT™ DRIP TECH

Our patented Easy Pivot™ drip tech system allows rosin to fall immediately onto a cold surface
below. This results in faster collection, higher terpene retention, and better yields, ensuring
proper directional flow. The Easy Pivot™ drip tech is available exclusively on TRP Stack.

#### 25 TON BVA HYDRAULIC CYLINDER

Equipped with a powerful 25-ton BVA hydraulic cylinder, the TRP and TRP Stack produce unrivaled
pressure across the platens and ensure maximum yield at the lowest temperatures. This reliable
pressure translates into lower pressing temperatures and higher terpene content for higher quality
rosin.

#### INDIVIDUAL PID TEMPERATURE CONTROL

Clear, flavorful rosin requires precision to enable repeatability during the pressing process. To
ensure quality yields, the TRP and TRP Stack have individual platen controls, allowing you to manage
the temperature range and determine the exact rosin temperature on demand for precise, repeatable
results.

## MAXIMUM VERSATILITY WITH PUMP OPTIONS

The rosin presses offer several pump options to accommodate your facility and workflow. The hand
pump provides the greatest feedback loop for the operator, making it perfect for craft producers and
commercial operations that constantly experiment with multiple strains or combinations.

The Air Hydraulic foot pump is an excellent choice for production environments running multiple
presses since a single large compressor can operate an entire room of presses when sized correctly.

## INVEST WITH CONFIDENCE

All Triminator Rosin Presses are guaranteed for one full year and backed by the Triminator support
team for the life of the product.

The touchpoints on every press are food-grade, keeping your solventless rosin free from harmful
chemicals and contamination. The TRP and TRP Stack meet all Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP)
requirements, featuring easy-to-clean anodized surfaces.

### ALL-IN-ONE HASH MAKING EQUIPMENT DESIGNED TO DELIVER TOP-TIER BUBBLE HASH FOR SOLVENTLESS LABS

The Triminator Maker™ combines intelligent design with commercial-scale production capacity to
deliver high yields of potent bubble hash. The Maker™ comes fully equipped and ready to run out of
the box with no additional parts required for operation. The no-shear impeller imitates hand washing
by creating an effective yet gentle vortex for easy trichome separation. The Triminator Maker™ is
the only hash washer to offer an all-inclusive design at an affordable price.
* All-in-one system (no additional parts needed)
* GMP-ready with stainless steel construction
* Automatic wash cycles with customizable and savable settings
* No-shear impeller for easy trichome separation
* Ultra-cool temperatures with thick insulated sleeve
* Large built-in thermometer for temperature tracking
* Tilt system for easy cleaning
* Small footprint with built-in step stool and stand for easy access

## CHOOSE YOUR CAPACITY

#### MODELS:

## MAKER™ STANDARD -> CAPACITY: 75 LITRES

## MAKER™ XL -> CAPACITY: 246 LITRES

## COMMERCIAL-SCALE HASH WASHING MACHINE

The Maker™ brings a new level of productivity to commercial bubble hash production. Available in 65-
or 20-gallon capacity models, you can supercharge your ice water extraction and scale your equipment
to fit your needs.

Crafted with food-grade materials and manufactured in North America, each Maker™ hash washer is
built using durable, sanitary welded stainless steel. This not only ensures effortless cleaning but
also allows users to maintain a clean wash environment, surpassing the limitations of plastic-based
solutions.

## OPTIMIZED TRICHOME SEPARATION

#### | **CUSTOM AUTOMATIC WASHING CYCLES**

Customize your wash sequence parameters to create unique washing cycles. Easily save and replicate
specific washes for ultimate customization and repeatability. Adjust and save any of the following
on your hash washer:
* RPM speed
* Run time (each direction)
* Rest time between switching directions
* Total run time

#### | **ULTRA-COOL TEMPERATURES**

The thick insulation sleeve helps reduce ice usage by up to 50% and is removable for easy cleaning.
Monitor and maintain optimal temperatures with the large built-in thermometer.

#### | GENTLE ON TRICHOMES

Our patent-pending, no-shear impeller imitates the effects of hand washing creating an effective yet
gentle vortex for easy trichome separation.

## PREMIUM FEATURES COME STANDARD

### ALL-INCLUSIVE PRICING

Unlike most hash washers on the market, the Maker™ comes complete with no additional parts required
for operation. The Maker™ is ready to wash with a water pump, collection vessel, and base frame all
included.

## FOOD-GRADE SANITARY DESIGN

#### | ALL-STAINLESS CONSTRUCTION

The Triminator Maker™ is built with 304 stainless steel to meet the highest sanitation standards.

#### | GMP-READY

FDA-approved food-grade components are ready for any GMP-certified facility.

#### | EASY CLEANING SYSTEM

Reduce downtime with the built-in tilt system for quick and easy cleaning. Industrial quarter-turn
valves make cleaning the hash washer simple and fast.

## DESIGNED FOR EXTRACTORS

The Maker™ hash washing system includes everything you need to produce top-quality bubble hash for
solventless extraction. The 75- and 246-litres models come equipped with micron bags, a collection
vessel, and an insulated sleeve for seamless trichome separation.

**Dr. Dabber Switch 2, the Best eRig ever developed is here. Switch² represents the culmination of
over a decade of innovation and customer feedback, resulting in what is considered to be the perfect
electric dabbing experience!**

**Patented IR Sensor Technology**

Exclusive to Switch², the **IR sensor technology** offers precision heating, making it the first
eRig ever with an integrated IR sensor for unparalleled temperature control

**Omni Directional Induction Heating**

Induction heating allows Switch² to offer true omnidirectional heating, ensuring the insert heats up
evenly from the sidewalls and the base at the same rate

**No Failing Atomizers**

ease, providing a consistent, long-lasting experience

**Dynamic Heating Modes: The Game-Changer**

completely change the way you look at electric dab rigs

Descent Mode: The default Dynamic Heating Mode on Switch² replicates traditional torch dabbing by
reducing temperature at a rate of 1° per second during your hit, preserving terpenes and eliminating
that notorious burnt taste

Ascent Mode: Perfect for cold starts and chasing terps, gradually increasing temperature for an
ideal low-temp experience

Steady Mode: Keeps a stable temperature throughout your hit, even adjusting temperature based on the
size of your dab and the rate of inhalation

**App-Enabled Customization**

Personalize your experience with the **Dr. Dabber App**
Customize temperature profiles, hold times, session times and light modes for complete control.

reflectors feature premium multifaceted 95% reflective European hammertone aluminum, giving
excellent light uniformity and diffusion.

The attached Phantom Dual CMh High Voltage ballast features low frequency, square-wave technology
and is silent, reliable, and energy-efficient. It has a USB port for PX1 controller compatibility
and dimming options. Four angled reflector positions can also be set, if desired. Input voltage
options are 277-347V, 277V, and 347V. **Lamps sold separately.**

meters.

## PHANTOM Cultivar GL250 LED, 250W Grow Light

[Request Quote][38]
Category: [Lighting][39] Tags: [grow light][40], [grow lights][41], [led][42], [led ligh][43], [led
light][44], [lights][45], [luminairs][46], [phantom][47]

## Product Details

**PHANTOM Cultivar GL250 LED** is designed for those who take their cultivation seriously,
regardless of what they grow. The compact, elegant yet robust fixture can be used for many different
applications. Offering 2.6 μMol/J efficacy, the GL250 incorporates a premium aluminum unibody
heatsink for longer diode life and less output degradation over time. The integrated
Master-Apprentice Dimmer knob (MAD) and Two-Step Spectrum switch (TSS) puts the grower in control
without the need for additional gear. The mission has always been the same since 1977: Cultivate
Higher.

**Nimble and Capable:**
The physical dimension of the fixture is only around 1 x 1.5 ft with a 2.3-inch profile and 11 lbs.
in weight.

Premium components offer performance and reliability. True IP65-rated fixture against dust and
humidity.

**Master-Apprentice Dimmer knob (MAD):
**It’s more than just an on-board dimming knob. The MAD dimmer lets you take control of up to four
GL250 fixtures when daisy-chained in an array using the included RJ12 cords. In addition, you can
always connect with an 0-10v external controller of your choice.

**Two-Step Spectrum switch (TSS):**
Use the IP65-rated TSS to switch between VEG/FLOWER mode. The FLOWER mode offers the classic S4
spectrum, providing a full spectrum with supplemented red LEDs at 660nm. The VEG mode will reduce
the red spectral output for vegetative plant development needs.

**Get more from PHANTOM Cultivar:**
Start growing your own immediately. We included a pair of ratcheting hangers in the box. We also
have PHANTOM Cultivar GT Grow Tents

**Features:**
* 250W Rated Input Power
* 641 µmol/s Photon Flux (PBAR 280-800 nm)
* 625 µmol/s Photon Flux (PAR 400-700 nm)
* 2.56 µmol/J Efficacy
* DLC Hort QPL Listed eligible for utility rebates
* Standard U.S. 120Vac Input Voltage
* Includes standard RJ12 control cable
* Control 4 GL250’s together with MAD dimmer function
* Dimming ability of 40-100% output
* Spectrum switch between Veg & Flower
* True IP65-rated

costs*

interconnection of multiple fixtures on a centralized controller.

**MX2 Upgrades Comparing to Previous Generation:**

## Product Details

The Phantom PHOTOBIO Advanced Quantum PAR Meter provides accurate and cost-effective measurement for
any light source used in horticultural applications. The Advanced Quantum PAR meter is designed to
measure PAR (Photosynthetically Active Radiation) flux in wavelengths ranging from 400 to 700nm.
There is a positive proportional relationship between the number of photons absorbed in 400 to 700nm
band and the rate of photosynthesis, important for maximizing crop yield.

Complete with compact main unit, remote sensor, two connection cables (short-coiled & 12’
long-straight), AAA batteries and protective carrying case. Convenience of storing up to 99
measurements for easy reference while adjusting light fixture height, dimmer setting and other
environmental changes throughout each phase of growth.

Phantom has a long-standing track record of providing reliable, high-performance products within the
horticultrual equipment industry.
* Compact, portable meter with highly accurate remote quantum sensor
* Simple and easy to use operation, with storage of up to 99 readings
* Ideal for grow tent, greenhouse and commercial grow applications
* Compatible with modern sole-source and supplemental LED fixtures, high pressure sodium (HPS) DE
grow lights, as well as any traditional indoor grow light source

## A800e LED Horticultural Luminaire – NOBEL COMMERCIAL

[Request Quote][38]
Category: [Lighting][39] Tags: [commercial lights][40], [grow lights][41], [growing lights][42],
[led][43], [led grow lights][44], [led lights][45], [light][46], [lighting][47], [lights][48]

From NOBEL COMMERCIAL, one of the Top Horticultural Lights used for commercial operations. Ideal for
large scale indoor cultivation, or greenhouse.

There are many advantages of choosing the **Nobel Commercial A800e LED lights**, over other
alternatives:

**Safety and Electrical Design:** The A800e LED lights use an insulated circuit design, which will
give an output between 30-56V which is safe for people and animal’s direct touch. Therefore no
safety risk of shock.

**Efficiency and Performance:** The A800e LED lights offer higher energy efficiency compared to
other cheaper alternatives. These lights are specifically designed with advanced LED diodes and
drivers to deliver superior efficiency and optimal performance for plant growth.

**Product Design and Purpose:** The A800e LED lights are designed as finished products, specifically
catering to the needs of commercial growers. They undergo thorough research and development to
ensure they meet the requirements of professional cultivation. This is very important when compering
alternatives, to make sure you don’t choose a hobbyist light for your commercial operations. Lights
that have not been tested for this, could indicate that they might not be fully optimized or
tailored for the needs of commercial growers.

**Extended Lifespan:** The A800e LED lights are designed with ballasts that have a theoretical
lifespan (factory declared) of 100,000 hours, which is significantly longer than other alternatives.
Furthermore, the LED diodes themselves have a theoretical lifespan of 50,000 hours. The A800e lights
have the potential to last 5-10 times longer than other cheaper alternatives.

**High Output and Efficiency**: The A800e LED lights offer a high output of more than 2000 µmol, as
demonstrated by real test reports. Normally this output surpasses those of alternative lights,
indicating that the A800e lights provide a higher photosynthetic photon flux density (PPFD) for
improved plant growth and productivity. Additionally, the A800e lights are designed to be
energy-efficient, boasting a 99% power factor and low voltage human safety driver. This ensures
optimal energy utilization and reduces power wastage.

## Cold Screw Oil Extraction Press

[Request Quote][38]
Categories: [Industrial Hemp][39], [Seed Press][40] Tags: [extraction][41], [hemp seed oil
extraction][42], [hemp seed press][43], [oil extraction][44], [seed oil][45], [seed oil
extraction][46], [seed press][47]

The M70.2 Precision Cold Screw Oil Extraction Press will extract 85% to 95% of the available oil
within the plant material and while kept under “cold press” requirement of 138F (59C). The oil
temperature coming out of the press is normally 90F to 120F (32C to 49C). The oil content of the
press meal can be as low as 5%, but is normally 7% to 9%, which for livestock protein feed is a
perfect energy to protein ratio. The M70.2 does not require preheating of the commodity going into
the press.

The M70.2 will crush out 1,000 to 1,500lbs (454Kg to 680Kg) over a 24 hour period which is 42 to 62
lbs per hour (19Kg to 28Kg per hour). Vastly speaking for all oil seed commodities having an oil
content of 38% to 44% oil, our clients report that they get 800lbs to 1200lbs of press meal (363Kg
to 544Kg) and 50 to 70 gallons (189 to 265 Liters) of oil over a 24hr period. That’s 33 to 50lbs
(15Kg to 23Kg) per hour of press meal and 2 to 3 gallons (7.5 to 11.3 Liters) per hour of oil. Nuts,
being of greater oil content will produce more oil and less press meal.

**Electrical.** The M70.2 OilPress is powered by 200V to 260V, single phase OR three phase, 50Hz or
60Hz. The M70.2 draws only 3 to 6 amps while running! Over a 24hr period, while crushing soybeans,
one of the more difficult commodities to crush, the M70.2 consumed only 21.3KwH. We have customers
who power their press with solar power.

**The M70.2 is the most efficient oil press on the market!**

**Specifications**. The M70.2 OilPress overall measures 38”/96.5cm long x 11”/28cm wide x 12”/30.5cm
height and weighs 190lbs/86Kg. The M70.2 OilPress ships in a crate that measures 36”/91cm x 22”/56cm
x 22”/56cm and weighs 250lbs/113Kg. We can also send the M70.2 broke down into 5 boxes that each
weigh less than 70lbs/32Kg. We have assembly videos that show how to assemble the press.

**Maintenance**. The press requires a gearbox and bearing housing oil change at about six months of
running 24×7 or 3,500 to 4,000 hours of operation. The oil is a synthetic gear oil 75W-110 that has
“EP” (extreme pressure) property. Only a few tools are needed to operate the M70.2 OilPress.

**Wear Parts**. The screw is the main wear part. The screw will last one to one and a half years
with the press running all day every day. The crush barrel will outlast 2 to 3 screws. It is not
necessary to purchase replacement parts with the press. We inventory the wear parts so delivery is
very fast.

**The M70.2 is the highest quality precision cold screw oil extraction press on the market and
includes a FIVE YEAR WARRANTY against any part breakage!**

## HurdMaster MD1000 Micro Decorticator

[Request Quote][38]
Category: [Industrial Hemp][39] Tags: [decorticator][40], [fiber][41], [fibre][42], [hempcrete][43],
[hemplime][44], [hurdmaster][45], [processing][46], [shredder][47], [stalks][48]

The HurdMaster is intended for small farming and processing operations and for CBD and marijuana
producers who want to capitalize on leftover stems. The machine is designed for separating the
cannabis stalk’s woody inner core (hurd, shivs, shives) from the exterior bast fibers. The resulting
hurd can be used for hempcrete construction, as animal bedding and animal litter, or as plant
bedding. With additional technology, the separated bast fibers can be further processed for a wide,
wide variety of applications.

Operation
* Manual input/output requires 2 workers
* Designed for long hemp stalks
* Max size for stalk up to 2.5 cm in diameter
* Produces shivs 5 – 30mm long
* Output up to 50kg per hour

Applications

• Hempcrete construction
• Natural fiber insulation
• Animal bedding & litter
• Plant bedding

Technical specifications
* Power supply: 220V / 1500W
* Capacity: ~50kg/hr
* Dimensions: 80cm x 200cm x 125 cm
* Weight: 260kg

## PRODUCTS

Our focus is to bring to Southern Africa the latest technical solutions for the hemp & cannabis
industry.

Technology that is tried and tested within the industry, and which will increase the efficiency of
your operations greatly.

We also supply to producers and growshops at wholesale price consumables that are needed in the day
to day operations.

Growshops or distributors can sign up online and create their own accounts for direct access to all
our products, and wholesale prices.

## SERVICES

We have partnered with Cannapro, internationally renowned for the design and construction of premium
indoor cannabis facilities & light dep greenhouses for growing high yielding healthy cannabis crops.

Customers have quickly come to learn we offer the best solutions, or nothing at all.

The CannaPro Group offers your cannabis growing team decades of professional horticultural
experience.

We have assembled a team of all-stars you could say, who bring you tried and true cultivation
methods.

Through them, we can assist with custom design and building of GMP certified rooms and commercial
greenhouses.

**If you have a cultivation license, and need help with your project planning, designing and
development, contact us now.**

## ROOT POUCH

[Request Quote][38]
SKU: N/A Category: [Pots][39] Tags: [pot][40], [pots][41], [pouch][42]

Root Pouch are geotextile pots made from recovered natural fibers and recycled plastic bottles.

They are a sustainable and ecological alternative in relation to other geotextile pots manufactured
with materials derived from oil to other plastic pots.

In addition Root Pouch are degradable to the 4-5 years buried along with the plant they contain.

These pots are fantastic for any type of plant, they are light and flexible, which makes it easy to
transport and send them without taking up much space and with much less weight than with plastic
pots.

The material used in manufacturing is breathable, allowing the roots to obtain an extra amount of
oxygen.

This oxygen supply stimulates the formation of new roots and secondary roots throughout the pot. The
cycle of “pruning” and “growth of new roots continues, creating abundant and healthy roots in the
culture medium.

Main features:

Healthier and stronger plants.

Absence of spiraling

They require less amount of substrate

Low risk of post-transparent shock

General improvement of the root structure.

¿Quiénes somos?

De la vocación, servicio y del interés en la búsqueda de las soluciones adecuadas a cada necesidad, nace AppChem .

Una compañía flexible y dinámica cuyo foco está en solventar las necesidades de los clientes de una forma rápida, eficiente, segura y respetando su confianza.

“Nuestra sólida formación y experiencia profesional nos genera una excelente combinación para poder asesorar y acompañar tanto en nuevos proyectos como en la mejora y optimización de otros existentes. Trabajamos para mantener lazos comerciales sanos y fuertes con nuestros Clientes, a quienes consideramos compañeros de trabajo. La formación y el conocimiento de la industria es un aspecto estratégico para poder ofrecer un trato personalizado, rápido y de alta calidad a nuestros clientes, que es nuestro principal objetivo.”

Con estos valores como visión, fundamos AppChem , ofreciendo una solución completa en la provisión de productos químicos, equipos y servicios para la industria.

Primer Contacto

Nuestras Referencias

Appchem Academy

¿Qué Hacemos?

En AppChem brindamos soluciones integrales para la industria, combinando productos de alta calidad, equipamientos de vanguardia y servicios especializados:

🔹 Productos Químicos

Reactivos de laboratorio (PA, alta pureza y diagnóstico). Medios de Cultivo.

Solventes, columnas para cromatografía y estándares de referencia certificados.

Materiales de Referencia: agroalimentarios, químicos para síntesis, intermedios, terminados e impurezas según farmacopeas internacionales.

Materias primas y excipientes para la industria farmacéutica y otras, con opciones de proveedores GMP y contratos competitivos.

🔹 Insumos de Laboratorio y Equipamiento Productivo

Insumos para análisis fisicoquímicos y microbiológicos.

Insumos para laboratorios de Investigación y Desarrollo.

Equipos de contención y seguridad.

Equipos de laboratorio: reactores, biofermentadores, destiladores, cromatografía preparativa (media y alta presión).

🔹 Equipos de Fabricación:

Reactores, fermentadores, homogeneizadores

Fabricación de productos Naturales (Extractores, destiladores, purificación)

Fabricación Farmacéutica: Solidos, líquidos, Aséptico, Inyectables, etc.

Aisladores, RABS, Cabinas de Seguridad, Cabinas de Pesada, Glove Tester.

🔹 Seguridad Industrial

Soluciones para almacenamiento, transporte y manejo seguro de inflamables y corrosivos.

Gestión de descartes HPLC y control de vapores de solventes.

🔹 Servicios Especializados

Servicios analíticos de alta complejidad, especialmente para las industrias farmacéutica, farmoquímica, química y biológica.

Servicios Toxicológicos: Informes OEL, PDE, Impurezas según ICHQ3, etc.

Mediciones Ambientales: SMEPAC

🔹 Logística y Suministro

Opciones de compra nacionalizada o internacional (CIF/CIP/ExW).

Almacén propio para gestionar entregas programadas y parciales.

The company offers a digital subscription to the "Revista Cáñamo Online," providing exclusive content and weekly updates, as well as a print subscription for readers interested in the cannabis community. Targeting cannabis enthusiasts and culture aficionados, Canamo serves as a valuable resource in the cannabis media and publishing industry.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### Please read our FAQ for all questions related to our service

[ What are the delivery charges for orders from Cannabiz Seed? ][37]

If you have made an order over $99, you will receive Free Shipping. If you are under $99, USA
orders are $10, Canada orders are $10, Australia orders are $15, Europe orders are 10 euros, and
worldwide outside of these areas are $22.

[ Which payment methods are accepted on our website? ][38]

We accept Major Credit Cards, Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, E Transfer, Bitcoin, Bank Transfer, and as
well Cash. Please check out all options at checkout and see what payment options you have based on
your location. Make sure to take advantage of our free seed options for certain payments.

[ How long will delivery take? ][39]

Delivery is estimated between 2 to 10 business days depending on your location. We do provide
tracking on orders for some countries.

[ How do you secure my transaction? ][40]

We go the distance with your browsing and purchase being secured by HTTPS with 2048 bit encryption.
We delete all of the transactions on our site daily, and keep no records of browsing or
transactions.

[ What exactly happens after ordering? ][41]

Once you order you will receive a confirmation email to confirm your order. Then you will receive
an email to confirm when your order will be shipped. All orders are shipped within 24-48 hours.
Please note that if you do not see your email, check junk email or spam in case our email has gone
there. Thanks!

[ Do I receive an invoice for my order? ][42]

Yes you will receive an invoice by email as well you receive your invoice at confirmation page too.

[ What currency will I be charged in? ][43]

Each country will have its set currency that will be charged. The majority of countries will be
charged in USD.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### Please read our FAQ for all questions related to our service

[ What are the delivery charges for orders from Cannabiz Seed? ][37]

If you have made an order over $99, you will receive Free Shipping. If you are under $99, USA
orders are $10, Canada orders are $10, Australia orders are $15, Europe orders are 10 euros, and
worldwide outside of these areas are $22.

[ Which payment methods are accepted on our website? ][38]

We accept Major Credit Cards, Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, E Transfer, Bitcoin, Bank Transfer, and as
well Cash. Please check out all options at checkout and see what payment options you have based on
your location. Make sure to take advantage of our free seed options for certain payments.

[ How long will delivery take? ][39]

Delivery is estimated between 2 to 10 business days depending on your location. We do provide
tracking on orders for some countries.

[ How do you secure my transaction? ][40]

We go the distance with your browsing and purchase being secured by HTTPS with 2048 bit encryption.
We delete all of the transactions on our site daily, and keep no records of browsing or
transactions.

[ What exactly happens after ordering? ][41]

Once you order you will receive a confirmation email to confirm your order. Then you will receive
an email to confirm when your order will be shipped. All orders are shipped within 24-48 hours.
Please note that if you do not see your email, check junk email or spam in case our email has gone
there. Thanks!

[ Do I receive an invoice for my order? ][42]

Yes you will receive an invoice by email as well you receive your invoice at confirmation page too.

[ What currency will I be charged in? ][43]

Each country will have its set currency that will be charged. The majority of countries will be
charged in USD.

[ Do you ship discreetly? ][44]

Yes all our orders are shipped discreetly with no labels on the front of the package. We want all
our customers to be able to buy in privacy.

[ Where do your seeds come from? ][45]

We source our seeds from top breeders across the globe, carefully selecting each one to ensure the
highest quality for our customers. Every breeder we work with undergoes rigorous testing to meet our
strict standards. If you’d like to learn more about the breeder behind a particular strain, please
feel free to reach out via email, and we’d be happy to provide you with the details.

## Have a question to ask about your order or our products?

Our team is here to assist you with any order or inquiries 24/7.

If you have urgent questions about a product or your order, simply navigate to the bottom right
corner of our website and click the chat icon. You’ll be connected with a real customer support
agent, not a bot, who will promptly address all your concerns.

For any queries related to growing or past orders, please reach out to our head office staff at:

We will get back to you right away 7 days a week to make sure your needs are accommodated.

Thank you for your support!

# We Are Cannabiz Seed

Welcome to the Cannabiz Seed community, where passion, quality, and innovation unite to deliver the
finest cannabis seeds for growers of all experience levels.

We are dedicated to providing top-tier genetics that empower growers to unlock the full potential of
their cannabis plants. Wherever you are in your cultivation journey, we offer a wide range of high
quality cannabis seeds that can cater to all your needs and preferences.

## Our Vision and Mission

Our Mission is simple: to offer high-quality Cannabis Seeds that produce healthy, robust plants with
excellent yields and potent effects.

What is the Digital Medicinal Cannabis Card?
This digital card is the convenient companion to an approved PT.33 prescription. It helps cardholders access participating shops and discounts across the WEED.TH network, but it is not the prescription itself. Why should I get a Medicinal Card from WEED.TH?

Unlike most physical cards that restrict you to a single dispensary, the WEED.TH card is widely accepted, currently honored by hundreds of shops across Thailand. Our mission is to expand this acceptance to all dispensaries nationwide.

DATA SECURITY
How does it work?
Card holders can access their digital card through the WEED.TH website or mobile app, but the PT.33 remains the primary prescription document. Each approved application goes through our consultation workflow and, if approved, is issued with a 30-day PT.33 and a matching digital card. The PT.33 original is signed in wet ink and mailed either to the patient or to the selected participating shop, while a matching digital copy is also available in the card system and by email.
Read the step-by-step PT.33 process
Why choose WEED.TH for your consultation?
Our secure consultation process ensures that only licensed Thai Traditional Medicine doctors have access to your sensitive personal and medical information. Unlike other providers who may ask you to submit documents through unsecured forms, messaging apps, or email where multiple staff members could access your data, our platform maintains strict privacy controls throughout the entire consultation process.
Your personal data is handled in compliance with PDPA laws and medical privacy standards. The consultation is conducted directly with qualified doctors, ensuring your medical information remains confidential and is only used for legitimate prescription purposes.

FAQ
What is the Digital Medicinal Cannabis Card?
This digital card is the convenient companion to an approved PT.33 prescription. It helps cardholders access participating shops and discounts across the WEED.TH network, but it is not the prescription itself. The primary medical document is the PT.33, and approved patients also receive that PT.33 as a mailed physical original together with a matching digital copy.
How much does a Medicinal Card Consultation cost?
Following regulatory updates in June 2025, the price for a consultation has been revised and now ranges from ฿200 to ฿500, depending on the clinic. This significant reduction from our previous pricing makes medicinal cannabis more accessible to Thai patients. This fee encompasses the consultation with a licensed Thai Traditional Medicine doctor, the issuance of a 30-day P.T. 33-compliant prescription, digital card creation, and participation in the Cannabis Card Network with ongoing support.
How does Cannabis Delivery work?
As a holder of a Medicinal Cannabis Card, you gain exclusive access to certified dispensaries that offer special discounts for medicinal cardholders. These dispensaries are rigorously verified as licensed sellers, ensuring a secure and trustworthy purchasing experience. Additionally, as a cardholder, you can conveniently order delivery services directly from these shops through our platform. This not only simplifies the ordering process but also allows you to avail of the exclusive discounts reserved for medicinal cardholders, enhancing your purchasing experience.
Why should I get a Medicinal Card from WEED.TH?
Choosing the WEED.TH Medicinal Cannabis Card offers numerous advantages, setting it apart in the Thai market. One of the key benefits is its digital format, which is not only more secure but also significantly more convenient than traditional physical cards. Unlike most physical cards that restrict you to a single dispensary, the WEED.TH card is widely accepted, currently honored by hundreds of shops across Thailand. Our mission is to expand this acceptance to all dispensaries nationwide.
Another distinctive feature of the WEED.TH card is our unique approach to partnerships with dispensaries. We do not charge them any fees for utilizing our cannabis card system. Instead, we require that they offer exclusive discounts to our cardholders. This mutually beneficial arrangement ensures that your expenditures not only support our platform but also contribute to a consumer-first network. We are committed to continuously enhancing the value of the WEED.TH Medicinal Cannabis Card in terms of savings, safety, and ease of use.
By choosing WEED.TH, you're not just getting a card; you're joining a movement to make medicinal cannabis more accessible and affordable in Thailand. We're dedicated to providing the most beneficial medicinal cannabis card in the country, focusing on your needs first.

WEED.TH is a digital platform that connects patients with licensed doctors and dispensaries. We are a team of passionate individuals who believe in the power of medicinal cannabis to improve the lives of patients in Thailand. We are committed to providing a safe, secure, and compliant platform for patients to access medicinal cannabis.
This platform is not affiliated with any government agency. We are an independent, private service committed to offering secure access to medicinal cannabis. Our goal is to complement, not replace, the guidance of healthcare professionals.

## Our History

Fluence was founded in Austin, Texas, in 2012 by forward-thinking entrepreneurs Nick Klase and Randy
Johnson.
They were the first to build custom-spectrum LED solutions and introduce white light that mimics
sunlight to the horticulture industry, a stark departure from the inefficient lighting systems
cultivators previously relied on.

This created a watershed moment across the global horticulture industry. Fluence lights used less
energy, lasted longer and ran cooler, enabling tiered setups that multiplied indoor grow spaces
while achieving impressive savings in energy, HVAC and water costs.

In 2014, Fluence began designing systems that could lead to more sustainable forms of crop
production. The result was a diverse product portfolio that allowed the world’s largest greenhouses
and indoor farms to shift from wasteful legacy lighting to the quality, output and reduced footprint
for which LED grow lights are now universally known.

In 2022, Fluence was acquired by Signify, the world leader in lighting. The acquisition added
Fluence’s complementary technology and market segments to Signify’s existing horticultural lighting
operations Today, Fluence operates as part of Signify’s Agricultural Lighting Business Unit
comprised of 250+ former growers, sought-after CEA researchers and leading cannabis business
experts.

As a leading LED lighting supplier in the global cannabis market, Fluence continues its commitment
to supporting the world’s top greenhouse and indoor growers from its original offices in Austin,
Texas, and EMEA offices in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

## SPYDR Series Overview

The SPYDR Series is Fluence’s purpose-built lighting platform for multi-tier cannabis cultivation –
designed to support growers of all experience levels and cultivation strategies.

**Leveraging Fluence’s deep expertise in cannabis photobiology and commercial cultivation, SPYDR
systems deliver precise light distribution, consistent performance, and scalable flexibility.
Whether the goal is to manage upfront investment, improve operational efficiency, or maximize
quality, the platform provides a reliable foundation for modern indoor and vertical growing
environments.**

Each SPYDR solution is engineered to support close-proximity canopy development and repeatable crop
outcomes, helping growers maintain control over both plant performance and operational costs. From
streamlined deployments to highly optimized facilities, the SPYDR Series meets the needs of the
grower—without compromising quality or reliability.

With multiple options, the SPYDR series allows growers to align their [lighting strategy][68] with
their operational priorities while staying grounded in a proven platform.

Lighting decisions impact far more than just plant growth—they influence installation timelines,
operational efficiency, maintenance requirements, and ultimately return-on-investment.

The SPYDR Series is designed to simplify that decision. By offering platforms with clearly defined
approaches, growers can choose a solution that aligns with their current needs while maintaining the
flexibility to evolve over time.

All SPYDR options are built on the same foundation of science and research, delivering consistent
light distribution, reliable performance, and seamless integration into [multi-tier cultivation
systems][69]. What differs is how each solution aligns to operational priorities—whether that’s
efficiency and controlled investment, or maximum output and durability in demanding environments.

**For growers navigating expansion, optimization, or new facility design, SPYDR provides a clear,
dependable path forward.**

## Questions? We've Got Answers
* #### What is the difference between SPYDR e and SPYDR 3?

SPYDR e and SPYDR 3 are built on the same Fluence platform but are designed to support different
operational priorities. SPYDR e delivers balanced performance with a focus on cost control and
efficient deployment, making it a practical option for growers managing capital or scaling
operations. SPYDR 3 is engineered for higher output and durability, with deeper canopy penetration
and a fully sealed design suited for [high-intensity environments][72] and facilities that require
consistent performance at scale.
* #### Which SPYDR fixture should I choose for my facility?

The right choice depends on your facility goals and operating conditions. Growers prioritizing
controlled investment and reliable, balanced performance often choose SPYDR e. Those focused on
maximizing output, achieving deeper canopy penetration, or operating in more demanding
environments typically choose SPYDR 3. Both fixtures integrate into multi-tier systems, so the
decision comes down to performance requirements, environmental conditions, and long-term
production strategy.
* #### What does IP66-rated mean and why does it matter in a grow environment?

An IP66 rating indicates that the fixture is fully protected against dust and resistant to
powerful water exposure. In a cultivation environment, this level of protection is important for
maintaining performance in high-humidity conditions and during routine cleaning cycles. The SPYDR
3 is a sealed design and IP-66 rated, helping reduce maintenance concerns, protect internal
components, and support long-term reliability in harsh commercial operations.
* #### What PhysioSpec^{TM} spectrum is recommended for the flowering stage?

growth stages, including flowering. Common flowering strategies often utilize spectra such as R4,
R4a and R45, depending on cultivation goals and environmental conditions. The right choice can
vary based on factors like cultivar, facility design, and desired plant characteristics, so many
growers evaluate spectrum selection as part of a broader lighting strategy.

spectrum luminaires, [reducing operational costs][72] while maintaining high yield.
* **Proven Light Recipes & Intuitive Interface:** Research-backed, scheduling expertise make it easy
to apply the right spectrum at the right time.
* **Fast ROI with Premium Results:** Realize ROI savings in as little as 18 months and maintain
higher-quality, market-ready flower that retains its full bag appeal.

PYTHN Series

## Maximum Growing Efficiency in Every Season

PYTHN is engineered for cannabis cultivators who demand high flower quality, maximum efficiency, and
lighting that’s easy to control:
* **Purpose-Built Under-Canopy Solution:** Even the most advanced toplighting systems can’t fully
penetrate a dense cannabis canopy. PYTHN delivers uniform, high-efficiency light directly to the
[lower canopy][72], activating photosynthesis where it’s been missing and encouraging robust bud
formation from top to bottom.
* **Proven Energy Efficiency (Up to 3.4 µmol/J):** Industry-leading efficacy reduces operational
costs while transforming previously wasted canopy space into premium flower production.
* **Seamless Integration & Easy Installation:** Purpose-built for both single-tier and multi-tier
cannabis operations, PYTHN integrates seamlessly with existing toplighting strategies with modular
snap-in connections and adjustable mounting.
* **Fast ROI with Premium Results:** Increase A-grade buds from 37% to 50%, reduce trim waste from
35% to 26%, and realize improved crop value with every harvest cycle.

## Specs of PYTHN Series

The PYTHN sets a new standard for under-canopy lighting with its exceptional Q90 36,000-hour
lifetime rating, delivering reliable performance that ensures consistent lower canopy development
throughout years of operation. Built with professional growers in mind, this durable fixture
maintains optimal light levels longer due to its robust thermally efficient design.

Operating with voltage ranges of 120–277V and 347–400V, the PYTHN is just as versatile in
single-tier indoor grows as it is in [multi-tier cannabis operations][74]. Its efficient design and
available R6 and R8 spectra provide superior light distribution while maximizing energy efficiency
across your growing operation.

# Controls

Why Controls?

## Advanced lighting control systems engineered for commercial cultivation excellence.

Lighting is no longer a fixed input—it’s a dynamic tool that directly influences growth rate,
morphology, cannabinoid development, and terpene expression.

Modern control systems allow cultivators to optimize every micromole, delivering [exact light
levels][68], spectra, and timing to match each plant’s needs.

## With advanced lighting control, growers can:

### OPTIMIZE CROP quality & CONSISTENCY:

Precise environmental control enables repeatable, [data-driven cultivation at scale][69].

### MAXIMIZE YIELD POTENTIAL:

Deliver the [right light intensity][70] and spectrum at the right time to maximize photosynthesis
and plant efficiency.

### DEVELOP data-driven PROTOCOLs:

Create, test, and refine lighting recipes backed by real performance data.

Whether you manage one room or an entire facility, controls are how you transform light from a
static input into an adaptive growth engine—driving higher performance and greater profitability
crop after crop.

[Digital display of cannabis LED grow lights showing photoperiod and output for commercial cannabis
cultivation.][Digital display of cannabis LED grow lights showing photoperiod and output for
commercial cannabis cultivation.]

### Wireless Flex Dimming
* **Fluence’s Wireless Flex Dimming** brings unprecedented simplicity, flexibility, and [cost
efficiency][71] to modern grow operations by replacing individual dimming cables with reliable
wireless control. By streamlining installation and removing the need for fixture-by-fixture
wiring, Wireless Flex Dimming significantly reduces labor costs, minimizes installation time, and
eliminates the risk of wiring errors.
* The result is a **cleaner infrastructure, easier scalability, and a more responsive lighting
environment**—giving growers the freedom to fine-tune intensity strategies without the physical
constraints of traditional cabling.

### GrowWise Control
* **Fluence’s GrowWise Control** gives growers complete flexibility and precision over their
lighting strategy, enabling fine-tuned intensity management, customizable spectral approaches, and
automated schedules that elevate crop quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Seamlessly integrating with leading climate and facility management systems, **GrowWise Control
simplifies daily operation while delivering the consistency [modern vertical farms][72],
greenhouses, and research environments demand**—empowering growers to optimize performance and
maximize yield with science-driven control.

# Ascending from Horizons

Barry, Illinois

[Home][68] » [Case Studies][69] » Ascending from Horizons

## Challenges
* Low DLI and temperatures in winter
* Transitioning from CMH and HPS to advanced Fluence LEDs
* Bio-security

“Fluence has provided excellent customer service. Everybody has been quick to answer my questions or
find somebody that can answer my question. Nothing is left open-ended.”

- Dennison Collard
Indoor Director of Cultivation, Ascend Barry

“Ascend Wellness is proof that quality and consistency are the benchmarks for the cannabis industry
moving forward. Many brands will be playing catch up while looking to Ascend’s model for
inspiration.”

- Aaron Fellabaum
Fluence Key Account Manager

## Consistency without Compromise

Just east of the Mississippi River, the small, unassuming farming town of Barry, Illinois, hides its
rustic charm in an endless sea of checkered fields. Those who stop for gas on their way to St. Louis
or Springfield may appreciate the slow, steady, peaceful rhythm of Barry—and perhaps even visit the
museum—before hopping back in the car. Yet, none would expect this 200-year-old town in flat fields
to host two of the most technologically advanced, data driven, and commercially [successful vertical
cannabis cultivation][70] facilities in the world: Ascend Wellness.

Founded in 2018, Ascend Wellness operates two separate grow facilities in Barry with mirrored
administrative teams and distinct cultivation structures. Their indoor facility boasts 52,000 square
feet, divided into four double-stacked cultivation rooms. The [greenhouse facility][71] is slightly
larger at 58,000 square feet, parceled into eighteen grow rooms. A coalition of advanced
technologies, best practices, and skilled employees allows Ascend Wellness to deliver unrivaled
quality and consistency from one harvest to the next. Consistency remains a major reason for their
ascent with popular brands such as Simply Herb, Ozone, Common Goods, and more.

[ Contact Us Today! ][72]

Barry, Illinois

##### Crop

Cannabis

##### Results
* 19 g per square inch increase in yield
* 30% overall increase in yield per room
* Higher DLI and lower energy costs

Challenges
Consistency is Key

From its conception, Ascend Wellness has emphasized consistent quality on par with America’s biggest
and most well-known brands. However, growing fragile plants—especially complex cannabis
strains—presents incredible challenges for even the most experienced growers and facility operators.
The Great State of Illinois offers additional hurdles like insects, low light, and cold winters, but
Ascend Wellness has climbed each rung with careful consideration.

The team operates with a rigorous commitment to biosecurity and cleanliness, treating the indoor and
greenhouse sections as entirely separate entities to prevent cross-contamination. Dedicated staff
perform Integrative Pest Management (IPM) and [fertigation][73], utilizing reverse osmosis storage
and direct injection systems. Leadership takes pride in maintaining one of the cleanest facilities
in the industry, comparing the standard to a pharmacy or medical office to ensure consumer trust.

Advanced [Fluence RAPTR LEDs][74] replaced the old HPS and CMH fixtures to ensure consistent
high-quality spectra, lighting controls, and canopy penetration during the cold, dark winter months.
Argus and Ridder climate control systems were also implemented for precise crop steering. When
coupled with Fluence’s Wireless Flex Dimming technology, the Ascend Wellness team can easily ensure
the optimal level of light intensity -regardless of the weather or time of year- without the
incremental cost and complexity of cables.

Despite the high level of control, the directors acknowledge the inherent difficulties of the “Wild
West” of cannabis genetics. They manage friendly competition between the indoor and greenhouse teams
while navigating the unique challenges posed by Mother Nature, such as extreme Illinois humidity and
winter ice. Ultimately, they view cannabis as a resilient but demanding crop that requires
365-day-a-year attention to detail. This intense schedule and commitment to quality is why Ascend’s
Barry facilities employ approximately 450 people, representing a significant portion of the
working-age adults in Pike County. The company has become a pillar of the local economy, generating
tax revenue and supporting local shops.

[ VYPR Series ][75]

## Results

### Lofty Goals, Higher Results

Ascend Wellness has enjoyed tremendous success and popularity in short time due to their rigorous
attention to detail. The results speak for themselves. For instance, upgrading to Fluence VYPR LEDs
resulted in a 19 gram per square foot increase in yield and a roughly 30% overall increase in yield
per room. The modular design of the new fixtures allows for easier maintenance and installation.
William Slayton, Director of Cultivation, reports that the LED rooms set site records with RAPTR
LEDs, averaging 113 grams per square foot. LEDs have proven particularly beneficial during Illinois
winters, providing a 9 DLI (Daily Light Integral) increase compared to HPS lights. Both directors
highlight that LEDs provide superior light penetration, turning what would typically be “shake” into
valuable “B-buds” or “C-buds” [deeper in the canopy][76].

Employees saw a notable difference in flower structure and stacking. One director described the
resulting buds as being the “size of Nerf footballs.” One thing is clear: something big is happening
in the small town of Barry, Illinois. Ascend Wellness is changing the cannabis industry by proving
what is possible with state-of-the-art facilities in the middle of humble, checkered fields just
east of the Mighty Mississippi.

## Challenges
* Re-establishing Thai cannabis as a respected product globally
* Navigating Thailand’s intense climate
* Creating a cultivation culture

“With Fluence lights, the spectrum is perfect for pushing the plants without stressing them, and the
reliability lets us focus on mindful cultivation instead of troubleshooting equipment.”

- Brian Hood
Chief Cultivator

“What makes Thai Stick special isn’t just the quality—it’s the culture. They cultivate with
intention, pride, and purpose. Their team, their energy, their history, and their vision represent
exactly why Fluence exists: to empower growers who honor both the plant and the community around
it.”

- Casey Rivero
Cannabis Solution Architect, Fluence
Thai Stick is a cultivation company rooted deeply in Thailand’s cultural and historical connection
to cannabis. Named after one of the most iconic Thai cannabis exports in history, the brand
represents a return to heritage—elevating traditional Thai respect for the plant through modern
science, advanced greenhouse technology, and Fluence LED lighting.

By combining a family-driven team culture with a mindful, respectful approach to plant care, Thai
Stick is producing some of the country’s cleanest, most aromatic, and most globally competitive
cannabis. Fluence fixtures power every stage of growth, reinforcing Thai Stick’s vision to honor the
past, cultivate with intention, and position Thailand once again as a global source of premium
cannabis.

Challenges
Honoring Thai Heritage While Building World-Class Cannabis

Thai Stick faced a unique challenge: to build a premium cultivation operation in a country where
cannabis is both ancient and newly rediscovered. Thailand’s climate required advanced technology to
grow consistently at global standards, but the company also wanted to stay true to Thai cultural
values— collectivism, warmth, mutual respect, and genuine care for each other and the plant.

Mindful cultivation became the guiding philosophy, requiring reliability from every environmental
system—especially lighting. Before Fluence, the team wasn’t fully confident they could meet the
precision needed to honor both tradition and global expectations.

## Results

### Where Culture, Community, and Technology Meet

Fluence lighting solutions helped Thai Stick unify sophisticated greenhouse operations with their
cultural philosophy. The team can now cultivate with intention—replicating perfect environmental
conditions, protecting terpene-rich flowers from heat stress, and enabling harvest timing based on
aroma expression, not guesswork.

This scientific precision reinforces their cultural ethos: do what is right for the plant, not what
is convenient for people. Employees feel like family, and the lighting system gives them confidence
that the plant is receiving what it needs, consistently, every day. Thai Stick’s flowers now reflect
both Thai heritage and world-class greenhouse performance.

## Control Brightness & Gain Consistency, Accuracy, & Efficiency

SHYFT Light Scheduler

SHYFT Light Scheduler’s Photoacclimation and Photoperiod modes help growers maximize crop quality,
yield and growth speed by carefully controlling the scheduling, consistency and quantity of light
delivered to plants in each stage of the growth cycle. Two programmable channels enable separate
management of distinct growth zones. Automated light controls can help produce repeatable results
for different crops. Pair the SHYFT Light Scheduler with the Wireless Flex Dimming, the innovative
wireless solution to replace 0-10V fixture control wiring.

[SHYFT LED grow light control panel for commercial cannabis cultivation on display.][SHYFT LED grow
light control panel for commercial cannabis cultivation on display.]

**1. CUSTOMIZABLE DIMMER MODES**
0%-100% light intensity control. Customize the Photoacclimation cycle brightness curve to set
individual brightness levels for each day, the Photoperiod brightness level, or just manually dim.

**2. PROGRAMMABLE DUAL CHANNELS**
Independent Zones. Up to 100 light fixtures (50 fixtures per channel).

**3. CONVENIENT INSTALLATION**
Wall and rail mounting options; IP65 rating for installation in wet, humid, and dusty locations.

**4. WARRANTY**
Provided with a 1-year limited warranty.

**5. RELIABLE BATTERY BACKUP**
Never lose your settings during a power outage.

**6. COLOR LCD TOUCH SCREEN**
Intuitive and easy to operate.

**7. FLEXIBLE PHOTOACCLIMATION CAPABILITY**
Gently acclimate crops to target brightness level and prevent negative effects due to abrupt change
in brightness. Use SHYFT’s built-in settings or customize.

**8. DAILY PHOTOPERIOD CONTROL**
Repeats a daily on/off schedule at a preset brightness level every 24 hours with optional sunrise
and sunset simulation.

[ Questions? Contact Us Today ][73]

### Product Installation

Install directly in the grow environment
With an IP65 rating, SHYFT Light Scheduler can be installed in humid, wet, and dusty environments,
eliminating the need for remote installation or a costly sealed enclosure.
[ Installation Resources ][74]

### Photoacclimation Tutorial

Create a Photoacclimation Cycle for your Photoperiods
Photoacclimation mode protects plant health by preventing shock to plants with a sudden change in
brightness level for a new growth stage. The Photoacclimation cycle incrementally changes the
Photoperiod brightness level until the target brightness level at the end of the cycle is reached.
Use the built-in settings or customize each day of the cycle. The Photoperiod will continue to
repeat at the last target brightness level after the Photoacclimation cycle ends.

### Photoperiod Tutorial

Create a daily Photoperiod schedule
Photoperiod mode functions like a 24-hour timer clock, but with additional advanced features. You
set a time to turn the zone on and off, a brightness level, and an optional simulated sunrise (ramp
up) when the cycle starts, and sunset (fade down) before turning off. The same Photoperiod schedule
repeats every 24 hours.

- Frank Golfieri

There are truly two halls of fame along the banks of the Connecticut River in Easthampton,
Massachusetts. One is the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame, where the most dedicated and

most devoted and talented growers are changing the game in the cannabis industry with

you look as you walk through their Easthampton facility. Director of Cultivation Frank Golfieri and
his all-star team members describe themselves as “obsessive” in their pursuit to produce
high-quality craft cannabis at the highest levels. The team prides itself on work ethic and
attention to detail at every step from strain selection and breeding to harvesting and packaging.

watching. Each year, they launch 50-70 new strains based on market demand, quality, potency, terpene

# Key Leaves

South of Lisbon, Portugal

[Home][68] » [Case Studies][69] » Key Leaves

## Challenges
* Increasing Energy Efficiency While Keeping Cost Low
* Implement sustainable and responsible systems and practices
* Drive Peak Performance of Plants from Beginning to End

[Cannabis plants thriving under LED grow lights for commercial cultivation.]

“Lighting in cannabis cultivation is an essential element to optimizing production and achieving
maximum quality of the crops, especially in a fully indoor installation like ours. With Fluence, we
are growing the highest quality product while attaining maximum yield and extremely consistent
production in all our cultivation rooms.”

- Alessandro Radici
Key Leaves CEO
[Headshot of Jörg Meyer-Brenken, expert in cannabis lighting technology, suited.][Headshot of Jörg
Meyer-Brenken, expert in cannabis lighting technology, suited.]

“The determination of the Green Fields team to break down barriers and improve the quality of
greenhouse medical cannabis production in Israel is extraordinary.”

- Jörg Meyer-Brenken
Lead Account Manager Cannabis, Fluence EMEA
It is said that the Greek hero Odysseus sailed beyond the Pillars of Hercules and founded the
ancient seaside city of Lisbon in modern-day Portugal. In 2015, Key Leaves began its own odyssey. In
2020, Alessandro Radici became CEO, and he envisioned an organization of excellence and
uncompromising values along this journey.

Licensed by Infarmed, the government agency of Portugal that regulates medicines and health
products, for the cultivation, import, and [export of cannabis products][70], Key Leaves is a fully
indoor pharmaceutical-grade Phyto-cannabinoids producer for medicinal use.

With a diverse international team, Key Leaves proudly works with some of the most renowned
professionals in the industry. Since its founding, Key Leaves has invested in the best technologies
and partnerships to deliver a highly standardized premium product with uninterrupted supply.

After completing more than twenty-one full cultivation cycles, Key Leaves is delivering the finest
medicinal cannabis products in compliance with Portugal’s laws and regulations. Their dedication to
science, education, and support is a key factor in their success. Fluence shares these values and is
proud to partner with Key Leaves.

Key Leaves in South of Lisbon, Portugal

Medical Cannabis

Challenges
GOALS

The experts at Key Leaves were determined to build a fully optimized indoor facility to cultivate
and deliver premium, medical-grade cannabis. Lighting intensity and light quality are keys to
unlocking top quality plant performance and higher yields. To offset constantly rising energy costs
while still achieving high photon utilization, Key Leaves chose Fluence LEDs and lighting solutions
for each of their growth stages—tailored both to their facility and plants. In every way, Key
Leaves’ operation is suited to achieve stable production of medical-grade cannabis.

[ VYPR Series ][75]

## Results

### Knowledge is Power

Following twenty-one cycles, Key Leaves has reported a tremendous amount of success and satisfaction
with the Fluence SPYDR, VYPR, and RAZR lighting technologies. More importantly, the Horticulture
Service Support team was there to help not only in the early design phase, but also after
implementation–during the actual growing—and continues to provide support through technical and
crop-specific consultation. Key Leaves has set themselves up for success from the beginning, and now
they are reaping the rewards of their harvests.

# LightSky Farms

Burton, MI

[Home][68] » [Case Studies][69] » LightSky Farms

## Challenges
* Ultra-competitive Michigan cannabis market.
* High barrier costs to entry.
* Needed advanced technologies with deep data capabilities.

[Jason Matlock, Ph.D., expert in cannabis lighting technology, wears flat cap.][Jason Matlock,
Ph.D., expert in cannabis lighting technology, wears flat cap.]

“LightSky and Shannon Walters are one-of-a-kind when it comes to crafting vintage strains and
superior products. Fluence is proud to support their pioneering spirit and use of Fluence LED
solutions and the VYNE intercanopy lighting.“

- Jason Matlock, M.S. Ph.D.
Horticulture Service Specialist Fluence
[Alex Gonzalez in hair net and glasses, smiling, expert in cannabis lighting technology.][Alex
Gonzalez in hair net and glasses, smiling, expert in cannabis lighting technology.]

“At LightSky Farms, partnering with Fluence has been a game-changer. Their innovative LED Lighting
technology has revolutionized how we cultivate cannabis, allowing us to unlock the full potential of
each plant and deliver unparalleled quality in every harvest.“

- Alex Gonzalez
Head of Product Development and Testing
LightSky Farms was founded in Traverse City, MI, in 2009 by Shannon Walters. His background included
winemaking, cultivation, and specialty wines, and he translated these techniques and his scientific
knowledge to produce high quality, meaningful products in the cannabis industry.

Since then, LightSky Farms has become a cult favorite in the ultra-competitive Michigan market,
while Shannon has become a 40x High Times Cannabis Award winner and achieved a World Cup in CBD.

It is easy to see why so many Michiganians are loyal to the brand. The expert growers at LightSky
Farms are driven by quality and dedicated to their craft at every stage. Nutrients are hand-mixed,
moms are hand-watered in nurseries, food and water are carefully curated and treated, and each plant
gets all the attention and love of a single child. Although not cheap or easy, the minutia and
extreme care exhibited at LightSky Farms sets it apart as a one-of-a-kind brand, whose products
deliver a well-rounded profile and an unsurpassed experience.

LightSky Farms has emphasized quality through cutting-edge technology and best practices since their
founding. Their experts gather data and use analytic equipment to decipher the bigger picture. Pheno
hunting and selective breeding allow them to grow novel strains with unique profiles [Fluence’s
VYPR][70] and RAZR-M LEDs enable maximum optimization, plant expression, and energy efficiency from
seedling to harvest.

The latest example of exploring cutting-edge technology is LightSky’s trials with Fluence’s VYNE
intercanopy lighting. Analyzing data from multiple trials, LightSky Farms has seen the total market
value of their crop increase due to improvements in the consistency of bud size, mass, and chemical
potency.
By “spoon-feeding” each plant with the exact inputs it needs—nutrients, water, light, et al., its
full genetic potential can be reached. This meticulous passion helps to explain how LightSky Farms
and Shannon Walters manage to bring out colors, aromas, and flavors that most growers rarely
achieve.

[ Contact Us Today! ][71]

#### Project Overview

##### Overview

LightSky Farms in Burton, MI.

##### Crop

Cannabis

##### Fluence Fixture

VYPR 2p, RAZR-M, VYPR 3×2

##### Facility

Indoor (85,000 sq. feet)

##### Results

Reduced Energy Costs
Improved Flower Quality
Greater Environmental Control

Challenges
Cut edges, not corners.

Quality is the central pillar at LightSky Farms. Each technology, process, and package is filtered
through the lens of the customer’s experience. Instead of cutting corners, the expert growers at
LightSky employ cutting-edge technology with a data-driven approach. They dabble in new ways to
improve their facility and final products, and they operate on the frontier of information and
science. Their philosophy towards superior quality requires extensive trials and testing with high
thresholds, including High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC). From the start, Walters and his
all-star team trialed a variety of lighting options before deciding that Fluence fixtures worked the
“absolute best.” Fluence’s VYPR fixtures were a natural choice for growing high-quality cannabis
that is rich in cannabinoids and desirable terpenes. [Intercanopy lighting][72] is just one major
example of LightSky’s dedication to innovation.

LightSky Farm’s 85,000-square-foot facility is entirely vertically integrated, meaning all the magic
happens under one roof. The operation utilizes four flower rooms (with three cultivars per room), a
dual-tier rack, an up-down flowering room, a seed test room, a mother room, and a nursery. Fluence
VYPR LEDs provide ideal lighting conditions and spectra across the various stages. Each room hosts
90 Fluence fixtures at 660 watts with advanced controls, such as wireless flex dimming, which
provide total environmental control and optimal light intensities to achieve peak quality.

[ SPYDR Series ][73]

## Results

### World-Class Expertise

LightSky’s success is made apparent by loyal customers and copious awards. After more than thirteen
years in Michigan, Shannon Walters and his expert team continue to produce the most popular and
celebrated cannabis strains and products. By using 100% original source material with no additives,
customers know exactly what they are getting when they buy premium THC and CBD products from
LightSky, including flower, tinctures, topicals, pre-rolls, edibles, and award-winning cartridges.
LightSky Farms combines world-class expertise with leading technologies and best practices to
cultivate the award-winning experience that continues to mesmerize Michiganians—as well as those who
travel there to see what they’ve been missing.

# Get to Know Us

[Home][68] » About Us

## Helping the World Grow Smarter

Fluence creates lighting solutions for commercial cannabis cultivation.

We apply the latest research in photobiology, evidence-based design, precise engineering, and
advanced technology to foster a healthier and more sustainable world.

### About Fluence Lighting: LED By Science

Fluence is transforming how the world grows cannabis indoors, enabling more efficient and
sustainable cultivation across continents.

Our specialized team brings decades of horticultural experience and advanced photobiology research
to develop revolutionary LED solutions. Understanding cannabis’s unique requirements, Fluence
delivers customized lighting strategies supported by scientific data, optimizing growth while
minimizing environmental impact.

By partnering with leading research institutions around the world, as well as conducting our own
research in Austin, Texas, we continuously refine our understanding of plant-light interactions.
This collaborative approach drives innovation in our product development, ensuring our solutions
meet the evolving needs of modern growing environments. Our commitment to scientific excellence has
established Fluence as a trusted leader in horticultural lighting technology.

### Global Leadership

Commercial cannabis cultivation is happening worldwide, and Fluence has a presence around the globe.
Our teams of account managers, horticultural services specialists, field application engineers, and
research scientists are located throughout the world and ready to support your growing needs,
wherever you might be located.

Everything we do is built on the values of curiosity, integrity, service, and passion. With our eyes

### Our Mission

At Fluence, we’re on a mission to improve the interaction between light and life to yield a
healthier and more sustainable world.

## Our History

Fluence was founded in Austin, Texas, in 2012 by forward-thinking entrepreneurs Nick Klase and Randy
Johnson.
They were the first to build custom-spectrum LED solutions and introduce white light that mimics
sunlight to the horticulture industry, a stark departure from the inefficient lighting systems
cultivators previously relied on.

This created a watershed moment across the global horticulture industry. Fluence lights used less
energy, lasted longer and ran cooler, enabling tiered setups that multiplied indoor grow spaces
while achieving impressive savings in energy, HVAC and water costs.

In 2014, Fluence began designing systems that could lead to more sustainable forms of crop
production. The result was a diverse product portfolio that allowed the world’s largest greenhouses
and indoor farms to shift from wasteful legacy lighting to the quality, output and reduced footprint
for which LED grow lights are now universally known.

In 2022, Fluence was acquired by Signify, the world leader in lighting. The acquisition added
Fluence’s complementary technology and market segments to Signify’s existing horticultural lighting
operations Today, Fluence operates as part of Signify’s Agricultural Lighting Business Unit
comprised of 250+ former growers, sought-after CEA researchers and leading cannabis business
experts.

As a leading LED lighting supplier in the global cannabis market, Fluence continues its commitment
to supporting the world’s top greenhouse and indoor growers from its original offices in Austin,
Texas, and EMEA offices in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Tcsco2 specializes in the delivery of bulk carbon dioxide and related gas solutions tailored for various industries, including food and beverage, breweries, restaurants, and cannabis cultivation. Their core offerings include high-quality bulk CO2, dry ice, blended gas systems, and nitrogen systems, all designed to meet the specific needs of their customers with customizable delivery options and reliable service. With a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, Tcsco2 serves as a trusted partner for businesses requiring efficient gas supply solutions.

# Contact Us

If you’d like more information about Bulk CO2 for your business, or to email our knowledgeable sales
or support team please complete the form below. Before contacting us, please check our service
territories below the contact form. Thank you!

Local: [(845) 513-2975][161]
Toll Free: [1-866-Soda-Gas][162]
Fax: (845) 794-0238
Email: [info@tcsco2.com][163]

**Tri-State Carbonation Service**

Mailing Address: PO Box 333

Thompsonville, NY 12784-0333

Street Address: 216 East Broadway
Monticello, NY 12701-8388

#### Locations & Service Areas
* Connecticut

Serving all of Connecticut including Hartford, New Haven, Norwich & Stamford .
* Massachusetts

Tri-State Carbonation serves most of Massachusetts. We currently serve: Berkshire, Bristol, Essex,
Franklin, Hampden, Hampshire, Middlesex, Plymouth, Norfolk, Suffolk, & Worcester Counties.
* New Jersey

We currently serve the northern half of New Jersey including Bergen, Essex, Hudson, Hunterdon,
Mercer, Middlesex, Monmouth, Morris, Ocean, Passaic, Somerset, Sussex, Union & Warren Counties.
* New York

Tri-State Carbonation serves virtually all of New York State with the exception of west of
Rochester and the far northern tier (Lake Placid & Lake George).
* Pennsylvania

We serve northeastern Pennsylvania including Bradford, Carbon, Columbia, Lackawana, Lehigh,
Luzerne, Lycoming, Monroe, Northampton, Pike, Schuylkill, Sullivan, Susquehanna, Wayne & Wyoming
Counties.
* Vermont

Tri-State Carbonation serves Southern Vermont including Bennington, Rutland, & Windham Counties.
* New Hampshire

Serving Southern New Hampshire including Cheshire, Hillsborough & Rockingham counties.

# Switch to TCSCO2

#### *We’ll help you all the way!*

If it’s time to make the break from a large corporate conglomerate, who is based in another country,
and come back to a family owned, local business.

[Switch to a local, famil owned business - TCSCO2] [Switch to a local, famil owned business -
TCSCO2]

Let Tri-State Carbonation help. We’ve helped businesses just like yours to make the break. Even if
your contract hasn’t expired, you may be entitled to switch suppliers as a result of a huge
corporate sale or takeover. Now is the time to explore your options.

Why switch? Here’s a few reasons:
* Locally owned and operated.
* Better Rates
* Fair business practices
* Higher quality service
* Better account management. No call center in a different part of the country that knows nothing
about your account.
* No hidden fees on your bill. Examples – “Driver Resource Fee”, “Invoice processing fee”
* CO2 Cancellation Guidelines

#### CO2 Cancellation Guidelines
1. Request a copy of your contract from your current supplier. If you don’t know the email
address, we’ll be happy to help you locate it. Be sure to include your account number and/or
name in the subject line along with “termination”. Include your address in the body of the
email if you do not have your account number. The email should read:

***“I request a copy of my agreement within the next 5 business days or I will assume that there
is no valid agreement in place and will be exploring other options. This notice also serves as
termination for any agreement you can produce.”***

2. If they produce an agreement; review and determine where you stand in relation to the term. If
you are in an automatic renewal term, then you should review the legality of this in your state.

3. If they do not produce an agreement in the 5 business days, you can decide on how you would
like to proceed. They will probably threaten you and maybe even produce an agreement after the 5
days but at least you have record of your intentions had they not produced the agreement in a
timely manner.

Regardless of how things go, they may threaten you and/or send you an enormous termination bill.
Keep in mind that large corporations have entire departments that sole purpose is to intimidate
and scare small businesses into not changing vendors. Don’t be afraid to push back! You are a
influential partner in the local restaurant industry and will not be afraid to let others know
about their tactics. Please note that these are guidelines and do not constitute legal
advice. **Please consult your attorney for specific legal advice.**

# Privacy & Security Policies

Privacy Policy

We respect and are committed to protecting your privacy. We may collect personally identifiable
information when you visit our site. We also automatically receive and record information on our
server logs from your browser including your IP address, cookie information and the pages(s) you
visited. We will not sell your personally identifiable information to anyone.

Security Policy

Your payment and personal information is always safe. Our Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) software is the
industry standard and among the best software available today for secure commerce transactions. It
encrypts all of your personal information, including credit card number, name, and address, so that
it cannot be read over the internet.

Online Account Data Inquiries and Deletion Request

For inquiries about the data associated with your online customer account accessed via the Tri-State
Carbonation Service Customer Portal or Tri-State Carbonation Service App or to request for your
account to be deleted, you can Contact Us to submit a [request form][161].

For questions on our policies, please contact our office at 866-763-2427 or email us at

# Commonly Asked Questions

[Bulk CO2 delivery - the no hassle way to carbonate!] [Bulk CO2 delivery - the no hassle way to
