Interested in knowing more? Call us at 866-Soda-Gas, or check out our frequently asked questions
below.
* Carbon Dioxide (CO2)

### **Carbon Dioxide ****(CO2)**

**What is liquid bulk carbon dioxide?**

Liquid bulk carbon dioxide is a safer, low-pressure alternative to high-pressure compressed gas
cylinders. With the TCS system, liquid bulk carbon dioxide is stored on the premises at a lower
pressure in a stainless steel holding tank, and is automatically refilled on a regular schedule
based on your usage pattern. Our tanks are permanently installed at your location, so you don’t
need to worry about the hassle of changing cylinders. Our professional sales staff will help you
to determine the system that is right for you.

**What is different about beverage quality carbon dioxide and why is it important to my
customers?**

A cold fountain soft drink or draught beer beverage is usually your customer’s first and defining
experience upon entering your establishment. Without a continuous and reliable supply of quality
carbon dioxide, your customer’s experience is at risk. Carbon dioxide is a key ingredient in
carbonated beverages and helps to determine the taste, aroma and level of carbonation – not all
carbon dioxide is made equal.

TCS delivers bulk carbon dioxide that is certified to be CGA-2000 I Grade, or “beverage quality.”
TCS is focused solely on the quality and integrity of carbon dioxide for fountain soft drink and
draught beer beverages. The product we deliver to you has been put through rigorous testing before
we deem it to be suitable for beverages. Alternatively, some distributors provide the same carbon
dioxide that you use in your food service operation to other customers for use in metal
fabrication, cleaning and solvent extraction, the production of pulp and paper and other
applications.

**Will a liquid bulk carbon dioxide system be compatible with my fountain soft drink or draught
beer system if I currently use high-pressure cylinders?**

The liquid bulk carbon dioxide systems supplied by TCS are fully compatible with all fountain soft
drink and draught beer beverage dispensing systems.
* Nitrogen

### Nitrogen

**What is a nitrogen generator?**

Nitrogen generators separate nitrogen from the other components of air on site at your
establishment, eliminating the need for nitrogen cylinders.

**Why should I use a nitrogen generator?**

Producing nitrogen on site eliminates the need for high-pressure nitrogen cylinders. This reduces
the stocking and handling of cylinders that can lead to safety concerns and accidents as a result
of mishandling.

Producing nitrogen on site also reduces the chances of running out of nitrogen gas and
interrupting the pouring of beer. Should nitrogen gas run out, the proper gas blend can no longer
be produced and the beer could be ruined.

orders are $10, and Canadian orders are $10

[ Which payment methods are accepted on our website? ][42]

We accept Major Credit Cards, Paypal, Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, E Transfer, and as well Cash. Please
check out all options at checkout and see what payment options give you free seeds on your order!

[ How long will delivery take? ][43]

Delivery is estimated between 2 to 10 days depending on your location. We do provide tracking on
orders.

[ How do you secure my transaction? ][44]

We go the distance with your browsing and purchase being secured by HTTPS with 2048 bit encryption.
We delete all of the transactions on our site daily, and keep no records of browsing or
transactions.

an email to confirm when your order will be shipped. All orders are shipped within 24 hours.

there. Thanks!

# Contact The Seed Fair

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### Please read our FAQ for all questions related to our service

[ What are the delivery charges for orders from The Seed Fair? ][41]

If you have made an order over $99, you will receive Free Shipping. If you are under $99, USA
orders are $10, and Canadian orders are $10

[ Which payment methods are accepted on our website? ][42]

We accept Major Credit Cards, Paypal, Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, E Transfer, and as well Cash. Please
check out all options at checkout and see what payment options give you free seeds on your order!

[ How long will delivery take? ][43]

Delivery is estimated between 2 to 10 days depending on your location. We do provide tracking on
orders.

[ How do you secure my transaction? ][44]

We go the distance with your browsing and purchase being secured by HTTPS with 2048 bit encryption.
We delete all of the transactions on our site daily, and keep no records of browsing or
transactions.

[ What exactly happens after ordering? ][45]

Once you order you will receive a confirmation email to confirm your order. Then you will receive
an email to confirm when your order will be shipped. All orders are shipped within 24 hours.
Please note that if you do not see your email, check junk email or spam in case our email has gone
there. Thanks!

[ Do I receive an invoice for my order? ][46]

Yes you will receive an invoice by email as well you are welcome to login into your account and view
your order.

[ What currency will I be charged in? ][47]

If you are in the USA your charge will be in US Dollars. If you are ordering from Canada your
charge will be in Canadian Dollars. However all Credit Card charges will be in USD.

[ Do you ship discreetly? ][48]

Yes all our orders are shipped discreetly with no labels on the front of the package. We want all
our customers to be able to buy in privacy.

[ Where do your seeds come from? ][49]

We buy from many top breeders all around the world. Each breeder we buy from are tested and hand
selected to make sure our customers receive the best quality seeds. If you are looking for breeder
information, please send us an email and we can let you know where your strain of interest comes
from.

## Have a question to ask about your order or our products?

We are available to help with any order and answer all your needs 24/7.

If you have immediate questions about a product or your order just look down below to the bottom
right side of the website and you will find our chat button. Click on that icon and a real chat
agent will answer all your questions. Note that we do not use bots and the person you are speaking
to is real and ready to help.

If you are looking for questions in regards to growing and or previous orders, please email our head
office staff to:

We will get back to you right away 7 days a week to make sure your needs are accommodated.

The Seed Fair, your go-to source for premium marijuana seeds, growing expertise, and exceptional
customer support!

discreet shipping, and an exceptional user experience.

suppliers from the United States, Canada, and Europe.

Our stringent quality control measures ensure the integrity of our supply chain, and we diligently

highest standards.

We are committed to discreet shipping practices to protect your privacy and ensure a seamless
experience from the moment you place your order until it arrives at your doorstep.

customers, from craft growers to large-scale marijuana companies in North America.

We aim to educate cannabis growers on best practices, helping them achieve ultimate results from
their investment. We take pride in offering premier seeds that produce high-quality marijuana and
are dedicated to ensuring that every seed we sell becomes your best plant for use.

We have been growing and germinating seeds for many years now with all of our expert staff and
growers. Taking advantage of these skills are essential in helping all with their best grows.

Thank you for taking the time in getting to know our staff as well as our expert authors, growers,
and client service people. We will continue to strive in helping all grow at their best and to find
premium seeds.

Bear Dance Autoflowering Marijuana Seeds are easy to care for but must be watered properly. The key
is to provide just enough water but not too much. Too little water will result in stunted growth and
poor yields. The best way to determine how much water your plants need is by applying the “finger
test.” Bear Dance Autoflowering Marijuana Seeds thrive best in a soil-based growing medium with good
drainage, aeration, and moderate fertility levels.

Humidity is also important; if it’s too low in your grow room, your plants will suffer from stress
and may struggle to produce buds. They might get moldy or have problems with pests like spider mites
if it’s too high. A good rule of thumb is that if you have an oscillating fan running 24 hours a day
in the room where your plants are growing, the humidity level should be between 40% and 60%.

Temperature is also crucial. You want it warm enough that your plants grow well but not hot enough
to burn up their leaves or buds prematurely. Most auto-flowering strains can handle temperatures
between 70°F/21°C and 85°F/29°C without any issues (try avoiding going above 85°F/29°C if possible).

The leaves of this plant are a sativa-indica hybrid, with Indica dominant characteristics. The
leaves are dark green and have a rough texture due to many trichomes. The leaves have some orange
hairs, but they tend to be sparse throughout the plant. The trichomes on this plant are vast and
thick; they appear as if they are almost ready to burst from their stalks on the buds. They are also
very dense on the buds, giving them a frosty appearance.

Its flowers have a slightly different appearance than its leaf; however, they still contain large
amounts of trichomes and orange hairs. The flowers will also become orange as they mature and ripen
for harvest.

The flowering time for these plants is between 65-75 days. They will be ready for harvest by the end
of October when grown outdoors or by late October when grown indoors. The large colas produced by
these seeds will be covered in trichomes, giving them a sticky appearance when fully mature.

800gr outdoors? In that case, Bear Dance Feminized Seeds are a perfect choice. These cannabis seeds
are the result of meticulous breeding techniques, which resulted in a plant that can grow in any
climate and produces large amounts of buds.

## White Widow Autoflower Seeds

They’re finally here: White Widow Autoflower Feminized Cannabis Seeds! Decades ago, the only option

Today, thanks to advancements in cannabis breeding research, growers can use specialized
auto-flowering kits like this one. Designed with both indoor and outdoor cultivation in mind, these
seeds produce a generous amount of buds – perfect for making BHO or hash oil!

This is an easy-to-grow feminized seed with the genetics of 10% Ruderalis, 40% Sativa, and 50%

This auto-flowering feminized cannabis seed produces a massive 26% THC content, this is the perfect
product for users who just want to chill with friends at home or while sitting in the park.

## Effects of White Widow Autoflower Seeds

One thing will immediately stand out about these new White Widow AutoFlower Feminized Cannabis
Seeds: they smell amazing! Its aromatic flavors and with undertones are sure to satisfy any palette.

The three different flavors of this strain pollinate each other with pine, earth, fruit and even
some spices. This means if you’re looking for a great taste along with your medicine, you found it.

Initial puffs of the smoke smell of earth and fruit, while later on it takes on a more piney aroma.
On the exhale, this strain produces a sweet herbal flavor with hints of spicy pepper. The effect is
crushing in both physical and mental relaxation, leading to a sense of total mind-body bliss.

This is a great strain for sharing with friends, as its mild-mannered effects promote relaxation and
socialization. Its 26% THC is perfect for anyone who wants relief without that intense or
couch-locking feeling. The 50% Indica side will ensure a happy relaxed experience, while the 42%
sativa provides both an uplifting high and energizing buzz.

This strain is best used in small doses at first because it’s difficult to judge your tolerance
against the blockbuster [THC][59] content resulting in hyperactivity when consumed more liberally.

This is a heavy-bodied plant with an incredibly potent euphoric effect that will leave you feeling
relaxed and uplifted. The effects of this strain last for hours, making it great for those with pain
as well as those who just want to relax and unwind. Euphoria and happiness will overwhelm you as the
Indica side of genetics kicks in.

This strain is a good idea for anyone with mood swings, depression, nightmares, stress, and lack of
appetite.

## How Does White Widow Grow?

White Widow Auto-Flowing Feminized Cannabis Seeds are cannabis seeds that can be used for both
indoor and outdoor cultivation.

The genetics of the strain make it great for beginners who want an easy to grow plant that produces
prodigious amounts of buds while taking a hit from minor errors.

As it’s [auto flowering][60], this strain will always be capable of growing without needing to
change the light cycles. Experience the joy of extra fast flowering periods thanks to the ruderalis
genetics.

The White Widow Auto-Flowing Feminized Cannabis Seeds germination process is also very easy and can

Our [White Widow Seeds][61] will show you the power of a weed in only 60 days! This all-female
strain will produce light green, frosted flowers with bright orange hairs. Total time for growing is

This beautiful feminized hybrid is a cross between White Widow and Auto-flowering genetics. With a

Every grower loves to hear that their plants are going to last all summer long outdoors too with an

## History of White Widow AutoFlower Feminized Cannabis Seeds

White Widow is the famous hybrid created by crossing two South landrace strains, namely Brazilian
Sativa and South Indian Indica. It was released in 1994 by the Green House Seed Company after
winning numerous awards that lengthened its stellar reputation. Notably, it scooped the Cannabis Cup
Winner in 1995.

## Durban Poison Autoflower Seeds

Have you ever tried Durban Poison Auto Flower Seeds? This is one of the most popular strains in the
world for stoners. If you want to try something new, a strain that is easy to grow produces heavy
yields and has an intense taste; this might be perfect for you. Durban Poison Auto-Flowering
Feminized Cannabis seeds will give you everything you need in one plant!

The Durban Poison Autoflower plant is not only easy to grow but turns into a hefty beast that
produces intensely resinous buds dripping with [THC][58] goodness. These cannabis seeds contain a
high level of THC (23%) and give you an intense high. This landrace strain is a pure Sativa
powerhouse dominating with 90% genetics leaving the [Ruderalis’s][59] 10%, whose effects and

The taste is very special, with a distinctly recognizable fragrance that any connoisseur enjoys,
especially if you’re into collecting good herbs for smoking in your home bong or the classic spliff
rolled up in a sheet of paper. Savor the earthy and piney flavors that this plant gives off,

throat!

## Effects Durban Poison Auto-Flowering Feminized Cannabis Seeds

This strain gives an excellent relaxation stone, ideal for late evenings! The high is strong but not
overpowering, giving a nice energy boost without leaving you feeling flat. The stone is long-lasting
and can be very intense if you haven’t smoked for a while. This strain makes an excellent choice for
medical marijuana users looking for pain relief or relief from stress/depression. Durban Poison
Auto Flower Seeds once grown, has many mood lifting properties. Imaginations run wild when on this
strain as well as helps to energize your day.

## How Does Durban Poison Auto Flower Seeds Grow?

This is for sure one of the easiest strains to grow and very suitable for beginners who want to give
growing cannabis seeds a go or professional growers who like results at low costs. Durban Poison
Auto Flower plants have a high resistance to disease and pests.

Durban Poison Auto Flower seeds are great to grow with their medium stature, explosive resin
production & massive yield potential. This strain is an excellent choice as it will grow well both
indoors and outdoors, whatever your climate. It’s even possible to grow this strain indoors without
a grow light if you live in a sunny area with long dark periods for at least 12 hours each day
during the winter months.

The flowering time is exceptionally short. So perfect for those who want results with short waiting
periods that translate to multiple harvests throughout the year. Many grow this strain because it
gives an intensely sweet smell even before blooming begins. The plants will grow around 1 meter
tall, and the yields are enormous, to say it like that. Durban Poison Auto-Flowering Feminized
Cannabis seeds produce heavy buds with lots of resin, hence their popularity in Amsterdam coffee
shops!

Our feminized Durban poison autos suffer from no hermaphrodism, so you will never see male
characteristics on your plant. This allows growers to sex their plants before flowering, resulting
in much higher yields because, as the rule goes ‘females produce smokable buds than males.

## Any Setup Will Do For Our Durban Poison Autoflower Seeds

Although Durban Poison Autoflower Feminized Cannabis seeds can be grown in virtually any setup, they
do best when grown indoors in a controlled environment. They can be grown in either soil or hydro,
but due to their size, we would recommend a larger pot; 10-litre pots are ideal. This allows
sufficient room for growth, and the root systems will quickly fill the whole pot once flowering
starts.

Durban Poison Auto Flower Seeds produce good yields of 300g/m² (that’s five zipped pockets). This
is done in 55 to 65 days when grown indoors. Probably sooner if you let her outside where the nights
are longer. Yields from this strain can be so substantial that they run out of space to put it all.
An overspill is given with some growers harvesting a staggering 400g from a single plant!

## How Does Afgooey Autoflowering Feminized Marijuana Seeds Grow?

Afgooey auto-flowering feminized seeds are easy to grow. The strain is resistant to most pests and

## Pineapple Express Seeds

Looking for Pineapple Express in a whole new way? You’ve found it with these Auto-Flowering
Feminized Cannabis Seeds! These seeds are the union of delightful genetics. They will grow tropical,
fruity Marijuana plants anywhere you want them to be. Pineapple Express Auto Flower Seeds are one
of our most popular strains on our website.

This hybrid boasts of a perfect blend with 10% Ruderalis and 30% Indica with the lion’s share going
to Sativa at 60%. The [Ruderalis][58] genes will automate the flowering process of the plant making
them auto flowering while the Indica/Sativa mix signs off its unique blend of effects and benefits.

This powerful strain of Marijuana has a relatively medium [THC][59] count of 15%. This is the right
balance for both recreational and medical users. It will give you just the right amount of buzz with
its cerebral and uplifting effects.

## Effects of Pineapple Express Auto-Flowering Feminized Cannabis Seeds

Pineapple Express Auto Flower Seeds are an easy-to-grow plant that will reward those who put in the
effort with exceptional quality and flavor.

The buds are beautifully sweet smelling with a pineapple scent that intensifies when the buds are
burnt. The tropical aroma also has many elements. Such as fruit that tantalizes the mouth with a
sugar high so strong and so delicious, words cannot describe it. And where will you find such power
in such an innocent weed seed? The main attraction here is the high resin content which produces a
lot of smoke once burnt.

The Indica/Sativa mix gives you the perfect balance between physical relaxation and mental euphoria.
It kicks off as a stimulant making your muscles tense then slowly relax generating a very calming
effect.

Overall, the effect of consuming Pineapple Express Auto is strong and Sativa-like. Along with
long-lasting strong mental clarity and creativity abilities which makes it perfect for creative
activities such as painting, writing or brainstorming.

This strain is recommended for its fatigue and pain management medical benefits. It is also valued
for its upbeat and uplifting buzz which helps with mental conditions like depression and anxiety.

## How Does Pineapple Express Auto Flower Seeds Grow?

If you’re looking for sweet marijuana seeds that will work indoors or outdoors then look no further
than these Pineapple Express Auto flowering feminized cannabis seeds.

Pineapple Auto-Flowering Feminized Cannabis Seeds are perfect for those looking to mix things up a
bit with their crop or are new to growing altogether. All you have to do is put these seeds in some
dirt, water them regularly and watch them grow! That’s right! No more complicated techniques of
messing with light cycles and different nutrients, just easy growing thanks to the Ruderalis genes.

These seeds produce medium plants though you can always bend them or tie them to control their
height if necessary. They do best indoors but you can grow them outdoors too if your region receives
substantial hours of sunlight per day.

Pineapple Express Auto Flower Seeds has a high resistance to pests and diseases. It’s easy to grow
weed with strong side branches that support massive yields of dense buds covered in resin. It
provides a good yield during the vegetative stage, perfect for indoor cultivation under artificial
lightings.

The plant grows vigorously with sturdy branches and strong roots, making them great for sea of green
growing techniques. The plants are of medium height and with broad leaves that give off the smell of
pineapples. They boast of these lovely golden orange hairs too. The yield is quite good and comes in
at up to 400-500 g/m2 indoors or 200-300 g/plant outdoors after only 65 days.

## History of Pineapple Auto-Flowering Feminized Cannabis Seeds

Bred from Pineapple Express and a Ruderalis plant, the Pineapple Express Auto-Flowering feminized
cannabis seeds have always been a big hit with pot smokers who are looking for their next weed seed
purchase to make the most of their smoking experience. This is because they deliver on taste,
strength, aroma and power. Although some people do complain about their size which can be considered
small by today’s standards. Although not as powerful as its high THC counterparts this strain is an

## **Sour Diesel Seeds**

They say there’s a little slice of heaven right inside these Sour Diesel Auto-Flowering cannabis
seeds. And maybe they’re right. With a delicious seductiveness, Sour Diesel Auto-Flowering Cannabis
Seeds are born to make your mouth water and your tongue seize the opportunity for intense flavor
exploration. That’s not all that impressive because you’ll find yourself rolling with anticipation
waiting for these feminized seeds – dubbed “Auto-Diva Flavors” – to burst into side-splitting
laughter as you indulge in their potent THC. The only question still unanswered is whether the
flurry of fruits found at its core will quench your taste buds or give them an ecstatic high?

The taste of Sour Diesel strain is a very earthy and natural one. It actually contains a very subtle
sweetness to the mouth so it doesn’t completely feel dry after smoking.

The aroma is so incredibly skunky, it’s really hard to miss when somebody lights up a joint of this
Sour Diesel strain in your vicinity. It has a very zesty sweet lemon scent which makes you want to
break it down and taste the flavor even more!

Can you believe that this feminized seed has 23% [THC][61] content? The CBD levels are very minimal
which means you’re going to get a pretty dank high from smoking these Sour Diesel strains.

From its cannabinoid profile, Sour Diesel is a pretty intense marijuana plant despite it producing
mostly mellow body high effects. You’ll feel the effects almost instantly! Then, after about 30
minutes or so it will start to mellow out and give you those uplifting and relaxing effects.

Sour Diesel Auto-Flowering Cannabis Seeds is mostly [Sativa][62] (60%) which means that you can
expect a very relaxed and soporific high. The 40% Indica genetics are just enough to keep your mind
awake for longer periods so not only will your head get hazy, but also your whole body.

## Effects of Our Sour Diesel Strain

Sour Diesel Auto-Flowering Cannabis Seeds is perfect for those that are suffering from any kind of
depression or anxiety. Our Sour Diesel Auto Feminized Seeds can act as a muscle relaxer because not
only will you be feeling very relaxed, but your muscles might just loosen up too!

Fire up those energy levels! This feminized strain will make you feel euphoric and energetic for the
start of your day which is why many believe Sour Diesel Auto-Flowering Cannabis Seeds works best in
the morning. It’s just what many patients need to help get themselves motivated to kickstart their
days or do some household chores around the house.

Migraines are one of the most distorting medical conditions that a person can experience. Luckily,
Sour Diesel has some amazing pain-relieving properties that will ease the intensity of your
migraines and make them a little more bearable. Just be careful with how much you smoke!

If you’re feeling nauseous, Sour Diesel Auto-Flowering Cannabis Seeds is the perfect weed for you.
It’s such a fast-acting strain that within minutes of smoking it, your nausea will slowly start to
fade away and eventually completely disappear!

## How Does Sour Diesel Auto-Flowering Cannabis Seeds Grow?

Our Sour Diesel Strain is a strain that has moderate growing ease. It’s not too difficult to grow
but also not quite as easy as some of the other strains out there. It will do well in most
conditions, but it does require a little more attention and care. If you’re looking for something to
grow in your garden with minimal effort, this isn’t the right strain for you.

These Sour Diesel Feminized Seeds are going to grow into a compact 30-39 inches tall plant. You can
expect a bushy plant with lots of leaves which you’ll have to trim often.

Being feminized seeds means that you won’t have to spend any time identifying your plants and just
simply enjoy! Feminized seeds tend to be slightly more expensive but they are worth every penny!

Sour Diesel is a plant that will produce an average yield. You’ll be able to get 11-13 ounces of
dried product per square meter indoors and up to 12 oz per plant outdoors! It will take anywhere
between 8-10 weeks before they’re ready to harvest. Of course, you’ll want to make sure that they
get 18 hours of light for them to flower in time!

## History of Sour Diesel

The Sour Diesel Auto-Flowering Cannabis Seeds have a straightforward lineage. It was a mix between
Sour Diesel and a Haze 2.0 Autoflowering that produced this amazing strain!

## How do Gorilla Glue grow?

Gorilla Glue seeds, available through The Seed Fair, offer a balanced genetic makeup, comprising 60%
Indica and 40% Sativa. Bred by Cali Connection, these seeds boast an impressive THC content of 24%,
delivering potent effects sought after by cannabis enthusiasts.

With a CBD content of 0%, Gorilla Glue seeds focus primarily on THC-rich cultivars. Indoor growers
can expect a generous yield of up to 500 grams per square meter, while outdoor cultivation can yield
a similar 500 grams per square meter. The flowering time ranges from 9 to 10 weeks, making it a
moderately fast-growing strain.

Gorilla Glue plants typically reach a medium height of 3 to 4 feet, making them suitable for both
indoor and outdoor cultivation. The genetic background of Gorilla Glue traces back to Sour Dubb,
Chocolate Diesel, and Chem’s Sister, resulting in a potent and flavorful strain.

When it comes to effects, Gorilla Glue induces a strong body high, offering sedative, calming, and
relaxing effects, often leading to sleepiness. Its flavor profile is characterized by a piney citrus
taste with hints of fuel and diesel, providing a unique and aromatic experience for cannabis
consumers.

Gorilla Glue seeds typically grow into robust and resinous cannabis plants known for their potent
effects and sticky buds. **Here’s a general overview of how Gorilla Glue seeds grow:**
1. **Germination**: Like most cannabis seeds, Gorilla Glue seeds start the growing process with
germination. This involves placing the seeds in a moist environment with access to oxygen. Once
the seeds have sprouted and the taproot emerges, they are ready for planting.
2. **Seedling Stage**: After germination, Gorilla Glue seeds develop into seedlings. During this
stage, they require gentle care, adequate lighting (such as fluorescent or LED lights), and a
controlled environment with proper temperature and humidity levels. Seedlings are typically kept
in small pots with a light potting mix to encourage healthy root development.
3. **Vegetative Growth**: As the seedlings mature, they enter the vegetative stage, characterized by
rapid growth of foliage and branches. Gorilla Glue plants thrive in a warm and humid environment
with plenty of sunlight or artificial light. During this stage, growers may use training
techniques such as topping or low-stress training (LST) to encourage bushier growth and maximize
yield potential.
4. **Flowering Stage**: After a period of vegetative growth, Gorilla Glue plants transition into the
flowering stage when they start producing buds. This stage is triggered by changes in light
cycles, typically switching from a longer light period to a 12-hour light/dark cycle. Gorilla
Glue plants typically produce dense, resinous buds with a high THC content.
5. **Harvesting**: The flowering stage lasts several weeks, during which the buds mature and develop
their characteristic aroma, flavor, and potency. Growers monitor trichome development to
determine the optimal time for harvesting. Once the buds are ripe, they are carefully trimmed and
dried before curing to enhance flavor and potency.
6. **Curing**: Curing is an essential step in the growing process that involves storing dried buds
in a controlled environment with proper humidity and airflow. This process allows the buds to
develop a smoother smoke, preserve terpenes, and enhance potency over time.

Throughout the growing process, it’s important for growers to monitor factors such as nutrient
levels, pH balance, and environmental conditions to ensure healthy growth and maximize the quality
of the final product. With proper care and attention, Gorilla Glue seeds can produce high-quality
cannabis buds prized for their potent effects and resinous texture.

## Gary Payton Seeds

Named after the legendary NBA Hall of Famer, Gary Payton, this rare-to-find hybrid strain is one to
look for. Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds is famous for its fast hard hitting effects that last

This is an evenly balanced hybrid strain with 50% Indica and 50% Sativa. It’s an excellent choice
for cannabis enthusiasts looking for a balance of both worlds. You get to enjoy the cerebral
uplifting and motivating high of the Sativa and the calming effects of the Indica.

It’s a cross of the Y and Snowman strains. The result is a strain with an average of 25% THC level
and little to almost no CBD. As such, both beginners and experienced tokers may enjoy a puff of the
Gary Payton. If you’re starting up, consider starting with a low quantity and increase it with time.

It has a sweet and spicy flavor with a hint of herbal taste during exhale. The smell is earthy and

daytime. It gives you the energy, motivation, focus and concentration to help you complete your
tasks.

Just like many strains, using this variety might leave you with a dry mouth and feeling thirsty.
This can be solved by drinking water and you’ll be good to go. You can enjoy your cannabis

The fact that the Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds are feminized has its advantages. It saves

The buds from feminized marijuana crops are also rich in cannabinoids. Although male plants also

## How Do Gary Payton Seeds Grow

Growing Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds is a walk in the park for all experience levels. Both
beginners and experienced farmers will have no challenge in growing this plant. As long as you take
care of the plant, you’re sure to get a good amount of harvest.

Consider planting your own seeds to get high-quality nuggets. Start by germinating them using paper
towels before transferring them to the garden. This process is affordable as you make use of readily
available materials such as paper towels, tweezers, and plates. Use the following steps to sprout
your seeds before planting them.
1. Ensure you have all the materials you need ready, including your seeds, paper towels, plates,
tweezers, and clean water.
2. Wet two paper towels and remove any excess moisture. Place one of the pieces on a plate.
3. Take your seeds and place them on the towel. You may use tweezers for the process and ensure
there’s a distance of about an inch between the seeds.
4. Take another paper towel and use it to cover the Gary Payton Feminized Seeds.
5. Ensure there isn’t any excess water left on the plate because it may cause your seeds to rot. If
there’s any left, use a cloth to dry it out.
6. Place the plate carrying your Gary Payton seeds in a dark and cool location.
7. Ensure the seeds remain moist for the first 2-3 days and keep a close eye on them to make sure
everything is going on well.
8. When your seeds have produced a tap root around an inch long, They’re ready for planting. Uncover
them and use tweezers to remove them from the plate into your growing medium. Ensure the root is
the first to get into the medium.

Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds do well in both hydro and soil media.

This strain can be grown both indoors and outdoors. In tight spaces, you’ll have to be careful since
this plant can grow up to 6 feet in height. The flowering time takes about 7 – 9 weeks indoors. The
best time to harvest the cannabis plant outside is around October.

For the best results, warm temperatures and above-average humidity are the ideal conditions for
growing this strain. Keeps the temperatures warm since the plant is susceptible to moisture damage
and fungal growth in an indoor controlled environment

You can get an indoor yield of about 500 – 600g per square meter. Outdoors, you can get up to 900g
per plant especially if the plants are exposed to more hours of sunlight.

The marijuana plant has little grape-shaped minty green nugs. The nugs have shining orange pistils
and a covering of frosty white crystal trichomes. The dominant terpenes profile in the plant is
caryophyllene. It’s followed by limonene and linalool.

When watering the plant, make sure you water it with the right amount. This is because excess
moisture can damage the roots of the plant.

As mentioned earlier, the Gary Payton Feminized Seeds are easy to grow. However, consider checking
out for various issues, especially when growing your plants indoors. Some of the problems that might
affect the overall growth and bud quality of your cannabis include spider mites and powdery mildew.

fertilizer during the flowering stage.

aerated and has good drainage. The size of the pot will depend on the size of the plant. But a
5-gallon pot is enough for a single plant. As for training techniques, you can use the Screen of

usually grows to a height of between 2 and 3 feet. The leaves of the plant are dark green. They are

produce photoperiod plants. This means it flowers when the days get shorter. But you can also force

## Liberty Haze Seeds

Liberty Haze Feminized Marijuana Seeds has an aroma that is relatively difficult to describe for
novice smokers. This strain has an earthy, pine-like smell with a hint of skunkiness and woodiness.
The taste is also quite pungent and has a strong skunky flavor with a hint of sweetness. Overall,
the smell and taste of this strain are pretty strong and may not be ideal for those who are
sensitive to these flavors.

This is a balanced [hybrid][60] that provides the best of both worlds. The indica genetics help
relax the body while the sativa genetics provide a cerebral high. This strain is perfect for those
who want to experience both the physical and mental effects of marijuana. This strain has a
relatively high [THC][61] level of 29%. This means that it is not recommended for novice smokers or
those sensitive to THC. Only a few strains can reach that THC level.

Because of the high THC level, this strain is not recommended for novice smokers or those who are
sensitive to THC. This strain is only recommended for those with a high tolerance for THC. It may
take quite a long time before newbies can work on their tolerance. Even experienced stoners are
usually careful with the dosage of this strain.

The onset of this strain is quick and relatively intense. The effects can be felt within a few
minutes after smoking. You will feel a cerebral high first, followed by a body high. The peak of
this strain can last for up to 2 hours. You will feel a strong high that can be pretty overwhelming
for some at this time. This is why it is essential to be careful with the dosage of this strain.

The active high of this strain is perfect for those who want to get things done. It lasts for up to
4 hours and provides a clear-headed high that can help you focus on your tasks. The comedown of this
strain is gradual and can last for up to 2 hours. You will feel relaxed and sleepy as the effects of
the strain start to wear off. The afterglow of this strain is relaxing and can last for up to 6
hours. You will feel a sense of calm and relaxation, which can be perfect for those who want to wind
down after a long day.

The best time to smoke this strain is in the morning for high-energy activities or the evening for
relaxation. This strain can also be smoked on weekends when you want to wind down and relax.

## Effects Of Liberty Haze Feminized Marijuana Seeds

Boosting creativity is one of the main effects of this particular strain. This is perfect for those
who need to be more creative in their work or hobbies. The cerebral high can also help with focus
and concentration. This strain is perfect for studying or working on creative projects for many
people. The body high can also help with relaxation and can be perfect for those suffering from
muscle aches or pains. This strain can also be used to treat anxiety and depression.

This strain is a great selection when you want to relieve pain without feeling too high. The
balanced hybrid provides just the right amount of indica and sativa to take the edge off while still
allowing you to function relatively normally. This strain is also perfect for those suffering from
anxiety or depression. The happy and uplifting effects can help to improve your mood and provide
relief from stress. This strain can also be used to treat nausea and increase appetite.

## How Does Liberty Haze Feminized Marijuana Seeds Grow?

This strain is perfect for new growers who don’t have much experience. The plants are resistant to
mold, pests, and diseases. Newbies can begin with this strain and then move on to more difficult
strains once they have mastered the basics. This is a friendly strain in terms of the growing
environment. It can be grown indoors in a controlled climate or outdoors in more forgiving climates.
So, this strain can be a good option for whichever growing method you prefer.

When growing this strain, it is important to water regularly and keeps the humidity levels in check.
The ideal temperature for this strain is between 70-85 degrees Fahrenheit. This strain also responds
well to a variety of nutrients. This strain can get quite tall, so it is essential to manage some
height. Planting in pots or using a trellis can help control this strain’s height.

The best way to describe the appearance of this strain would be “lanky.” The leaves are long and
thin, and the trichomes are abundant. The flowers are small and densely packed. This strain is
feminized, so you don’t have to worry about males. The process of selecting or sorting males is
eliminated. This makes it an excellent strain for rookies. The flowers are also smokable, so you
don’t have to worry about that either.

This is a photoperiod strain so it will need about 12 hours of light per day. The light schedule can
be tweaked to accommodate your needs. This strain has an average flowering time of 55-65 days. This
is an ideal duration for a strain that is easy to grow. Newbies will not have to wait too long for
their first harvest. This strain has the potential to yield massive amounts of weed. Indoor growers
can expect up to 600 g/m², and outdoor growers can expect up to 600 gr/plant.

## History Of Liberty Haze Feminized Marijuana Seeds

Norcal Farms created Liberty Haze. This farm is located in Northern California and is known for its
high-quality cannabis. Liberty Haze strain is a cross between G13 and Chemdawg 91. This strain was
created to be a balanced hybrid with the best of both worlds. In 2011, Liberty Haze won the High
Times Cannabis Cup. This is a very prestigious award, and it is given to the best weed in the world.
This strain beat out some of the best strains in the world to take home this coveted prize.

Because this is an Indica dominant strain, expect relaxation effects that can lead to couch-lock.
Yoda OG is perfect for when you want to unwind after a long day or week. Happiness is another common
effect, which can help to improve your mood.

The sativa genetics in Yoda OG can provide some cerebral stimulation. This can help with focus and
creativity. This makes it an excellent strain when you need to get things done. However, the
couch-locking effects can make it challenging to get up and moving if you smoke too much.

The Yoda OG Feminized Marijuana Seeds are a hybrid strain known for its medical benefits. The most
common use for this strain is to relieve pain, but it can also help with insomnia, nausea, and loss
of appetite. This strain is also known for its ability to relax the body and mind, making it an

## How Does Yoda OG Feminized Marijuana Seeds Grow?

Yoda OG Feminized Seeds are easy to grow and an excellent choice for those new to growing. They are
also suitable for those who want to grow many plants. One of the main reasons new growers choose
this strain is its ability to resist mold and mildew. They grow well in grow rooms, greenhouses, and
outdoor climates. It is a versatile strain that can be grown in various environments.

The optimal growing conditions for this strain are a temperature of 70-85 degrees Fahrenheit, a
humidity of 40-50%, and water every 3-4 days. These seeds do well in soil that is rich in nutrients.
It is essential to ensure that the soil is well aerated so the roots can grow properly.

These seeds grow to medium-sized plants that reach a height of 3-4 feet. This makes them a good

The Yoda OG Feminized Seeds are photoperiod flowering. This means they need 12 hours of darkness and

best used in the evening or night, as it helps you feel relaxed and ready for bed. However, if you

While the Sensi Star strain is pretty more expensive than other strains, it’s worth it for your
experience. The Sensi Star strain high is happy, relaxing, and sleepy. This strain’s high sets in
quickly and lasts for a long time.

## How Does Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds Grow

Sensi Star strain grows well indoors, outdoors, and in greenhouses. This marijuana strain needs
plenty of light during its vegetative stage but not too much during flowering so that your plants
don’t grow too tall or become lanky. Sensi Star is relatively easy to cultivate indoors or outdoors
but does best in warm climates with lots of sunshine.

Plant Sensi Star strain outdoors with plenty of space to spread its roots; otherwise, keep this
plant pruned so it doesn’t get too bushy and cover up too much light from hitting your plants’
leaves. It’s best to use a soil-based medium for growing this plant because soil retains more
moisture than hydroponics or coco coir.

However, if you’re growing outdoors, then a mix of peat moss and perlite will also do the job just
fine! You can also use organic nutrients to feed your plants with all the nutrients they need to
flourish.

If you’re growing inside, then be sure to give your plants plenty of space because they’ll need it!
Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds grow fast and tall, so be sure to give them room to stretch
their legs and space for their roots to expand! You should also prune your plants when they begin
flowering to avoid getting too big for their britches!

The Sensi Star strain is easy to grow, but it’s essential to know how much water and food they need
during their life cycle. You’ll also want to pay attention to humidity levels, temperature and light
intensity, and carbon dioxide levels.

To grow Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds, you need to ensure that your environment is suitable
for optimal growth. This means keeping everything at a constant temperature between 21-25 degrees
Celsius (70-77 degrees Fahrenheit) and keeping humidity levels between 50-60%. These conditions will
allow the plant to grow at an ideal rate without getting too hot or cold, so it doesn’t stress out
or suffer from frostbite during colder months.

The Sensi weed strain grows up to 80-100 cm tall and has dark green leaves which turn yellowish when
harvested. Sensi Star strain has thick white hairs on the buds that give them an appearance of
having been dusted with sugar crystals. The trichomes are amber-coloured when young but turn milky
white as they mature. The flowers appear in three clusters between olive green calyxes that open up
during flowering.

The flowering period lasts about 50-6 days indoors with an average yield of 350g/m2 or 400g/plant
outdoors when grown under optimal conditions. Sensi Star cannabis strain produces large harvests
with minimal effort, it is great for beginners looking for an easy-to-grow strain that delivers high
yields without much effort!

## History Of Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds

The history of the Sensi Star weed strain is a story that spans generations and one that every
cannabis enthusiast should know. Sensi Star originally came from breeder Willits’ breeding of Mostly
Afghani Indica, which they crossed with Skunk #1. They then bred this new plant with Northern Lights
#5 (which was then called Shiva Skunk). This new plant was named Sensi Star and released to the
public in 1994.

Sensi Star strain has numerous awards to its name, including the High Times Cannabis Cup award for
best indica in 1994 and 1995 and High Times’ Best Overall Strain award in 2001.

# About Root Sciences

## Root Sciences: Leading the Future of Cannabis Processing

Root Sciences is the global leader in the distribution of end-to-end equipment and support services
for processing facilities in the cannabis and hemp industries, providing [premium
extraction][36], [distillation][37], and other post-processing technologies, as well as [business
planning and lab/facility design][38] and [consulting services][39].

We are more than equipment providers; we are strategic partners. Collaborating with [world-renowned
suppliers and manufacturing experts][40], we tailor our cutting-edge technology to the specific
needs of cannabis and hemp processors. With reliable throughput and yield rates, our equipment has
earned the trust of over 400 processors worldwide, many of whom are repeat customers. Check out our
clients [here][41].

At Root Sciences, a sale marks the beginning of a lasting partnership. From installation to
comprehensive training and after-sales support, we are dedicated to ensuring our clients unlock the
full potential of their investment. Our commitment to providing industry-leading support and
solutions has cemented us as a trusted partner in the cannabis processing space.

# About Root Sciences

## Root Sciences: Leading the Future of Cannabis Processing

Root Sciences is the global leader in the distribution of end-to-end equipment and support services
for processing facilities in the cannabis and hemp industries, providing [premium
extraction][36], [distillation][37], and other post-processing technologies, as well as [business
planning and lab/facility design][38] and [consulting services][39].

We are more than equipment providers; we are strategic partners. Collaborating with [world-renowned
suppliers and manufacturing experts][40], we tailor our cutting-edge technology to the specific
needs of cannabis and hemp processors. With reliable throughput and yield rates, our equipment has
earned the trust of over 400 processors worldwide, many of whom are repeat customers. Check out our
clients [here][41].

At Root Sciences, a sale marks the beginning of a lasting partnership. From installation to
comprehensive training and after-sales support, we are dedicated to ensuring our clients unlock the
full potential of their investment. Our commitment to providing industry-leading support and
solutions has cemented us as a trusted partner in the cannabis processing space.

## Our Core Values

The principles that guide everything we do

### Innovation

Pioneering cutting-edge extraction technologies that set industry standards.

### Quality & Safety

Delivering equipment that meets the highest safety and compliance standards.

### Partnership

Building lasting relationships through exceptional service and support.

### Efficiency

Maximizing output while minimizing operational costs for our clients.

## Company History

A decade of innovation and industry leadership

2015

### Company Founded

Root Sciences was founded by a group of passionate entrepreneurs who began cultivating cannabis in
the US and Canada. United by a drive to elevate the industry, they founded Root Sciences with a
focus on innovation and excellence in extraction processes.

2016

### VTA Partnership

Root Sciences formed a pivotal partnership with VTA, a leading German thin film technology provider
and process engineer, bringing state-of-the-art distillation equipment to the cannabis market. This
collaboration set the foundation for Root Sciences’ reputation as an industry pioneer, and today,
that same innovative spirit continues to guide our global success.

2018

### CryoEXS Development

In collaboration with DEVEX, Root Sciences developed the CryoEXS, an all-in-one cold-ethanol
extraction system for cannabis processing.

2019

### GEA Partnership

Through a partnership with GEA, Root Sciences once again redefined best practices for manufacturing
cannabinoid beverages and edibles.

### Description

The newest banger on the block is beveled, baby! And what makes a beveled edge better? It’s all
about the flush seal the edge creates between the banger and the carb cap. This seal results in more
pressure which means more vapor at lower temperatures. So jump on the low temp train with a beveled
banger today.

This quality banger made from 100% FDA-grade crystal quartz rocks the ‘Yo’ down below, with our
household name etched on the bottom of the banger (instead of the side), which is a new look for us.

The Beveled Banger is available in 10mm, 14mm, and 19mm male or female joints with a 90 degree
angled neck.

Essential accessories include the [Cyclone Cap][81], [Terp Pearls][82] or an [Opaque Insert][83],
and other carb caps like our [Quartz Thermal Cap][84], [Glass GTR Cap][85] or [Quartz Directional
Airflow Carb Cap][86].

### Description

You can’t beat the convenience of having a rig setup ready to go straight out of the box! Choose
from three different rig styles and get your hands on everything you need to dab with our dab rig
sets. In the box, you’ll have everything you need to start dabbing minus your favorite concentrates
and your torch, of course.

#### **What’s included:**
* Your choice of dab rig style (Swiss, Klein or Can)
* 1 auto spinner nail (banger)
* 2 quartz terp pearls
* 1 honeycomb sphere cap
* 1 glass cap stand
* 1 versatile spatula dab tool

Between impressive function and the affordability of all of these kits, you can enjoy your favorite
concentrates both at home and on the go.

#### **Features:**
* Your choice between three different rig styles (Swiss, Klein, Can)
* Angled mouthpiece

### Description

### Don’t Waste It. Blast It.

Every dabber knows that feeling. You’re down to the last bit in the jar, scraping around trying to
get it out, and it’s just frustrating. Good wax costs real money and leaving it stuck to the glass
is leaving money on the table.
That’s exactly why Brandon invented the Jar Blaster. After years of dealing with the same problem,
he finally designed a solution and brought it to market. There’s nothing else like it.

### How It Works

The Jar Blaster is built with quartz pillars that heat up like a diamond knot. When you’re down to
the end of a jar, heat it up and set the jar directly on top. The heat melts everything left on the
sides and base. Larger dabs collect in the dish below. Smaller amounts flow straight through the
airflow holes. Clean, efficient, nothing left behind.

### What You Get
* Purpose-built quartz nail designed to vaporize straight from the jar
* Wide 40mm dish catches every last drop
* Built-in airflow for smooth, clean hits
* Fits 10mm or 14mm male joints
* Made from high-quality quartz

Every dabber’s got a collection of nails. This one actually solves a real problem.

into a nail easier than ever. This sleek and portable hot knife device is similar to a standard vape
pen battery and is incredibly easy to use.

With just five clicks of a button, the device turns on and is ready to use. To heat the ceramic tip,
all you have to do is hold down the button. And with three temperature settings to choose from, you
can customize your dabbing experience to your preferences.

One of the key benefits of using our Thermal Blade is that it makes loading hard or messy
concentrates into bangers a breeze. The heated and precise blade allows you to easily cut through
even the most stubborn concentrates, with minimal mess and waste. This means you can enjoy your
concentrates to their fullest potential, without any frustration or hassle.

Another advantage of the Thermal Blade is its long battery life. You can use it for several dab
sessions before needing to recharge it, making it perfect for on-the-go dabbing. And its sleek and
portable design means you can easily take it with you wherever you go.

Overall, the Thermal Blade is a must-have tool for any dab enthusiast. Its easy-to-use design,
precise cutting capabilities, and long battery life make it a top choice among experienced dabbers.
If you’re looking to take your dabbing experience to the next level, then be sure to add the Thermal
Blade to your collection today!

# About Yo Dabba Dabba

## Built by dabbers, for dabbers. Since 2009.

Yo Dabba Dabba started as part of [NHM][33], a wholesale smoking accessories company supplying head
shops across the country. When the dabbing renaissance hit around 2012 at the peak of the Green
Rush, we saw an opportunity – and a gap. There was real demand for quality dabbing gear, but most of
what was out there was either overpriced, underbuilt, or both. So we split off, set up shop in
Phoenix, Arizona, and went to work.

More than a decade later, Yo Dabba Dabba is one of the most recognized names in the dab tools
industry. We stock [quartz bangers][34], [dab rigs][35], [eNails][36], [carb caps][37], [terp
pearls][38], inserts, and a full lineup of accessories – all vetted before they land on the site. We
know this space well, and we don’t carry gear we wouldn’t use ourselves.

### Education Is Part of the Deal

Dabbing has been overcomplicated and gatekept for too long. Our goal has always been to make it
accessible – for complete beginners and experienced connoisseurs alike. That means carrying gear at
real prices, backing it with honest information, and making sure you know how to use what you buy.

On the site you’ll find [in-depth resource articles][39] and how-to content covering everything from
banger selection to cleaning technique. If you want a structured start, [Dab University][40] is our
free course platform – five courses covering rig setup, concentrates, technique, temps, and eNails.
Thousands of dabbers have gone through it. It’s worth your time.

### Customer Service Is Not an Afterthought

We’re a real company with real people behind it. If something isn’t right with your order, reach out
and we’ll make it right – fast. Check out our [customer reviews][41] if you want to see what people
actually think. We’re proud of them.

Questions about your setup, what banger fits your rig, or how to dial in your temps? [Contact
us][42] – that’s what we’re here for. Nail Every Dab.

### Description

The latest carb cap to join our collection features a unique design that utilizes carved channels to
control airflow, and (of course) make those [terp pearls][39] spin. Made of high-quality quartz, the
Disc Cap gets its name from its base shape. But, unlike the other quartz caps in our inventory,
there’s no air hole on this handle. Instead, air makes its way through the tiny swirled channels
carved in the cap’s thick and disc-shaped base.

The pattern of the channels swirls air from all sides to amplify convection within the nail’s bucket
and support the vaporization of concentrates at the lowest temperature possible. When testing out
this cap’s function, our team gave it five stars for low-temp support. Plus, it just looks cool.

The Disc Cap is so versatile thanks to its shape and can be paired with most flat tops. It works
perfectly with our [20mm][40], [25mm][41] and [30mm][42] flat top bangers, and our extra-large
[sumo][43] banger. You can even pair it with our [quartz ebanger][44] for a truly elevated[
eNail][45] experience. And, we just love how it looks on our [seamless flat top][46]: straight
stylin’.

To get full, rich flavors and the most cannabinoids from your concentrates, use a Titanium Carb Cap
from Yo Dabba Dabba. Its sleek, tried-and-tested design allows a controlled flow of air around your
dab nail to obtain full vaporization (and therefore every last drop of goodness from your herbal
extracts), at the lowest temperatures possible.

Made from medical-grade titanium to fit any 14mm or 19mm domeless nail, this carb cap also doubles

for longer, even if you’re caught out in bad weather.

Thanks to its angled air vent, this Titanium Carb Cap is also excellent at preventing the pooling
and puddling of concentrates. Its airflow (which you can control), creates a vortex pointed at the
moat of the nail so you can evenly heat your oils and waxes for maximum vaping efficiency. Not only
does this have an eye-popping effect on the flavors and densities of your draws, it also leads to
more powerful hits.

So, for a durable, versatile and functional dabbing accessory which will amplify the flavors and
potency of your concentrates, get your hands on a Titanium Carb Cap from Yo Dabba Dabba, today.

### Description

The Dichro Sphere carb cap is specifically designed for use with a Terp Slurp nail. Because this
unique style of nail features built-in airflow control, the compatible carb cap does not. The solid
design of the Dichro Sphere allows you to get the most out of a terp slurp, because any additional
airflow from a carb cap would reduce the pressure inside the bucket, weakening the hit and
decreasing temperature. Two things you don’t want!

If you’re loving our [Seamless Terp Slurp][38] or [Channel Slurp][39], accessorizing with this carb
cap is a must. Color selection is at random, but if you’re set on a certain shade, leave it in the
notes at check out and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

This dabbing tool may look basic, but there’s a lot more to this Pin Dabber than meets the eye.
Forged in the USA and CNC-machined to the highest standards from Grade-2 Titanium, this sleek and
ergonomic dab tool has been specifically crafted for functionality and durability. So, it may look
boring – and some might even say gothic – but it gets your concentrates moving from A to B with
ease. And thanks to its titanium construction, it also ensures you get a clean, tasty and potent
draw, every time.

Not only that, but this 3-inch (7.6cm) dab tool is virtually unbreakable; good news for the
heavy-handed among us. Ideal for lancing solid concentrates, this skinny Pin Dabber also makes a
very useful tool for anything requiring a good ‘poke-y’. This does not include people, no matter how
annoying they are!

Sure, this Pin Dabber may look humble, but being uncompromisingly uncomplicated in design and being
made from premium US titanium make it an effective little dab tool. With excellent heat retention
and pin-point precision, the Pin Dabber makes moving concentrates – and mountains – easy. Its slim,
needle-like point spreads waxes like a knife through butter and ensures not a drop of concentrate is
wasted. And the resulting hit? Spectacularly flavorsome, potent and most importantly, pure.

Move mountains and enhance your dabbing experience with the Yo Dabba Dabba Pin Dabber. For less than
it would cost you to buy a combo meal from Taco Bell, this tasty piece will last you a lifetime and
won’t give you heartburn – just a pleasurable dabbing adventure.

### Description

Get that glob on the dabber and keep it handy — this domeless quartz nail will be heated and ready
to go in less than ten seconds, making it ideal for busy dabbers who find themselves always on the
go.

Beginners and advanced dabbers alike love the banger design of this domeless nail. Just torch its
large, sidecar dish and drop in the desired amount of concentrates, then watch the smoke swirl and
travel down the banger’s long neck. Pair this quartz stepper banger with a [Quartz Banger Carb
Cap][40] to make each hit as smooth and tasty as possible while reducing vapor loss and preventing
concentrates from puddling or going to waste. For novices, the banger design is a foolproof way to
protect beloved oil rigs from heat damage. The banger’s outward-bent, extended neck holds the dish
far away from the rig, preventing the torch flame from ever coming into contact with it. Don’t worry
about restricted airflow: although the quartz stepper banger’s neck is bent at nearly a 90° angle,
it’s blown without being pinched in and provides ample space for the smoke to travel through and
into the rig. Adorned with a frosted-glass joint, this sleek-styled domeless nail fits both male or
female 14mm and 19mm joints.

If you can only do one thing today to upgrade your dabbing experience, let it be swapping out your
tired, old banger for this Domeless Nail with Ceramic Base: a high-quality concentrate set
consisting of two parts.

Base is the perfect marriage between heat retention and practicality. Together, this hard-wearing
dynamic duo helps everyday dabbers extend their dab sessions and get the most out of their

Dabba’s got it covered with the titanium banger carb cap! Designed with a slanted top, this titanium

### Description

Bangers are great…until it comes time to find a carb cap that fits right over that oddly shaped cup.
That’s why Yo Dabba Dabba started carrying the titanium banger carb cap!

Unlike ordinary carb caps which require twisting, turning and sometimes wiggling to restrict the
airflow of a banger enough to do its job, these titanium carb caps have a slanted cap, making it
easy to use despite the nail’s angled bowl. Made of Grade 2 Titanium, this carb cap enhances the
flavor and vapor of low-temperature dabs by creating a partial vacuum over the nail, thanks to its
cleverly crafted sidecar air-intake hole. With the air-intake hole drilled at an angle, the titanium
carb cap creates a vortex that circulates airflow and insulates the nail, preventing pooling or
puddling of waxy concentrates.

An additional benefit of using a carb cap is that it helps to retain vapor that would have otherwise
been lost.

This two-in-one carb cap also doubles as a handy dab tool, making it easy for you to maneuvre your
dabs onto the nail. Choose between a round and flat head depending on the concentrates you use.

# Tasa al viento: Olavarría pretende cobrar US$ 5.200 dólares por cada aerogenerador de energía
# eólica

[Política][18]
[ Por **En Linea Noticias** ][19] El **Jun 25, 2026** [ 0][20]

En Línea Noticias pudo analizar algunos aspectos el proyecto de Ordenanza que este jueves tomará
estado parlamentario en el Concejo Deliberante.

[[Elegí a En linea]][21]

El **intendente Maximiliano Wesner **elevó al **Honorable Concejo Deliberante** un proyecto de
ordenanza que busca establecer un marco tributario específico para la generación de energía
eléctrica de fuentes eólicas dentro del «ejido del Municipio de Olavarría.»

El proyecto de Ordenanza comenzará a debatirse a partir de este jueves vez que tome estado
parlamentario y sea girado a la comisión Hacienda. Allí tendrá su primer debate para, luego, pasar a
la de Legislación. En principio, por los giros de comisión dispuestos, se especula con que el
oficialismo buscará darle al proyecto un trámite rápido.

> [Ingresa al Concejo un proyecto para gravar la generación de energía eólica][22]

**En Línea Noticias** accedió al texto del proyecto de Ordenanza que quedó contenido en el
**Expediente 208/26** del cuerpo deliberativo.

El articulado al que accedió este medio plantea modificaciones de fondo en la estructura impositiva
local, fijando una tasa anual de **USD 5.200 por cada aerogenerador instalado** y otorgando un
régimen de estabilidad fiscal por el término de diez años para las empresas operadoras.

Lo que dice el Municipio respecto de la contraprestación de ésta Tasa.

Sin embargo, la documentación oficial enviada por el Departamento Ejecutivo omite variables clave
para evaluar su alcance real: no contiene proyecciones sobre la recaudación estimada, carece de un
informe técnico que fundamente el valor económico asignado a cada equipo y no especifica los montos
que los parques eólicos tributan actualmente bajo la normativa vigente.

En la Ordenanza Fiscal e Impositiva ya se encuentra gravada la generación de energía y si bien el
nuevo proyecto deja en claro que se busca crear un marco especifico para las eólicas no se deja en
claro si con el nuevo marco de cobro se recaudaría más o menos respecto de la legislación local
vigente.

Algunos consultados indicaron que esto significa un cambio de reglas de juego respecto de las
empresas que ya tienen en funcionamiento sus parques eólicos dados que estos se radicaron en la
ciudad con un marco normativo que, ahora y de ser aprobada la Ordenanza, cambiará.

También algunos consultados dijeron a En Línea Noticias que al no existir estimaciones concretas, al
menos por ahora, no queda claro si las empresas pagarían más o menos respecto del marco normativo
vigente

#### **El fundamento del Ejecutivo: El «vacío» en el nomenclador actual**

En la exposición de motivos que acompaña el texto, el Departamento Ejecutivo argumenta que la
presentación de la norma responde a un vacío técnico en la estructura de recaudación vigente.

Actualmente, la Ordenanza Impositiva regula en su artículo 5 las alícuotas correspondientes a las
distintas actividades comerciales e industriales utilizando un nomenclador general. Dentro de ese
listado, las empresas dedicadas a la producción energética tributan bajo el código genérico **Nº
401190 denominado «Generación de energía N.C.P.»** (No Clasificada en otra Parte).

El gobierno municipal sostiene en los fundamentos que ***«no existe un código específico para la
generación de energía proveniente de fuentes renovables, en particular la eólica»*.** Según la
postura oficial del Ejecutivo, este encuadre unificado ***«genera inequidades, ya que actividades de
naturaleza, escala e impacto radicalmente diferentes quedan encuadradas bajo un mismo código
genérico»*.** Por este motivo, el proyecto busca separar la producción eólica del resto de las
industrias energéticas tradicionales que operan en el distrito.

##### **Modificación impositiva: De ingresos brutos a un cobro por infraestructura**

La reforma sustancial del proyecto radica en el cambio de la base de cálculo para la determinación
del tributo.

El Artículo 3º de la propuesta determina la creación formal del código de actividad **Nº 401191,
bajo la denominación «Generación de energía eléctrica mediante fuentes eólicas»** dentro del
nomenclador de la Ordenanza Impositiva Municipal. El texto aclara expresamente que este nuevo
apartado normativo tendrá un carácter ***«especial y prevalente sobre las normas generales»***.

En lugar de aplicar una alícuota variable sobre la facturación o los ingresos brutos declarados por
las firmas, el Municipio pretende fijar un esquema basado de forma directa en la infraestructura
física de los establecimientos^{}. De acuerdo con el Artículo 4º, la base imponible de la Tasa por
Inspección de Seguridad e Higiene (TISH) estará constituida únicamente por **la cantidad de
aerogeneradores instalados en cada parque**^{}.

Para la aplicación de este criterio, el proyecto estipula las siguientes condiciones técnicas:
**Criterio de cuantificación:** Se computará el total de unidades físicas montadas dentro del ejido,
*«independientemente de su potencia individual, factor de carga o de la energía efectivamente
generada en cada período»* (Artículo 5º); **Mecanismo de verificación:** El número de molinos se
constatará de forma directa a través de los datos técnicos obrantes en el expediente de derechos de
construcción y habilitación tramitado ante las oficinas de la administración municipal;
**Tratamiento de ampliaciones:** El Artículo 6º prevé que, ante futuras expansiones de los predios
productivos, los nuevos aerogeneradores se incorporarán de manera automática a la base imponible en
el momento exacto en que queden registrados en el expediente municipal correspondiente.

##### **Un canon en moneda extranjera y el procedimiento de liquidación**

Maximiliano Wesner en la inauguración del Parque Eólico de Cementos Avellaneda e YPF

El Capítulo III del proyecto regula el aspecto estrictamente económico del nuevo derecho municipal.
El Artículo 7º determina de forma taxativa fijar la tasa anual de la TISH en la suma de **USD
5.200** por cada unidad instalada y por año.

Respecto a la modalidad operativa para el cobro, el Artículo 8º detalla el procedimiento de
conversión monetaria^{}. El monto determinado originalmente en dólares se liquidará y abonará en
moneda nacional, calculando su equivalencia en pesos según **el tipo de cambio vendedor del Banco de
la Nación Argentina** que corresponda al día hábil inmediato anterior a la fecha de vencimiento o
del pago efectivo, lo que ocurra primero^{}.

El calendario impositivo propuesto por el Ejecutivo determina que la tasa tendrá carácter anual y
**deberá cancelarse por adelantado**, fijando el vencimiento general el día 10 de enero de cada año
calendario (Artículo 9º)^{}. En el caso de aquellos emprendimientos que inicien sus actividades
comerciales de forma posterior a esa fecha, el Artículo 10º dispone una liquidación proporcional por
los meses restantes del año, estableciendo un plazo de treinta días corridos para abonar el tributo
tras obtener la habilitación local^{}. El Artículo 12º añade una penalidad administrativa: la
presentación del comprobante de pago de esta tasa anual funcionará como una **condición
obligatoria** para obtener la renovación o mantener la vigencia de la habilitación municipal del
establecimiento^{}.

Al menos en lo que se conoce hasta ahora el Municipio no explica de dónde surge el monto de 5.200
dólares para fijar la alicuota.

##### **Las omisiones del expediente: Sin proyecciones fiscales ni justificación técnica**

A pesar del detalle en el esquema de cobro, el Expediente 208/26 que ingresará al análisis
legislativo evidencia la falta de variables de impacto económico e histórico de la actividad en
Olavarría.

En ninguna de las fojas del proyecto remitido por el Intendente Wesner y la Jefatura de Gabinete se
incorpora un estudio financiero que justifique técnicamente la elección de la cifra de USD 5.200
anuales por aerogenerador, ni se adjuntan análisis comparativos con las estructuras fiscales de
otros municipios de la provincia de Buenos Aires que posean radicaciones similares.

De igual modo, el texto **no incluye datos sobre el rendimiento económico del sistema de recaudación
actual**. Los fundamentos omiten detallar los montos totales que la administración central percibe
en el presente por parte de las empresas operadoras bajo el código general 401190.

Al no registrarse estimaciones presupuestarias sobre la recaudación proyectada con el nuevo código
401191, el expediente omitió documentar si la implementación de este canon fijo en dólares
constituirá un incremento real de la presión fiscal sobre el sector, una reducción de los montos
vigentes o una modificación de carácter neutro para el erario público.

##### **El cruce normativo: Poder de policía local versus regulación federal**

La argumentación legal de la iniciativa ocupa un lugar central en los fundamentos redactados por la
comuna, previendo posibles objeciones en el recinto respecto a la superposición de competencias con
los marcos regulatorios nacionales^{}. El texto cita la Ley Nacional N° 24.065 de Régimen de Energía
Eléctrica y las potestades del Ente Nacional Regulador de la Electricidad (ENRE), reconociendo que
sus atribuciones federales *«pueden generar tensiones con la tributación municipal cuando ésta recae
directamente sobre la energía generada o transportada»*^{}.

Asimismo, el expediente menciona el impacto del **Artículo 161 de la Ley 27.742**, norma que dispuso
la creación del Ente Nacional Regulador del Gas y la Electricidad para reemplazar y unificar las
funciones del ENARGAS y del ENRE^{}. El proyecto aclara de forma expresa que cualquier mención al
ENRE en la normativa local debe comprender a este nuevo organismo como su sucesor institucional,
asegurando que el cambio de organigrama federal *«no altera el análisis de compatibilidad entre la
tasa municipal aquí propuesta y el marco regulatorio federal aplicable al sector eléctrico»*^{}.

Para validar la legalidad de la tasa, el texto invoca la jurisprudencia y la doctrina de los
tribunales que definen a la Tasa por Inspección de Seguridad e Higiene como una contraprestación
directa por servicios efectivamente prestados por la comuna (habilitación, control edilicio,
urbanístico y fiscalización de condiciones de sanidad) y no como un impuesto al fluido eléctrico en
sí mismo^{}. En esa línea, los fundamentos citan las directrices del **Decreto 450/2025** —que
adecuó el marco regulatorio eléctrico nacional—, detallando que la tasa regulatoria fijada por el
Ente Nacional para generadores y transportistas funciona únicamente como un parámetro indicativo^{}.
El Municipio defiende que, al calcular el tributo local sobre una base técnica alternativa (unidades
físicas de aerogeneradores) y no sobre la facturación o los ingresos brutos, se evita incurrir en
una superposición o conflicto legal con las facultades impositivas del Estado Nacional^{}.

A nivel de fomento, la propuesta menciona su articulación formal con la Ley Nacional Nº 27.191 y la

renovables), además de las normativas de Generación Distribuida (Ley Nacional Nº 27.424 y Ley

# Provincia posterga la paritaria y no hay contactos con los gremios

[La Provincia][18]
[ Por **En Linea Noticias** ][19] El **May 6, 2025** [ 0][20]
[[Elegí a En linea]][21]

Los gremios docentes, estatales y judiciales de la provincia de Buenos Aires iban volver a reunirse
este miércoles con autoridades del Gobierno bonaerense para intentar acercar posiciones en torno a
las negociaciones salariales, luego de rechazar la semana pasada una suba del 7% en dos tramos.
Pero **el encuentro fue postergado, a última hora, para el lunes 12 de mayo.**

Los gremios llegaban a esta tercera reunión (en la primera no hubo oferta) con expectativas de una
propuesta superadora a la de la semana pasada, rechazada por “insuficiente”. En ese encuentro,
P**rovincia ofreció un 4% de incremento para mayo, (a cobrar en junio), y del 3% en julio (a cobrar
en agosto), totalizando una suba del 7% **pero sobre la base del salario de marzo. Además, el
segundo incremento no se computaría para el aguinaldo.

**El último acuerdo alcanzado fue en febrero con una suba del 7% en el salario básico que se
percibió en marzo y un ajuste del 2% cobrado en abril.** Sin embargo, después de esas cifras, se
produjo la salida del cepo cambiario y la inflación sufrió una aceleración, y la última medición del
INDEC marcó un 3,7%, y caso 6% en alimentos. A esto se sumará como mínimo otro 3% de inflación de
abril, de acuerdo a estimaciones del propio ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo.

**Desde los gremios que nuclean a los trabajadores estatales coincidieron en que hubo poco o nulo
contacto informal con Provincia, algo que suele darse en la previa de cada encuentro**. “Nosotros
seguimos insistiendo con un aumento de dos dígitos, al menos para junio y julio”, indicó una fuente
consultada, que agregó que “si van a desdoblar el aumento, el primer porcentaje debería ser el
mayor”.

Otra fuente consultada, señaló que esperaba que hoy pudiera haber algún tipo de contacto informal,
mientras que sobre la oferta que esperan de Provincia “**nos parece que hay que elevar el número
para mayo, de mínima, para que ese aumento entre en el aguinaldo**“.

**“Es necesario una propuesta que supere el aumento de los precios y para ello es necesario un mayor
esfuerzo desde el Gobierno provincial**”, dijo el secretario General de ATE provincia, Claudio
Arévalo.

La situación no difiere entre los docentes, donde desde uno de los gremios admitieron que “no
tuvimos ningún otro contacto, sólo la convocatoria”, y “que **lo que planteamos es la preocupación
de que se nos va muy lejos el cobro del aumento**“, en referencia a lo que fue la oferta oficial.
“Pensamos que la Provincia va a ofrecer algo superador pero la verdad es que no tenemos más
precisión sobre cuánto va a ser ni si van a modificar los plazos”, completó. (DIB)

# Tasa al viento: Olavarría pretende cobrar US$ 5.200 dólares por cada aerogenerador de energía
