company.name: Little Green Pharma
company.description: Little Green Pharma is a leading producer and exporter of medicinal cannabis products, with operations in Australia and Denmark. The company is committed to innovation and sustainability in the natural health sector, focusing on research and development to improve patient outcomes.
company.tagline: Making a world of difference
company.regulatory_status: Listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX)

competitive_advantages: First Australian producer and exporter of locally developed medicinal cannabis products
Pioneered the Australian natural health sector
Strong focus on sustainability and innovation
regulatory_compliance: Compliant with Australian and European medicinal cannabis regulations

leadership.name: Brent Dennison
leadership.title: Independent Non-Executive Chair
leadership.bio: Brent Dennison was most recently the Chief Executive Officer of the Cell Care Group, an international cord blood bank and cellular therapy investor. He led Cell Care Group’s expansion into Asia and North America prior to the company’s acquisition by US-based Generate Life Sciences in 2021. Brent is also a director of Service Stream Ltd., Aspire2 Group, The Cheesecake Shop and The Bays Health Care Group.

leadership.name: Paul Long
leadership.title: Group Chief Executive Officer and Director
leadership.bio: Paul Long is an accomplished leader with a proven track record in the health and pharmaceutical industries. As the former Chief Executive of Onsite Health Solutions, he led the company to significant growth and innovation.

leadership.name: Michael Lynch-Bell
leadership.title: Independent Non-Executive Director
leadership.bio: Michael is an experienced corporate finance executive and consultant with a background in auditing clients within the oil and gas sectors.

leadership.name: Thomas Huppert
leadership.title: Non-Executive Director
leadership.bio: Mr. Thomas (Tommy) Huppert is a recognised medicinal cannabis health economist with over 30 years’ experience building and scaling businesses across Australia and Japan. He founded Cannatrek Ltd and led it to become one of Australia’s largest medicinal cannabis companies.

leadership.name: Seth Yakatan
leadership.title: Independent Non-Executive Director
leadership.bio: Seth Yakatan, co-founder of Katan Associates, Inc., brings over 30 years of expertise in corporate finance, particularly in the cannabis, wellness, and biotech sectors.

leadership.name: Paula Butler
leadership.title: Group Chief Financial Officer
leadership.bio: Paula has extensive experience in complex financial environments both in Australia and internationally, holding several executive management roles in Finance and Operations.

leadership.name: Jason Rance
leadership.title: Chief Executive Officer (Australia)
leadership.bio: Jason excels at leading brands and businesses through positive change and transformation to deliver outstanding results, with expertise in product and service innovation.

leadership.name: Alistair Warren
leadership.title: General Counsel and Company Secretary
leadership.bio: Alistair has been in practice since 2003 and was previously in-house counsel to BHP, advising on international commodity sales and strategic resourcing.

leadership.name: James Kapetanios
leadership.title: Head of Post Merger Integration
leadership.bio: James leads operations at Cannatrek across cultivation, GMP manufacturing, and distribution, with over 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

leadership.name: Chris Petrakis
leadership.title: General Manager, Technology
leadership.bio: Chris has over 25 years of experience in healthcare, biotech, and research environments, leading global teams and delivering major system implementations.

all_classified.polished_summary: Little Green Pharma is a leading producer and exporter of medicinal cannabis products, with operations in Australia and Denmark. The company is committed to innovation and sustainability in the natural health sector, focusing on research and development to improve patient outcomes. Making a world of difference Industries: Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, Natural Health, Cannabis, Natural Health Products

all_classified.company_summary: Mankind Pharma is a leading pharmaceutical company dedicated to making healthcare more affordable and accessible. With a diverse portfolio that includes formulations, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and consumer healthcare products, the company is committed to innovation and quality through its six cutting-edge R&D facilities. Targeting both domestic and international markets, Mankind Pharma strives to improve the health and well-being of communities by providing high-quality healthcare solutions.
all_classified.operational_presence: Markets mentioned on website: Europe, India, UK

Somos un centro médico especializado en tratamientos con Cannabis Medicinal.
Contamos con equipo médico, legal y psicológico que ofrecen un servicio y acompañamiento integral al paciente y usuario.
La modalidad es online mediante atenciones por video llamada.

Agenda tu hora aquí

Servicios

Consulta Médica Cannábica

Atención Psicológica

Asesoría Legal​

RECETARIO MAGISTRAL

Se conoce como farmacia magistral a la modalidad que comprende la preparación de los medicamentos en base a Cannabis con THC y/o CBD al momento en que se prescribe la receta.
El paciente con su Receta Médica Física o Receta Electrónica de Mariamed puede visitar alguna farmacia para la elaboración de un producto en base al tratamiento establecido en su prescripción, el cual puede ser en cápsulas, aceite sublingual, gomitas, trociscos, resina y extractos para vaporización, entre otros.
Dentro de los productos que producimos para el uso humano, tenemos los aceites, cremas, lociones, unguentos, champús, soluciones para otros fines, todos producidos con las siguientes materias primas: THC Full Spectrum, CBD Full Spectrum, CBD Asilado, CBD Broad Spectrum. Linea veterinaria, Ademas capsulas, trociscos (gomitas).

Estos productos tienen las siguientes ventajas:
> Elaborado en base a preparado FULL SPECTRUM, con informe de cannabinoides, terpenos y flavonoides.
> Receta magistral puede indicar el % de cannabinoides deseados.
> Autorizados por el ISP Esta es la forma más segura tanto en cantidades, concentraciones y registros sanitarios que recomendamos aparte de las otras vías de acceso

Puedes encontrarlos en las siguientes farmacias:

Preguntas Frecuentes (FAQ)

¿Es legal la receta electrónica?

Si, en en nuestra consulta médica se extienden recetas que no son retenidas, por lo tanto no requieren firma electrónica avanzada. Nuestras prescripciones contienen firma digital y código QR , la cual podrás imprimir o portar en tu celular.
Producto de la pandemia causada por el COVID-19 se han dictado numerosas resoluciones (204-2020) que han regulado con mayor detalle este tipo de atención y prestación. FONASA al respecto señala “Si el doctor debe entregar una receta médica, ésta la podrá enviar digitalmente para que el paciente la imprima o muestre en la farmacia, a excepción de aquellas recetas para estupefacientes o psicotrópicos, que deben seguir siendo emitidas físicamente, o aquellas que requieren firma electrónica avanzada.”

¿Puedo cultivar con receta médica?

Los pacientes con Receta Médica que indique el uso de Cannabis pueden cultivar para su uso personal y próximo en el tiempo, justificado por este documento emitido por un Médico Cirujano que indique el diagnóstico, tratamiento y duración según el artículo 8 de la Ley 20.000 y su nueva indicación agregada por la Ley Antinarcos.

¿Cuáles son las 5 enfermedades más tratadas con Cannabis Medicinal?

– Fibromialgia
– Ansiedad y depresión
– Insomnio
– Dolor Crónico
– Bruxismo

¿De qué se trata Mariamed?

Somos un centro médico que nace el año 2017 enfocado en tratamientos de cannabis medicinal y terapias alternativas. Contamos con equipo médico, legal y psicológico compuesto por profesionales especializados para ofrecer un servicio con una visión amplia de salud.
El usuario puede optar por una atención médica cannábica donde se analizará si el paciente se puede ver beneficiado de un tratamiento con cannabis, en el cual nosotros ofrecemos la educación, orientación, acompañamiento e indicación del tratamiento conforme al marco legal vigente en Chile.
Si el Paciente califica para un tratamiento en base a cannabis puede optar a adquirir un producto farmacéutico a través de Receta Magistral o un tratamiento particular, además de contar con la documentación necesaria para justificar el uso del cannabis medicinal y personal basado en su tratamiento médico.

¿Qué pasa si no tengo cómo acreditar mi enfermedad?

En ese caso te recomendamos tomar una hora con nuestros terapeutas para acreditar documentalmente tu condición y luego puedes tomar una hora médica con nuestros especialistas.

¿Qué debo llevar a la consulta? (exámenes, documentos, etc.)

Cualquier documentación como por ejemplo diagnóstico, epicreses, control, entre otros que acrediten tu patología o molestia sirve para agilizar el proceso de diagnóstico por parte del médico.

¿Es legal la receta electrónica?

Sí, en en nuestra consulta médica se extienden recetas que no son retenidas, por lo tanto no requieren firma electrónica avanzada. Nuestras prescripciones contienen firma digital y código QR , la cual podrás imprimir o portar en tu celular.
Producto de la pandemia causada por el COVID-19 se han dictado numerosas resoluciones (204-2020) que han regulado con mayor detalle este tipo de atención y prestación. FONASA al respecto señala “Si el doctor debe entregar una receta médica, ésta la podrá enviar digitalmente para que el paciente la imprima o muestre en la farmacia, a excepción de aquellas recetas para estupefacientes o psicotrópicos, que deben seguir siendo emitidas físicamente, o aquellas que requieren firma electrónica avanzada.”
Además para recetas magistrales nuestros especialistas se encuentran inscritos en RECEMED, por lo cual con su firma y formato electrónico se podrán adquirir productos farmacéuticos y farmacias y laboratorios.

¿El médico está certificado?

Los médicos cirujanos de nuestra consulta cuentan con registro en la Superintendencia de Salud y Eunacom aprobado.
Artículo 6 de la ley 20.000: El médico cirujano, odontólogo o médico veterinario que recete alguna de las sustancias señaladas en el artículo 1º, sin necesidad médica o terapéutica, será penado con presidio mayor en sus grados mínimo a medio y multa de cuarenta a cuatrocientas unidades tributarias mensuales.
A contrario sensu por tanto cualquier médico cirujano, dentista o veterinario puede prescribir cannábis en Chile si hay necesidad médica o terapéutica.
Además el año 2015 se hizo una regulación para la venta medicinal de cannabis que contenga THC:
Decreto 84 del Ministerio de Salud: Promulgado el 30 de Octubre de 2015, autoriza la venta de Cannabis y derivados como productos farmacéuticos a través de Farmacias y Laboratorios bajo Receta Médica (sumidades floridas o con fruto de la planta de Cannabis, resina no extraída. Resina separada, en bruto o purificada, obtenida de la planta de Cannabis)

¿Puedo optar por una receta cannábica para consumir cannabis con fines recreativos?

No, en Chile a diferencia de otros países tenemos una legislación más permisiva respecto del Cannabis, permitiendo su uso exclusivo y personal fundamentado siempre con antecedentes médicos.
Sin embargo aún falta regulación para expandir la legalidad para el consumo y cultivo de esta planta con fines recreacionales. No está demás decir que hay un sinnúmero de enfermedades que pueden tratarse con el Cannabis y sus derivados, siendo este un tratamiento paliativo y por tanto, complementario en cuanto a la medicina en general.

¿Qué me recomiendan para tal enfermedad?

Para diagnósticos, tratamientos y dosis para ciertos dolores y enfermedades lo mejor es consultar con un especialista. En nuestro centro médico contamos con médicos cirujanos especialistas en Cannabis medicinal que pueden orientarte y darte una receta.

Si no tengo documentos médicos ¿puedo atenderme?

En ese caso como no tienes un diagnóstico o algo que acredite una dolencia puedes agendar una hora con nuestro psicólogo para evidenciar eso y luego pasas por interconsulta con nuestros médicos por tu tratamiento cannábico.

RECETARIO MAGISTRAL

Se conoce como farmacia magistral a la modalidad que comprende la preparación de los medicamentos en base a Cannabis con THC y/o CBD al momento en que se prescribe la receta.
El paciente con su Receta Médica Física o Receta Electrónica de Mariamed puede visitar alguna farmacia para la elaboración de un producto en base al tratamiento establecido en su prescripción, el cual puede ser en cápsulas, aceite sublingual, gomitas, trociscos, resina y extractos para vaporización, entre otros.
Dentro de los productos que producimos para el uso humano, tenemos los aceites, cremas, lociones, unguentos, champús, soluciones para otros fines, todos producidos con las siguientes materias primas: THC Full Spectrum, CBD Full Spectrum, CBD Asilado, CBD Broad Spectrum. Linea veterinaria, Ademas capsulas, trociscos (gomitas).

Estos productos tienen las siguientes ventajas:
> Elaborado en base a preparado FULL SPECTRUM, con informe de cannabinoides, terpenos y flavonoides.
> Receta magistral puede indicar el % de cannabinoides deseados.
> Autorizados por el ISP Esta es la forma más segura tanto en cantidades, concentraciones y registros sanitarios que recomendamos aparte de las otras vías de acceso

Preguntas Frecuentes (FAQ)

¿Es legal la receta electrónica?

Si, en en nuestra consulta médica se extienden recetas que no son retenidas, por lo tanto no requieren firma electrónica avanzada. Nuestras prescripciones contienen firma digital y código QR , la cual podrás imprimir o portar en tu celular.
Producto de la pandemia causada por el COVID-19 se han dictado numerosas resoluciones (204-2020) que han regulado con mayor detalle este tipo de atención y prestación. FONASA al respecto señala “Si el doctor debe entregar una receta médica, ésta la podrá enviar digitalmente para que el paciente la imprima o muestre en la farmacia, a excepción de aquellas recetas para estupefacientes o psicotrópicos, que deben seguir siendo emitidas físicamente, o aquellas que requieren firma electrónica avanzada.”

¿Puedo cultivar con receta médica?

Los pacientes con Receta Médica que indique el uso de Cannabis pueden cultivar para su uso personal y próximo en el tiempo, justificado por este documento emitido por un Médico Cirujano que indique el diagnóstico, tratamiento y duración según el artículo 8 de la Ley 20.000 y su nueva indicación agregada por la Ley Antinarcos.

¿Cuáles son las 5 enfermedades más tratadas con Cannabis Medicinal?

– Fibromialgia
– Ansiedad y depresión
– Insomnio
– Dolor Crónico
– Bruxismo

¿De qué se trata Mariamed?

Somos un centro médico que nace el año 2017 enfocado en tratamientos de cannabis medicinal y terapias alternativas. Contamos con equipo médico, legal y psicológico compuesto por profesionales especializados para ofrecer un servicio con una visión amplia de salud.
El usuario puede optar por una atención médica cannábica donde se analizará si el paciente se puede ver beneficiado de un tratamiento con cannabis, en el cual nosotros ofrecemos la educación, orientación, acompañamiento e indicación del tratamiento conforme al marco legal vigente en Chile.
Si el Paciente califica para un tratamiento en base a cannabis puede optar a adquirir un producto farmacéutico a través de Receta Magistral o un tratamiento particular, además de contar con la documentación necesaria para justificar el uso del cannabis medicinal y personal basado en su tratamiento médico.

¿Qué pasa si no tengo cómo acreditar mi enfermedad?

En ese caso te recomendamos tomar una hora con nuestros terapeutas para acreditar documentalmente tu condición y luego puedes tomar una hora médica con nuestros especialistas.

¿Qué debo llevar a la consulta? (exámenes, documentos, etc.)

Cualquier documentación como por ejemplo diagnóstico, epicreses, control, entre otros que acrediten tu patología o molestia sirve para agilizar el proceso de diagnóstico por parte del médico.

¿Es legal la receta electrónica?

Sí, en en nuestra consulta médica se extienden recetas que no son retenidas, por lo tanto no requieren firma electrónica avanzada. Nuestras prescripciones contienen firma digital y código QR , la cual podrás imprimir o portar en tu celular.
Producto de la pandemia causada por el COVID-19 se han dictado numerosas resoluciones (204-2020) que han regulado con mayor detalle este tipo de atención y prestación. FONASA al respecto señala “Si el doctor debe entregar una receta médica, ésta la podrá enviar digitalmente para que el paciente la imprima o muestre en la farmacia, a excepción de aquellas recetas para estupefacientes o psicotrópicos, que deben seguir siendo emitidas físicamente, o aquellas que requieren firma electrónica avanzada.”
Además para recetas magistrales nuestros especialistas se encuentran inscritos en RECEMED, por lo cual con su firma y formato electrónico se podrán adquirir productos farmacéuticos y farmacias y laboratorios.

¿El médico está certificado?

Los médicos cirujanos de nuestra consulta cuentan con registro en la Superintendencia de Salud y Eunacom aprobado.
Artículo 6 de la ley 20.000: El médico cirujano, odontólogo o médico veterinario que recete alguna de las sustancias señaladas en el artículo 1º, sin necesidad médica o terapéutica, será penado con presidio mayor en sus grados mínimo a medio y multa de cuarenta a cuatrocientas unidades tributarias mensuales.
A contrario sensu por tanto cualquier médico cirujano, dentista o veterinario puede prescribir cannábis en Chile si hay necesidad médica o terapéutica.
Además el año 2015 se hizo una regulación para la venta medicinal de cannabis que contenga THC:
Decreto 84 del Ministerio de Salud: Promulgado el 30 de Octubre de 2015, autoriza la venta de Cannabis y derivados como productos farmacéuticos a través de Farmacias y Laboratorios bajo Receta Médica (sumidades floridas o con fruto de la planta de Cannabis, resina no extraída. Resina separada, en bruto o purificada, obtenida de la planta de Cannabis)

¿Puedo optar por una receta cannábica para consumir cannabis con fines recreativos?

No, en Chile a diferencia de otros países tenemos una legislación más permisiva respecto del Cannabis, permitiendo su uso exclusivo y personal fundamentado siempre con antecedentes médicos.
Sin embargo aún falta regulación para expandir la legalidad para el consumo y cultivo de esta planta con fines recreacionales. No está demás decir que hay un sinnúmero de enfermedades que pueden tratarse con el Cannabis y sus derivados, siendo este un tratamiento paliativo y por tanto, complementario en cuanto a la medicina en general.

¿Qué me recomiendan para tal enfermedad?

Para diagnósticos, tratamientos y dosis para ciertos dolores y enfermedades lo mejor es consultar con un especialista. En nuestro centro médico contamos con médicos cirujanos especialistas en Cannabis medicinal que pueden orientarte y darte una receta.

Si no tengo documentos médicos ¿puedo atenderme?

En ese caso como no tienes un diagnóstico o algo que acredite una dolencia puedes agendar una hora con nuestro psicólogo para evidenciar eso y luego pasas por interconsulta con nuestros médicos por tu tratamiento cannábico.

# Jorge Cervantes

Growers in the cannabis cultivating community revere Jorge Cervantes as a legend for his lifetime of
contribution to the community. Cervantes is entering his fifth decade as a [cannabis
cultivation][53] author, photographer, and YouTube influencer. His books and videos have gained a
reputation as industry standards in the cannabis industry, offering crucial information and
inspiration to growers worldwide. Marijuana Grow Basics, Hydroponic Basics, and Five Easy Gardens
are just of few of more than 50 books in 8 languages that Cervantes published and wrote.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### What do I need to bring along?

You will be required to bring your charger and cable for laptops.

### What if I do not like the value after assessment?

You can choose to not accept the trade-in value, but the value shown is final.

### Can multiple devices be traded in during the same transaction?

Unfortunately, only one device can be traded in per transaction.

### Do I get to keep the memory card from the trade-in devices?

We recommend that you remove and keep all your memory cards before you trade-in a device

### Would I be able to get back my old device back after the trade-in?

You would not be able to retrieve your old device as all trade-ins are final. Prior to trading in
your device, we recommend backing up all your important content such as contacts, photos, videos,
etc.

### Can I trade-in my device if it does not work?

We would not be able to assess your device if we are unable to power on your device.

### What if my device is not found in the trade-in device list?

You can head down to our stores to get your device assessed by our iStudio Experts to check if it is
accepted.

Our Story

## Healthcare businesses deserve better.

Medical Marketing Group exists because healthcare businesses deserve a marketing team that actually
knows healthcare. Our team has built their expertise over a decade in this space. GP clinics, allied
health, NDIS, dental, telehealth, medicinal cannabis, aged care, and more. This is all we do.

We started as CJ&CO, a broader digital agency. But healthcare clients kept coming back, and we kept
getting better results for them than anyone else. Eventually the choice was obvious: go all in on
what we do best. Medical Marketing Group was born from that decision, and we haven't looked back.

That focus means when you work with us, you're not paying for us to learn your industry. You're
benefiting from everything we've already figured out across 100+ clients. The strategies that work.
The approaches that don't. The benchmarks that matter.

We've built internal tools that would take enterprise clients months and significant budget to
develop. Market intelligence, attribution tracking, performance benchmarking. They're what happens
when you focus on one thing and build the tools to do it better.

We know what works. We've already solved the problems you're facing. For businesses exactly like
yours.

FAQ

## Questions before we connect.

### What happens after I submit the form?

A member of our team will review your details and reach out within one business day. We'll have a
conversation about your practice, your goals, and whether we're the right fit. No sales pitch, just
a genuine discussion.

### Do you offer free consultations?

Yes. We offer a complimentary 30-minute strategy session where we review your current marketing,
identify opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations. You'll leave with valuable insights
regardless of whether you choose to work with us.

### What should I prepare before our call?

It helps to have a rough idea of your current patient volume, existing marketing activities,
approximate budget, and specific challenges. But don't worry if you don't have everything ready. We
can work through it together.

### Do you work with practices outside major cities?

Yes. We work with healthcare practices across every state and territory in Australia. Digital
marketing doesn't require physical proximity. We've helped practices from sole practitioners to
enterprise groups like HotDoc and Better Rehab.

### How quickly can you start?

For most clients, we can begin within 1-2 weeks of signing an agreement. Because we already know
your industry, we don't need months to get up to speed. You're benefiting from what we've already
figured out across 100+ healthcare clients.

### What if we're not the right fit?

We'll tell you. Honestly. If we don't think we can help, or if another approach would serve you
better, we'll say so. We only take on clients we can genuinely help.

knows healthcare. Our team has built their expertise over a decade in this space. GP clinics, allied
health, NDIS, dental, telehealth, medicinal cannabis, aged care, and more. This is all we do.

We started as CJ&CO, a broader digital agency. But healthcare clients kept coming back, and we kept
getting better results for them than anyone else. Eventually the choice was obvious: go all in on
what we do best. Medical Marketing Group was born from that decision, and we haven't looked back.

That focus means when you work with us, you're not paying for us to learn your industry. You're
benefiting from everything we've already figured out across 100+ clients. The strategies that work.
The approaches that don't. The benchmarks that matter.

We've built internal tools that would take enterprise clients months and significant budget to
develop. Market intelligence, attribution tracking, performance benchmarking. They're what happens
when you focus on one thing and build the tools to do it better.

## Questions before we connect.

### What happens after I submit the form?

A member of our team will review your details and reach out within one business day. We'll have a
conversation about your practice, your goals, and whether we're the right fit. No sales pitch, just
a genuine discussion.

### Do you offer free consultations?

Yes. We offer a complimentary 30-minute strategy session where we review your current marketing,
identify opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations. You'll leave with valuable insights
regardless of whether you choose to work with us.

### What should I prepare before our call?

It helps to have a rough idea of your current patient volume, existing marketing activities,
approximate budget, and specific challenges. But don't worry if you don't have everything ready. We
can work through it together.

### Do you work with practices outside major cities?

Yes. We work with healthcare practices across every state and territory in Australia. Digital
marketing doesn't require physical proximity. We've helped practices from sole practitioners to
enterprise groups like HotDoc and Better Rehab.

### How quickly can you start?

For most clients, we can begin within 1-2 weeks of signing an agreement. Because we already know
your industry, we don't need months to get up to speed. You're benefiting from what we've already
figured out across 100+ healthcare clients.

### What if we're not the right fit?

We'll tell you. Honestly. If we don't think we can help, or if another approach would serve you
better, we'll say so. We only take on clients we can genuinely help.

experiences for consumers.

### About

Medicinal Harvest is a federally licenced cultivator of medicinal cannabis, located in Queensland,
Australia. We produce consistent medicinal flower bud all year around at our high-tech, indoor
facility. As a contract grower, we work with wholesale customers to achieve the required product
specification.

The provenance of our Australian grown medicinal flower bud is valued by the entire supply chain.
Medicinal Harvest uses sustainable production including the recycling of water and the use of solar
power. In addition, no pesticides are applied and strict microbial standards are met.

Medicinal Harvest built its first facility in 2020/21 and began cultivation in June 2021. Due to the
success of this facility, a second, co-located facility was constructed in 2023. Planning for stage
three expansion has begun.

Medicinal Harvest is 100 percent Australian owned and operated.

## Our Directors

[Andrew Olley.jpg]

### Andrew Olley
### Co-founder and Cultivation Director

Andrew has a Bachelor of Agricultural Science Degree from the University of Queensland specialising
in plant nutrition and protected cropping. He has 25 years’ experience in all aspects of plant
nutrition, greenhouse and hydroponic production techniques for a multitude of crops.

Andrew is on the steering committee of the Australian Cannabis Cultivators Group, a sub-association
of the Australian Medicinal Cannabis Association (AMCA).

[andrew@medicinalharvest.com][9]

[+61 437 077 220][10]

[Tracey Perez.JPG]

### Tracey Perez
### Co-founder and Business Director

an executive level in product management and marketing to Australia’s largest telecommunications
company as well as to the national futures trading exchange. She also has marketing experience in
the agricultural industry.

### Services

Medicinal Harvest provides contract growing services to third parties seeking unique medicinal
cannabis flower products, either from inhouse genetics or supplied genetics. We can provide bulk
flower bud or manufactured, finished product.

#### Indoor Cultivation

The facility is an indoor cultivation system with positive pressure air control, utilising high
output LED light at 1000 uMol/s/m plus in the flowering compartments. Customised climate control
solutions ensure high quality cannabinoid production and consistency of output.

We use multi-tiered racking to maximise canopy space and improve efficiency.

The significant degree of control in the facility, combined with our experience in high technology
greenhouse and sole source lighting facilities, enables the development and consistent supply of
unique product profiles.

Sustainability is a key driver of Medicinal Harvest's cultivation practices.

[Icon - Services Page V2.jpg]

#### Inhouse Genetics

Medicinal Harvest offers inhouse strains for the local medicinal market, curated for unique terpene
profiles. These strains are available for contract growing with the option of exclusivity.

We continue to invest in pheno-hunting at our indoor facility and have gained valuable feedback from
prescribers to achieve strains that meet patient needs.

# About Mood

Who we are, and what we stand for

## About Mood

Who we are, and what we stand for

We believe that everyone’s got different moods, and improving yours should be easy. That’s why we
created Mood, an online source for 100% federally legal cannabis from America’s favorite farms, that
helps you quickly and easily get to your best mood.

**Mission.** We think cannabis should be accessible, affordable, convenient, and transparent. But
most importantly, we believe in supporting the American farmers who make all of this possible.

**Story.** Founded in 2022, Mood now has a global team of 200+ full-time employees in addition to
our robust network of small, U.S. farmers and manufacturing partners. We've built partnerships with
over 50 small American farms, bolstering local economies and promoting sustainable farming
practices.

**Values.** At our core is a commitment to product quality and world-class customer experiences. Our
company culture fosters open communication and open doors: everybody here has a voice, and we
believe that by investing in both our people and our customers, we all will rise.

**Impact.** Social impact is a business pillar, not an afterthought. This year, we've donated tens
of thousands of dollars to pet humane societies. We’ve contributed to the campaigns of politicians
who advocate for cannabis, contributing to the broader movement toward recognition and acceptance.

created Mood, an online source for 100% federally legal cannabis from America’s favorite farms, that
helps you quickly and easily get to your best mood.

**Mission.** We think cannabis should be accessible, affordable, convenient, and transparent. But
most importantly, we believe in supporting the American farmers who make all of this possible.

**Story.** Founded in 2022, Mood now has a global team of 200+ full-time employees in addition to
our robust network of small, U.S. farmers and manufacturing partners. We've built partnerships with
over 50 small American farms, bolstering local economies and promoting sustainable farming
practices.

**Values.** At our core is a commitment to product quality and world-class customer experiences. Our
company culture fosters open communication and open doors: everybody here has a voice, and we
believe that by investing in both our people and our customers, we all will rise.

**Impact.** Social impact is a business pillar, not an afterthought. This year, we've donated tens
of thousands of dollars to pet humane societies. We’ve contributed to the campaigns of politicians
who advocate for cannabis, contributing to the broader movement toward recognition and acceptance.

# About Us

## Open Access Government is a digital publication that provides an in-depth perspective on key
## public policy areas worldwide, including health and social care, research and innovation,
## technology, government, environment and energy

Open Access Government is an open access journal, which means that all content is freely available
without charge to the user or his/her institution. Users are allowed to read, download, copy,
distribute, print, search, or link to the full texts of the articles or use them for any other
lawful purpose, without asking prior permission from the publisher or the author. This is in
accordance with the BOAI definition of open access.

Each quarterly edition features a wide range of prestigious contributors, including government
ministers, European commissioners, members of the European Parliament, industry associations and
charities.

The website hosts the quarterly publication, and each article from that is uploaded directly to the
website and is promoted on our social media channels. We also publish daily news, plus a wide range
of special reports and publications that provide a high level of detail on key policy issues, such
as health and research.

The feedback we receive from our [contributors][95] is very encouraging, more of which you can find
on [our testimonials page][96]. It is this spirit of positivity that drives all that we do and is
reflected throughout the content found on the Open Access Government website.

We comply with the requirements of the CC-BY licence.

### Publication Enquiries

If you have ideas for our digital publication regarding an opinion piece on health and social care,
plus animal health, please get in touch with Lorna Rothery, Digital Publication Editor at
[[email protected]][97]

If you have ideas for our digital publication on all other sections (research, digital
transformation, environment, agriculture, energy, government and transport), please get in touch
with the Managing Editor, Jonathan Miles, at [[email protected]][98]

### Web Content Enquiries

If you have any non-commercial content to upload solely to the Open Access Government website, then
please get in touch with one of our digital editors by emailing [[email protected] &
][99][[email protected]][100]

We look forward to hearing from you.

# About Us

## Open Access Government is a digital publication that provides an in-depth perspective on key
## public policy areas worldwide, including health and social care, research and innovation,
## technology, government, environment and energy

Open Access Government is an open access journal, which means that all content is freely available
without charge to the user or his/her institution. Users are allowed to read, download, copy,
distribute, print, search, or link to the full texts of the articles or use them for any other
lawful purpose, without asking prior permission from the publisher or the author. This is in
accordance with the BOAI definition of open access.

Each quarterly edition features a wide range of prestigious contributors, including government
ministers, European commissioners, members of the European Parliament, industry associations and
charities.

The website hosts the quarterly publication, and each article from that is uploaded directly to the
website and is promoted on our social media channels. We also publish daily news, plus a wide range
of special reports and publications that provide a high level of detail on key policy issues, such
as health and research.

The feedback we receive from our [contributors][95] is very encouraging, more of which you can find
on [our testimonials page][96]. It is this spirit of positivity that drives all that we do and is
reflected throughout the content found on the Open Access Government website.

We comply with the requirements of the CC-BY licence.

# Company car tax changes sees uptake of electric vehicles

May 1, 2020
[[company car tax changes]][99]© Aron M |

## Lauren Pamma, electrification propositions lead at [Lex Autolease][100], discusses how the latest
## company car tax changes can support a wider uptake of electric vehicles across the UK

With the sustainability agenda becoming ever more prominent, appetite for electric vehicles (EVs)
continues to rise. Over the last 12 months we’ve seen a 177% increase in orders for EVs, and the
latest annual registration figures report more than 37,000 pure-electric vehicles have entered the
market. That’s in part due to the introduction of the new [zero per cent benefit-in-kind (BIK)
taxation][101] level for EVs that came into effect in April 2020.

Company car drivers are now more confident in the financial implications of their decision to take
an EV. This increase in popularity among company car drivers will make a significant difference to
the low-emission vehicle market in general, too. Any trends in the [company car market][102]
eventually play out in the second-hand market as company car contracts come to an end.

Coupled with the change in customer attitudes towards the climate change agenda, the demand for EVs
is expected to rise throughout 2020 and beyond.

### Financial incentives for drivers

The fall in BIK rates from 16 per cent to zero means company car drivers will make a considerable
saving on current costs and, in some cases, result in EVs becoming cost neutral, or even cheaper
than petrol or diesel equivalents.

To put this into perspective, a driver of a Nissan Leaf EV currently pays between £871 and £1,960 in
company car tax per year, depending on their salary. From April, they’ll pay nothing.

The zero percent tax rate also applies to hybrid vehicles with emissions from 1 – 50g/km and a pure
electric range of over 130 miles, giving drivers and fleets a wider range of vehicles to choose
from.

Although the electric car tax will increase marginally to one percent in 2021 / 2022 and two percent
in 2022 / 2023, this still represents a major reduction compared to current levels. The recent
Budget confirmed that the two percent rate will continue until at least 2024 / 2025 providing a full
five years of tax certainty for drivers.

As well as encouraging EV adoption, the new tax rules could see a swing back towards company cars
after the trend in recent years for employees to opt for cash alternatives.

The new tax legislation presents huge potential cost savings for company car drivers and could be
the catalyst for the next stage of EV growth. It is likely to increase demand from employees, and as
businesses introduce a wider selection of EVs on their company car policies to meet this demand, the
appetite from drivers in response to greater choice will only grow stronger.

### Increase in EV adoption for businesses

It’s not only fiscal incentives that have boosted appetite for EVs. The rapid expansion of
sustainable technology – including investment in charging infrastructure, evolving battery
technology and an ever-increasing range of models on the market – removes many of the barriers to
uptake cited by drivers, suggesting the upward curve is set to continue. In the Budget, the
Chancellor’s announcement of a £500m investment in charging infrastructure to ensure no driver is
ever more than 30 miles from a charge point should provide further comfort to drivers and remove
range anxiety.

Even so, we’re at the early stage of the curve and demand for EVs is still hampered by some
hesitancy from the market. To put it into perspective, the 37,000 EVs registered last year
represents just 1.6 per cent of the total new cars on the roads – so there is still work to do to
get businesses with fleets on board, especially as the government’s net-zero targets loom large.

According to our research, more than a fifth (22 per cent) of Brits say they don’t know enough about
the different fuel types available and what would suit their driving needs, which might put them off
making the switch.

To address this residual uncertainty, the focus has to be on increased education and awareness about
EVs for both businesses, fleet managers and drivers, to make sure they have the right vehicle for
the right job.

It’s true that there is not one EV solution that fits all business needs. In some cases, the very
latest diesel vehicles will still be the most practical option for many job roles in the short to
medium-term, especially those with high mileage requirements.

By contrast, for low mileage job roles – which are often concentrated in urban areas, such as last
mile delivery services – electric vehicles are more than capable and represent an opportunity to
make savings on fuel, maintenance, repairs, taxation and charges such as those for entering Clean
Air Zones. All of these factors need to be included when calculating the whole-life cost of a
vehicle, which is essential when considering when and where to begin transitioning to electric.
While EVs may have a higher list price than petrol or diesel they can cost less in total over their
lifetime with all of those other costs considered.** **Our advice to businesses is to carefully
consider what each vehicle in their fleet will be used for, and to start the transition to electric
technology where it will fit seamlessly into their operation**.**

For businesses who have decided to begin the move towards low and zero emission vehicle technology,
the next question is whether to lease or buy outright. The key benefits of the former are
flexibility and access to expert advice. That way, businesses have the best chance of successfully
completing the transition to EVs in line with increased product availability and access to charge
points. ** **

# Will the Government app solve contact tracing at venues?

September 21, 2020
[[contact tracing, venue]][99]© Matteo Artizzu

## The new outsourced test and trace app is set for launch on 24^{th} September: How does it look
## for contact tracing at venues?

It is intended as a big weapon in the Government’s arsenal to defeat COVID-19. One of its ambitions
is to support contact tracing at venues. According to the [government website][100] the app will
‘enable people to scan the unique QR codes of venues they have visited to aid contact tracing and
help understand the spread of the virus.’ Government advice suggests that if a venue is currently
using a QR code service to log customers they should ‘now switch to the official NHS QR code
system.’

So, is this the easy contact tracing solution that venues have been searching for? Not so fast.

The Government has given some indication as to how the app will work: ‘If a venue is identified as
high risk, your app will alert you, and if you test positive, you will be able to use your check-in
log to remind yourself where you have been when [talking to a contact tracer.’][101]

### What do venue owners have to do?

So, where does this leave venue owners? As indicated the Government is asking venues to display QR
codes linked to the NHS app and have customers scan them as they enter the premises. Though strongly
urged to do so, this is not a legal requirement on the part of anyone.

However, it is a legal requirement for venues to collect customer data in some form. Obviously not
everyone has a smart phone and there will be many, as we will see in a moment, who have not
downloaded the app. This means venues must have complementary system in place to satisfy their legal
obligation to collect customer data. Landlords should be aware that just displaying the Government
QR codes is not enough.

### Data security

By its own admission, the Government recognises that for the app to work there must be widespread
take up. Academics suggest that more than 60% of the population will need to download it for it to
work effectively.

Although the Government is at pains to stress the [data collected on the app is secure][102] there
are concerns among the public about data protection and perhaps a nagging suspicion the Government
is tracking your every move. Some may worry it could be used for policing those who are forced to
self-isolate though there is scant evidence to suggest that is the case.

### Conspiracy theories

What follows is bordering on the murky world of conspiracy theories, but it has been suggested the
app could be used by unscrupulous people to settle scores.

Got beef with someone? Spend time with them, report via the app that you have COVID-19 thus forcing
your frenemy to self-isolate. Have you visited a pub and been barred for anti-social behaviour?
Report you have contracted the disease thus leaving open the possibility that the pub might be
forced to shut down. All done by an unpleasant person who is able to remain anonymous.

Some of the above may be stretching credibility but there’s no doubt It’s going to be a tough sell
to get the public on board, especially as the Government itself sees the app as part of a ‘digital
diary’ tracking where you have been.

### Have a plan B

Whether the Government app actually works or is adopted widely by the public remains to be seen. For
landlords, restaurant owners and the rest the law is clear: You must collect customer data. The
Government app has a role to play and it may help punters but will be of limited use to publicans.
It’s not a game changer.

This may be unwelcome news, but amid all the COVID confusion it’s important to understand that
venues need back-up. And back-up means having your own contact tracing solution.

# Why does leadership training matter?

December 6, 2018
[[leadership training]][99]

## David Willett, Corporate Director, at The Open University explains why leadership training
## matters

Employers in the UK are currently in a difficult and unpredictable position. We do not yet know what
the long-term impact of Brexit will be on our workforce; both in terms of managing our existing
talent, and accessing the skills we will need in the future.

If the UK’s departure from the EU has an enduring impact on access to overseas talent, the public
sector could find itself in a difficult or even untenable position, particularly in sectors such as
the NHS, where one in eight employees are ‘not of British nationality.1 Other
areas of the public sector may also be significantly impacted, so it is crucial that employers
carefully consider potential obstacles, and the workforce they will need to develop to overcome
them, to ensure that they are prepared for the future.

With many challenges on the horizon – the fourth industrial revolution and our post-[Brexit][100]
economy included – it will fall to leaders to effectively communicate and manage the changes faced
by their workforce. But with 73% of employers struggling to recruit for leadership roles in the past
year2, what can public sector employers do to ensure they are able to effectively weather the storm?

### Leading from the front

A strong leader can make or break a team, but worryingly, a recent study found that two-thirds of
the British workforce believed that they could do a better job than their boss.3 Not only can this
mindset have a significant impact on personnel issues, such as loyalty and retention, but also
undoubtedly has an effect on a work-force’s output and productivity. And in high-pressure [working
environments][101], such as the public sector, this can be problematic.

Over five million people were employed by the public sector in 20184 and with such a vast and
diverse workforce to oversee, navigating change becomes even more of a challenge – and strong,
competent leaders and managers become paramount. They need to be able to see new initiatives and
technology put into place, but also communicate change and reassure more junior staff when
necessary.

The public sector is renowned for its opportunities for career progression, with many workers
joining shortly after leaving education and transferring between roles, industry specialisms or
departments until they retire. But progression is often based on longevity, as well as experience,
so workers can often find themselves in a management or leadership position without much guidance on
how to manage people or budgets. Thrown in the deep end, many do pick up the skills they need – but
it is a steep learning curve, which can take time that may not be forthcoming as the UK experiences
rapid change.

At the same time, there is also a shortage of leadership and management skills in the labour market,
which means it is time-consuming and expensive to hire in new employees – and even then it takes
time for them to acclimatise to the role. So instead, to ensure that the public sector is fully
future-proofed, employers should consider the benefits of offering formal leadership training to
existing staff to overcome the issues of inexperience, either in a role or in an organisation.

### Using training effectively

It is a common misconception that leadership training and professional development are the reserve
of the youngest and most junior members of a team. In fact,
employees of all levels can benefit from continuous professional development that gives them the
opportunity to build on existing skills and learn new skills appropriate to more senior roles as
they move up the ranks.

Learning should be a lifelong endeavour, and for the most part public sector employers are excellent
at investing in people, both on the job and through formal training. But with the introduction of
the apprenticeship levy, to which the public sector is the biggest contributor, there are new
opportunities to develop the workforce.

With tight budgets, it is essential that organisations secure good return on investment, and use the
funding in their National Apprenticeship Service accounts to ensure they have the skills they need
to manage future changes – at all levels.

So, with a shortage of leadership talent, the public sector needs to ensure it is prepared for the
changes and challenges that lie ahead; able to manage change and personnel effectively, and
anticipate and plan for future opportunities and changes.

And while organisations already invest in training their workforces, the apprenticeship levy is a
golden opportunity to develop strong and loyal leaders, who can motivate the workforce, drive
forward plans and address issues with confidence.

About us

**A CMO for therapies that define legacies**

As a reliable extension of your network, we provide premium contract manufacturing to maximize your
product’s potential and reach patients quickly. Because for patients, time is life.

From oral solid doses (OSD) and sterile injectables (SI) to complex biologics, we provide
manufacturing solutions across diverse modalities built on a decades-long legacy of bringing
high-quality products to commercialization.

Powered by Pfizer

As an award-winning CMO, we help maximize your products' potential and reach patients faster.
Powered by Pfizer’s proven technical expertise and extensive global network, we provide premium
contract manufacturing to help ensure the lightspeed delivery of your life changing therapies to
patients waiting.

We specialize in commercial manufacturing for oral solids, sterile injectables and biologic drug
products. With seamless process optimization, scalable production, rigorous IP protection and
regulatory excellence, giving you confidence at every stage of your journey.

Ready to help you build your lasting legacy.

Your network: extended, exceptional, exclusive

We make it easy for you to partner with and benefit from our Pfizer global network where we have
spent decades developing the signature Pfizer approach, earning an uncompromising reputation for
reliability, quality and regulatory support.

Across North America to Europe, Asia and Australia, our facilities are equipped to handle your
diverse manufacturing needs, from oral solids, and sterile injectables to complex biologics.

Explore our sites

Loading

Leadership crafting the future of healthcare alongside you

We are guided by a leadership team of seasoned professionals with extensive experience in the
pharmaceutical industry who bring diverse expertise spanning all facets of drug manufacturing, from
technical services to supply chain management and regulatory affairs.

With a deep understanding of the complexities of the industry, our leadership team is committed to
providing clients with seamless support and open communication.

Meet our leadership team

Loading

A track record of global regulatory excellence

We maintain strict adherence to the highest global standards (cGMP, FDA, EMA) with uncompromising
commitment to quality, employing the same robust processes and adhering to the same stringent
quality standards used for Pfizer's own medicines.

Our global team of regulatory affairs professionals has over eight decades of experience and
in-depth knowledge of regulatory requirements in more than 150 countries, supporting you from Phase
II to commercialization.

Explore our regulatory services

Loading

Deeply committed to sustainable practices

As a leading global CMO powered by Pfizer, we uphold the highest standards for sustainability across
all areas of our business and share it’s goal to achieve the Net-Zero Standard by 2040 with a focus
on:

* Carbon reduction
* Water conservation/reduction
* Waste management

Discover our sustainability approach

Helping deliver a smarter, faster and more patient‑centric future for OSD manufacturing

Oral solid dose (OSD) manufacturing is entering a new era, driven by rising demand for complex
formulations, faster timelines and therapies designed around patient needs. As the industry evolves,
manufacturers must navigate increasing technical complexity while maintaining quality, reliability
and regulatory compliance.

Our eBook explores the key trends shaping the future of OSD manufacturing — from the shift toward
Pharma 5.0 and digital innovation to the growing focus on patient‑centric dosage forms, challenging
APIs and flexible manufacturing and packaging strategies. Discover how advanced technologies,
data‑driven insights and deep scientific expertise are helping transform OSD production to be
smarter, faster and more resilient.

Powered by Pfizer’s global network and decades of experience, Pfizer CentreOne brings the
capabilities, scale and insight needed to help simplify complexity, accelerate development and
deliver high‑quality OSD therapies to patients worldwide.

market.

Pfizer, with strategically located OSD manufacturing facilities across Germany, Ireland, Italy and
Japan.

including cytotoxic and controlled substances.

helps ensure the reliability and quality of your OSD project.
* **Simplicity in scale and scope: **Find out about the flexibility and scalability we bring to your
OSD project from its early clinical phases to meet your evolving project needs.

How successful CMO collaboration sets the foundation for sterile injectable product success

In the realm of sterile injectables (SI), biotechs and pharma organizations come in a variety of
sizes and with a range of experience levels. The oncology segment, which will drive much of the
growth in the SI market (expected CAGR of 9.1%) in the coming years, is the focus of many drug
developers with significant differences when it comes to history, footprint and experience.¹ The
same is true for contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) and the dynamics of these
outsourcing relationships have a huge influence on project success.

CMOs work with all types of biotechs and pharma organizations, from small, emerging, sometimes
virtual companies, to large organizations. To accommodate such variety, CMOs must make every
possible effort to customize their operations to the product’s technical needs without compromising
quality or safety. The two mottos, “right first time” and “no cutting corners allowed” are pillars
for a CMO.

¹ [https://www.datamintelligence.com/research-report/sterile-injectable-market][4]

What does it take to navigate the future of OSD development?

The oral solid dosage (OSD) market is rapidly evolving. As the demand for OSD products rises,
developers and manufacturers are under pressure to adopt proactive and innovative approaches,
embracing strategies that make OSD production:
* Smarter: Leveraging advanced technologies and data-driven insights to optimize formulations,
streamline processes and enhance product quality.
* Faster: Implementing strategies to accelerate OSD development and manufacturing without
compromising quality or safety.
* More patient-centric: Prioritizing patient needs and preferences throughout OSD development.

In our latest eBook, we explore the key trends shaping the future of OSD and provide insights into
how to optimize your OSD development and manufacturing processes to prepare for future demands.

# Pharma Synth – Pharma Company in India

## Company Overview

Serving the ailing humanity.

Since 1984, Pharma Synth Formulations Limited has emerged as one of the leading top Pharmaceutical
Company in India with a strong manufacturing base in [Delhi][26] and Haridwar.

Over a period of more than three and a half decades, Pharma Synth has earned a prime place amongst
the pharma manufacturers, trade and medical profession. PharmaSynth has a GMP certified,
state-of-the-art manufacturing unit in the holy city of Haridwar to produce quality [products][27],
aiming to serve the ailing humanity with a religious and patriotic personal touch to everyone, as we
believe in God, as well as in our sovereignty.

## Recognition

7 awards one after another

Apart from GMP & ISO certificate, we have been conferred with several prestigious National &
International awards for quality, productivity and fair business practices, of which following are
worth to mention:
1. “Excellence Award” and Udyog Ratna by IES, New Delhi.
2. “International Star Award for Quality in Gold category” by BID in their Geneva convention in the
   year 2007.
3. “National Award-2007” for Quality by Ministry of MSME, Govt. of India,  presented by Hon’ble
   Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh.
4. “Special Recognition Award” by Govt. of Uttrakhand.
5. “MSME award” by National Productivity Council of India, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Govt. of
   India for excellence in productivity in 2010.
6. “Fair Business Practices Award” by Council of corporate code of conduct, Mumbai
7. A national award with international repute, “Rajiv Gandhi National Quality Award-2011” by BIS,
   Ministry of Consumer Affair, Govt. of India.

## Innovation

Creating something new

Pharmasynth is now considered as top pharma company in India because our manufacturing unit has
latest and sophisticated machines to produce world class and contamination free products. All the
inputs (raw materials, packaging materials, consumables, etc.) has to pass through astringent
quality tests, and only high-quality materials are used to produce our formulations.

To keep pace with growing technological advancements, all our technical staff is exposed to a
regular periodical and online in-house training, so that they may use the validated methods and
procedures perfectly, to produce zero-defect and final products.

## Beyond Manufacturing

Covering some extra miles

Pharmasynth gets a prime place amongst top pharmaceutical companies in India because we have a team
of renowned and highly professional consultants are on our panel, to get valuable support for the
development of new molecules and technical up-gradation to tune up with ever-changing time and
technology.
Today Pharma Synth is proud of its capabilities in the manufacturing quality medicines such as
 Tablets, Capsules (including Beta-Lactam), Liquid Orals, Powders, Ointments, Creams, Ear drops,
Enema and various other dosage forms.
Apart from manufacturing, we are committed to develop individuals, who are dedicated to serve the

Our motto is to serve the ailing humanity by making world-class medicines, readily available at
every nook and corner of the country, at an affordable price.

## Building Beyond Medicines

A step forwards for our society

*Our goal is not only to manufacture medicines!*

We believe that it is our responsibility for the well-being of our society. As a gesture of paying
back to it, we are actively involved towards in our CSR activities. [Read Complete Story…][29]

*Our Services!*

We are not only in manufacturing and distribution of our products. [Read Complete Story…][30]

## Know us Better

Useful Information

**Quality**
We follow the most stringent quality policies due to which we have won various awards for quality,
productivity and fair business practices.

**Team of Professionals**
Our team of highly trained professionals enables us for development and up-gradation of medicines

**Collaboration**

We were a brand partner with WHO-ORS campaign “Sathi Bachpan Ke” a PSP-One project promoted by USAID
(United States Agency for International Development) from Oct. 2004 to Sep. 2009.

ABT Associates Inc. has launched MBPH (Market Based Partnership for Health), a project for rural
health awareness program funded by the USAID. In this project, PharmaSynth played an important role
to spread the ORS Powder (Vitalyte) to the deep-rural area of backward districts of U.P. from Oct.
2008 to Oct 2014.

**Career**

We always welcome competent, appropriately qualified, well trained, experienced and highly motivated
individuals in our goal for serving humanity.

of renowned and highly professional consultants are on our panel, to get valuable support for the
development of new molecules and technical up-gradation to tune up with ever-changing time and
technology.
Today Pharma Synth is proud of its capabilities in the manufacturing quality medicines such as
 Tablets, Capsules (including Beta-Lactam), Liquid Orals, Powders, Ointments, Creams, Ear drops,
Enema and various other dosage forms.
Apart from manufacturing, we are committed to develop individuals, who are dedicated to serve the
Organization, the Society and humanity as a whole. [The company][28] is also known for its social
and patriotic activities.
We have a dedicated and committed team of honest and result oriented people. They are putting their
smart efforts with the aim to promote the products vigorously and to establish them as brand leaders
in various therapeutic segments.
Our motto is to serve the ailing humanity by making world-class medicines, readily available at
every nook and corner of the country, at an affordable price.

## Building Beyond Medicines

A step forwards for our society

*Our goal is not only to manufacture medicines!*

We believe that it is our responsibility for the well-being of our society. As a gesture of paying
back to it, we are actively involved towards in our CSR activities. [Read Complete Story…][29]

*Our Services!*

We are not only in manufacturing and distribution of our products. [Read Complete Story…][30]

## Know us Better

Useful Information

**Quality**
We follow the most stringent quality policies due to which we have won various awards for quality,
productivity and fair business practices.

**Team of Professionals**
Our team of highly trained professionals enables us for development and up-gradation of medicines

**Collaboration**

We were a brand partner with WHO-ORS campaign “Sathi Bachpan Ke” a PSP-One project promoted by USAID
(United States Agency for International Development) from Oct. 2004 to Sep. 2009.

ABT Associates Inc. has launched MBPH (Market Based Partnership for Health), a project for rural
health awareness program funded by the USAID. In this project, PharmaSynth played an important role
to spread the ORS Powder (Vitalyte) to the deep-rural area of backward districts of U.P. from Oct.
2008 to Oct 2014.

**Career**

We always welcome competent, appropriately qualified, well trained, experienced and highly motivated
individuals in our goal for serving humanity.

# About Us

## About PharmOut

PharmOut is an international consultancy founded in 2006 which has grown a strong reputation in
offering leading GMP compliance, validation, regulatory, engineering and architectural consulting
services solutions to the [pharmaceutical and life science industries][86].

PharmOut holds ISO 9001:2015 certification from [LRQA][87] and our Quality Management System is
certified to the ISO 9001:2015 standard for the provision of [engineering][88], [architectural
design][89] and [consultancy][90] services.

We aim to give you a competitive advantage by helping you design, build and operate manufacturing
facilities that will fully comply with international Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) regulations
as issued by regulatory agencies such as the US FDA, EU EMA, CFDA and PIC/S member agencies such as
the Australian TGA, New Zealand MedSafe, Singaporean HSA to list a few of the nearly 50 agencies.

### [Meet the PharmOut Team][91]

Meet some of our hugely diverse group of consultants who regularly work across the Asia Pacific
Region, and we can often have a GMP consultant on your doorstep within 24 hours.

clients, our staff and the company?

### [Pharmaceutical Jobs and Careers][94]

# About Us

## About PharmOut

PharmOut is an international consultancy founded in 2006 which has grown a strong reputation in
offering leading GMP compliance, validation, regulatory, engineering and architectural consulting
services solutions to the [pharmaceutical and life science industries][86].

PharmOut holds ISO 9001:2015 certification from [LRQA][87] and our Quality Management System is
certified to the ISO 9001:2015 standard for the provision of [engineering][88], [architectural
design][89] and [consultancy][90] services.

We aim to give you a competitive advantage by helping you design, build and operate manufacturing
facilities that will fully comply with international Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) regulations
as issued by regulatory agencies such as the US FDA, EU EMA, CFDA and PIC/S member agencies such as
the Australian TGA, New Zealand MedSafe, Singaporean HSA to list a few of the nearly 50 agencies.

### [Meet the PharmOut Team][91]

**3-Morpholino-1-(4-nitrophenyl)-5,6-dihydropyridin-2(1H)-one**, is a key compound used as an
**Apixaban Intermediate** in pharmaceutical synthesis. **Punagri** is a reliable **503615-03-0
Indian manufacturer and supplier**, offering high-quality intermediates for pharmaceutical and
chemical industries.

This compound plays a crucial role in the production of **Apixaban**, a widely used anticoagulant

## About PURE5™ Extraction Equipment

**PURE5™** is the most innovative cannabis and hemp processing & extraction equipment company. With
our superior **cannabis extraction equipment** and unique approach to extracting botanical plant
materials with minimal degradation to the natural ingredients, we have set the bar for a new level
for extracting quality cannabis concentrates in the industry.

### What Makes Our Extraction Equipment Superior?

We can sum up the superiority of PURE5™ devices in 3 simple words:

Safe, Fast, and Efficient. Our Extraction Systems deliver a terpene-rich oil and more
strain-specific end product at a fraction of the cost compared to running Carbon Dioxide (CO2),
Hydrocarbon, or Ethanol machines for cannabis oil extraction.

## EQUIPMENT AND PRODUCTS

PURE5™ is the most innovative botanical extraction equipment company focusing on cannabis and hemp.
Our superior technology gently extracts botanicals, delivers full natural potency, and has set a new
higher level of standards in the cannabis industry.

### HTE Extraction Systems

[ View all ][85]

### **R134a Aerosol Extraction Systems**

High Terpene Extraction (HTE) is perfect for extracting the fine oil fraction from every botanical.
The extraction process is gentle to the oil and the plant material, using low pressure, room
temperature, and delivers naturally potent terpene rich full-spectrum oil. It collects the complete
terpene and cannabinoid profile without degradation of components.

Our R134a [solventless cannabis extraction equipments][86] are:
* 20 Liter MAX CBD/THC extraction machine: ideal for small-scale extraction operations
* 50 Liter CBD/THC extraction machines: ideal for small to mid-scale extraction operations
* 100 Liter CBD/THC extraction machines: ideal for mid-scale scale extraction operations
* 200 Liter systems: Ideal for medium to large commercial operations
* 500 Liter systems: For large-capacity commercial production
* 1000 Liter systems: Ideal for very-large-scale production

### 1500L Ethanol Extraction System

[ View all ][87]

### **Ethanol CBD/**THC Extraction Equipment** (EtOH) – 20-1000L Ethanol Extraction System**

Ethanol is a universal solvent with power in resin and alkaloid extraction. We pair the R134a
aerosol and EtOH extraction to extract any plant material. Our [ethanol cannabis extraction
system][88] utilize a chemical process that feeds the material continuously via a conveyor into the
extraction vessel and delivers a consistent output of purified oil.
* 20-1000 liter EtOH extraction equipment: Get a better quality final product by eliminating
  undesired compounds and preserve all terpenes and cannabinoids.
* Easy evaporation results in clean and pure extract without traces of solvent
* Easy-to-use Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and touchscreen interface
* Fully automatic with all safety features. Users can program pressure, temperature, and time.

### Post Processing & Test Lab Equipment Systems

[ View all ][89]

### **Lab Equipment – Post Processing & Test Lab Equipment Systems**

PURE5™ provides own-build, high-quality [cannabis lab testing equipment][90], including stainless
steel molecular systems for the distillation process, various sizes of vacuum industrial ovens, THC
remediation equipment, stainless steel isomerization, and crystallization reactors, and gas
chromatography equipment.
* **50L Crystallization Reactor**: Produce high-quality cannabis isolate from various plant sources
  with minimal impurities and no residual solvents or other unwanted compounds.
* **Gas Chromatography**: Quick and low-cost analyses of potency, residual solvents and terpenes and
  the quantification of their concentrations according to molecular weight and boiling point.
* **50L – 500L Vacuum** Oven: Dry, Decas and Decarboxylate cannabis extracts and activate the
  cannabinoids in the extract at low temperatures and pressures, allowing for a more efficient
  extraction process.
* **20L-200L HTE**: More efficient extraction. The lower temperatures also reduce the risk of
  burning off valuable compounds while allowing for more precise control over the extraction
  temperature and times for optimal cannabinoid potency.

# Safe, Fast & Efficient Cannabis Extraction Equipment & Systems

We manufacture the best CBD & THC extraction equipment for the cannabis industry

[ CONTACT US ][83]
[ ][84]

## About PURE5™ Extraction Equipment

**PURE5™** is the most innovative cannabis and hemp processing & extraction equipment company. With
our superior **cannabis extraction equipment** and unique approach to extracting botanical plant
materials with minimal degradation to the natural ingredients, we have set the bar for a new level
for extracting quality cannabis concentrates in the industry.

### What Makes Our Extraction Equipment Superior?

We can sum up the superiority of PURE5™ devices in 3 simple words:

Safe, Fast, and Efficient. Our Extraction Systems deliver a terpene-rich oil and more
strain-specific end product at a fraction of the cost compared to running Carbon Dioxide (CO2),
Hydrocarbon, or Ethanol machines for cannabis oil extraction.

## EQUIPMENT AND PRODUCTS

PURE5™ is the most innovative botanical extraction equipment company focusing on cannabis and hemp.
Our superior technology gently extracts botanicals, delivers full natural potency, and has set a new
higher level of standards in the cannabis industry.

### HTE Extraction Systems

[ View all ][85]

### **R134a Aerosol Extraction Systems**

High Terpene Extraction (HTE) is perfect for extracting the fine oil fraction from every botanical.
The extraction process is gentle to the oil and the plant material, using low pressure, room
temperature, and delivers naturally potent terpene rich full-spectrum oil. It collects the complete
terpene and cannabinoid profile without degradation of components.

Our R134a [solventless cannabis extraction equipments][86] are:
* 20 Liter MAX CBD/THC extraction machine: ideal for small-scale extraction operations
* 50 Liter CBD/THC extraction machines: ideal for small to mid-scale extraction operations
* 100 Liter CBD/THC extraction machines: ideal for mid-scale scale extraction operations
* 200 Liter systems: Ideal for medium to large commercial operations
* 500 Liter systems: For large-capacity commercial production
* 1000 Liter systems: Ideal for very-large-scale production

### 1500L Ethanol Extraction System

[ View all ][87]

### **Ethanol CBD/**THC Extraction Equipment** (EtOH) – 20-1000L Ethanol Extraction System**

Ethanol is a universal solvent with power in resin and alkaloid extraction. We pair the R134a
aerosol and EtOH extraction to extract any plant material. Our [ethanol cannabis extraction
system][88] utilize a chemical process that feeds the material continuously via a conveyor into the
extraction vessel and delivers a consistent output of purified oil.
* 20-1000 liter EtOH extraction equipment: Get a better quality final product by eliminating
  undesired compounds and preserve all terpenes and cannabinoids.
* Easy evaporation results in clean and pure extract without traces of solvent
* Easy-to-use Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and touchscreen interface
* Fully automatic with all safety features. Users can program pressure, temperature, and time.

### Post Processing & Test Lab Equipment Systems

[ View all ][89]

### **Lab Equipment – Post Processing & Test Lab Equipment Systems**

PURE5™ provides own-build, high-quality [cannabis lab testing equipment][90], including stainless
steel molecular systems for the distillation process, various sizes of vacuum industrial ovens, THC
remediation equipment, stainless steel isomerization, and crystallization reactors, and gas
chromatography equipment.
* **50L Crystallization Reactor**: Produce high-quality cannabis isolate from various plant sources
  with minimal impurities and no residual solvents or other unwanted compounds.
* **Gas Chromatography**: Quick and low-cost analyses of potency, residual solvents and terpenes and
  the quantification of their concentrations according to molecular weight and boiling point.
* **50L – 500L Vacuum** Oven: Dry, Decas and Decarboxylate cannabis extracts and activate the
  cannabinoids in the extract at low temperatures and pressures, allowing for a more efficient
  extraction process.
* **20L-200L HTE**: More efficient extraction. The lower temperatures also reduce the risk of
  burning off valuable compounds while allowing for more precise control over the extraction
  temperature and times for optimal cannabinoid potency.

### THC Remediation Equipment

[ View all ][91]

### **THC Remediation Systems and Equipment**

Our patented [THC Remediation equipment][92] is a first and only of its kind in the hemp industry.
It uses a dynamic combination of gas, low heat, and low pressure to isomerize THC into other
cannabinoids such as CBD, CBC, CBN, etc.
* Fully organic remediation process uses no solvents.
* Easy-to-use, fully automated system
* DEA compliant
* 5 liter – 150 liter/day processing capacity range for small to large-scale commercial production

## Cannabis Distillation Equipment

PURE5™ [cannabis distillation equipment][93] is designed for high-quality, large-batch cannabis
extraction. They use a highly efficient and reliable wiped-film distillation process to separate and
purify compounds in cannabis oils. The system features a two-stage thin film process, whereby the
rotation of a heated rotor element creates a thin film on the inside wall of the distillation
vessel. This process is highly efficient and can achieve very high-quality separations of compounds
in cannabis oils.

### The 6" SS Wipe Film Distillation System

[ Tech Information ][94]

### The 6″ SS Wipe Film Distillation system

Made of 304 or 316 stainless steel and can process faster compared to its glass counterpart. This is
because stainless steel has a higher heat transfer rate, resulting in more than double the
processing capacity of conventional glass wipe film distillation systems.

The SS system also features a ball valve discharge system that automates the flow rate and also
provides increased safety during the distillation process.

### The 6" GL Wipe Film Distillation system

[ More about the 6"GL ][95]

### The 6″ GL Wipe Film Distillation system

Made of food-grade glass can process up to 7 liters/hour and features a fully automated terpene and
solvent recovery collection systems, allowing for easy collection and storage of the distillate. It
also includes a unique filtration system that removes unwanted solids to ensure the highest quality
product.

#### Main features of the PURE5™ Wipe Film Distillation Systems
* Fast and efficient distillation
* High quality and purity of the final product
* Precise temperature control
* Ease of operation with automated systems
* Safe and efficient solvent recovery
* Cost-effective solution with low maintenance requirements.

## Farming Equipment

### Hemp Harvester

[ Harvester Tech Data ][96]

### Hemp Harvester

Our robust hemp harvester is a specialized agricultural machine for harvesting and collecting hemp
plants. It combines cutting, gathering, and baling hemp plants into one process. The harvester has
adjustable settings for the length and thickness of plant stems, allowing for various harvesting
styles.

### The 10T Conveyor Dryer System

[ Dryer Tech Info ][97]

### 10T Conveyor Dryer System

The dryer is composed of a heated chamber that circulates and dries the plants with warm to hot dry
air, similar to a convection oven. A 22KW heat exchange furnace generates the necessary heat from
25C to 60C to dry the plants, while a control cabinet controls temperature, airflow, power, and
other variables to ensure optimal drying conditions.

### Stick and Seed Separation

[ More about the Separator ][98]

### Stick and Seed Separation

Our Stick and Seed Separation system separates hemp sticks from flower and seeds for further
processing. Then further separates the seeds from flower in 4 fractions.
* The food-grade stainless steel feeding conveyor moves the hemp material from the drying process to
  the sifter.
* The sifter uses a vibratory motion to separate the hemp sticks from the seeds that are light
  enough to roll down the mesh.
* They then pass through a blower cyclone system to further separate the large particles from the
  smaller ones.
* The control cabinet allows users to ensure optimal power, speed, and temperature as the sticks are
  sorted and separated.

The end result is a clean, dry batch of seeds ready for further processing or sale.

With a commitment to preserving the integrity of botanical materials, PURE5 Extraction sets a new standard in efficient and safe extraction technology.
