## Comprar Semillas de Cannabis en España: La Guía Completa

En seis años atendiendo a cultivadores en Andalucía, Cataluña, Valencia y todas las demás
comunidades autónomas durante los últimos seis años, el factor más importante que separa una gran
cosecha de una decepcionante es la **calidad de la semilla**. No los nutrientes. No la iluminación.
Las semillas.

Esto lo vemos a diario porque nuestro equipo de soporte habla con cultivadores cada día — más de 200
conversaciones de selección de variedades por semana — y el patrón es constante: los cultivadores
que empiezan con genética fresca y probada de una fuente fiable obtienen resultados. Los que compran
semillas baratas de plataformas no verificadas se llevan una decepción.

Por eso fundamos Royal King Seeds España alrededor de una idea: **dar a los cultivadores domésticos
españoles acceso a más de 1.600 [variedades premium de semillas de cannabis][46] que realmente se
prueban antes de llegar a tu puerta**. Ofrecemos más de 1.600 variedades de cannabis categorizadas
por rendimiento, nivel de THC, dificultad de cultivo, compatibilidad climática y perfil terpénico —
porque creemos que un cultivador informado es un cultivador exitoso.

Un ejemplo concreto: el verano pasado un cliente de Jaén nos escribió tras perder un cultivo
exterior de sativa por el oídio que llegó con las tormentas de agosto. Le recomendamos cambiar a
híbridos indica-dominantes con estructura de cogollo abierta y bajar la fecha de plantación dos
semanas. Cosechó 480 g por planta en su segundo intento — el mismo balcón, el mismo sustrato,
distinta genética y distinto calendario. Estos ajustes regionales son la diferencia entre una
cosecha frustrante y un cultivo viable.

Haz clic en un tema

### Legalidad de las Semillas de Cannabis en España

▼

Vamos al grano, ya que es la primera pregunta que hacen la mayoría de compradores nuevos. En España,
la compra y posesión de semillas de cannabis es legal, ya que se consideran productos de
coleccionismo y preservación genética. Las semillas no contienen THC y su venta está permitida. Sin
embargo, el cultivo de cannabis está regulado: **el cultivo privado para autoconsumo en espacios no
visibles al público se encuentra en una zona gris legal**, mientras que los clubes sociales de
cannabis operan bajo marcos regulatorios específicos en comunidades como **Cataluña, País Vasco y
Navarra**. El cultivo con fines comerciales o la venta de marihuana sigue siendo ilegal. Siempre
recomendamos a nuestros clientes informarse sobre la legislación vigente en su comunidad autónoma
antes de germinar. El panorama legal evoluciona constantemente, y lo que estaba restringido el año
pasado puede haber cambiado.

### Cómo Funciona Realmente el Envío Discreto

▼

Nos preguntan por esto constantemente, así que aquí te explicamos exactamente lo que ocurre. Cada
pedido se envía en **embalaje neutro y sin marcas** — sin logotipos, sin branding, sin indicación
del contenido. La dirección del remitente utiliza un nombre comercial genérico. Las semillas van
dentro de viales a prueba de aplastamiento dentro de sobres acolchados.

Enviamos con seguimiento completo a toda España y Europa — sin riesgos aduaneros dentro de la UE.
Según los datos de seguimiento de nuestros últimos 12.000 envíos, el 94% de los pedidos llegan en 5
días laborables, y muchos de nuestros clientes en la península ibérica reciben sus paquetes en solo
3 días. Pedidos superiores a 99€ tienen [envío discreto gratuito][47].

We offer you a full white label portfolio of medicinal cannabis from flos to extract and from
high-THC over balanced to CBD-dominant variants. Contact us to learn more.

30 years of plant cultivation experience means we can offer you fully EU-GMP certified plants and
extracts at Europe’s lowest prices, and you can be sure to never run out of stock

Every patient and every need is different. We breed our own genetics, to make sure that medicinal
cannabis is available in exactly the strength and terpene profile each person needs.

produce to meet the strict EU GMP standard at our sites in both Denmark and Portugal.

# Marijuana Seeds

Welcome to Semillas-de-marihuana.com, your **trusted online shop for premium marijuana seeds since
2001**. With our vast selection of world-class [marijuana seeds][206], we invite you to discover and
indulge in the best that nature has to offer. All our seeds are supplied in their original
packaging, ensuring authenticity, freshness, and quality. Plus, we offer free shipping and
delightful gifts with every purchase. As our commitment to authenticity, we never stock bulk seeds
or imitations, but only the finest cannabis seeds from the worlds leading producers.

Our passion for cannabis extends beyond the products we offer. At Semillas-de-marihuana.com, we love
to engage in enlightening discussions about marijuana, its diverse strains, unique characteristics,
varying effects, and everything in between. As part of our commitment to keeping you updated, we
annually refresh our seed catalogue with exciting new strains that enter the market. Our dedicated
team of experts is always ready to inform you about these latest additions and help you select the
perfect strain that aligns with your needs.

Whether youre seeking autoflowering marijuana seeds, feminized seeds, regular seeds, or CBD seeds,
Semillas-de-marihuana.com is your one-stop destination. We proudly stock an extensive range of over
1,000 strains from esteemed Dutch, Spanish, American, and other international seed banks. Upholding
our guarantee of quality, we ensure our seeds are always fresh and stored under stringent
preservation conditions. We provide urgent, discreet shipping, ensuring your privacy and rapid
delivery.

Explore our comprehensive catalogue and discover reputable cannabis seed banks available at
competitive prices. We adhere to a strict quality standard and only partner with the most
environmentally conscious producers. If any product fails to meet these high standards, we promptly
remove it from our shop. For your convenience, weve grouped our seeds into specific sections based
on their unique traits, such as high-yield or fast-flowering marijuana varieties. To simplify your
shopping experience, weve implemented advanced search filters, helping you quickly find the perfect
strains for your needs.

Semillas-de-marihuana.com is more than just a shop its a gateway to acquiring the highest quality
cannabis seeds. We strive to provide an unparalleled online shopping experience, allowing you to
enjoy the finest marijuana right from the comfort of your home. Discover the Experiencia Natural
difference today – purchase your favourite cannabis seeds from us and experience a level of quality
and service that will surely exceed your expectations! Also, be sure to visit our [Blog about
Cannabis][207], where we have many sections with fascinating articles for you.

# To be The Leader for Spray Dryer in the World -Pilotech

Pilotech started to produce laboratory spray dryer since 2005. We have over 50 patents and over 15
software copyrights. Our company is also the only manufacturer in the world that can produce a wide
range of spray dryers, including benchtop spray dryer, vacuum spray dryer, spray-freezing dryer,
all-in-one machine for spray drying and fluidized granulator, organic solvent spray dryer and nano
spray dryer. Our laboratory spray dryer has many advantages, such as stable performance, easy
operation and durable service. For this reason, the product is very popular among researchers. It
has occupied more than 70% of the market in China. It is now used by more than 3,500 users in the
world, and exported to more than 60 countries and regions, including USA, UK, Germany, Italy,
Russia, South Korea, Singapore, Japan, Malaysia, Canada, Australia, South Africa, Taiwan and Hong
Kong.

## Pilotech Journey

As a leader in the field of spray drying, we have recently successfully developed a three-fluid
spray head.

2005
[YC-015: The first lab two fluid spray dryer in China][136]
Our laboratory spray dryer is very small, but it solves many problems. For example, with our
product, you don’t need to face the problems like difficulty in preparing materials, large coverage,
and big noise.
2007
[YC-1800: The first lab low temperature spray dryer in China][137]
You don’t need to worry that the materials containing sugar will stick on the wall when they are
used for spray drying. You don’t need to worry that the heat-sensitive materials, such as enzymic
preparations, will degenerate when they are used for spray drying.
2008
[YC-015A: The first inert loop spray dryer in China (for organic solvents)][138]
It can also ensure safe spray drying of organic solvent in laboratory. With our product, both toxic
and oxidizable materials can be treated with spray drying in laboratory.
2009
[YC-1000: The first lab spray granulator in China][139]
Only one machine can realize four functions, including spray drying, spray granulation, fluidized
bed drying and fluidized bed coating.
2010
[YC-2000: The first lab vacuum spray dryer in China][140]
It is a perfect combination of vacuum drying and spray drying. The heat sensitive materials such as
probiotics can remain active after spray drying in laboratory.
2011
[YC-3000: The first lab spray freeze dryer in China][141]
It is also a perfect combination of spray drying and freeze drying. Compared with freezer dryer, our
spray dryer can provide a faster drying process, and the dried materials have better fluidity and
solubility.
2012
[YC-018: The first pilot scale spray dryer, powder recvoery rate can reach 92%][142]
Our spray dryer for pilot plant test is also very small. It only covers an area of 1 square meter,
but it has the processing capacity of 3L/H. It has the advantages, such as low noise, low power
(only 5.5KW), and high material recovery rate.
2013
[YC-500: benchtop spray dryer][143]
The processing capacity is 500ML/H. The minimum material volume is 20ML material (related to factors
such as the solid content of the material). Because it is very small, it can be placed on the
workbench.
2014
[YC-501 and YC-018A: Inert loop spray dryer][144]
YC-501 is the smallest organic solvent spray dryer. It can be applied to spray drying of very tinny
materials. YC-018A is organic solvent spray dryer for pilot plant test. It applies to the
preparation of materials in laboratory and pilot plant.
2016
[YC-510: Multifunctional spray dryer, which contains high temperature type, vacuum low temperature
type and inert loop type][145]
YC-510 is a multifunctional device. It can be used as traditional laboratory spray dryer, vacuum
spray dryer and organic solvent spray dryer to process different materials.
2017
Developed a new concentric spray nozzle
If the materials are atomized by traditional spray nozzle, they can be easily sprayed to the wall of
bottle, because traditional spray nozzle may have some defects in installation or spraying accuracy.
So we recommend the concentric spray nozzle. The concentric spray nozzle has better performance. Its
spray will form an umbrella around the nozzle.

[YC-018A Pilot Scale Inert Loop Spray Dryer][138]

Pilotech YC-018A inert loop spray dryer (pilot scale organic solvent spray dryer) is capable of
processing 3000ML/H, and it is suitable for the spray drying of aqueous solutions and most organic
solvents. The YC-018A spray dryer is suitable for the use in the [laboratory][139] and pilot plant,
and a minimum volume of 100ML (related to factors such as the solid content of the material) is
enough to perform one experiment. After the drying process, the materials feature high degree of
sphericity and mobility, and the recovery rate of the material can be as high as 92%.

Pilotech YC-500 laboratory spray dryer is small in size and suitable for use on the laboratory
table. Its maximum capacity is 500ML/H, and a minimum volume of 10-20ml (related to factors such as
the solid content of the material) is enough to perform one experiment. The maximum and minimum
inlet air temperature as well as the minimum outlet air temperature for the YC-500 spray dryer are
200 °C, 140 °C and 80 °C respectively. The YC-500 spray dryer can be upgraded to an organic solvent
spray dryer with an optional inert loop system, or can be upgraded to a vacuum low temperature spray
dryer with an optional vacuum system.

Pilotech YC-501 mini Inert loop spray dryer is a split-type spray dryer, and it is divided into the
spray dryer main machine and the inert loop system. The main machine is used for drying the spray of
aqueous solutions. After being connected to the nitrogen circulation system, it is able to spray dry
of most organic solvents. The capacity of YC-501 spray dryer is 500ML/H. It is small in size as it
occupies less than one square meter and it is easy to install and operate.

solvents and aqueous solutions. It is capable of processing 1500ML per hour, and it only needs 30ML
(related to factors such as the solid content of the material) to perform one experiment. The
YC-015A mini Inert loop spray dryer has a built-in oxygen monitoring system. When the oxygen
concentration is higher than the preset value for safe operation, the system will not start or cease
to operate automatically, which will ensure the safety of your laboratory.

minimum amount of 100ML materials (related to factors such as the solid content of the material) to
perform one experiment. Is suitable both for laboratory use and the pilot plant use. The inlet air
temperature for the YC-018 laboratory spray dryer ranges from 105 to 280 °C. As the range is
relatively wide, it is suitable for drying the spray of most materials. After the drying process,
the particle size ranges from 1 to 80 microns, so it is suitable for the spray drying of

Pilotech started to produce laboratory spray dryer since 2005. We have over 50 patents and over 15
software copyrights. Our company is also the only manufacturer in the world that can produce a wide
range of spray dryers, including benchtop spray dryer, vacuum spray dryer, spray-freezing dryer,
all-in-one machine for spray drying and fluidized granulator, organic solvent spray dryer and nano
spray dryer. Our laboratory spray dryer has many advantages, such as stable performance, easy
operation and durable service. For this reason, the product is very popular among researchers. It
has occupied more than 70% of the market in China. It is now used by more than 3,500 users in the
world, and exported to more than 60 countries and regions, including USA, UK, Germany, Italy,
Russia, South Korea, Singapore, Japan, Malaysia, Canada, Australia, South Africa, Taiwan and Hong
Kong.

## Pilotech Journey

As a leader in the field of spray drying, we have recently successfully developed a three-fluid
spray head.

2005
[YC-015: The first lab two fluid spray dryer in China][136]
Our laboratory spray dryer is very small, but it solves many problems. For example, with our
product, you don’t need to face the problems like difficulty in preparing materials, large coverage,
and big noise.
2007
[YC-1800: The first lab low temperature spray dryer in China][137]
You don’t need to worry that the materials containing sugar will stick on the wall when they are
used for spray drying. You don’t need to worry that the heat-sensitive materials, such as enzymic
preparations, will degenerate when they are used for spray drying.
2008
[YC-015A: The first inert loop spray dryer in China (for organic solvents)][138]
It can also ensure safe spray drying of organic solvent in laboratory. With our product, both toxic
and oxidizable materials can be treated with spray drying in laboratory.
2009
[YC-1000: The first lab spray granulator in China][139]
Only one machine can realize four functions, including spray drying, spray granulation, fluidized
bed drying and fluidized bed coating.
2010
[YC-2000: The first lab vacuum spray dryer in China][140]
It is a perfect combination of vacuum drying and spray drying. The heat sensitive materials such as
probiotics can remain active after spray drying in laboratory.
2011
[YC-3000: The first lab spray freeze dryer in China][141]
It is also a perfect combination of spray drying and freeze drying. Compared with freezer dryer, our
spray dryer can provide a faster drying process, and the dried materials have better fluidity and
solubility.
2012
[YC-018: The first pilot scale spray dryer, powder recvoery rate can reach 92%][142]
Our spray dryer for pilot plant test is also very small. It only covers an area of 1 square meter,
but it has the processing capacity of 3L/H. It has the advantages, such as low noise, low power
(only 5.5KW), and high material recovery rate.
2013
[YC-500: benchtop spray dryer][143]
The processing capacity is 500ML/H. The minimum material volume is 20ML material (related to factors
such as the solid content of the material). Because it is very small, it can be placed on the
workbench.
2014
[YC-501 and YC-018A: Inert loop spray dryer][144]
YC-501 is the smallest organic solvent spray dryer. It can be applied to spray drying of very tinny
materials. YC-018A is organic solvent spray dryer for pilot plant test. It applies to the
preparation of materials in laboratory and pilot plant.
2016
[YC-510: Multifunctional spray dryer, which contains high temperature type, vacuum low temperature
type and inert loop type][145]
YC-510 is a multifunctional device. It can be used as traditional laboratory spray dryer, vacuum
spray dryer and organic solvent spray dryer to process different materials.
2017
Developed a new concentric spray nozzle
If the materials are atomized by traditional spray nozzle, they can be easily sprayed to the wall of
bottle, because traditional spray nozzle may have some defects in installation or spraying accuracy.
So we recommend the concentric spray nozzle. The concentric spray nozzle has better performance. Its
spray will form an umbrella around the nozzle.

# To be The Leader for Spray Dryer in the World -Pilotech

Pilotech started to produce laboratory spray dryer since 2005. We have over 50 patents and over 15
software copyrights. Our company is also the only manufacturer in the world that can produce a wide
range of spray dryers, including benchtop spray dryer, vacuum spray dryer, spray-freezing dryer,
all-in-one machine for spray drying and fluidized granulator, organic solvent spray dryer and nano
spray dryer. Our laboratory spray dryer has many advantages, such as stable performance, easy
operation and durable service. For this reason, the product is very popular among researchers. It
has occupied more than 70% of the market in China. It is now used by more than 3,500 users in the
world, and exported to more than 60 countries and regions, including USA, UK, Germany, Italy,
Russia, South Korea, Singapore, Japan, Malaysia, Canada, Australia, South Africa, Taiwan and Hong
Kong.

## Pilotech Journey

As a leader in the field of spray drying, we have recently successfully developed a three-fluid
spray head.

2005
[YC-015: The first lab two fluid spray dryer in China][136]
Our laboratory spray dryer is very small, but it solves many problems. For example, with our
product, you don’t need to face the problems like difficulty in preparing materials, large coverage,
and big noise.
2007
[YC-1800: The first lab low temperature spray dryer in China][137]
You don’t need to worry that the materials containing sugar will stick on the wall when they are
used for spray drying. You don’t need to worry that the heat-sensitive materials, such as enzymic
preparations, will degenerate when they are used for spray drying.
2008
[YC-015A: The first inert loop spray dryer in China (for organic solvents)][138]
It can also ensure safe spray drying of organic solvent in laboratory. With our product, both toxic
and oxidizable materials can be treated with spray drying in laboratory.
2009
[YC-1000: The first lab spray granulator in China][139]
Only one machine can realize four functions, including spray drying, spray granulation, fluidized
bed drying and fluidized bed coating.
2010
[YC-2000: The first lab vacuum spray dryer in China][140]
It is a perfect combination of vacuum drying and spray drying. The heat sensitive materials such as
probiotics can remain active after spray drying in laboratory.
2011
[YC-3000: The first lab spray freeze dryer in China][141]
It is also a perfect combination of spray drying and freeze drying. Compared with freezer dryer, our
spray dryer can provide a faster drying process, and the dried materials have better fluidity and
solubility.
2012
[YC-018: The first pilot scale spray dryer, powder recvoery rate can reach 92%][142]
Our spray dryer for pilot plant test is also very small. It only covers an area of 1 square meter,
but it has the processing capacity of 3L/H. It has the advantages, such as low noise, low power
(only 5.5KW), and high material recovery rate.
2013
[YC-500: benchtop spray dryer][143]
The processing capacity is 500ML/H. The minimum material volume is 20ML material (related to factors
such as the solid content of the material). Because it is very small, it can be placed on the
workbench.
2014
[YC-501 and YC-018A: Inert loop spray dryer][144]
YC-501 is the smallest organic solvent spray dryer. It can be applied to spray drying of very tinny
materials. YC-018A is organic solvent spray dryer for pilot plant test. It applies to the
preparation of materials in laboratory and pilot plant.
2016
[YC-510: Multifunctional spray dryer, which contains high temperature type, vacuum low temperature
type and inert loop type][145]
YC-510 is a multifunctional device. It can be used as traditional laboratory spray dryer, vacuum
spray dryer and organic solvent spray dryer to process different materials.
2017
Developed a new concentric spray nozzle
If the materials are atomized by traditional spray nozzle, they can be easily sprayed to the wall of
bottle, because traditional spray nozzle may have some defects in installation or spraying accuracy.
So we recommend the concentric spray nozzle. The concentric spray nozzle has better performance. Its
spray will form an umbrella around the nozzle.

all_classified.polished_summary: Smallcappower is a financial media company that specializes in providing insights and analysis on small-cap investment opportunities across various sectors, including base metals, energy, precious metals, and healthcare. Through a range of content formats, such as news articles, video interviews, and expert commentary, the company aims to inform investors about emerging companies and market trends, helping them navigate the complexities of the small-cap investment landscape.

all_classified.company_summary: Smallcaps is a financial platform focused on providing insights and data on small-cap stocks listed on the ASX. The company offers a range of services, including market analysis, stock recommendations, and updates on key sectors such as mining, biotechnology, and technology, catering to investors seeking opportunities in emerging markets. Through its comprehensive tools and resources, Smallcaps aims to empower investors with the information needed to make informed decisions in the dynamic landscape of small-cap investments.

About SOMAÍ

compassionate care scientifically crafted
SOMAÍ is a leading EU-GMP European vertically integrated Multi-Country Operator (MCO) company with a global footprint of distribution for the largest and most advanced EU GMP-certified cannabinoid-containing pharmaceutical extract portfolio.

At SOMAÍ, we are building a leading global brand with the most robust pipeline of innovative cannabis-based therapeutics. We envision a world where people live a healthy lifestyle empowered by natural cannabis medicine.

SOMAÍ owns a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility and indoor cultivation in Lisbon, Portugal, and has global sales teams in the largest medical cannabis markets. We are continuing to make acquisitions and global brand partnerships that make us one of a few and the first European-based vertically integrated companies in the EU able to cater to the diverse needs of fast-growing global cannabis markets.

effects for patients. Oral solutions provide a user-friendly alternative for patients looking to
integrate cannabis into their treatment regimen with precision and ease. SOMAÍ’s oral solutions
portfolio, based on three full spectrum cannabis extracts’ types, combines a large range of THC/CBD
ratios to cover a wide variety of medical conditions.

conditions. SOMAÍ’s proprietary 10:10 series is a combination of different excipients, terpenes and
nano emulsions designed for various conditions.

## Our product categories

We craft products for today, tomorrow, and beyond with unparalleled knowledge of how to make what
patients need
[7][7]

### Oral Solutions

Oral solutions are carefully crafted to deliver consistent and accurate dosages, ensuring reliable
effects for patients. Oral solutions provide a user-friendly alternative for patients looking to
integrate cannabis into their treatment regimen with precision and ease. SOMAÍ’s oral solutions
portfolio, based on three full spectrum cannabis extracts’ types, combines a large range of THC/CBD
ratios to cover a wide variety of medical conditions.
[Untitled 1920 x 950 px 1][Untitled 1920 x 950 px 1]

### Proprietary formulations

Proprietary formulations represent unique and specialized blends to address specific therapeutic
needs. These formulations involve a proprietary combination of cannabinoids, terpenes, and other
compounds, tailored to provide enhanced efficacy and targeted relief for specific medical
conditions. SOMAÍ’s proprietary 10:10 series is a combination of different excipients, terpenes and
nano emulsions designed for various conditions.
[SOMAI IG Size 1920 x 950 px 6][SOMAI IG Size 1920 x 950 px 6]

### Inhalation Oils

Designed for vaporization, these formulations allow controlled cannabinoid inhalation without
traditional smoking’s combustion. The fast onset of effects makes vape oils a preferred choice for
those seeking rapid relief. Vape oils provide patients with a modern and efficient way to
incorporate cannabis into their treatment plans. Our premium vape oil available in multiple distinct
terpene formulas, is an alternative to vaporizing dried flower.
[4][4]

### Oral sprays

The spray delivery format provides convenient administration with precise dosage with a peppermint
taste profile in a balanced THC/CBD ratio. The fast onset of effects makes them suitable for
patients seeking quick relief. Additionally, oral sprays’ compact and portable nature enhances their
accessibility, allowing patients to manage their symptoms conveniently throughout the day.
[5][5]

### Soft Gel capsules

The soft gel capsule delivery format allows comfortable administration and precise dosage for the
convenience of patients. Soft gel capsules are easy to swallow, making them a convenient option for
patients who prefer oral administration. The standardized dosing and ease of integration into daily
routines make soft gel capsules a practical and patient-friendly option for those seeking the
benefits of cannabinoids in a pharmaceutical-grade form.
[6][6]

### Dried Cannabis Flower

Dried medical cannabis flower is a natural and unprocessed form of therapeutic cannabis, containing
a diverse array of cannabinoids. It offers a versatile way to manage symptoms and provides
customized and fast relief, particularly beneficial in medical conditions requiring a rapid onset.
SOMAÍ procures high-quality GMP flowers utilizing selected cultivars grown both indoors and
greenhouse.
[Newsletter (32)][Newsletter (32)]

### Oral Gums

Oral Gums are innovative pharmaceutical formulations designed to cater to the unique therapeutic
requirements of patients with specific needs. Combining ease of use with a pleasant experience,
these gums ensure a practical and effective delivery of cannabinoids, making them an excellent
option for personalized care.

## PRODUCTS

all_classified.polished_summary: SYNBIOTIC SE is a leading European corporate group specializing in the medical cannabis and industrial hemp sectors, encompassing the entire value chain from cultivation to retail. The company offers a diverse range of high-quality products, including medicinal cannabis for therapeutic applications, industrial hemp for sustainable manufacturing, and recreational cannabis for home cultivation. As a publicly listed entity, SYNBIOTIC SE provides investors with the opportunity to capitalize on the rapidly expanding markets of hemp and cannabis.

all_classified.company_summary: Tcsco2 specializes in the delivery of bulk carbon dioxide and related gas solutions tailored for various industries, including food and beverage, breweries, restaurants, and cannabis cultivation. Their core offerings include high-quality bulk CO2, dry ice, blended gas systems, and nitrogen systems, all designed to meet the specific needs of their customers with customizable delivery options and reliable service. If you’d like more information about Bulk CO2 for your business, or to email our knowledgeable sales
or support team please complete the form below. Before contacting us, please check our service
territories below the contact form. Thank you!

**Tri-State Carbonation Service**

Mailing Address: PO Box 333

Monticello, NY 12701-8388

#### Locations & Service Areas
* Connecticut

Serving all of Connecticut including Hartford, New Haven, Norwich & Stamford .
* Massachusetts

Tri-State Carbonation serves most of Massachusetts. We currently serve: Berkshire, Bristol, Essex,
Franklin, Hampden, Hampshire, Middlesex, Plymouth, Norfolk, Suffolk, & Worcester Counties.
* New Jersey

We currently serve the northern half of New Jersey including Bergen, Essex, Hudson, Hunterdon,
Mercer, Middlesex, Monmouth, Morris, Ocean, Passaic, Somerset, Sussex, Union & Warren Counties.
* New York

Tri-State Carbonation serves virtually all of New York State with the exception of west of
Rochester and the far northern tier (Lake Placid & Lake George).
* Pennsylvania

We serve northeastern Pennsylvania including Bradford, Carbon, Columbia, Lackawana, Lehigh,
Luzerne, Lycoming, Monroe, Northampton, Pike, Schuylkill, Sullivan, Susquehanna, Wayne & Wyoming
Counties.
* Vermont

Tri-State Carbonation serves Southern Vermont including Bennington, Rutland, & Windham Counties.
* New Hampshire

Serving Southern New Hampshire including Cheshire, Hillsborough & Rockingham counties.
* Rhode Island

Serving Bristol, Kent, Newport, Providence & Washington Counties.

# Switch to TCSCO2

#### *We’ll help you all the way!*

If it’s time to make the break from a large corporate conglomerate, who is based in another country,
and come back to a family owned, local business.

[Switch to a local, famil owned business - TCSCO2] [Switch to a local, famil owned business -
TCSCO2]

Let Tri-State Carbonation help. We’ve helped businesses just like yours to make the break. Even if
your contract hasn’t expired, you may be entitled to switch suppliers as a result of a huge
corporate sale or takeover. Now is the time to explore your options.

Why switch? Here’s a few reasons:
* Locally owned and operated.
* Better Rates
* Fair business practices
* Higher quality service
* Better account management. No call center in a different part of the country that knows nothing
about your account.
* No hidden fees on your bill. Examples – “Driver Resource Fee”, “Invoice processing fee”
* CO2 Cancellation Guidelines

#### CO2 Cancellation Guidelines
1. Request a copy of your contract from your current supplier. If you don’t know the email
address, we’ll be happy to help you locate it. Be sure to include your account number and/or
name in the subject line along with “termination”. Include your address in the body of the
email if you do not have your account number. The email should read:

***“I request a copy of my agreement within the next 5 business days or I will assume that there
is no valid agreement in place and will be exploring other options. This notice also serves as
termination for any agreement you can produce.”***

2. If they produce an agreement; review and determine where you stand in relation to the term. If
you are in an automatic renewal term, then you should review the legality of this in your state.

3. If they do not produce an agreement in the 5 business days, you can decide on how you would
like to proceed. They will probably threaten you and maybe even produce an agreement after the 5
days but at least you have record of your intentions had they not produced the agreement in a
timely manner.

Regardless of how things go, they may threaten you and/or send you an enormous termination bill.
Keep in mind that large corporations have entire departments that sole purpose is to intimidate
and scare small businesses into not changing vendors. Don’t be afraid to push back! You are a
influential partner in the local restaurant industry and will not be afraid to let others know
about their tactics. Please note that these are guidelines and do not constitute legal
advice. **Please consult your attorney for specific legal advice.**

# Privacy & Security Policies

Privacy Policy

We respect and are committed to protecting your privacy. We may collect personally identifiable
information when you visit our site. We also automatically receive and record information on our
server logs from your browser including your IP address, cookie information and the pages(s) you
visited. We will not sell your personally identifiable information to anyone.

Security Policy

Your payment and personal information is always safe. Our Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) software is the
industry standard and among the best software available today for secure commerce transactions. It
encrypts all of your personal information, including credit card number, name, and address, so that
it cannot be read over the internet.

Online Account Data Inquiries and Deletion Request

For inquiries about the data associated with your online customer account accessed via the Tri-State
Carbonation Service Customer Portal or Tri-State Carbonation Service App or to request for your
account to be deleted, you can Contact Us to submit a [request form][161].

For questions on our policies, please contact our office at 866-763-2427 or email us at

Interested in knowing more? Call us at 866-Soda-Gas, or check out our frequently asked questions
below.
* Carbon Dioxide (CO2)

### **Carbon Dioxide ****(CO2)**

**What is liquid bulk carbon dioxide?**

Liquid bulk carbon dioxide is a safer, low-pressure alternative to high-pressure compressed gas
cylinders. With the TCS system, liquid bulk carbon dioxide is stored on the premises at a lower
pressure in a stainless steel holding tank, and is automatically refilled on a regular schedule
based on your usage pattern. Our tanks are permanently installed at your location, so you don’t
need to worry about the hassle of changing cylinders. Our professional sales staff will help you
to determine the system that is right for you.

**What is different about beverage quality carbon dioxide and why is it important to my
customers?**

A cold fountain soft drink or draught beer beverage is usually your customer’s first and defining
experience upon entering your establishment. Without a continuous and reliable supply of quality
carbon dioxide, your customer’s experience is at risk. Carbon dioxide is a key ingredient in
carbonated beverages and helps to determine the taste, aroma and level of carbonation – not all
carbon dioxide is made equal.

TCS delivers bulk carbon dioxide that is certified to be CGA-2000 I Grade, or “beverage quality.”
TCS is focused solely on the quality and integrity of carbon dioxide for fountain soft drink and
draught beer beverages. The product we deliver to you has been put through rigorous testing before
we deem it to be suitable for beverages. Alternatively, some distributors provide the same carbon
dioxide that you use in your food service operation to other customers for use in metal
fabrication, cleaning and solvent extraction, the production of pulp and paper and other
applications.

**Will a liquid bulk carbon dioxide system be compatible with my fountain soft drink or draught
beer system if I currently use high-pressure cylinders?**

The liquid bulk carbon dioxide systems supplied by TCS are fully compatible with all fountain soft
drink and draught beer beverage dispensing systems.
* Nitrogen

### Nitrogen

**What is a nitrogen generator?**

Nitrogen generators separate nitrogen from the other components of air on site at your
establishment, eliminating the need for nitrogen cylinders.

**Why should I use a nitrogen generator?**

Producing nitrogen on site eliminates the need for high-pressure nitrogen cylinders. This reduces
the stocking and handling of cylinders that can lead to safety concerns and accidents as a result
of mishandling.

Producing nitrogen on site also reduces the chances of running out of nitrogen gas and
interrupting the pouring of beer. Should nitrogen gas run out, the proper gas blend can no longer
be produced and the beer could be ruined.

## WHO WE ARE

#### The Best Grow is Africa’s leading turnkey cannabis and industrial hemp solutions company, based
#### in South Africa, delivering end-to-end licensed facilities, processing infrastructure,
#### compliant machinery, and regulatory consulting

## OUR MISSION

**To empower Africa’s cannabis and hemp industry with innovative, reliable, and compliant
cultivation and processing solutions, while delivering personalized support and trusted partnerships
for long-term growth.**

## WHY LICENSED PRODUCERS TRUST US
* **Exclusive Distribution Rights – We represent leading global brands like STM Canna, Triminator,
CenturionPro, Dr Dabber, Current Culture H2O, Grotek, King Palm, and more.**
* **Industry Expertise – Over a decade of combined experience in cannabis cultivation, post-harvest
processing, and compliance standards.**
* **Local Support & Training – Technical guidance, product demonstrations, and after-sales support
tailored to African operators.**
* **Turnkey Solutions – From seed to sale, we provide equipment and strategies that integrate
seamlessly into licensed operations.**

## What We Offer

We deliver a carefully curated portfolio of professional-grade cannabis equipment and supplies,
including:
* **Pre-Roll Production Equipment** – STM Canna Mini-RocketBox Plus+, Valenveras testing devices.
* **Grinding & Milling Solutions** – STM Mini-Revolution Grinder for consistent, terpene-friendly
milling.
* **Trimming Solutions** – High-performance CenturionPro trimmers, built for speed, precision, and
gentle handling of cannabis flower, ensuring maximum yield and quality during post-harvest.
* **Extraction & Hash Processing** – Triminator Hash Maker Washing Machines and TRP Rosin Presses
for solventless live rosin production.
* **Hydroponics & Nutrients** – Grotek Impact Grow, Impact Bloom, and Monster Bloom enhancers.
* **Testing & Compliance Tools** – Valenveras potency testing solutions for on-site quality control.

## How We Help You Grow
* **Consultation & Needs Assessment** – We align with your facility’s scale, goals, and compliance
requirements.
* **Equipment Selection** – Recommend tailored solutions for cultivation, post-harvest, or retail.
* **Quote & Supply** – Transparent pricing, import logistics, and warranty-backed equipment.
* **Training & Support** – Our team

## WHO WE ARE

#### The Best Grow is Africa’s leading turnkey cannabis and industrial hemp solutions company, based
#### in South Africa, delivering end-to-end licensed facilities, processing infrastructure,
#### compliant machinery, and regulatory consulting

## OUR MISSION

**To empower Africa’s cannabis and hemp industry with innovative, reliable, and compliant
cultivation and processing solutions, while delivering personalized support and trusted partnerships
for long-term growth.**

## WHY LICENSED PRODUCERS TRUST US
* **Exclusive Distribution Rights – We represent leading global brands like STM Canna, Triminator,
CenturionPro, Dr Dabber, Current Culture H2O, Grotek, King Palm, and more.**
* **Industry Expertise – Over a decade of combined experience in cannabis cultivation, post-harvest
processing, and compliance standards.**
* **Local Support & Training – Technical guidance, product demonstrations, and after-sales support
tailored to African operators.**
* **Turnkey Solutions – From seed to sale, we provide equipment and strategies that integrate
seamlessly into licensed operations.**

## What We Offer

We deliver a carefully curated portfolio of professional-grade cannabis equipment and supplies,
including:
* **Pre-Roll Production Equipment** – STM Canna Mini-RocketBox Plus+, Valenveras testing devices.
* **Grinding & Milling Solutions** – STM Mini-Revolution Grinder for consistent, terpene-friendly
milling.
* **Trimming Solutions** – High-performance CenturionPro trimmers, built for speed, precision, and
gentle handling of cannabis flower, ensuring maximum yield and quality during post-harvest.
* **Extraction & Hash Processing** – Triminator Hash Maker Washing Machines and TRP Rosin Presses
for solventless live rosin production.
* **Hydroponics & Nutrients** – Grotek Impact Grow, Impact Bloom, and Monster Bloom enhancers.
* **Testing & Compliance Tools** – Valenveras potency testing solutions for on-site quality control.

## How We Help You Grow
* **Consultation & Needs Assessment** – We align with your facility’s scale, goals, and compliance
requirements.
* **Equipment Selection** – Recommend tailored solutions for cultivation, post-harvest, or retail.
* **Quote & Supply** – Transparent pricing, import logistics, and warranty-backed equipment.
* **Training & Support** – Our team provides onboarding, training, and after-sales care to ensure
long-term success.

## Our Commitment to Africa’s Cannabis Industry

As regulations evolve, The Best Grow is committed to supporting the African cannabis sector with
SAHPRA-compliant solutions, local expertise, and global partnerships. Our goal is to help licensed
operators remain competitive while building a sustainable, world-class cannabis market on the
continent.

## Ready to Take Your Facility to the Next Level?

Whether you’re scaling pre-roll production, building out extraction, or optimizing cultivation, The
Best Grow has the expertise and exclusive equipment to help you succeed.

## SOLVENTLESS COMMERCIAL ROSIN PRESSES

Engineered to offer simplicity in high-volume solventless extraction, the TRP and TRP Stack Rosin
Presses were built for production scalability. The Triminator presses are designed with a Power
Frame capable of withstanding up to 25 tons of force and food-grade aluminum platens, delivering the
highest-quality rosin. The Rosin TRP Stack provides drip technology allowing the rosin to quickly
drop to a cool surface with the seamless rotation of the platens. With 6 precision heating elements
and an ergonomic construction, pressing at a commercial scale has never been easier.

## TOP-TIER COMMERCIAL ROSIN PRESS

#### PRESERVE TERPENES

Ensure maximum retention of valuable terpenes and cannabinoids by pressing your rosin at higher
pressure and lower temperatures with the innovative design of the TRP and TRP Stack. The lower temps
ensure you are preserving the quality of your rosin while minimizing any degradation of your
cannabinoids.

#### FASTER, HIGHER YIELD RETURNS

Increase your rosin production with our industry-leading aluminum large-pressing platens. Boost
pressing efficiency with the 3-platen TRP Stack while extracting more product and increasing profits
from every harvest. Achieve commercial-scale production with craft cannabis quality.

#### PURE CONCENTRATE

The technology behind the Triminator Rosin Presses ensures you are producing the cleanest possible
extracts with no use of solvents or harsh chemicals. Using consistent pressure and low temperatures,
the versatile TRP and TRP Stack can press rosin from flower, trim, kief, or bubble hash.

### USED BY BEST SOLVENTLESS EMERALD CUP AWARD WINNER

## INDUSTRY-LEADING TECHNOLOGY

#### PATENTED EASY PIVOT™ DRIP TECH

Our patented Easy Pivot™ drip tech system allows rosin to fall immediately onto a cold surface
below. This results in faster collection, higher terpene retention, and better yields, ensuring
proper directional flow. The Easy Pivot™ drip tech is available exclusively on TRP Stack.

#### 25 TON BVA HYDRAULIC CYLINDER

Equipped with a powerful 25-ton BVA hydraulic cylinder, the TRP and TRP Stack produce unrivaled
pressure across the platens and ensure maximum yield at the lowest temperatures. This reliable
pressure translates into lower pressing temperatures and higher terpene content for higher quality
rosin.

#### INDIVIDUAL PID TEMPERATURE CONTROL

Clear, flavorful rosin requires precision to enable repeatability during the pressing process. To
ensure quality yields, the TRP and TRP Stack have individual platen controls, allowing you to manage
the temperature range and determine the exact rosin temperature on demand for precise, repeatable
results.

## MAXIMUM VERSATILITY WITH PUMP OPTIONS

The rosin presses offer several pump options to accommodate your facility and workflow. The hand
pump provides the greatest feedback loop for the operator, making it perfect for craft producers and
commercial operations that constantly experiment with multiple strains or combinations.

The Air Hydraulic foot pump is an excellent choice for production environments running multiple
presses since a single large compressor can operate an entire room of presses when sized correctly.

## INVEST WITH CONFIDENCE

All Triminator Rosin Presses are guaranteed for one full year and backed by the Triminator support
team for the life of the product.

The touchpoints on every press are food-grade, keeping your solventless rosin free from harmful
chemicals and contamination. The TRP and TRP Stack meet all Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP)
requirements, featuring easy-to-clean anodized surfaces.

Our patent-pending, no-shear impeller imitates the effects of hand washing creating an effective yet
gentle vortex for easy trichome separation.

**Phantom Dual 315W CMH w/4200K Philips Lamps, 120 – 240V**

The Phantom Dual CMh System is a highly versatile system that allows you to run a single 315W lamp
or both at the same time for 630W of high-PAR CMh light. The dual reflectors can be used in the
standard position or rotated 90 degrees downward to give a low-profile hanging configuration that is
ideal for tight spaces.

The Phantom Dual CMh High Voltage System is a highly versatile fixture that allows you to run
multiple ballast positions. The dual reflectors can be used in the standard position or rotated 90
degrees downward to give a low-profile hanging configuration that is ideal for tight spaces. The
reflectors feature premium multifaceted 95% reflective European hammertone aluminum, giving
excellent light uniformity and diffusion.

The attached Phantom Dual CMh High Voltage ballast features low frequency, square-wave technology
and is silent, reliable, and energy-efficient. It has a USB port for PX1 controller compatibility
and dimming options. Four angled reflector positions can also be set, if desired. Input voltage
options are 277-347V, 277V, and 347V. **Lamps sold separately.**
* Designed for intense, even coverage over an area of 0.91 meters x 1.52 meters, or 1.38 square
meters.
* Autopilot PX series controller compatible
* Dimming/boosting wattage control
* Proven Phantom reliability and performance
* Flexible hanging options

## Product Details

**PHANTOM Cultivar GL250 LED** is designed for those who take their cultivation seriously,
regardless of what they grow. The compact, elegant yet robust fixture can be used for many different
applications. Offering 2.6 μMol/J efficacy, the GL250 incorporates a premium aluminum unibody
heatsink for longer diode life and less output degradation over time. The integrated
Master-Apprentice Dimmer knob (MAD) and Two-Step Spectrum switch (TSS) puts the grower in control
without the need for additional gear. The mission has always been the same since 1977: Cultivate
Higher.

**Nimble and Capable:**
The physical dimension of the fixture is only around 1 x 1.5 ft with a 2.3-inch profile and 11 lbs.
in weight.

Premium components offer performance and reliability. True IP65-rated fixture against dust and
humidity.

**Master-Apprentice Dimmer knob (MAD):
**It’s more than just an on-board dimming knob. The MAD dimmer lets you take control of up to four
GL250 fixtures when daisy-chained in an array using the included RJ12 cords. In addition, you can
always connect with an 0-10v external controller of your choice.

**Two-Step Spectrum switch (TSS):**
Use the IP65-rated TSS to switch between VEG/FLOWER mode. The FLOWER mode offers the classic S4
spectrum, providing a full spectrum with supplemented red LEDs at 660nm. The VEG mode will reduce
the red spectral output for vegetative plant development needs.

**Get more from PHANTOM Cultivar:**
Start growing your own immediately. We included a pair of ratcheting hangers in the box. We also
have PHANTOM Cultivar GT Grow Tents

**Features:**
* 250W Rated Input Power
* 641 µmol/s Photon Flux (PBAR 280-800 nm)
* 625 µmol/s Photon Flux (PAR 400-700 nm)
* 2.56 µmol/J Efficacy
* DLC Hort QPL Listed eligible for utility rebates
* Standard U.S. 120Vac Input Voltage
* Includes standard RJ12 control cable
* Control 4 GL250’s together with MAD dimmer function
* Dimming ability of 40-100% output
* Spectrum switch between Veg & Flower
* True IP65-rated

## Product Details

The Phantom PHOTOBIO Advanced Quantum PAR Meter provides accurate and cost-effective measurement for
any light source used in horticultural applications. The Advanced Quantum PAR meter is designed to
measure PAR (Photosynthetically Active Radiation) flux in wavelengths ranging from 400 to 700nm.
There is a positive proportional relationship between the number of photons absorbed in 400 to 700nm
band and the rate of photosynthesis, important for maximizing crop yield.

Complete with compact main unit, remote sensor, two connection cables (short-coiled & 12’
long-straight), AAA batteries and protective carrying case. Convenience of storing up to 99
measurements for easy reference while adjusting light fixture height, dimmer setting and other
environmental changes throughout each phase of growth.

Phantom has a long-standing track record of providing reliable, high-performance products within the
horticultrual equipment industry.
* Compact, portable meter with highly accurate remote quantum sensor
* Simple and easy to use operation, with storage of up to 99 readings
* Ideal for grow tent, greenhouse and commercial grow applications
* Compatible with modern sole-source and supplemental LED fixtures, high pressure sodium (HPS) DE
grow lights, as well as any traditional indoor grow light source

From NOBEL COMMERCIAL, one of the Top Horticultural Lights used for commercial operations. Ideal for
large scale indoor cultivation, or greenhouse.

There are many advantages of choosing the **Nobel Commercial A800e LED lights**, over other
alternatives:

**Safety and Electrical Design:** The A800e LED lights use an insulated circuit design, which will
give an output between 30-56V which is safe for people and animal’s direct touch. Therefore no
safety risk of shock.

**Efficiency and Performance:** The A800e LED lights offer higher energy efficiency compared to
other cheaper alternatives. These lights are specifically designed with advanced LED diodes and
drivers to deliver superior efficiency and optimal performance for plant growth.

**Product Design and Purpose:** The A800e LED lights are designed as finished products, specifically
catering to the needs of commercial growers. They undergo thorough research and development to
ensure they meet the requirements of professional cultivation. This is very important when compering
alternatives, to make sure you don’t choose a hobbyist light for your commercial operations. Lights
that have not been tested for this, could indicate that they might not be fully optimized or
tailored for the needs of commercial growers.

**Extended Lifespan:** The A800e LED lights are designed with ballasts that have a theoretical
lifespan (factory declared) of 100,000 hours, which is significantly longer than other alternatives.
Furthermore, the LED diodes themselves have a theoretical lifespan of 50,000 hours. The A800e lights
have the potential to last 5-10 times longer than other cheaper alternatives.

**High Output and Efficiency**: The A800e LED lights offer a high output of more than 2000 µmol, as
demonstrated by real test reports. Normally this output surpasses those of alternative lights,
indicating that the A800e lights provide a higher photosynthetic photon flux density (PPFD) for
improved plant growth and productivity. Additionally, the A800e lights are designed to be
energy-efficient, boasting a 99% power factor and low voltage human safety driver. This ensures
optimal energy utilization and reduces power wastage.

## Cold Screw Oil Extraction Press

[Request Quote][38]
Categories: [Industrial Hemp][39], [Seed Press][40] Tags: [extraction][41], [hemp seed oil
extraction][42], [hemp seed press][43], [oil extraction][44], [seed oil][45], [seed oil
extraction][46], [seed press][47]

The M70.2 Precision Cold Screw Oil Extraction Press will extract 85% to 95% of the available oil
within the plant material and while kept under “cold press” requirement of 138F (59C). The oil
temperature coming out of the press is normally 90F to 120F (32C to 49C). The oil content of the
press meal can be as low as 5%, but is normally 7% to 9%, which for livestock protein feed is a
perfect energy to protein ratio. The M70.2 does not require preheating of the commodity going into
the press.

The M70.2 will crush out 1,000 to 1,500lbs (454Kg to 680Kg) over a 24 hour period which is 42 to 62
lbs per hour (19Kg to 28Kg per hour). Vastly speaking for all oil seed commodities having an oil
content of 38% to 44% oil, our clients report that they get 800lbs to 1200lbs of press meal (363Kg
to 544Kg) and 50 to 70 gallons (189 to 265 Liters) of oil over a 24hr period. That’s 33 to 50lbs
(15Kg to 23Kg) per hour of press meal and 2 to 3 gallons (7.5 to 11.3 Liters) per hour of oil. Nuts,
being of greater oil content will produce more oil and less press meal.

**Electrical.** The M70.2 OilPress is powered by 200V to 260V, single phase OR three phase, 50Hz or
60Hz. The M70.2 draws only 3 to 6 amps while running! Over a 24hr period, while crushing soybeans,
one of the more difficult commodities to crush, the M70.2 consumed only 21.3KwH. We have customers
who power their press with solar power.

**The M70.2 is the most efficient oil press on the market!**

**Specifications**. The M70.2 OilPress overall measures 38”/96.5cm long x 11”/28cm wide x 12”/30.5cm
height and weighs 190lbs/86Kg. The M70.2 OilPress ships in a crate that measures 36”/91cm x 22”/56cm
x 22”/56cm and weighs 250lbs/113Kg. We can also send the M70.2 broke down into 5 boxes that each
weigh less than 70lbs/32Kg. We have assembly videos that show how to assemble the press.

**Maintenance**. The press requires a gearbox and bearing housing oil change at about six months of
running 24×7 or 3,500 to 4,000 hours of operation. The oil is a synthetic gear oil 75W-110 that has
“EP” (extreme pressure) property. Only a few tools are needed to operate the M70.2 OilPress.

**Wear Parts**. The screw is the main wear part. The screw will last one to one and a half years
with the press running all day every day. The crush barrel will outlast 2 to 3 screws. It is not
necessary to purchase replacement parts with the press. We inventory the wear parts so delivery is
very fast.

**The M70.2 is the highest quality precision cold screw oil extraction press on the market and
includes a FIVE YEAR WARRANTY against any part breakage!**

## HurdMaster MD1000 Micro Decorticator

[Request Quote][38]
Category: [Industrial Hemp][39] Tags: [decorticator][40], [fiber][41], [fibre][42], [hempcrete][43],
[hemplime][44], [hurdmaster][45], [processing][46], [shredder][47], [stalks][48]

The HurdMaster is intended for small farming and processing operations and for CBD and marijuana
producers who want to capitalize on leftover stems. The machine is designed for separating the
cannabis stalk’s woody inner core (hurd, shivs, shives) from the exterior bast fibers. The resulting
hurd can be used for hempcrete construction, as animal bedding and animal litter, or as plant
bedding. With additional technology, the separated bast fibers can be further processed for a wide,
wide variety of applications.

Operation
* Manual input/output requires 2 workers
* Designed for long hemp stalks
* Max size for stalk up to 2.5 cm in diameter
* Produces shivs 5 – 30mm long
* Output up to 50kg per hour

Applications

• Hempcrete construction
• Natural fiber insulation
• Animal bedding & litter
• Plant bedding

Technical specifications
* Power supply: 220V / 1500W
* Capacity: ~50kg/hr
* Dimensions: 80cm x 200cm x 125 cm
* Weight: 260kg

## PRODUCTS

Our focus is to bring to Southern Africa the latest technical solutions for the hemp & cannabis
industry.

Technology that is tried and tested within the industry, and which will increase the efficiency of
your operations greatly.

We also supply to producers and growshops at wholesale price consumables that are needed in the day
to day operations.

Growshops or distributors can sign up online and create their own accounts for direct access to all
our products, and wholesale prices.

## SERVICES

We have partnered with Cannapro, internationally renowned for the design and construction of premium
indoor cannabis facilities & light dep greenhouses for growing high yielding healthy cannabis crops.

Customers have quickly come to learn we offer the best solutions, or nothing at all.

The CannaPro Group offers your cannabis growing team decades of professional horticultural
experience.

We have assembled a team of all-stars you could say, who bring you tried and true cultivation
methods.

Through them, we can assist with custom design and building of GMP certified rooms and commercial
greenhouses.

**If you have a cultivation license, and need help with your project planning, designing and
development, contact us now.**

## ROOT POUCH

[Request Quote][38]
SKU: N/A Category: [Pots][39] Tags: [pot][40], [pots][41], [pouch][42]

Root Pouch are geotextile pots made from recovered natural fibers and recycled plastic bottles.

They are a sustainable and ecological alternative in relation to other geotextile pots manufactured
with materials derived from oil to other plastic pots.

In addition Root Pouch are degradable to the 4-5 years buried along with the plant they contain.

These pots are fantastic for any type of plant, they are light and flexible, which makes it easy to
transport and send them without taking up much space and with much less weight than with plastic
pots.

The material used in manufacturing is breathable, allowing the roots to obtain an extra amount of
oxygen.

This oxygen supply stimulates the formation of new roots and secondary roots throughout the pot. The
cycle of “pruning” and “growth of new roots continues, creating abundant and healthy roots in the
culture medium.

Main features:

Healthier and stronger plants.

Absence of spiraling

They require less amount of substrate

Low risk of post-transparent shock

General improvement of the root structure.

A Global Cannabis Company

Cronos is a global cannabis company focused on scaling leading consumer goods products through R&D and innovation. With a passion to responsibly elevate the consumer experience, Cronos is building an iconic brand portfolio. Cronos’ diverse international brand portfolio includes Spinach ® , PEACE NATURALS ® , LIT™ and Lord Jones ® .

About

Mission

Build brands and create products that enhance experiences

Vision

Take experiences to new highs

Values

At the heart of Cronos are our values. They are the principles that steer our actions and define our character. They represent who we are, how we operate, and the reputation we aspire to build and maintain within the industry and all our stakeholders who help shape it.

Community

We believe in building and supporting a fair and equitable industry.

Fun

We believe in creating your favorite products through innovation and imagination.

Responsibility

We believe our products are for adults* (*Adults are those of the legal age of consumption in the relevant jurisdiction).

Quality

We believe in elevating industry practices to provide quality products focused on reliability and transparency.

The

Team

Our management team comprises experts in their fields, with a goal to establish the most valuable international cannabis company. They are passionate, daring people, driven by quality and integrity, who are determined to write history, not read about it.

Mike Gorenstein

Anna Shlimak

Mike Gorenstein

Mike Gorenstein

Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer
Mike Gorenstein serves as Cronos Group’s Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer. In addition, Mr. Gorenstein is a Co-Founder and passive Member of Gotham Green Partners. Before joining Cronos, Mike was the Vice President and General Counsel at Alphabet Partners, LP, a New York City based multi-strategy investment management firm, focused on identifying mispriced assets across various industries, asset classes and geographies. Prior to Alphabet Partners, LP, he was a corporate attorney at Sullivan & Cromwell LLP, where he focused on mergers and acquisitions and capital markets transactions. Mike graduated from the University of Pennsylvania Law School with a Juris Doctor, the Wharton School at University of Pennsylvania with a certificate in Business Economics and Public Policy and the Kelley School of Business at Indiana University with a Bachelor of Science of Business in Finance.

Anna Shlimak

Anna Shlimak
Chief Financial Officer
Anna serves as Cronos’ Chief Financial Officer. Anna recently served as the Company’s Chief Strategy Officer and was responsible for managing and directing the organization’s corporate strategy, investor relations, communications, government affairs, and information systems departments. Prior to joining Cronos, Anna was the Head of Investor Relations at Quest Partners LLC, a research-driven alternative investment firm. Anna was responsible for business development, investor reporting, marketing, and communication initiatives for the fund. Before that, Anna held a range of roles at the New York Stock Exchange in both the New York and London offices. She received a Master of Business Administration from Columbia Business School and holds a Bachelor of Science in Economics from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania.

Jeff Jacobson

Jeff Jacobson
Chief Growth Officer
As Chief Growth Officer, Jeff leads the Marketing, Innovation, Operations and Sales team in North America as well as the Consumer Insights and Data Analytics teams for Cronos Group’s global business. Jeff sets the strategy for our brands and is responsible for leading our global teams to help execute Cronos Group’s vision. Jeff previously served as Cronos Group’s General Manager of Canada and Europe. Before joining Cronos Group, Jeff founded a Toronto based marketing agency and successfully launched and licensed several innovative software products in the mobile industry. As a co-founder of Peace Naturals, Jeff’s expertise and experience in licensing and compliance, new business development, project management and resource management help Cronos Group lead in a variety of markets.

Shannon Buggy

Shannon Buggy
Senior Vice President, Global Head of People
Shannon serves as the SVP, Global Head of People for Cronos Group where she leads HR strategy across the Company’s global operations. Prior to Cronos Group, Shannon was the Senior Vice President of Global Human Resources for Nielsen where she led HR strategy for Nielsen Media. With over 30 years of experience, Shannon has a proven track record of leading and managing global human resources teams and driving excellence in talent acquisition, development, retention, employee relations, compensation, benefits, talent management and labor relations. Shannon holds a certification as a Senior Professional in Human Resources from the HR Certification Institute. She graduated magna cum laude with a Bachelor of Science degree in Human Resources Management from the Pace University, Lubin School of Business.

Terry Doucet
General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
Terry Doucet serves as Cronos Group’s General Counsel and Corporate Secretary. In this capacity, he manages all legal and regulatory affairs at Cronos Group and also serves as the Company’s Corporate Secretary. Prior to joining Cronos, Terry was a corporate lawyer at Davies Ward Phillips & Vineberg LLP in Toronto, where he focused primarily on M&A in large, complex and cross-border transactions across numerous industries, as well as securities, corporate finance and lending transactions. During that time, Terry was also seconded to RBC Capital Markets, where he supported the bank’s derivative trading desks. Terry is an Ontario-qualified lawyer, holding a Juris Doctor from the University of Toronto and a joint honours (first class) Bachelor of Arts degree from McGill University in Montreal.

Arye Weigensberg

Arye Weigensberg
Head of Research and Development
As Head of Research and Development, Arye is responsible for leading Cronos’ innovation program, where he oversees research and technology functions, and leads scientific efforts to unlock the potential of rare cannabinoids. Before joining Cronos, Arye was the CEO of Altria Israel Ltd, an Altria research and development innovation hub. Arye joined Altria as part of its acquisition of Green Smoke, where he was the Director of Marketing and Brand Management. Prior to Green Smoke, Arye held a variety of roles in brand management and marketing, supporting food brands such as Manischewitz, Lawry’s, Ragu, Knorr and Country Crock. Arye graduated from Concordia University’s John Molson School of Business with a Bachelor of Commerce in Marketing and International Business.

Adam Wagner

Adam Wagner
General Manager, Cronos Israel
Adam Wagner serves as Senior Vice President, Head of Cronos Israel. Adam oversees the business and strategy of Cronos Israel. Before he was appointed as Head of Cronos Israel, he was the VP of Finance at Cronos Israel where he oversaw the regional Israel finance department, including FP&A, controllership, audit, treasury, tax, as well as IT, supply chain and procurement . Before joining Cronos, Adam worked as a Director of Finance at Motus GI, a publicly traded medical device company, where he oversaw the Israel-based finance department. Before that, Adam was a Finance Manager at Medtronic, a publicly traded medical equipment manufacturer, where he oversaw the Israel-based finance department functions. Prior to Medtronic’s acquisition, he was the Corporate Controller for Mazor Robotics, a dual-listed public medical device company. Adam began his career as a Senior Auditor at EY where he managed a team that performed audits for various publicly traded and private companies. Adam also serves as a Finance expert on an advisory board for a wellness and healthcare start-up. Adam is a CPA (Israel) and studied Accounting at Bar-Ilan University. Adam also holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Science of Nutrition and his Master of Science in Genetics and Biochemistry from Tel Aviv University.

[ What are the delivery charges for orders from The Seed Fair? ][41]

If you have made an order over $99, you will receive Free Shipping. If you are under $99, USA
orders are $10, and Canadian orders are $10

[ Which payment methods are accepted on our website? ][42]

We accept Major Credit Cards, Paypal, Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, E Transfer, and as well Cash. Please
check out all options at checkout and see what payment options give you free seeds on your order!

[ How long will delivery take? ][43]

Delivery is estimated between 2 to 10 days depending on your location. We do provide tracking on
orders.

[ How do you secure my transaction? ][44]

We go the distance with your browsing and purchase being secured by HTTPS with 2048 bit encryption.
We delete all of the transactions on our site daily, and keep no records of browsing or
transactions.

[ What exactly happens after ordering? ][45]

Once you order you will receive a confirmation email to confirm your order. Then you will receive
an email to confirm when your order will be shipped. All orders are shipped within 24 hours.
Please note that if you do not see your email, check junk email or spam in case our email has gone
there. Thanks!

## Freakshow Seed (cannabis lusus monstra)

The 2019 release of the Freakshow seed, created by growers/breeders Shapeshifter, is a novel and
forward-thinking innovation. Humboldt Seed Company refers to it as Cannabis Lusus Monstra (after the
son of the Roman god of wine and divine madness Bacchus).

Freakshow is a Bx4 variety with wholly novel fern-like leaf forms. The California breeder
“Shapeshifter” made it a personal challenge to select plants with deformities as his objective.
“Normal becomes quite monotonous after 40 years,” he explains.

There are no specific or unusual cultivation techniques for Freakshow. However, it may be more
difficult to distinguish male and female plants than with other cannabis strains.

Freakshow is a high-yielding, 90% Sativa cultivar. Indoor flowering lasts approximately 65 days.
Outdoor harvesting in the northern hemisphere is possible between October 5 and 15 when you can
preserve cannabis oddities.

## Feminized OG Kush Seeds

Our OG Kush seeds originated from the West Coast of the US. Once thought to be originally from
Florida in the early 90’s, more recently found that it all started in California. Hence the name
OG, this powerhouse cannabis seed packs a heavy punch with a THC level of 27%. This is the highest
THC content that we carry among our marijuana seed collection. OG Kush Strain is almost a full
balanced Sativa strain. This weighs in at 55% Sativa and 45% Indica. There are some speculation
that the name “OG” comes from “Original Coast”, but due to the high THC content “OG” is definitely
coming from the original name “Original Gangster”.

OG Kush is a mix of Chem Dawg, and some original Kush. The taste of this famous strain is earthy,
pine, woody, and some lemon tinges. According to High Times, OG Kush Strain is the winner of “Best
Strain of All Time” in the entire world. We managed to get the exact strain for OG Kush so that all
our customers can enjoy this award winner.

## Effects of OG Kush Seeds

Our OG Kush seeds produce beautiful neon green buds covered in heavy trichomes that deliver a sweet
and potent smoke. This strain is loved by many for its full-body and mindful high that can help
reduce stress and promote relaxation. The uplifting effects of OG Kush can also inspire creativity
and boost mood, making it a great choice for those looking to unwind and get inspired.

In addition to its mental benefits, OG Kush is also reported to have physical benefits such as
reducing nausea and alleviating pain. These effects can make it an excellent option for individuals
undergoing cancer treatments or those who suffer from chronic pain.

OG Kush is also an easy-growing strain that’s perfect for beginners or those who prefer
low-maintenance grows. With a high yield and a relatively short flowering time, this strain is a
great choice for those looking for a bountiful harvest in a short amount of time.

Overall, OG Kush is a well-rounded strain that delivers a sweet and potent smoke and provides
numerous physical and mental benefits. Add it to your collection and experience its many benefits
for yourself!

## How does OG Kush Grow?

The Seed Fair’s OG Kush is great for all levels of growers. Even though more experienced growers
are recommended for this strain, we have seen many new growing clients pull off some decent size
yields from this gem. OG Kush Strain is known at the beginning to stretch as a plant, but soon
fills out as the time goes on. The buds are heavily settled on this plant with large lime green
dense buds. If you are looking to top early in the vegetative stage, this will force the plants to
produce multiple main stems and more flowering areas. Flowering time is approximately 8 to 9
weeks. In addition, Indoor yields can be seen at 500 grams per plant while outdoor yields are 600
grams per plant.

Harvesting should finish by early October, as well note that the plant likes to thrive in a very
large pot or planter box. The OG Kush Strain will also need a warmer climate when growing
outdoors. Be very watchful of your grow, as these plants are more susceptible to mold, disease,
pests, and mildew. Many have recommended to keep the humidity down with a humidifier. A little
more attention of course is needed for OG Kush, however once cultivated you will be left a
powerhouse strain you will not forget.

## Bear Dance Seeds

When you’re a bear, you’ve got to dance. And when you’ve got Bear Dance Autoflowering Feminized
Marijuana Seeds, you can dance all night long! The strain comes with an aroma that is like a

The flavors of Bear Dance Autoflowering Feminized Marijuana Seeds are varied and complex, with an
herbal base that can be described as lemon-like or piney. The Bear Dance is a marijuana strain that
will leave you feeling like you’re dancing with the bears. But don’t worry, we mean that in the best
way possible!

We know you’re tired of the same old, same old weed experience. You want something new and exciting.
You want to break out of your shell, but you also need to be able to rely on a strain that won’t
leave you feeling like a shell of your former self. That’s where the Bear Dance strain comes in.
This hybrid is 70% [Sativa][64] and 30% Indica—just the right mix to get you high without blowing
your mind or making you feel like the world is coming down around your ears.

And if that wasn’t enough, the Bear Dance strain packs an impressive 33% [THC][65] punch, so it’ll
leave you feeling well-satisfied after a few hits. It’s an excellent strain for daytime use because
it gives you a lot of energy and focus.

## Effects Of Bear Dance Autoflowering Feminized Marijuana Seeds

Bear Dance is a strain that provides you with a creative, focused, and happy high. The high sets in
quickly, peaks within an hour or two, and then calms down to a low-key buzz that lasts for hours.

It is best used during the day because it can help you stay focused and relax and enjoy yourself.
You will feel energized but not jittery, making Bear Dance cannabis seeds a great strain for
creative work or activities requiring focus.

Bear Dance strain has been known to help people with anxiety disorders such as generalized anxiety
disorder (GAD), panic disorder, and depression by reducing symptoms of these conditions such as
stress and worry.

## How Does Bear Dance Autoflowering Feminized Marijuana Seeds Grow

Bear Dance strain is a tall plant that can grow up to 6 feet high. This is an intermediate plant,
which means it’s not too difficult to grow and not too easy either. It will require some maintenance
and probably some experience, but it will not be a full-time job.

Bear Dance Autoflowering Marijuana Seeds are easy to care for but must be watered properly. The key
is to provide just enough water but not too much. Too little water will result in stunted growth and
poor yields. The best way to determine how much water your plants need is by applying the “finger
test.” Bear Dance Autoflowering Marijuana Seeds thrive best in a soil-based growing medium with good
drainage, aeration, and moderate fertility levels.

Humidity is also important; if it’s too low in your grow room, your plants will suffer from stress
and may struggle to produce buds. They might get moldy or have problems with pests like spider mites
if it’s too high. A good rule of thumb is that if you have an oscillating fan running 24 hours a day
in the room where your plants are growing, the humidity level should be between 40% and 60%.

Temperature is also crucial. You want it warm enough that your plants grow well but not hot enough
to burn up their leaves or buds prematurely. Most auto-flowering strains can handle temperatures
between 70°F/21°C and 85°F/29°C without any issues (try avoiding going above 85°F/29°C if possible).

The leaves of this plant are a sativa-indica hybrid, with Indica dominant characteristics. The
leaves are dark green and have a rough texture due to many trichomes. The leaves have some orange
hairs, but they tend to be sparse throughout the plant. The trichomes on this plant are vast and
thick; they appear as if they are almost ready to burst from their stalks on the buds. They are also
very dense on the buds, giving them a frosty appearance.

Its flowers have a slightly different appearance than its leaf; however, they still contain large
amounts of trichomes and orange hairs. The flowers will also become orange as they mature and ripen
for harvest.

The flowering time for these plants is between 65-75 days. They will be ready for harvest by the end
of October when grown outdoors or by late October when grown indoors. The large colas produced by
these seeds will be covered in trichomes, giving them a sticky appearance when fully mature.

Are you looking for an autoflowering strain that can yield up to 500g/m² indoors and produce up to
800gr outdoors? In that case, Bear Dance Feminized Seeds are a perfect choice. These cannabis seeds
are the result of meticulous breeding techniques, which resulted in a plant that can grow in any
climate and produces large amounts of buds.

## History Of Bear Dance Autoflowering Feminized Marijuana Seeds

Bear Dance Autoflowering Feminized Marijuana Seeds result from a cross between Purple Kush and
Uzbeki Hashplant. This strain is a genetic blend that’s never been seen before and has quickly
become one of our favorites!

This strain was bred by DNA Crew, a well-known breeder specializing in creating some unique strains
on the market today. Bear Dance strain has been awarded many times, including the Cannabis Cup in
2010 and 2011.
