## Gary Payton Seeds

Named after the legendary NBA Hall of Famer, Gary Payton, this rare-to-find hybrid strain is one to
look for. Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds is famous for its fast hard hitting effects that last
long and boosts your body with uplifting energy.

This is an evenly balanced hybrid strain with 50% Indica and 50% Sativa. It’s an excellent choice
for cannabis enthusiasts looking for a balance of both worlds. You get to enjoy the cerebral
uplifting and motivating high of the Sativa and the calming effects of the Indica.

It’s a cross of the Y and Snowman strains. The result is a strain with an average of 25% THC level
and little to almost no CBD. As such, both beginners and experienced tokers may enjoy a puff of the
Gary Payton. If you’re starting up, consider starting with a low quantity and increase it with time.

It has a sweet and spicy flavor with a hint of herbal taste during exhale. The smell is earthy and
diesel-like with a touch of herbal aroma. The most preferred time to use this strain is during the
daytime. It gives you the energy, motivation, focus and concentration to help you complete your
tasks.

Just like many strains, using this variety might leave you with a dry mouth and feeling thirsty.
This can be solved by drinking water and you’ll be good to go. You can enjoy your cannabis
stress-free.

The fact that the Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds are feminized has its advantages. It saves
you the trouble of sexing your crops manually. If you plant regular seeds, you’ll have to go through
the process of separating the male ones from their female counterparts. Otherwise, fertilization may
happen, affecting the quality of your buds. Using feminized seeds helps you avoid this process.

The buds from feminized marijuana crops are also rich in cannabinoids. Although male plants also
produce useful buds, the quality may not be as good as what you get from their female counterparts.

## Effects of Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds

A puff from this strain will help you carry on with your day with a boost of energy and focus. It
has also been found to have creative effects that help you to get ideas on the tasks you’re

Due to its high THC level, this strain helps mitigate headaches or migraines leaving you calm and
relaxed. It also relieves chronic stress, anxiety, and depression. People with [Attention Deficit
Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)][63] or Attention deficit Disorder (ADD) disorders might find this
strain helpful.

If you just want to spend the night catching up with friends then this is the perfect match for you.
It makes you talkative and sociable. It gives extreme excitement and leaves you giggly.

Why be sad when you can just be happy? This strain will make you dismiss all your worries and give
you peace of mind. Just forget your troubles and rock high with a blast of Gary Payton cannabis.

More doesn’t always mean better. You don’t need to take a lot of this strain to feel the effect. A
puff hits hard and fast with a long-lasting feeling of high energy and a boost of happiness. You are
sure of relaxation whether during the day or at night.

## How Do Gary Payton Seeds Grow

Growing Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds is a walk in the park for all experience levels. Both
beginners and experienced farmers will have no challenge in growing this plant. As long as you take
care of the plant, you’re sure to get a good amount of harvest.

Consider planting your own seeds to get high-quality nuggets. Start by germinating them using paper
towels before transferring them to the garden. This process is affordable as you make use of readily
available materials such as paper towels, tweezers, and plates. Use the following steps to sprout
your seeds before planting them.
1. Ensure you have all the materials you need ready, including your seeds, paper towels, plates,
tweezers, and clean water.
2. Wet two paper towels and remove any excess moisture. Place one of the pieces on a plate.
3. Take your seeds and place them on the towel. You may use tweezers for the process and ensure
there’s a distance of about an inch between the seeds.
4. Take another paper towel and use it to cover the Gary Payton Feminized Seeds.
5. Ensure there isn’t any excess water left on the plate because it may cause your seeds to rot. If
there’s any left, use a cloth to dry it out.
6. Place the plate carrying your Gary Payton seeds in a dark and cool location.
7. Ensure the seeds remain moist for the first 2-3 days and keep a close eye on them to make sure
everything is going on well.
8. When your seeds have produced a tap root around an inch long, They’re ready for planting. Uncover
them and use tweezers to remove them from the plate into your growing medium. Ensure the root is
the first to get into the medium.

Gary Payton Feminized Cannabis Seeds do well in both hydro and soil media.

This strain can be grown both indoors and outdoors. In tight spaces, you’ll have to be careful since
this plant can grow up to 6 feet in height. The flowering time takes about 7 – 9 weeks indoors. The
best time to harvest the cannabis plant outside is around October.

For the best results, warm temperatures and above-average humidity are the ideal conditions for
growing this strain. Keeps the temperatures warm since the plant is susceptible to moisture damage
and fungal growth in an indoor controlled environment

You can get an indoor yield of about 500 – 600g per square meter. Outdoors, you can get up to 900g
per plant especially if the plants are exposed to more hours of sunlight.

The marijuana plant has little grape-shaped minty green nugs. The nugs have shining orange pistils
and a covering of frosty white crystal trichomes. The dominant terpenes profile in the plant is
caryophyllene. It’s followed by limonene and linalool.

When watering the plant, make sure you water it with the right amount. This is because excess
moisture can damage the roots of the plant.

As mentioned earlier, the Gary Payton Feminized Seeds are easy to grow. However, consider checking
out for various issues, especially when growing your plants indoors. Some of the problems that might
affect the overall growth and bud quality of your cannabis include spider mites and powdery mildew.

## Effects of the Gelato Glue strain

The effects of this strain are well-balanced. You will experience both the indica and sativa
effects, which are perfect for those who want to enjoy the best of both worlds. The hybrid nature of
this strain makes it perfect for socializing and creative activities. The high THC level of this
strain means you can expect to feel its effects almost immediately. The effects start with a
cerebral high that boosts your mood and leaves you feeling euphoric. This is followed by a body high
that relaxes your muscles and relieves any tension or stress you may be feeling. This strain’s

Gelato Glue feminized seeds are an amazing option for people looking for medical benefits. This type

## How do Gelato Glue feminized seeds grow?

Cannabis cultivation is not as complex as many people think because there are strains that will not
challenge you, even if it’s your first time growing. A strain like Gelato Glue feminized is one of
those kinds, and it is perfect for growers with little to no experience. All you need is to provide
basic requirements like water, light, and air, and the strain will take care of the rest. This also
applies to the growing area. You can grow it indoors, outdoors, or in a greenhouse. You must only
remember to give the plant the right amount of water and light. If you are growing it indoors, then
using artificial lighting is fine. But if you are growing it outdoors, ensure the climate is not too
harsh.

Being easy to grow, this strain is perfect for novice growers. However, it is still important to
understand the optimal growing conditions for the plant. The ideal temperature for Gelato Glue seeds
is between 68 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit. The humidity level should be around 40 to 50 percent. When
it comes to watering, you should water the plant when the topsoil is dry. As for nutrition, you can
use a balanced fertilizer during the vegetative stage. But it is best to use a phosphorus-rich
fertilizer during the flowering stage.

These seeds can be grown in almost any soil type. But it is important to ensure the soil is well
aerated and has good drainage. The size of the pot will depend on the size of the plant. But a
5-gallon pot is enough for a single plant. As for training techniques, you can use the Screen of
Green (SCROG) method. This will help you maximize yields. These seeds are short and bushy plants. It
usually grows to a height of between 2 and 3 feet. The leaves of the plant are dark green. They are
also wide and serrated. The flowers are dense and sticky. They are usually white or light green. The
pistils are also white or light green. And the resin coat is very thick.

All of the Gelato Glue fem seeds are female. This means there is no chance of males for pollination.
You only need to worry about providing the plant with the right environment and nutrients. The seeds
produce photoperiod plants. This means it flowers when the days get shorter. But you can also force
the plant to flower by switching to the 12/12 light cycle.

The flowering period is between 55 and 65 days. This is considered to be moderately quick. Their
yield is quite good. Indoors, you can expect to get 500g/m². And outdoors, you can get up to 700
gr/plant.

Canuk Seeds is credited with the creation of Gelato Glue seeds, a remarkable hybrid born from the
marriage of two esteemed cannabis varieties: GG#4 and [Gelato][61]. GG#4, renowned for its potency
and resin production, is a cross between Chocolate Diesel and [Sour Dubb][62]. On the other hand,
Gelato, a beloved hybrid derived from Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Cookies, contributes its
delightful flavors and uplifting effects to the genetic blend. With Gelato Glue, Canuk Seeds has
crafted a strain that combines the best traits of its parent strains, captivating the cannabis
community with its exceptional qualities and enticing aroma.

earthy scent with subtle hints of vanilla. These smells will be more intense in a room where Yoda OG
Feminized Marijuana Seeds are grown. You will notice an increase in these smells when the buds are

orange, and vanilla. This makes for a very smooth and tasty smoke that is sure to please. Why will
you not love a strain with excellent aroma and taste?

This is an Indica dominant hybrid with a ratio of 85% [Indica][59] to 15% Sativa. The effects will

genetics will provide some cerebral stimulation that can help with creativity and focus. Because of
the Indica-dominant nature of Yoda OG, it is best to enjoy this strain in the evening or on weekends
when you have time to relax. The couch-locking effects can make it challenging to get things done if

## Effects Of Yoda OG Feminized Marijuana Seeds

Because this is an Indica dominant strain, expect relaxation effects that can lead to couch-lock.
Yoda OG is perfect for when you want to unwind after a long day or week. Happiness is another common
effect, which can help to improve your mood.

The sativa genetics in Yoda OG can provide some cerebral stimulation. This can help with focus and
creativity. This makes it an excellent strain when you need to get things done. However, the
couch-locking effects can make it challenging to get up and moving if you smoke too much.

The Yoda OG Feminized Marijuana Seeds are a hybrid strain known for its medical benefits. The most
common use for this strain is to relieve pain, but it can also help with insomnia, nausea, and loss
of appetite. This strain is also known for its ability to relax the body and mind, making it an
excellent choice for those who suffer from anxiety or stress. The Yoda OG is a versatile strain that
can be used to treat a variety of medical conditions. This strain is worth trying if you are looking
for a natural way to relieve your symptoms.

## How Does Yoda OG Feminized Marijuana Seeds Grow?

Yoda OG Feminized Seeds are easy to grow and an excellent choice for those new to growing. They are
also suitable for those who want to grow many plants. One of the main reasons new growers choose
this strain is its ability to resist mold and mildew. They grow well in grow rooms, greenhouses, and
outdoor climates. It is a versatile strain that can be grown in various environments.

The optimal growing conditions for this strain are a temperature of 70-85 degrees Fahrenheit, a
humidity of 40-50%, and water every 3-4 days. These seeds do well in soil that is rich in nutrients.
It is essential to ensure that the soil is well aerated so the roots can grow properly.

These seeds grow to medium-sized plants that reach a height of 3-4 feet. This makes them a good
choice for those who want to grow in tight spaces. Typically, growers want to minimize the amount of
space the plant takes up to maximize its yield. That is only possible when you get a strain like
Yoda OG that doesn’t grow too tall.

Males should be avoided because they can pollinate the female plants, reducing the buds’ quality.

these two strains makes for a potent strain that is perfect for medical use. Over the past few

## Sensi Star Seeds

Ask any experienced stoner who has grown some Sensi Star feminized marijuana seeds what the best
three weed strains in the world are and it’ll be no surprise that she comes up on top! This strain
is famous for its unrivaled potency, delicious flavor, and super-fast flowering time. Here is why
she is so loved by growers and smokers alike.

Sensi Star strain is an old-school classic. Known for its excellent quality and sweet taste, Sensi
Star has been around for a long time. The buds of this strain have an earthier and pine aroma, with
a spicy flavor that is somewhat sweet and somewhat skunky.

Sensi Star strain is a 70% [Indica dominant][60] bud with 30% Sativa. This makes it ideal for those
who want to relax and unwind after a long day but also enjoy the benefits of being productive. It’s
best used in the evening or night, as it helps you feel relaxed and ready for bed. However, if you
prefer to be more active, Sensi Star will give you just enough energy to keep going throughout the
day.

It has an average THC content of around 26%. With the massive THC, things may get a tad too serious
especially if you are a first-time user, so be careful. But if you are looking for something to
enhance your mood and make you happy as an experienced stoner, then the Sensi Star strain is the
right choice for you.

## Effects Of Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds

While the Sensi Star strain is pretty more expensive than other strains, it’s worth it for your
experience. The Sensi Star strain high is happy, relaxing, and sleepy. This strain’s high sets in
quickly and lasts for a long time.

The high comes on quickly, and you’ll feel relaxed and happy. The high is not overpowering at all.
But instead, it’s very soothing and comforting. You’ll feel like your worries have melted away, and
you can relax and enjoy yourself.

As the high starts to wear off and you begin to come down from your buzz, you may feel sleepy. You
might want to take a nap or go to bed after smoking the Sensi Star cannabis strain.

This marijuana plant is perfect for treating stress, depression, anxiety disorders, nausea, chronic
pain, and headaches. It’s also great for appetite stimulation, making it ideal for those who have
trouble eating due to cancer treatment or other illnesses that cause loss of appetite.

## How Does Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds Grow

Sensi Star strain grows well indoors, outdoors, and in greenhouses. This marijuana strain needs
plenty of light during its vegetative stage but not too much during flowering so that your plants
don’t grow too tall or become lanky. Sensi Star is relatively easy to cultivate indoors or outdoors
but does best in warm climates with lots of sunshine.

Plant Sensi Star strain outdoors with plenty of space to spread its roots; otherwise, keep this
plant pruned so it doesn’t get too bushy and cover up too much light from hitting your plants’
leaves. It’s best to use a soil-based medium for growing this plant because soil retains more
moisture than hydroponics or coco coir.

However, if you’re growing outdoors, then a mix of peat moss and perlite will also do the job just
fine! You can also use organic nutrients to feed your plants with all the nutrients they need to
flourish.

If you’re growing inside, then be sure to give your plants plenty of space because they’ll need it!
Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds grow fast and tall, so be sure to give them room to stretch
their legs and space for their roots to expand! You should also prune your plants when they begin
flowering to avoid getting too big for their britches!

The Sensi Star strain is easy to grow, but it’s essential to know how much water and food they need
during their life cycle. You’ll also want to pay attention to humidity levels, temperature and light
intensity, and carbon dioxide levels.

To grow Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds, you need to ensure that your environment is suitable
for optimal growth. This means keeping everything at a constant temperature between 21-25 degrees
Celsius (70-77 degrees Fahrenheit) and keeping humidity levels between 50-60%. These conditions will
allow the plant to grow at an ideal rate without getting too hot or cold, so it doesn’t stress out
or suffer from frostbite during colder months.

The Sensi weed strain grows up to 80-100 cm tall and has dark green leaves which turn yellowish when
harvested. Sensi Star strain has thick white hairs on the buds that give them an appearance of
having been dusted with sugar crystals. The trichomes are amber-coloured when young but turn milky
white as they mature. The flowers appear in three clusters between olive green calyxes that open up
during flowering.

The flowering period lasts about 50-6 days indoors with an average yield of 350g/m2 or 400g/plant
outdoors when grown under optimal conditions. Sensi Star cannabis strain produces large harvests
with minimal effort, it is great for beginners looking for an easy-to-grow strain that delivers high
yields without much effort!

## History Of Sensi Star Feminized Marijuana Seeds

The history of the Sensi Star weed strain is a story that spans generations and one that every
cannabis enthusiast should know. Sensi Star originally came from breeder Willits’ breeding of Mostly
Afghani Indica, which they crossed with Skunk #1. They then bred this new plant with Northern Lights
#5 (which was then called Shiva Skunk). This new plant was named Sensi Star and released to the
public in 1994.

Sensi Star strain has numerous awards to its name, including the High Times Cannabis Cup award for
best indica in 1994 and 1995 and High Times’ Best Overall Strain award in 2001.

## Kimbo Kush Seeds

If you’re looking for a high-quality feminized marijuana seed that packs a powerful punch, then look
no further than Kimbo Kush Feminized Marijuana Seeds. The aroma of Kimbo Kush is simply
intoxicating, with earthy, mango, pungent, and sweet aromas that can easily fill a room. And when it
comes to the taste, Kimbo Kush gives users a perfect blend of berry, citrus, fruity, and sweet
flavours. The sweetness of the mango comes through on the exhale, making for a very pleasant smoking
experience. You can expect a smooth smoke with hints of citrus and spice. So if you’re looking for a
delicious and potent strain that’s easy to grow, then don’t hesitate to give Kimbo Kush a try.

Kimbo Kush Feminized Marijuana Seeds is an [Indica][60] dominant strain (70%), however, it does have
a nice 30% Sativa content which makes for a well-balanced hybrid. The [THC][61] level of Kimbo Kush
is a high 26%. The high from such potent THC amounts is one that will creep up on you. This is not a
strain for beginners, as it can easily overwhelm those with a low tolerance. Intermediate stoners
who are seeking a powerful body stone will find Kimbo Kush perfect for their needs while experienced
smokers will enjoy the cerebral high that Kimbo Kush provides.

Kimbo Kush is best enjoyed in the evening or on the weekends when you can relax and let the high
wash over you. This is not a strain that you’ll want to use during the day, as it can easily leave
you feeling couch-locked and immobile. Unless, of course, you’re seeking a powerful body stone to
ease your aches and pains. Then, by all means, enjoy Kimbo Kush any time of day. Why wait to enjoy
its medical benefits?

## Effects Of Kimbo Kush Feminized Marijuana Seeds

You’ll likely find yourself becoming more talkative and social during the onset of this strain’s
high. As the high progresses, you’ll begin to feel a sense of relaxation wash over your entire body.
This is when the Indica effects really. You may also notice an increase in your appetite. This is
when it’s time to reach for the snacks.

The peak of this high will last for several hours. During this time, you’ll be incredibly stoned and
may find it difficult to function. It’s best to just relax during this time and let the high rule
over you. You may find yourself becoming tired and falling asleep towards the end of the high.

And if you may ask, its comedown is relatively mellow. You’ll likely find yourself feeling slightly
tired and lazy. However, the head high will slowly start to fade away, leaving you feeling
clear-headed and refreshed.

## How Does Kimbo Kush Feminized Marijuana Seeds Grow?

Kimbo Kush is a relatively easy strain to grow, even for those with little to no experience. The
plants are resistant to mould, pests, and diseases, making them easier to take care of. They grow
well in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, those growing indoors will need to create an
optimally controlled climate in order to get the best results.

When it comes to watering, Kimbo Kush prefers a light hand. The soil should be allowed to dry out
between waterings. As for humidity, Kimbo Kush prefers a moderate level. too much humidity can lead
to mould and mildew problems. The ideal temperature range is between 70 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit.

Kimbo Kush strain is a medium-sized plant that doesn’t require much trimming. The plants typically
reach a height of between 2 and 3 feet. The leaves of Kimbo Kush are medium green in colour while
the trichomes are dense and sticky. This strain’s flowers are absolutely gorgeous to look at. You
will easily fall in love with small and compact shapes accompanied by lots of frosty trichomes.

Kimbo Kush is a 100% feminized strain, which means that all of the plants will produce flowers.
There are no male plants to worry about. Growers who want to produce smokable flowers will be happy
to know that Kimbo Kush produces high-quality smokable buds.

Being a photoperiod strain, it means that the plants need to be exposed to a specific light schedule
in order to flower optimally. The plants should be given 12 hours of darkness and 12 hours of light
each day for an indoor setup. This helps them mimic the changing of the seasons, telling them when
it’s time to flower.

These seeds grow into plants that have a relatively short flowering time of 55 to 65 days. Not many
strains can match this speed. Kimbo Kush is a high-yielding strain, with indoor plants producing up
to 500 grams per square meter. Outdoor plants can produce even more, with yields reaching up to 600
grams per plant.

The name Kimbo Kush was inspired by the street fighter Kimbo Slice. It was created by the DNA crew,
a team of breeders who are based in the Netherlands. The team set out to create a strain that would
be easy to grow and produce high-yielding plants. After several generations of selection and
crossbreeding, they finally came up with the perfect strain.

The Facility

Green Scope Medicinal’s (GSM) GMP facility is situated in a prime rural suburb of Sydney NSW. GSM’s current 20,569 square foot facility encompasses our cultivation and manufacturing operations. The facility is one of seven greenhouse structures on the property which all share a similar footprint. Our expansion plan will utilise all seven greenhouse structures situated on 143, 983 square feet. The remaining six greenhouses will be retrofitted to become GMP certified state-of-the-art facilities encompassing Cultivation, Manufacturing and will also include Research & Development operations.

Security

Green Scope Medicinal (GSM) aim to be the benchmark when it comes to securing our GMP certified facility in this emerging industry. GSM’s facility design will implement leading state-of-the-art technology combined with dynamic procedures to mitigate risk and ensure an efficient operation.

GSM’s facility will utilise industry leading technology in alarm systems, motion sensors, CCTV, physical deterrents and controlled access points to safeguard staff and the facility.

Licenses & Regulatory
Compliance

Therapeutic Goods Administration

GMP Certification Licences to Cultivate and Manufacture Therapeutic Goods

Department of Health Office of Drug Control

Cannabis Research Licence

Green Scope Medicinal operates as the license holder, engaging in a collaborative partnership with its subsidiary, Three 6 Zero. Together, they manage all aspects of sales and marketing, seamlessly integrating their efforts within the corporate framework for optimal operational synergy.

Green Scope Medicinal are audited and accredited by the Australian Therapeutic Goods Administration and the Department of Health Office of Drug Control. GSM currently holds a license to Cultivate and Manufacturing Medicinal Cannabis. Phase 3 will include an additional GMP certified Research & Development license expected to be issued Q1 of 2024.

Corporate Social Responsibility

Green Scope Medicinal (GSM) believes in being socially responsible and giving back to the community. GSM also seeks to engage in sustainable practices and minimize its environmental impact through its cultivation, manufacturing, and product development processes. This includes initiatives such as using renewable energy sources, reducing waste and carbon emissions, and promoting eco-friendly packaging. GSM is committed to being a responsible corporate citizen and making a positive difference in the world.

Future Developments

Green Scope Medicinal is an innovative Australian based fully integrated pharmaceutical medicinal cannabis company. GSM are in phase two of a three phase set up to become the finest producer and supplier of a diverse range of medicinal cannabis products, treatments, and services globally.

GSM aims to contribute to the understanding of Medicinal Cannabis through various clinical programs to collate supporting data amid at patients with unmet medical needs. Clinical trials will also pave the way for innovation by enhancing GSM’s manufacturing and product development capabilities to ultimately improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world.

# About Tilray

## Our Company

Tilray was founded in Canada in 2013. Just one year later, we received approval from the Canadian
health authority for the production and research of medicinal cannabis. Since then we have been
supplying numerous doctors, pharmacies, hospitals, authorities and researchers worldwide with our
high-quality pharmaceutical products.

Tilray is one of the leading companies in the production, development and research of medicinal
cannabis world-wide. We are proud of that and are particularly pleased to be able to provide a
steadily growing number of patients with a better quality of life.

## We Are a Global Pioneer

We have supplied high-quality medical cannabis products to tens of thousands of patients in eighteen
countries spanning five continents across the globe through our subsidiaries in Europe, Canada,
Australia and Latin America, and through agreements with established pharmaceutical distributors.

founded 2013
Export to 20 Countries
5 continents
Production in Germany, Portugal & Canada
Scientific research Worldwide
study program
Standardized Pharma­ceutical grade medicinal cannabis
First GMP-Certified Cannabis Company
Build the World's most trusted Cannabis Company
Thousands of patients have used our products
Highest ethical & medical policies

Tilray is absolutely convinced that patients should have safe access and a reliable supply of
quality-tested pure, precise and predictable medical cannabis products. We aspire to lead,
legitimize and define the future of our industry by building the world’s most trusted and valued
medicinal cannabis company. We are pioneering the future of medical cannabis research, cultivation,
processing and distribution globally. Tilray’s EU campus in Cantanhede serves as a hub to support
[Tilray’s clinical research][8], product developments and distribution across Europe and other
international markets.

## GMP-certified Producer

Our Tilray Cantanhede, Portugal and Tilray Nanaimo, Canada facilities are Good Manufacturing
Practices (GMP) certified:
* GMP is an internationally recognized standard that ensures medicines are consistently produced and
controlled with the highest levels of pharmaceutical grade quality and purity.
* GMP certification has allowed us to export our products all over the world, through our
subsidiaries in Europe, Canada, Australia and Latin America, and through agreements with
established pharmaceutical distributors.

# About Tilray

## Our Company

Tilray was founded in Canada in 2013. Just one year later, we received approval from the Canadian
health authority for the production and research of medicinal cannabis. Since then we have been
supplying numerous doctors, pharmacies, hospitals, authorities and researchers worldwide with our
high-quality pharmaceutical products.

Tilray is one of the leading companies in the production, development and research of medicinal
cannabis world-wide. We are proud of that and are particularly pleased to be able to provide a
steadily growing number of patients with a better quality of life.

## We Are a Global Pioneer

We have supplied high-quality medical cannabis products to tens of thousands of patients in eighteen
countries spanning five continents across the globe through our subsidiaries in Europe, Canada,
Australia and Latin America, and through agreements with established pharmaceutical distributors.

Tilray is absolutely convinced that patients should have safe access and a reliable supply of
quality-tested pure, precise and predictable medical cannabis products. We aspire to lead,
legitimize and define the future of our industry by building the world’s most trusted and valued
medicinal cannabis company. We are pioneering the future of medical cannabis research, cultivation,
processing and distribution globally. Tilray’s EU campus in Cantanhede serves as a hub to support
[Tilray’s clinical research][8], product developments and distribution across Europe and other
international markets.

## GMP-certified Producer

Our Tilray Cantanhede, Portugal and Tilray Nanaimo, Canada facilities are Good Manufacturing
Practices (GMP) certified:
* GMP is an internationally recognized standard that ensures medicines are consistently produced and
controlled with the highest levels of pharmaceutical grade quality and purity.
* GMP certification has allowed us to export our products all over the world, through our
subsidiaries in Europe, Canada, Australia and Latin America, and through agreements with
established pharmaceutical distributors.

# Bringing Quality to Life

Manufacturing of Medical Cannabis Extracts

## Our Services

### Contract Processing

Contract processing services of medical cannabis flower to extracted products for licensed
producers.

[Read More][6]

### White Label

Supply of full-spectrum medical cannabis oil. Products can be marketed under the customer’s own
brand.

### Bulk Extract

Extracted cannabinoids in bulk format. Consistent supply of bulk for formulation or further
downstream processing.

[THC][10]
[CBD][11]

## Our Products

From our facility in Denmark, we manufacture full-spectrum cannabis oil for declaration of THC, CBD,
and balanced formulations. Our unique manufacturing capabilities enable us to create the highest
quality of products with a well-preserved profile of terpenes and flavonoids. Valcon Medical is GMP
certified.

### Standardised Cannabis Oil
* Full-spectrum C02–extracted
* THC, CBD, mixed, or balanced
* MCT carrier oil
* 30 ml primary packaging

Products are manufactured under EU-GMP and tested in accordance with the German Monograph for
cannabis extracts, DAB Eingestellter Cannabisextract, and the European Pharmacopoeia, Ph. Eur.
Products are composed of a specified amount of extracted cannabinoids from Cannabis Sativa L.
flowers (floss) of a defined strain, in MCT oil (medium-chain triglycerides). The extraction solvent
is carbon dioxide.

### Bulk Herbal Cannabis Extract
* Full-spectrum C0₂–extracted
* THC, CBD, or Balanced
* 50-500 ml container

Cannabis herbal extracts are manufactured under EU-GMP and tested in accordance with the German
Monograph for cannabis extracts, DAB Eingestellter Cannabisextract (up to standardization), and the
European Pharmacopoeia, Ph. Eur. Products are composed of a > 70% concentrated soft extract of
cannabinoids from Cannabis Sativa L. flowers (floss) of a defined strain. The extraction solvent is
carbon dioxide.

Valcon Medical is a European manufacturing organisation specialising in medical cannabis extracts.

## News

Dec 21, 2023

##### Valcon Medical achieves milestone: First Danish-manufactured medical cannabis oil approved by
##### the Danish Medicines Agency

Valcon Medical A/S, a Danish medical cannabis manufacturing company, disclosed a significant
achievement. The Danish Medicines Agency (DKMA) has approved the inclusion of the first
Danish-manufactured medical cannabis oil on the list of authorized medical cannabis products.

##### The European Pharmacopoeia Commission (EPC) has adopted a new European monograph for Cannabis
##### flower

The European Pharmacopoeia Commission has adopted a new European monograph for Cannabis flower at
the latest Commission meeting in June 2023. The monograph describes quality requirements for the raw
material Cannabis flower.

[Read the article][19]

##### Valcon Medical has reached another significant milestone with the successful implementation of
##### a consistent supply chain to United Kingdom

In United Kingdom Medicinal Cannabis is classified as an unlicensed medicine/Specials and
manufactured to meet a specific patient’s clinical needs. Valcon Medical offers exciting partnership
opportunities for standardised cannabis oil brands in the United Kingdom.

##### Valcon Medical is proud to announce its new partnership agreement with a well reputed Polish
##### manufacturer of medicinal cannabis

extracts, and tinctures.

##### Valcon Medical acquires Danish cannabis distributor and re-packer ScanLeaf ApS, extends
##### product reach and capabilities

position in the European Medical Cannabis market. Valcon Medical are excited to announce that they

## Our mission is to help you make the best choices for your health.

Welcome to Verywell Health, an award-winning resource for credible, fact-based, and up-to-date
information you need to confidently make health choices for yourself and your loved ones.

We are dedicated to empowering you with the best answers to your most pressing questions, from
understanding infectious diseases to managing a new diagnosis and everything in between.

For more than 20 years, we’ve worked to create and refine our curated library of comprehensive and
trustworthy information. Our team of writers and editors are industry experts and health journalists
who create and update our 22,000+ article library, and research and report vital health and medical
news.

The Verywell Health Medical Expert Board of board-certified physicians vets our articles and join us
in our mission to make you confident in your next steps to better health.

## Meet Our Medical Expert Board

Our team of more than 150 experienced medical professionals join us in our mission to empower you to
confidently take the next steps in your health journey—for yourself or a loved one. They ensure our
content is medically accurate and reflects the latest in evidence-based research and health
information.

The [Medical Expert Board][72] of board-certified physicians represents 30+ specialties. Here are a
few of our members:

American College of Cardiology.

## Our Editorial Process

Our editorial process centers on aiming to ensure you understand what you’re reading and know how to
use the information to make confident choices about your health. Our writers, editors, and fact
checkers only use fact-based, up-to-date research and present it in a clear, judgement-free way that
empowers you to take an active role in your health.

Our editorial team manages all of our content, which includes new articles on evergreen topics,
coverage on the latest news, and updates to existing content to ensure our information is reflective
of the latest research. The integrity of our content is a top priority. We are not influenced by
advertisers in our coverage. We rely on current primary sources, including peer-reviewed studies and
government institutions, to ensure our information is as up to date as possible, and applicable to
real people.

### Our Content Integrity Promise

Verywell Health is committed to content integrity. As a People Inc., we follow [The People Inc.
Content Integrity Promise][81]. This means that the quality and trustworthiness of our content and
editorial processes is very important to us. Our team of writers, editors, fact checkers,
illustrators, photographers, and medical professionals rigorously researches and reviews all content
on an ongoing basis to ensure it is up to date, accurate, and puts the needs of our readers first.

We are committed to telling readers when there is an error in an article, and to fixing it. When we
discover an error, we will correct the article as quickly as possible and add a correction note. All
corrections will be clearly labeled, dated, and include information about what was corrected.

If you believe we have published a factual error in any of our content, please let us know and we
will investigate and take appropriate corrective and/or updating measures. You can report a possible
error by emailing us at corrections@people.inc.

Verywell Health is committed to independent, impartial, fair journalism. Our editorial content is
not influenced by our advertisers. We maintain a strict separation between advertising and editorial
content and clearly differentiate editorial content from that provided by advertisers.

Our team of more than 150 experienced medical professionals join us in our mission to empower you to
confidently take the next steps in your health journey—for yourself or a loved one. They ensure our
content is medically accurate and reflects the latest in evidence-based research and health
information.

The [Medical Expert Board][72] of board-certified physicians represents 30+ specialties. Here are a
few of our members:

### Anisha Shah, MD

Internist, Interventional Cardiologist
[Anisha Shah, MD]
Anisha Shah, MD, is a board-certified internist, interventional cardiologist, and a fellow of the
American College of Cardiology.
[Read more ][73]

### Mary Choy, PharmD

Pharmacist
[Mary Choy, PharmD]
Mary Choy, PharmD, is board-certified in geriatric pharmacotherapy. She currently serves as the
director of pharmacy practice of the New York State Council of Health-System Pharmacists.
[Read more ][74]

### Anju Goel, MD

Physician, Public Health Professional
[Anju Goel, MD]
Dr. Goel, MD, is board-certified in internal medicine. She has over 10 years of experience in the
California public health system addressing communicable disease, health policy, and disaster
preparedness.
[Read more ][75]

### David Ozeri, MD

Rheumatologist
[David Ozeri, MD]
David Ozeri, MD, is a board-certified rheumatologist. He is based in Tel Aviv, Israel, where he does
research at Sheba Medical Center. Previously, he practiced at New York-Presbyterian Hospital.
[Read more ][76]

### Doru Paul, MD

Oncologist
[Doru Paul, MD]
Doru Paul, MD, is triple board-certified in medical oncology, hematology, and internal medicine and
is an Associate Professor of Clinical Medicine at Weill Cornell Medical College.
[Read more ][77]

### Anita Sadaty, MD

Obstetrician-Gynecologist
[Anita Sadaty, MD]
Anita Sadaty, MD, is board-certified in obstetrics-gynecology. She is a clinical assistant professor
at Hofstra Northwell School of Medicine and founder of Redefining Health Medical.
[Read more ][78]

### Jay N. Yepuri, MD

Gastroenterologist
[Jay N. Yepuri, MD]
Jay Yepuri, MD, MS, is board-certified in gastroenterology. He is a partner with Digestive Health
Associates of Texas and a medical director at Texas Health Harris Methodist HEB Hospital.
[Read more ][79]

## Our Editorial Process

Our editorial process centers on aiming to ensure you understand what you’re reading and know how to
use the information to make confident choices about your health. Our writers, editors, and fact
checkers only use fact-based, up-to-date research and present it in a clear, judgement-free way that
empowers you to take an active role in your health.

Our editorial team manages all of our content, which includes new articles on evergreen topics,
coverage on the latest news, and updates to existing content to ensure our information is reflective
of the latest research. The integrity of our content is a top priority. We are not influenced by
advertisers in our coverage. We rely on current primary sources, including peer-reviewed studies and
government institutions, to ensure our information is as up to date as possible, and applicable to
real people.

[Learn More About Our Editorial Process][80]

### Our Content Integrity Promise

Verywell Health is committed to content integrity. As a People Inc., we follow [The People Inc.
Content Integrity Promise][81]. This means that the quality and trustworthiness of our content and
editorial processes is very important to us. Our team of writers, editors, fact checkers,
illustrators, photographers, and medical professionals rigorously researches and reviews all content
on an ongoing basis to ensure it is up to date, accurate, and puts the needs of our readers first.

We are committed to telling readers when there is an error in an article, and to fixing it. When we
discover an error, we will correct the article as quickly as possible and add a correction note. All
corrections will be clearly labeled, dated, and include information about what was corrected.

If you believe we have published a factual error in any of our content, please let us know and we
will investigate and take appropriate corrective and/or updating measures. You can report a possible
error by emailing us at corrections@people.inc.

Verywell Health is committed to independent, impartial, fair journalism. Our editorial content is
not influenced by our advertisers. We maintain a strict separation between advertising and editorial
content and clearly differentiate editorial content from that provided by advertisers.

Every Verywell Health staff member and contributor is held accountable to a high standard of honesty
and transparency. All of our writers, editors, and contributors are responsible for disclosing any
potential conflicts of interest.

[Read the People Inc. Editorial Policy and Standards][82]

### Our Inclusion Promise

Our goal is to create inclusive content that spans the geographic, racial, gender, and body
diversity of our readers.

People Inc.'s Anti-Bias Review Board evaluates content bias and inclusivity. We regularly work with
the Anti-Bias Review Board to ensure that our content and images continue to reflect the needs of
our readership and modern society.

We will continue to identify specific areas of improvement in the topic areas we cover to ensure our
library of content is accurate, inclusive and accessible to the millions of Americans who rely on
us.

We will continue to work with the Review Board and apply recommendations that come out of the
ongoing content audit. We prioritize person-first language over stigmatizing identity-first
language.

Over the past four years, we’ve partnered with organizations including [Let's Talk Menopause][83],
[WomenHeart][84], [The White Dress Project][85], and [Allergy & Asthma Network][86] as part of our
Health Divide series on health inequities. We will continue to pursue partnerships with a variety of
organizations to spotlight their work and share stories of real people across all backgrounds and
life experiences.

Our pledge and commitment to these goals is part of the ongoing work of our team to listen, learn,
and help our readers best care for their physical and mental health.

In order to do so, our team remains dedicated to building an inclusive community, addressing
inaccuracies, and ensuring our content reflects the diversity of the audience we serve.

## Meet Our Team

We are dedicated to providing comprehensive, accurate information that you can rely on. Our team of
editors, designers, developers, and more have experience, expertise, and passion for health content.

Meet some of our team below. They are just one part of our staff, which includes SEO experts,
product managers, designers, developers, and sales and marketing partners.

### Welcome to Waterside Pharmaceuticals

Waterside Pharmaceuticals is a UK-based life sciences and agriculture company based in
Aberdeenshire, Scotland, focused on the cultivation, importation and distribution of high-quality
medicinal cannabis.


We combine pharmaceutical standards with innovative and sustainable practices to ensure consistent,
traceable and patient-safe products, from cultivation through to final supply. Our fully indoor
facility is built for total environmental control and automation, with operations designed to meet
the highest standards of quality, compliance and care.

### Redefining Medicinal Cannabis

Waterside Pharmaceuticals brings together pharmaceutical-grade precision and next-generation
vertical farming to cultivate consistent cannabis plants to be used as a starter material for final
product medicines in a fully indoor facility based in Aberdeenshire, Scotland.


Our Total Controlled Environment Agriculture (TCEA) system allows us to finely regulate lighting,
climate, irrigation, and nutrition, delivering stable cannabinoid and terpene profiles, batch after
batch.


We operate to GACP and GDP standards but apply GMP principles throughout our cultivation activities
with the aim of becoming GMP certified in the next year or two. 

 

By growing locally, we aim to reduce the UK's dependence on imports, supporting a more secure,
high-quality supply of medical cannabis for patients across the country.

[Learn More ][6]
[Waterside Pharma-53.jpg]

### Cultivating with Purpose: Precision, Sustainability, and Patient Focus

We’re taking a thoughtful, science-led approach to medicinal cannabis cultivation, combining
pharmaceutical precision, sustainable practices, and a deep commitment to patient wellbeing.

UK Based

imports and improving patient access.

[Medicinal Drugs]

consistency in every batch.

Total Controlled Environment Agriculture (TCEA)

[Vertical Farming]

Our fully indoor, pesticide-free cultivation facility creates precise, replicable growing
conditions, guaranteeing premium-quality medicinal cannabis.

Sustainability

[Planet Earth Icon]

Our approach ensures a responsible, eco-friendly cultivation process while maintaining the highest
standards of quality and efficiency.

Innovation

[Plant Innovation]

By integrating cutting-edge technology and advanced cultivation methods, we are continuously
improving consistency, efficiency, and product quality.

Patient-Centered Care

[Doctor Patient]

Our priority is delivering safe, high-quality, and consistent medicinal cannabis.

### Key Milestones in Our Journey

[Waterside Pharma-33.jpg]

UK Re-Classifies Cannabis for Medical Use

In Nov 2018, the UK reclassified cannabis‑based medicinal products (CBPMs) to Schedule 2, allowing
specialist doctors to prescribe unlicensed “specials” on a named‑patient basis, enabling tightly
regulated access for patients in need

[More Info ][7]

2018

Innovation Through Research

We began investing in research and detailed business planning, building an understanding of patient
needs, market dynamics, and regulatory pathways to guide our long-term vision, sustainable growth,
and commitment to safe, effective, and accessible cannabis-based medicines.

[More Info ][8]

2020

Foundation of Waterside Pharmaceuticals

Waterside Pharmaceuticals was founded with a clear purpose: to develop a responsible, UK-based
supply of high-quality cannabis-based medicines. Rooted in science, sustainability, and patient
care, and built to meet evolving clinical and regulatory expectations.

[More Info ][9]

2022

### Description

The newest banger on the block is beveled, baby! And what makes a beveled edge better? It’s all
about the flush seal the edge creates between the banger and the carb cap. This seal results in more
pressure which means more vapor at lower temperatures. So jump on the low temp train with a beveled
banger today.

This quality banger made from 100% FDA-grade crystal quartz rocks the ‘Yo’ down below, with our
household name etched on the bottom of the banger (instead of the side), which is a new look for us.

The Beveled Banger is available in 10mm, 14mm, and 19mm male or female joints with a 90 degree
angled neck.

Essential accessories include the [Cyclone Cap][81], [Terp Pearls][82] or an [Opaque Insert][83],
and other carb caps like our [Quartz Thermal Cap][84], [Glass GTR Cap][85] or [Quartz Directional

### Description

You can’t beat the convenience of having a rig setup ready to go straight out of the box! Choose
from three different rig styles and get your hands on everything you need to dab with our dab rig
sets. In the box, you’ll have everything you need to start dabbing minus your favorite concentrates
and your torch, of course.

#### **What’s included:**
* Your choice of dab rig style (Swiss, Klein or Can)
* 1 auto spinner nail (banger)
* 2 quartz terp pearls
* 1 honeycomb sphere cap
* 1 glass cap stand
* 1 versatile spatula dab tool

Between impressive function and the affordability of all of these kits, you can enjoy your favorite
concentrates both at home and on the go.

#### **Features:**
* Your choice between three different rig styles (Swiss, Klein, Can)
* Angled mouthpiece
* Sturdy base
* 14mm female rig joint
* Built in percolators for extra cooling without sacrificing flavors
* Saves ~20% compared to buying each accessory separately

perc. You’ll also love the aesthetics of this piece and the way the included perc smooths out your
hit without sacrificing flavor.

#### Klein Rig Set

][48]

Our Klein rig set also includes all of the accessories, but features our Klein recycler rig. The

design also comes with one of our Yo! percolators, and stands at 7.5″ tall with an angled
mouthpiece.
* [

#### Can Rig Set

][49]

Our Can rig set offers a no fuss design featuring a single Yo! percolator. Standing at 7.5″ tall
with a nice wide base and an angled mouthpiece, the clear Can rig offers smooth, clean hits without
so many tough-to-reach nooks and crannies. Best of all, you get all of the accessories we mentioned
above.

### Description

### Don’t Waste It. Blast It.

Every dabber knows that feeling. You’re down to the last bit in the jar, scraping around trying to
get it out, and it’s just frustrating. Good wax costs real money and leaving it stuck to the glass
is leaving money on the table.
That’s exactly why Brandon invented the Jar Blaster. After years of dealing with the same problem,
he finally designed a solution and brought it to market. There’s nothing else like it.

### How It Works

The Jar Blaster is built with quartz pillars that heat up like a diamond knot. When you’re down to
the end of a jar, heat it up and set the jar directly on top. The heat melts everything left on the
sides and base. Larger dabs collect in the dish below. Smaller amounts flow straight through the
airflow holes. Clean, efficient, nothing left behind.

### What You Get
* Purpose-built quartz nail designed to vaporize straight from the jar
* Wide 40mm dish catches every last drop
* Built-in airflow for smooth, clean hits
* Fits 10mm or 14mm male joints
* Made from high-quality quartz

Every dabber’s got a collection of nails. This one actually solves a real problem.

### Description

We’re excited to announce Yo Dabba Dabba’s newest addition: our Seamless Long Barrel Slurper Nail –
the ultimate accessory for slurper fanatics. This innovative slurp-style nail features a longer
bucket that allows for bigger dabs and significantly less waste. Designed with a seamless weld, this
nail offers maximum durability for long-lasting use, even with prolonged exposure to high
temperatures.

Available in both 45 and 90-degrees with a 14mm male joint, the Seamless Long Barrel Slurper Nail is
compatible with marble caps and works just like a traditional terp slurper nail. The extended bucket
ensures that less concentrates are sucked through into your rig, resulting in less wastage and a
cleaner nail and rig.

Experience the best of both worlds with Seamless Long Barrel Slurper Nail. The sleek design looks
great with any setup and is compatible with accessories like pillars and terp pearls to boost your
flavors and reduce mess. Between durability, accessory compatibility, and less waste and mess, it’s
the perfect daily driver.

with a sleek aesthetic. The internal recycling system ensures that vapor stays cool and smooth from
start to finish, all while keeping the rig compact and easy to handle.

# About Yo Dabba Dabba

## Built by dabbers, for dabbers. Since 2009.

Yo Dabba Dabba started as part of [NHM][33], a wholesale smoking accessories company supplying head
shops across the country. When the dabbing renaissance hit around 2012 at the peak of the Green
Rush, we saw an opportunity – and a gap. There was real demand for quality dabbing gear, but most of
what was out there was either overpriced, underbuilt, or both. So we split off, set up shop in
Phoenix, Arizona, and went to work.

More than a decade later, Yo Dabba Dabba is one of the most recognized names in the dab tools
industry. We stock [quartz bangers][34], [dab rigs][35], [eNails][36], [carb caps][37], [terp
pearls][38], inserts, and a full lineup of accessories – all vetted before they land on the site. We
know this space well, and we don’t carry gear we wouldn’t use ourselves.

### Education Is Part of the Deal

Dabbing has been overcomplicated and gatekept for too long. Our goal has always been to make it
accessible – for complete beginners and experienced connoisseurs alike. That means carrying gear at
real prices, backing it with honest information, and making sure you know how to use what you buy.

On the site you’ll find [in-depth resource articles][39] and how-to content covering everything from
banger selection to cleaning technique. If you want a structured start, [Dab University][40] is our
free course platform – five courses covering rig setup, concentrates, technique, temps, and eNails.
Thousands of dabbers have gone through it. It’s worth your time.

### Customer Service Is Not an Afterthought

We’re a real company with real people behind it. If something isn’t right with your order, reach out
and we’ll make it right – fast. Check out our [customer reviews][41] if you want to see what people
actually think. We’re proud of them.

Questions about your setup, what banger fits your rig, or how to dial in your temps? [Contact
us][42] – that’s what we’re here for. Nail Every Dab.

### Description

The latest carb cap to join our collection features a unique design that utilizes carved channels to
control airflow, and (of course) make those [terp pearls][39] spin. Made of high-quality quartz, the
Disc Cap gets its name from its base shape. But, unlike the other quartz caps in our inventory,
there’s no air hole on this handle. Instead, air makes its way through the tiny swirled channels
carved in the cap’s thick and disc-shaped base.

The pattern of the channels swirls air from all sides to amplify convection within the nail’s bucket
and support the vaporization of concentrates at the lowest temperature possible. When testing out
this cap’s function, our team gave it five stars for low-temp support. Plus, it just looks cool.

The Disc Cap is so versatile thanks to its shape and can be paired with most flat tops. It works
perfectly with our [20mm][40], [25mm][41] and [30mm][42] flat top bangers, and our extra-large
[sumo][43] banger. You can even pair it with our [quartz ebanger][44] for a truly elevated[
eNail][45] experience. And, we just love how it looks on our [seamless flat top][46]: straight
stylin’.

### Description

These Quartz Hybrid Carb Caps have been specially designed to function in tandem with the popular
Hybrid Ti Nail. Two dabbing tools in one, this quartz carb cap-with-dabber allows for the slicing,
dicing, squishing and smearing of concentrates before they’re efficiently vaporized.

Crafted from 100-percent pure crystal quartz, the draws that these Hybrid Carb Caps produce are
cool, creamy and filled with flavors. As well as satisfying taste buds, these hits also pack one
heck of a punch. Great news for concentrate connoisseurs and ideal for medicinal marijuana users.

More importantly, every draw from a Yo Dabba Dabba Quartz Hybrid Carb Cap is clean and pure. Not
only does quartz have anti-bacterial and anti-microbial properties, it’s also non-porous, meaning
this 2-in-1 dab tool reaches and retains optimal dabbing temperatures quickly and efficiently. So,
as well as getting a pure vape every time, your concentrates will never be squandered again.

Please note, this Quartz Hybrid Carb Cap is meant to be used with a Yo Dabba Dabba [Hybrid Ti
Nail][38]. So, if you’re looking for a different kind of carb cap, why not check out what we have to
offer on our dedicated [Carb Cap][39] page? There’s something on offer for every rig!

The Quartz Hybrid Carb Cap: the only accessory any dab devotee will ever need for their Hybrid Ti
Nail setup.

### Description

The Dichro Sphere carb cap is specifically designed for use with a Terp Slurp nail. Because this
unique style of nail features built-in airflow control, the compatible carb cap does not. The solid
design of the Dichro Sphere allows you to get the most out of a terp slurp, because any additional
airflow from a carb cap would reduce the pressure inside the bucket, weakening the hit and
decreasing temperature. Two things you don’t want!

If you’re loving our [Seamless Terp Slurp][38] or [Channel Slurp][39], accessorizing with this carb
cap is a must. Color selection is at random, but if you’re set on a certain shade, leave it in the
notes at check out and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

### Description

It may look like an ordinary paperclip, but this premium Grade-2 Titanium Paperclip Dabber is far
from it. Behind this wand’s funky façade lies a dab tool brimming with functionality. Specifically
designed to evoke memories of Reddit threads about stopgap dabbing tools, this top-shelf dabber
sports a quirky handle and ultra-fine, needle-like point. Perfect for slicing waxes, spearing
shatter and working with extra-sticky concentrate consistencies.

Individually made, no two Paperclip Dabbers are alike, which just adds to this dab tool’s
unconventional appeal. On top of that, it provides elevated control and a slim point which offers
the highest precision for an enhanced dabbing experience. Approximately 10cm (4in) in length, the
Paperclip Dabber’s high-grade titanium body helps keep dabs clean and effortlessly spreads
concentrates around until there’s absolutely nothing left.

Thanks to its thermal properties and smart design, the Paperclip Dabber really does make handling
hot, sticky puddles a breeze. By using this tool, you’re not just ensuring that every drop of your
dab will be vaped, you’re also guaranteeing that every draw will be clean, tasty and strong.
Seriously, this dabber isn’t just a pretty face. It changes your entire dabbing adventure.

So, what are you waiting for? Turn your ordinary dabbing sessions into extraordinary ones by
ordering a Paperclip Dabber, today!

### Description

This dabbing tool may look basic, but there’s a lot more to this Pin Dabber than meets the eye.
Forged in the USA and CNC-machined to the highest standards from Grade-2 Titanium, this sleek and
ergonomic dab tool has been specifically crafted for functionality and durability. So, it may look
boring – and some might even say gothic – but it gets your concentrates moving from A to B with
ease. And thanks to its titanium construction, it also ensures you get a clean, tasty and potent
draw, every time.

Not only that, but this 3-inch (7.6cm) dab tool is virtually unbreakable; good news for the
heavy-handed among us. Ideal for lancing solid concentrates, this skinny Pin Dabber also makes a
very useful tool for anything requiring a good ‘poke-y’. This does not include people, no matter how
annoying they are!

Sure, this Pin Dabber may look humble, but being uncompromisingly uncomplicated in design and being
made from premium US titanium make it an effective little dab tool. With excellent heat retention
and pin-point precision, the Pin Dabber makes moving concentrates – and mountains – easy. Its slim,
needle-like point spreads waxes like a knife through butter and ensures not a drop of concentrate is
wasted. And the resulting hit? Spectacularly flavorsome, potent and most importantly, pure.

Move mountains and enhance your dabbing experience with the Yo Dabba Dabba Pin Dabber. For less than
it would cost you to buy a combo meal from Taco Bell, this tasty piece will last you a lifetime and
won’t give you heartburn – just a pleasurable dabbing adventure.

### Description

Get that glob on the dabber and keep it handy — this domeless quartz nail will be heated and ready
to go in less than ten seconds, making it ideal for busy dabbers who find themselves always on the
go.

Beginners and advanced dabbers alike love the banger design of this domeless nail. Just torch its
large, sidecar dish and drop in the desired amount of concentrates, then watch the smoke swirl and
travel down the banger’s long neck. Pair this quartz stepper banger with a [Quartz Banger Carb
Cap][40] to make each hit as smooth and tasty as possible while reducing vapor loss and preventing
concentrates from puddling or going to waste. For novices, the banger design is a foolproof way to
protect beloved oil rigs from heat damage. The banger’s outward-bent, extended neck holds the dish
far away from the rig, preventing the torch flame from ever coming into contact with it. Don’t worry
about restricted airflow: although the quartz stepper banger’s neck is bent at nearly a 90° angle,
it’s blown without being pinched in and provides ample space for the smoke to travel through and
into the rig. Adorned with a frosted-glass joint, this sleek-styled domeless nail fits both male or
female 14mm and 19mm joints.

### Description

In collaboration with Mood Mats, our upcycled and ultra-durable Show Us Your Yo dab mat is perfect
for keeping your sesh station clean, protecting your tabletop surfaces, and boosting your
aesthetics. It’s rigid rubber construction helps keep everything in one place and looks awesome
under any rig. This heady design features vibrant shades of yellow, green, blue, and pink in a neon
graffiti art-style that looks incredible under black lighting, LEDs, or your trusty lava lamp. The
design also showcases one of our rigs and a swirling smoke pattern that drives home the effects of
our cyclone carb cap and terp pearls.

Mood Mats are made with upcycled rubber sourced from clean donations that saves over two tons of
rubber from entering landfills every month. Since they’re made from rubber, they last a long time
and don’t need to be replaced nearly as often as ordinary dab mats. Best of all, when you’re done
with it, you can recycle it. They’re the eco-friendly choice for creating a non-slip dabbing surface
that keeps your tools in one place and your tables safe from the sticky. Between the artful design,
durable construction, and recyclable aspect, our Show Us Your Yo Mood Mat is the last dab mat you’ll
ever buy. It’s the perfect size for most standard rigs and tables.

### Description

Bangers are great…until it comes time to find a carb cap that fits right over that oddly shaped cup.
That’s why Yo Dabba Dabba started carrying the titanium banger carb cap!

Unlike ordinary carb caps which require twisting, turning and sometimes wiggling to restrict the
airflow of a banger enough to do its job, these titanium carb caps have a slanted cap, making it
easy to use despite the nail’s angled bowl. Made of Grade 2 Titanium, this carb cap enhances the
flavor and vapor of low-temperature dabs by creating a partial vacuum over the nail, thanks to its
cleverly crafted sidecar air-intake hole. With the air-intake hole drilled at an angle, the titanium
carb cap creates a vortex that circulates airflow and insulates the nail, preventing pooling or
puddling of waxy concentrates.

An additional benefit of using a carb cap is that it helps to retain vapor that would have otherwise
been lost.

This two-in-one carb cap also doubles as a handy dab tool, making it easy for you to maneuvre your
dabs onto the nail. Choose between a round and flat head depending on the concentrates you use.

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.
